ambiguous.zh: 这里的措辞故意模棱两可。

ambiguous.en: This agreement is very ambiguous and open to various interpretations.
ambiguous.zh: 这个协议非常模棱两可，可以有多种解释。

ambitious.en: He is ambitious and susceptible to flattery.
ambitious.zh: 他雄心勃勃，而且很喜欢听恭维话。

ambitious.en: For socially ambitious couples this is a problem.
ambitious.zh: 对在社会地位方面有野心的夫妇来说，这是个问题。

ambitious.en: Chris is so ambitious, so determined to do it all.
ambitious.zh: 克里斯是如此雄心勃勃，如此坚决地要把它做完。

ambition.en: He was corrupted by power and ambition.
ambition.zh: 权力与野心使他腐化堕落。

ambition.zh: 即使当我年轻的时候我也从未有过什么雄心。

ambulance.zh: 他尖叫着，要妻子叫辆救护车来。

ambulance.zh: 救护车离开后人群便散了。

amend.en: To forestall is better than to amend.; Prevention is better than cure.
amend.zh: 与其补救于已然，不如防范于未然。

amend.zh: 议会可能会修正提议的征税法。

amends.en: He wanted to make amends for causing their marriage to fail.
amends.zh: 他想为一手造成他们婚姻的破裂做出补偿。

amends.en: She was sincere and genuine in her wish to make amends for the past.
amends.zh: 她诚恳而真心地希望弥补过去的错误。

amends.en: He was full of remorse and asked Beatrice what he could do to make amends.
amends.zh: 他悔恨不已，问比阿特丽斯他可以做点什么来弥补。

American.zh: 我不是美国人，我是加拿大人。

amongst.en: I found the letter amongst his papers.
amongst.zh: 我在他的文件中找到这封信。

amongst.en: Morale amongst the players is very high at the moment.

amongst.zh: 选民中出现日渐不满的迹象。

amount.en: The generous amount of garlic adds flavour.

amount.zh: 我必须现在全部付清吗？

ampere.en: Megavolt Ampere of transformation capacity achieved the target of 75,000 MVA.
ampere.zh: 新增变电能力完成了75000兆伏安的目标。

ampere.zh: 新增变电能力达79522兆伏安，超额完成了75000兆伏安的目标。

ampere.zh: 每一套装置应包括一个主开关和电流表，电流表的刻度范围约20安培。

among.zh: 死者中有两名美军士兵。

ample.en: There was ample time to get to the airport.
ample.zh: 有足够的时间到达机场。

ample.en: The driver had ample time to brake or swerve and avoid the woman.
ample.zh: 该司机有足够的时间刹车或急转来避让那女子。

amplify.en: This landscape seemed to trap and amplify sounds.
amplify.zh: 这种地形好像能聚拢和扩大声音。

amplify.en: Subjects are wearing headphones that amplify their heartbeat.
amplify.zh: 受试者正戴着放大他们心跳声的耳机。

analogy.en: The analogy between music and fragrance has stuck.
analogy.zh: 音乐与香味的类比已经深入人心了。

analogy.en: The teacher drew an analogy between the human heart and a pump.
analogy.zh: 老师打了个比喻，把人的心脏比作水泵。

amuse.en: She suggested several ideas to help Laura amuse the twins.
amuse.zh: 她给劳拉出了一些主意，好逗这对双胞胎开心。

amuse.en: I need distractions. I need to amuse myself so I won't keep thinking about things.
amuse.zh: 我需要娱乐。我需要自我消遣，这样我才不会一直想事情。

analyse.zh: 他试图分析自己的感情。

analyse.en: We need to analyse what went wrong.
analyse.zh: 我们需要分析是什么出了差错。

analyse.en: We haven't had time to analyse those samples yet.
analyse.zh: 我们还没有时间化验分析那些样本。

analysis.en: I agree with her analysis of the situation.
analysis.zh: 我赞成她对形势的分析。

analysis.en: The book is an analysis of poverty and its causes.
analysis.zh: 这本书分析了贫困及其原因。

analysis.en: You can ask for a chemical analysis of your tap water.
analysis.zh: 你可以要求给你的自来水做化学分析。

analytic.en: For one thing, excellent writing ability is beneficial to people's logical think and analytic ability.
analytic.zh: 一方面，优秀的写作能力有利于人们的逻辑思维和分析能力。

analytic.en: Linda, co-founder of Scores, a leading digital analytic company, established her organization on a simple premise.
analytic.zh: 领先的斯科尔数字分析公司的联合创始人琳达，在简易的前提下建立了自己的组织。
我还会有这样的分析能力吗？

analytical.zh: 他缺乏深度和分析的精确性。

analytical.en: I have an analytical approach to every survey.
analytical.zh: 我对每项调查都采用一种分析的方法。

ancestor.en: Her Chinese friends referred to the empress as their venerable ancestor.
ancestor.zh: 她的中国朋友们称那位皇后是令他们尊敬的祖先。

ancestor.en: Their ancestor is different from that of micro bats.
ancestor.zh: 它们的祖先与微型蝙蝠的祖先不同。

ancestor.en: My ancestor was a preacher, traveling around the countryside.
ancestor.zh: 我的祖先是一位游历于乡间的传教士。

anchor.en: The ship lay at anchor two miles off the rocky coast.
anchor.zh: 船在离岩岸两英里处抛锚停泊。

ancient.en: Lettuce was grown by the ancient Romans.
ancient.zh: 莴苣是由古罗马人种植的。

ancient.en: Tai Chi is an ancient form of self-defence.
ancient.zh: 太极拳是一种古老的自卫手段。

ancient.en: The town is notable for its ancient harbour.
ancient.zh: 这座小镇因其古老的港口而出名。

and.en: America and her partners are helping to rebuild roads and bridges and buildings.
and.zh: 美国及其伙伴正帮助重建道路、桥梁和楼房。

and.en: The room was dim and cool and quiet.
and.zh: 这房间昏暗、阴冷且安静。
她阴险、狡诈，而且爱操纵他人。

angel.en: The angel appeared unto him in a dream.
angel.zh: 在梦中天使出现在他面前。

angel.en: She could not see herself in the role of ministering angel.
angel.zh: 她想象不出自己成为一名救死扶伤的天使会是什么样。

angel.en: She played the part of an angel, complete with wings and a halo.
angel.zh: 她扮演天使，身上的双翼和头上的光轮一应俱全。

anger.zh: 他眼里冒着强压的怒火。
强压的怒火在他眼里燃烧。

angle.en: Her leg was bent at an unnatural angle.
angle.zh: 她的腿弯曲的角度反常。

angle.en: The photo was taken from an unusual angle.
angle.zh: 这张照片是从不寻常的角度拍摄的。

angle.en: The boat is now leaning at a 30 degree angle.
angle.zh: 这条船现在正以30度角倾斜着。

angry.zh: 他生气时间从来不会长。
罗伯塔感到又懊丧又生气。
这条消息引起了人们的愤怒。

animal.en: The animal is hunted for its fur.
animal.zh: 狩猎这种动物是为了获取其毛皮。
这只动物缩回到自己的壳里。

ankle.zh: 他跌了一跤，扭伤了脚踝。
他摔了一跤，扭伤了脚踝。

anniversary.zh: 今天是我们的结婚纪念日。
今天是我们的周年纪念日。

anniversary.en: We celebrated our 25th wedding anniversary in Florence.
anniversary.zh: 我们在佛罗伦萨庆祝结婚25周年。

announce.en: They will announce the result of the vote tonight.
announce.zh: 今晚他们将宣布投票结果。

announce.en: He used the occasion to announce further tax cuts.
announce.zh: 他利用这个机会宣布再次减税。

announce.en: She was planning to announce her engagement to Peter.
announce.zh: 她在计划宣布她与彼得的婚约。

announcer.zh: 我想知道你能否告诉我一些有关你作为电台播音员工作的情况。

annoy.zh: 如果其他人做得似乎不够努力，这会使你烦恼吗？

annual.en: How much annual leave do you get?

anonymous.en: You can remain anonymous if you wish.
anonymous.zh: 如果你愿意你可以保持匿名。
捐赠者希望不披露姓名。

anonymous.zh: 有人匿名举报后，那个人被抓了起来。

another.zh: 时间是另一个需要考虑的重要因素。

ant.en: From the very beginning, Stuart Leslie Goddard, a.k.a. Adam Ant, knew he was going to be a star.
ant.zh: 从一开始，斯图尔特·莱斯利·戈达德，又叫蚂蚁亚当，就知道他将会成为明星。

ant.en: Have you ever stepped on an ant?

antarctic.zh: 南极周围的原始水域将永远消失。

antarctic.zh: 这些发现成果的出现正值人们对南极洲的未来日益担忧之际。

antarctic.zh: 在俄罗斯的帮助下，白俄罗斯正准备建立第一个南极基地。

answer.zh: 他没有能回答那个问题。

anticipate.en: We anticipate that sales will rise next year.
anticipate.zh: 我们预料明年销售量将会增加。

anticipate.zh: 他们预期年底前迁入较大的经营场址。

anticipate.en: Try to anticipate what your child will do and forestall problems.
anticipate.zh: 尽量预见你的孩子会干什么，并预先阻止问题发生。

antique.en: This isn't a genuine antique—you've been done.
antique.zh: 这不是真正的古董—你上当了。

antique.zh: 他们在设法把那张普通桌子当真正的古董推销出去。

anxiety.zh: 睡眠不足可能导致焦虑。

anxious.zh: 他急于维护自己的名声。

anyhow.zh: “无论如何”，她干脆利索地加了一句：“这不关我的事。”

任何人都能欣赏我们的音乐。

anyway.zh: 不管怎么说，他懂什么足球？

anyway.zh: “不管怎样，她很快会回来。”他最后说道。

apart.zh: 除足球外我喜欢所有的运动。

apparatus.zh: 其中的一个男孩得由戴着呼吸设备的消防队员们营救。

apparatus.zh: 他们缺少进一步研发这些技术设备的科技人员。

apparatus.zh: 他们设计了一种将婴儿的奶嘴与计数装置连接起来的装置。

apparent.zh: 她接到这消息时显然无动于衷。

appear.en: Cracks began to appear in the walls.

appendix.zh: 我们不能确定阑尾破了没有。

appendix.zh: 这本书还包含一个列有所有美国总统的附录。

appetite.zh: 所有的水獭都有一个贪吃的胃口。

applaud.zh: 他开始鼓掌，其他人也跟着鼓起掌来。

applaud.zh: 分析家们赞同对边际业务的削减，但坚持认为公司必须作出更大牺牲。

appliance.en: Before you buy a new appliance, talk to someone who owns one.
appliance.zh: 购买新电器之前，先和有这个电器的人谈谈。

appliance.zh: 当人们发现电器坏了，通常就不会再去使用它了。

appliance.zh: 如果你的电器坏了，那就给出售它的商店写封信。

applicable.zh: 对一个家庭合理的标准对于另一个家庭并不适用。

applicable.zh: 另一个缺点是它不适用于一些像运动员和健美运动员这样的肌肉发达的人，他们也可以有人为造成的身体质量指数偏高的情况。

applicable.zh: Keyssar 考察了1870-1920年这段时期，重点研究了马萨诸塞州，那里的历史资料特别丰富，研究结果也适用于其他工业区。

application.en: My application got lost in the post.

application.zh: 你把申请书寄去了没有？

apply.zh: 他们可能申请加入该组织。

appoint.en: It made sense to appoint a banker to this job.
appoint.zh: 任命一位银行家做这项工作是合理的。

appoint.en: He promised to appoint an AIDS czar to deal with the disease.
appoint.zh: 他承诺任命一位艾滋病特使来对付这种疾病。

appoint.zh: 经过适当考虑，我们决定委任戴维斯先生干这项工作。

appraisal.en: She was honest in her appraisal of her team's chances.
appraisal.zh: 她对自己队获胜机会的估计是诚实的。

appraisal.zh: 可能还需要对该房产做个新的估价。

appraisal.zh: 在此类情况下需要的是对形势的冷静估计。

appreciable.en: The new regulations will not make an appreciable difference to most people.
appreciable.zh: 新的规定对大多数人将无大影响。

appreciable.zh: 在过去的一周，两国关系发生了相当大的转变。

appreciable.zh: 她有没有试图对他施以影响，从而改变历史呢？

apprehension.zh: 这反映出对未来真正的愤怒和忧虑。

apprehension.zh: 他对钟摆附录的全面理解是显而易见的。

apprehension.zh: 缓慢的日子一天天过去，每过去一天，心头的忧虑就稍稍减轻一点。

approach.zh: 我对每项调查都采用一种分析的方法。

approach.zh: 这种方法有一定的新意。

approach.zh: 他采取了一种非常科学的管理方法。

approve.zh: 我不赞成任何形式的暴力行为。

approximately.zh: 大约晚上11:30的时候，波拉德终于对搜查予以同意。

approximate.zh: 大致的费用在$150至$250之间不等。

approximate.zh: 下面所描述的混合物会与之近似，但不完全一样。

apt.en: The words of this report are as apt today as in 1929.
apt.zh: 这份报告的措词在当今如在1929年一样恰当。

apt.zh: 婴儿爱把东西往嘴里塞。

apt.zh: 她常常提高嗓门并挥舞双手。

attorney.zh: 新上任的地方检察官承诺要与司法腐败作斗争。

attorney.zh: 律师可以出示证据，也可以提请证人作证。

attract.en: She tried to attract the waiter's attention.
attract.zh: 她试图引起服务员的注意。

attract.zh: 她轻轻地咳了一声以引起我的注意。

attraction.en: The main attraction at Giverny is Monet's garden.
attraction.zh: 吉维尼主要的景点是莫奈花园。

attraction.zh: 摄影术的吸引力部分在于它那些小装置和机械玩意儿。

attraction.zh: 她是这个节目中耀眼的明星。

attribute.zh: 每个级别都应该有一个标题属性。

attribute.en: People were beginning to attribute superhuman qualities to him.
attribute.zh: 人们开始赋予他超人的品质。

attribute.zh: 如果没有进一步的情况，委员会拒绝归罪于任何人。

August.zh: 在八月份，这个地方挤满游人。

August.zh: 这位选手签约参加比赛到八月份。

augment.en: While searching for a way to augment the family income, she began making dolls.
augment.zh: 为求增加家庭收入，她开始做起了玩具娃娃。

augment.zh: 政府首要关注的是扩充军队与后备军。

augment.zh: 换句话说，我们需要研究机器如何辅助人类劳动，而不是研究其如何取代它。

audience.zh: 观众又是喝彩又是鼓掌。

aunt.en: He was brought up by his aunt.

aunt.zh: 埃米莉阿姨把旧袜子补好了。

aural.en: He became famous as an inventor of astonishing visual and aural effects.
aural.zh: 他因创造了令人震撼的视听效果而出名。

aural.zh: 七个层次练习是为了改善这些孩子的听觉语音接收能力。

aural.en: He used tapes as aural material to teach English.
aural.zh: 他用磁带作为听觉教材来教英语。

Australian.zh: 她说话带有浓重的澳大利亚口音。

Australian.zh: 澳大利亚队将乘坐商务舱。

Australian.zh: 她生于意大利，但现在是澳大利亚公民。

authentic.en: She has authentic charm whereas most people simply have nice manners.
authentic.zh: 她有真正的魅力，而大多数人只是有礼貌而已。

authentic.en: Authentic Italian cooking is very healthy—witness the low incidence of heart disease in Italy.
authentic.zh: 正宗的意大利烹饪对健康非常有益，在意大利心脏病发病率低就是证据。

authentic.en: I don't know if the painting is authentic.
authentic.zh: 我不知道这幅画是不是真迹。

author.en: He became an author late in life.

author.zh: 作者是位经验丰富的大学教师。

authoritative.en: He has a commanding presence and deep, authoritative voice.
authoritative.zh: 他仪态威严，声音深沉而有权威。

authoritative.en: The first authoritative study of polio was published in 1840.
authoritative.zh: 关于小儿麻痹症的首篇权威研究报告发表于1840年。

authoritative.zh: 阿曼达开始了一番对合同的权威解释。

authority.en: Her speech carried the ring of authority.
authority.zh: 她的讲话带着权威的口吻。

authorize.en: Only the president could authorize the use of the atomic bomb.
authorize.zh: 只有总统能授权原子弹的使用。

authorize.en: It would certainly be within his power to authorize a police raid like that.
authorize.zh: 他肯定有权批准那种警方突袭行动。

authorize.en: The Wilderness Society lobbied Congress to authorize the Endangered Species Act.
authorize.zh: 荒野协会游说国会批准《濒危物种法》。

auto.en: The Auto Pact yoked Ontario into the United States economy.
auto.zh: 《汽车协定》强行将安大略纳入了美国经济体。

auto.zh: 过去的10年来汽车盗窃案上升了56％以上。

auto.en: Other authorities, however, think the auto is here to stay.
auto.zh: 然而，其他权威人士认为，汽车将继续存在。

automatic.zh: 她把照相机调到自动状态。

automation.en: Automation meant the loss of many factory jobs.
automation.zh: 自动化意味着许多工厂工人失业。

automation.en: In the last ten years automation has reduced the work force here by half.
automation.zh: 在过去的10年中，自动化已经减少了这里一半的劳动力。

automation.en: Administrative staff may be deskilled through increased automation and efficiency.
automation.zh: 随着自动化程度和效率提高，行政人员可能不再需要专业技能。

automobile.en: Thanks to the automobile, Americans soon had a freedom of movement previously unknown.
automobile.zh: 由于有了汽车，美国人很快就获得了前所未有的行动自由。

automobile.en: The parts of an automobile are standardized.
automobile.zh: 汽车零件是标准化了的。

automobile.en: Automobile accidents maim many people each year.
automobile.zh: 汽车车祸每年使许多人残废。

autumn.zh: 秋季是我最喜欢的季节。

autumn.en: I love the reds and golds of autumn.
autumn.zh: 我喜欢秋天的火红色和金黄色。

autonomy.en: She sets a high value on autonomy.
The six fractious republics are demanding autonomy.
autonomy.zh: 这六个不安分的加盟共和国要求自治。

autonomy.en: Each of the area managers enjoys considerable autonomy in the running of his own area.
autonomy.zh: 每一位地区经理在各自主管的区域都享有相当大的自主权。

avail.en: The doctors tried everything to keep him alive but to no avail.
avail.zh: 医生千方百计想使他活下来，但无济于事。

avail.en: Your ability to argue is of little avail if the facts are wrong.
avail.zh: 如果论据是错的，你的辩才也就没有什么用了。

auxiliary.en: Esperanto was invented as an auxiliary language.
auxiliary.zh: 世界语是作为辅助语发明的。

auxiliary.en: Esperanto is an artificial language, designed to serve internationally as an auxiliary means of communication among speakers of different languages.
auxiliary.zh: 世界语是一种人造语言，目的是充当国际上不同语言使用者之间交流的辅助手段。

auxiliary.en: The government's first concern was to augment the army and auxiliary forces.
auxiliary.zh: 政府首要关注的是扩充军队与后备军。

avenue.en: He walked up Fifth Avenue to clear his head.
avenue.zh: 他在第五大街上走，让头脑清醒清醒。

avenue.en: Lily lives in a penthouse just off Park Avenue.
avenue.zh: 莉莉住在离公园大街不远的一处顶层公寓里。

avenue.zh: 伯格多夫·古德曼在第五大道上开了一家男装店。

available.zh: 所有的方案现在均可选择。
植物能从任何可获得的空间中迅速生长。

avert.en: He did his best to avert suspicion.
The aim of the current round of talks is to promote free trade and to avert the threat of increasing protectionism.
avert.zh: 本轮会谈的目的是促进自由贸易，消除日益加剧的贸易保护主义的威胁。

avert.en: They discovered the danger in time, and made shift to avert it.
avert.zh: 他们及时发现了危险，并设法避免了。

aviation.en: The man had genius and had made his mark in the aviation world.
aviation.zh: 那位男士拥有天赋，而且在航空界已经成名。

aviation.en: The civil aviation minister ordered all the planes to be grounded.
aviation.zh: 该民航部长命令所有飞机不得起飞。

aviation.en: The airline's biggest headache is the increase in the price of aviation fuel.
aviation.zh: 令航空公司最头疼的问题是航空燃料价格的上涨。

await.en: We eagerly await the sound of the engines.
await.zh: 我们急切等待引擎声的声音。

await.en: We await your decision.; We are expecting you to make a decision.

avoid.en: We have tried to avoid any moralizing.
avoid.zh: 我们已力图避免任何形式的说教。

avoid.en: They avoid going out alone after dark.
avoid.zh: 他们避免黄昏后独自出门。

avoid.en: He tends to avoid all physical contact.
avoid.zh: 他倾向于避免一切身体接触。

aware.en: She is aware of her own failings.
He was well aware of the problem.
We are fully aware of the dangers.

awake.en: Suddenly he found himself awake and fully alert.
awake.zh: 突然他发觉自己醒了过来，而且高度警觉。
我瞌睡得再也熬不住了。

award.en: He was nominated for the best actor award.
award.zh: 他获得最佳演员奖提名。

award.en: He deservedly won the player of the year award.
award.zh: 他理所应当地赢得了年度最佳球员奖。

awfully.zh: 这是一个非常好的故事。

awful.zh: 可怕的事实慢慢地清晰起来。

awkward.zh: 艾米用双手做了一个笨拙的手势。

axis.zh: 地球环绕自身的轴心转动。

axis.en: Precession, basically is the change in the direction of earth's axis of rotation.
axis.zh: 岁差，基本上是地球自转轴方向的改变。

bachelor.zh: 他是日本最令人中意的单身汉。

bachelor.zh: 他是这个城市里的黄金单身汉。

bachelor.en: Believe it or not, he is still a bachelor.

background.en: In the background was that eternal hum.
background.zh: 背景里是那没完没了的哼哼声。

bacteria.zh: 温牛奶是细菌理想的繁殖地。

backward.en: The diver flipped over backward into the water.
backward.zh: 跳水运动员向后翻转跳入水中。

backward.zh: 他打开2号公寓的门锁，向后瞥了拉里一眼之后走进去就不见了。

backward.zh: 她正在人行道上向后走。

badminton.zh: 打羽毛球的时候，我把跟腱撕裂了。

badminton.zh: 试试网球、羽毛球或帆板运动。简而言之，任何有挑战性的东西。

baffle.zh: 有时候作出的决定使我困惑甚至愤怒。

baffle.zh: 骗子想骗取他的钱，可是没成功。

baggage.zh: 所有出口必须保持通畅，不得堆放行李。

baggage.zh: 火是从行李舱着起来的。

bake.zh: 把糕饼烤至外皮呈金黄色。

bald.en: The sun beat down on his bald pate.

balance.zh: 运动员要有良好的平衡感。

balance.zh: 他失去了平衡，往后跌倒了。

balloon.zh: 她用叉子把气球砰的一声戳爆了。

banana.zh: 这些公司决定对香蕉业进行压制。

banana.zh: 这个香蕉来自于一棵苹果树。

ban.zh: 他们要求彻底禁止拥有手枪。

ban.zh: 化学武器已被禁止使用。

ban.zh: 加拿大将于今年晚些时候禁止在所有办公场所吸烟。

这个乐队正在重新合成一些曲目。

bandage.zh: 我们在他的膝盖上涂了些药膏，还缠了一条绷带。

bandage.zh: 水疱破口后必须包扎上绷带。

bankrupt.zh: 照此情形，我们很快就会破产。

bank.zh: 不凑巧，银行现在不营业。

banner.zh: 当我们被挤向相反的方向的时候，我感到横幅撕裂了。

banner.zh: 他用白板笔在海报大小的横幅上写了七个数字。

banner.zh: 爱国志士们打出了自由的旗帜。

barber.zh: 爸爸把我拽到当地理发师奥托跟前，让他把我的头发剪短。

bare.zh: 河谷上面的山是光秃秃的岩石。

bar.en: At the bar he ordered a cider.
bar.zh: 他在酒吧点了一杯苹果汁。

bargain.zh: 他和当局达成了辩诉交易。

bargain.en: She has an eye for a bargain.

bark.zh: 我把原木放在地上，然后刨掉树皮。

barn.zh: 他有意朝谷仓大步走去。

barn.zh: 1979年，作为折扣酒品专卖店的立可仓生意兴隆。

barrel.en: They came and rolled the barrel towards the water.

barren.en: He wants to use the water to irrigate barren desert land.
barren.zh: 他想用该水来灌溉贫瘠的沙漠土地。

barren.en: That's probably the most bare, bleak, barren and inhospitable island I've ever seen.
barren.zh: 那可能是我见过的最光秃、最荒凉、最贫瘠和最不适合居住的岛屿。

barrier.zh: 我认识到我必须得克服语言障碍。

barrier.zh: 长江是东北方向的一道天然屏障。

barrier.zh: 臭氧是地球防止紫外线辐射的屏障。

base.en: He didn't make it past first base.

basement.en: Kitchen goods are sold in the basement.
basement.zh: 厨房用具在地下室出售。

basement.zh: 我的办公室在地下室的一间小屋里。

basement.en: The basement hallway is painted a warm yellow.
basement.zh: 地下室的走廊被涂成暖色调的黄色。

basically.en: People are basically the same the world over.
basically.zh: 世界各地的人基本上都一样。

basic.zh: 鼓是非洲音乐的基本乐器。

basic.en: Water is a basic necessity of life.
basic.zh: 水是一种基本生活必需品。

basic.zh: 享有公正是一种基本权利。

basin.zh: 水滴入房间后面的一个盆里。

basin.zh: 我们得到了一盆水洗手。

basin.zh: 他洗漱完后开始把水盆擦干净。

basis.zh: 美满婚姻的基础是信赖。

basis.zh: 教育是民主社会的基础。

basket.zh: 我们房间里有一篮免费赠送的水果。

basket.zh: 他看见那条狗颤搐的鼻子从篮子里露出来。

basket.zh: 美元对其最大贸易伙伴们的一篮子货币今年贬值了6.5%。

batch.en: She brought a large batch of newspaper clippings.

batch.zh: 每年夏天都有一批新的学生要找工作。

bat.en: I bolted the door the instant I saw the bat.
bat.zh: 我一看到那只蝙蝠就把门闩上了。

bat.en: In Chinese folklore the bat is a symbol of good fortune.
bat.zh: 在中国民间传说中，蝙蝠是好运的象征。

bat.zh: 如果你是棒球队球童，那么你就要为棒球队员拿球棒。

bath.zh: 助产士给他洗了个温水澡。

bath.zh: 他冲洗了浴缸，然后放满了一缸水。

bathe.zh: 警方已经警告本市居民不要在那条被污染的河里游泳。

bathe.zh: 慢慢地，人们开始更频繁地洗澡。

They refused to comply with the UN resolution.
comply.zh: 他们拒绝遵守联合国的决议。

comply.en: Some beaches had failed to comply with environmental regulations.
comply.zh: 一些海滩没能遵守环保规定。

component.zh: 态度隐含着行为性的成分。
最后，态度具有行为上的成分。

component.en: That said, curiosity does have a genetic component.
component.zh: 这就是说，好奇心确实有基因成分。

compose.en: Protein molecules compose all the complex working parts of living cells.
compose.zh: 蛋白质分子构成了活细胞所有复杂的工作部件。

compose.en: He started at once to compose a reply to Anna.
compose.zh: 他立刻开始给安娜写回信。

composite.en: Spain is a composite of multifarious traditions and people.
composite.zh: 西班牙是多种传统和多个民族的合成体。

composite.en: The document was a composite of information from various sources.
composite.zh: 这份文件是不同来源信息的综合。

composite.en: Galton devised a method of creating composite pictures in which the features of different faces were superimposed over one another.
composite.zh: 高尔顿发明了一种将不同脸的部位相互叠加而创作合成图片的方法。

comprehension.zh: 这完全超出了她的理解力。

comprehension.en: Is this test a good measure of reading comprehension?
comprehension.zh: 这种测试是判断阅读理解力的好方法吗？

comprehension.en: Your reading speed and comprehension are tested during this exercise.
comprehension.zh: 你的阅读速度和理解能力将在这个练习中得到测试。

compound.en: Common salt is a compound of sodium and chlorine.
compound.zh: 普通食盐是钠和氯的化合物。

compound.en: A compound sentence contains two or more clauses.
compound.zh: 复合句包含两个或多个从句。

compound.en: Honey is basically a compound of water, two types of sugar, vitamins and enzymes.
compound.zh: 蜂蜜主要是水、两种糖、维生素和酶的混合物。

composition.en: We had to write a composition on the subject "My Pet."
composition.zh: 我们得就“我的宠物”这个主题写一篇作文。

composition.en: Television has transformed the size and social composition of the audience at great sporting occasions.
composition.zh: 电视改变了大型体育赛事观众的数量及其社会构成。

composition.en: Extracting information about the large-scale composition of a planet from a sample weighing a millionth of a gram was a fascinating example of scientific endeavour.
composition.zh: 从重量为百万分之一克的样品中提取有关行星宏观组成的信息是一个极为有趣的科学尝试实例。

comprehensive.en: Streaming within comprehensive schools is common practice.
comprehensive.zh: 综合中学常把学生按能力分班。

comprehensive.en: The idea was to create a comprehensive road map of the Web.
comprehensive.zh: 这个想法原是为万维网做一个综合指南。

comprehensive.en: The Rough Guide to Nepal is a comprehensive guide to the region.
comprehensive.zh: 《尼泊尔概览》是介绍该地区的一本全面指南。

compress.en: This system uses powerful microchips to compress huge amounts of data onto a CD-ROM.
compress.zh: 这一系统使用功能强大的微芯片来把大量数据压缩到CD-ROM上。

compress.en: The bin can also compress the waste so it will take up less space.
compress.zh: 垃圾桶还可以压缩垃圾，这样就会占用更少的空间。

compress.en: The sheep, horses, goats and pigs brought by Europeans, however, have hard hooves, which compress the thin soil and cause erosion.
compress.zh: 然而，欧洲人带来的绵羊、马、山羊和猪却有着坚硬的蹄子，这压紧了稀薄的土壤并导致了水土流失。

compulsory.en: There is a compulsory course in statistics.
compulsory.zh: 有一门统计学的必修课。

compulsory.en: Certain courses are compulsory, others are optional.
compulsory.zh: 某些课程是必修的，其他是选修的。

compulsory.en: It is compulsory for all motorcyclists to wear helmets.
compulsory.zh: 所有骑摩托车的人都必须戴头盔，这是强制性的。

comprise.en: Older people comprise a large proportion of those living in poverty.
comprise.zh: 在那些生活贫困的人中，老年人占有很大的比例。

comprise.en: People with disabilities comprise a large part of the population.
comprise.zh: 残疾人占人口的很大一部分。

comprise.en: These finds, together with later finds, comprise all that experts know about Minoan culture.
comprise.zh: 这些发现，连同之后的发现，是专家对米诺斯文化的全部了解。

compromise.zh: 我拒绝在原则问题上妥协。

compromise.en: Compromise is an inevitable part of life.
compromise.zh: 妥协是生活不可避免的一部分。

compute.en: At the top of the list is the notion that intelligence is measured by your ability to solve complex problems; to read, write and compute at certain levels; and to resolve abstract equations quickly.
compute.zh: 最重要的一点是，智力是通过你解决复杂问题的能力来衡量的；一定的读写和计算能力；能快速解出抽象方程。

compute.en: The Six Sigma Black Belt should be able to compute the mean and standard deviation from a grouped frequency distribution.
compute.zh: 六西格玛黑带应该能够计算出一个分组发生频次分布数据的均值和标准偏差。

comrade.en: Better be careful of your bookish approach, comrade.
Most of the goats ran away from their rough comrade.
comrade.zh: 大多数山羊都从它们粗暴的伙伴身边跑开了。

comrade.en: We can't remain indifferent when any comrade is in difficulty.
comrade.zh: 同志们有困难我们不能不闻不问。

conceal.zh: 蒂姆几乎掩饰不住自己的失望。

conceal.en: If only he could conceal his part in the accident.
conceal.zh: 如果他能掩盖他在那次事故中有份参与就好了。

conceal.en: He didn't attempt to dissimulate or conceal his true feelings.
conceal.zh: 他没有尝试着掩饰或隐瞒自己的感受。

conceive.en: Women, he says, should give up alcohol before they plan to conceive.
conceive.zh: 他说女人在计划怀孕前应该戒酒。

conceive.en: It is impossible to conceive of a self arising outside of social experience.
conceive.zh: 我们不可能设想一个在社会经验之外产生的自我。（自我和社会是密不可分的。）

concede.en: I had to concede the logic of this.
concede.zh: 我得承认这件事情有它的逻辑。

concede.en: He was forced to concede (that) there might be difficulties.
concede.zh: 他被迫承认可能有困难。

concede.en: After losing this decisive battle, the general was forced to concede.
concede.zh: 输掉了这场决定性的战役后，那位将军不得不承认失败。

concentrate.en: At work you need to be able to concentrate.
We need to concentrate on our core business.
concentrate.zh: 我们需要集中在核心业务上。

concentrate.en: I am leaving to concentrate on writing fiction.
concentrate.zh: 我要离开去专心写小说。

concentration.zh: 疲劳影响注意力的集中。

conception.en: My conception of a garden was based on gardens I had visited in England.
conception.zh: 我对花园的概念是基于我在英格兰参观过的一些花园的。

conception.en: The plan was brilliant in its conception but failed because of lack of money.
conception.zh: 尽管这计划构想绝妙，但终因资金不足而告流产。
整个概念在科学上是不准确的。

concept.en: Ten years on, the original concept was wearing well.
concept.zh: 十年过去，最初的观念依然适用。

concept.en: The concept of saturation marketing makes perfect sense.
concept.zh: 饱和营销的概念很有道理。

concept.en: It's not a question of some abstract concept of justice.
concept.zh: 这不是一个有关正义的某一抽象概念的问题。

concerning.en: He asked several questions concerning the future of the company.
concerning.zh: 他问了几个有关公司前途的问题。

concerning.en: All cases concerning children are dealt with in a special children's court.
concerning.zh: 所有涉及儿童的案件均由儿童特别法庭审理。

concerning.en: His work is full of profundities and asides concerning the human condition.
concerning.zh: 他的作品充满了有关人类境况的深邃见解和话外音。

concert.zh: 他们在那儿的音乐会座无虚席。

concert.en: The concert had been a great success.

concession.en: He was ready to make a concession.
She made no concession to his age; she expected him to work as hard as she did.
concession.zh: 她丝毫也不体谅他的年龄，要求他干得像她一样卖力。

concession.en: Finish the following sentence with an adverbial clause of concession.
concession.zh: 用让步状语从句完成下列句子。

concise.zh: 伯顿的文章文字简洁、内容丰富。

concise.en: Good science also requires contextual understanding, clear explanation and concise presentation.
concise.zh: 好的科学也需要对语境的理解、清晰的解释和简洁的表达。

concise.en: But good science also requires contextual understanding, clear explanation and concise presentation.
concise.zh: 但是好的科学也需要对上下文的理解，清晰的解释和简洁的表达。

conclude.zh: 你从这件事中得出了什么结论？

conclude.en: So what can we conclude from this debate?
conclude.zh: 那么从这场辩论中我们能推断出什么呢？

conclude.en: The competitors cantered into the arena to conclude the closing ceremony.
conclude.zh: 赛手们慢跑进入比赛场地，结束了闭幕式。

conclusion.zh: 你是如何得出这个结论的？
很少有人会不同意这个结论。
法官的结论显然是错误的。

concrete.zh: 我们坐在混凝土地板上。
我当时没有明确而具体的证据。

condense.en: When you summarize, you condense an extended idea or argument into a sentence or more in your own words.
condense.zh: 总结的时候，用自己的话把拓展了的观念或论据简缩成一句或几句话。

condense.en: If some reefs are destroyed by storms, starfish populations that inhabited those reefs would have to condense and concentrate on the reefs that are left.
condense.zh: 如果一些珊瑚礁被风暴摧毁了，居住在那些珊瑚礁上的海星种群将不得不集中在剩下的珊瑚礁上。

condense.en: The arch-fiend whispered him to condense into a small compass.
condense.zh: 大恶魔低声说他凝结成一个小指南针。

condemn.en: The Church has a duty to condemn violence.
condemn.zh: 基督教会有义务谴责暴力。

condemn.en: Like everyone else, I deplore and condemn this killing.
condemn.zh: 我同所有人一样强烈谴责这桩凶杀案。

condemn.en: Political leaders united yesterday to condemn the latest wave of violence.
condemn.zh: 政治领袖们昨天联合谴责最近发生的一波暴力事件。

conduct.zh: 他因为不符合运动员道德的行为被驱逐。

conduct.en: The sport has a strict code of conduct.
conduct.zh: 体育运动有严格的行为规范。
警察会随机进行吹气酒精测试。

condition.zh: 他的健康状况一天天好转。

confer.en: He wanted to confer with his colleagues before reaching a decision.
confer.zh: 他想与他的同事先商议一下再作出决定。

confer.en: I will now confer a benefit on him.
As any geriatric ward shows, that is not the same as to confer enduring mobility, awareness and autonomy.
confer.zh: 正如任何老年病房所显示的那样，这与赋予病人持久的行动、意识和自主权是不一样的。

conductor.en: The conductor beat time with a baton.
Graphite is a highly efficient conductor of electricity.
conductor.zh: 石墨是一种高效的电导体。

conductor.en: Under its new conductor, the orchestra has established an international reputation.
conductor.zh: 在新指挥的领导下，这个乐团建立了国际声誉。

conference.en: The conference will be held in Glasgow.
conference.zh: 会议将在格拉斯哥举行。

conference.en: Such threats could scuttle the peace conference.
conference.zh: 这样的威胁可能会破坏和平会议。

confident.zh: 玛丽娜是个自信、快乐的孩子。

confident.en: She was in a relaxed, confident mood.
He feels more confident on home turf.
confident.zh: 他在主场感到更有信心。

confess.en: We persuaded her to confess her crime.
confess.zh: 我们说服她坦白她的罪行。

confess.en: She was reluctant to confess her ignorance.
confess.zh: 她不愿意承认自己无知。

confess.en: "I confess to being a big wuss," she admitted.
confess.zh: “我承认我是个胆小鬼。”她实话实说。

confidential.en: My letter is, of course, strictly private and confidential.
confidential.zh: 当然，我的信纯属私人信件，务须保密。

confidential.en: The deliberations of the committee are completely confidential.
confidential.zh: 委员会的审议过程是绝对保密的。

confidential.en: From time to time he passed on confidential information to him.
confidential.zh: 他不时地传送机密情报给他。

configuration.en: Prices range from $119 to $199, depending on the particular configuration.
configuration.zh: 价格根据配置的不同从119美元到199美元不等。

configuration.en: The precise configuration of a heat island depends on several factors.
configuration.zh: 热岛的精确结构取决于几个因素。

configuration.en: If this is the initial configuration, the server should not be running.
configuration.zh: 如果这是初始配置，则服务器不应该在运行。

confine.en: He did not confine himself to the one language.
confine.zh: 他没把自己局限于这一门语言。

confine.en: I will confine myself to looking at the period from 1900 to 1916.
confine.zh: 我将把自己考察的范围限定在1900年至1916年这段时间以内。

confine.en: Confine the use of insecticides to the evening and do not spray plants that are in flower.
confine.zh: 只限晚间使用杀虫剂，并且不要对花期植物喷药。

confirm.zh: 你能证实一下发生了什么事吗？

confirm.en: Can you write and confirm your booking?
confirm.zh: 你能写信来确认你的预订项目吗？

confirm.en: A brief dip into history serves to confirm this view.
confirm.zh: 随便翻阅一下历史就足以证实这种观点。

conflict.zh: 这些结果与早期的发现相矛盾。

conflict.en: John often comes into conflict with his boss.
conflict.zh: 约翰经常和他的老板发生争执。

conform.en: The building does not conform with safety regulations.
conform.zh: 这座建筑物不符合安全条例。

conform.en: The lamp has been designed to conform to new safety standards.
conform.zh: 该灯设计得符合新的安全标准。

conform.en: This mark signifies that the products conform to an approved standard.
conform.zh: 这个标志说明这些产品符合指定的标准。

confront.en: Once again, I chose to confront the issue head-on.
confront.zh: 又一次，我选择了直面这个问题。
我们必须乐观地面对未来。

confuse.en: I always confuse my left with my right.

confuse.zh: 不要把自由与放纵混为一谈。

confuse.en: People often confuse me and my twin sister.
confuse.zh: 人们常常把我和我的孪生妹妹搞错。

congratulation.en: She flashed him a false smile of congratulation.
congratulation.zh: 她向他虚情假意地微微一笑表示祝贺。

congratulation.en: We have received many letters of congratulation.
congratulation.zh: 我们收到了许多祝贺信。

confusion.zh: 曼迪的主导情绪是困惑。

confusion.en: Teddy turned to Mona with a look of mild confusion.
confusion.zh: 特迪转向莫娜，脸上带着些许困惑。

confusion.en: There followed a long period of confusion and muddle.
confusion.zh: 接下来是很长一段时间的困惑和混乱。

congress.zh: 国会因意见分歧而陷入僵局。

congress.en: Congress scores low in public opinion polls.
congress.zh: 国会在民意测验中得分很低。

congress.en: Congress will vote on the proposals tomorrow.
congress.zh: 国会明天将对提案进行投票表决。

congratulate.en: I congratulate all of you on this achievement.
congratulate.zh: 我祝贺你们的这一成就。

congratulate.en: I should congratulate you that you resisted the temptation.
congratulate.zh: 我应向你祝贺，你抗住了这种引诱。

conjunction.en: Textbooks are designed to be used in conjunction with classroom teaching.
conjunction.zh: 教科书被设计成与课堂教学配合使用。

conjunction.en: The system is designed to be used in conjunction with a word processing program.
conjunction.zh: 本系统是为与文字处理软件配合使用而设计的。

conquer.en: The only way to conquer a fear is to face it.
conquer.zh: 克服恐惧的唯一方法是正视恐惧。

conquer.en: The band is now setting out to conquer the world.
conquer.zh: 这支乐队现在要去征服世界。
你不能征服珠穆朗玛峰。

connection.en: I felt a strong connection between us.
connection.zh: 我感觉到了我们之间的强烈关系。

connection.en: I'm having problems with my Internet connection.
connection.zh: 我的互联网连接有问题。

connection.en: My flight was late and I missed the connection.
connection.zh: 我乘坐的航班晚点了，因此我错过了联运航班。

connect.zh: 点击 Continue 连接到互联网。

connect.en: You can connect the speakers to your CD player.
connect.zh: 你可以将这些扬声器与你的激光唱机连接起来。

connect.en: The canal was built to connect Sheffield with the Humber estuary.
connect.zh: 修建这条运河是为了将设菲尔德和亨伯河河口连接起来。

conquest.en: The chase is always much more exciting than the conquest anyway.
conquest.zh: 无论如何，追求总比征服更令人兴奋。

conquest.en: The play is being widely read as an allegory of imperialist conquest.
conquest.zh: 这出戏正被广泛地诠释为帝国主义征服的寓言。

conquest.en: The invasion is known as the Norman Conquest, and it is very important for two reasons.
conquest.zh: 这次入侵被称为诺曼征服，它很重要，原因有二。

conscientious.en: We are generally very conscientious about our work.
conscientious.zh: 我们一般对工作都是很认真的。
中央电视台的记者很有责任心。

conscientious.en: She is very conscientious and never skimps her work.
conscientious.zh: 她办事认真，从不敷衍了事。

conscience.en: He won't let it trouble his conscience.
conscience.zh: 他不会让这件事搞得自己良心不安。

conscience.en: He lay awake, scourged by his conscience.
conscience.zh: 他备受良心的折磨，不能入睡。

conscience.en: The crime lay heavy on her conscience.
conscience.zh: 那件罪行使她内疚不安。

conscious.en: She's very conscious of the problems involved.
conscious.zh: 她完全意识到了所涉及的问题。

conscious.en: He was conscious of a clock ticking.
conscious.zh: 他意识到了时间正在消逝。

consciousness.en: She banged her head and lost consciousness.
It took her a few minutes to recover consciousness.
consciousness.zh: 过了几分钟她才恢复知觉。

consciousness.en: I can't remember any more—I must have lost consciousness.
consciousness.zh: 我想不起来了—我当时一定是失去了知觉。

consecutive.en: The Cup was won for the third consecutive year by the Toronto Maple Leafs.
consecutive.zh: 这个奖杯连续第三年由多伦多枫叶队赢去了。

consecutive.en: The manufacturing economy contracted in October for the sixth consecutive month.
consecutive.zh: 制造业经济到10月份已连续萎缩6个月了。

consecutive.en: In Ontario, August was the first month with below-normal temperatures after eight consecutive months above normal.
consecutive.zh: 在安大略省，8月份是连续8个月高于正常温度之后的第一个低于正常温度的月份。

consensus.en: There is a growing consensus of opinion on this issue.
consensus.zh: 对这个问题的看法日趋一致。

consensus.en: There is a general consensus among teachers about the need for greater security in schools.
consensus.zh: 教师们对必须加强学校的保安有普遍的共识。

consensus.en: The consensus among the world's scientists is that the world is likely to warm up over the next few decades.
consensus.zh: 全世界科学家的共识是地球可能在未来几十年中变暖。

consent.en: Silence must not always be read as consent.
consent.zh: 不要总是将沉默理解为同意。

consent.en: The written consent of a parent is required.
consent.zh: 要求有家长的书面同意。

consent.en: At no time did I give my consent to the plan.
consent.zh: 我从未同意过这项计划。

consequence.en: This is a necessary consequence of progress.
It was an inevitable consequence of the decision.
consequence.zh: 那是这个决定的必然后果。

consequence.en: One consequence of global warming is extinction.
consequence.zh: 全球变暖的后果之一是物种灭绝。

consequent.en: The warming of the Earth and the consequent climatic changes affect us all.
consequent.zh: 全球变暖以及随之而来的气候变化影响我们每个人。

consequent.en: The reduction in bullying—and the consequent improvement in pupil happiness—is surely a worthwhile objective.
consequent.zh: 减少恃强凌弱现象——进而提高小学生的幸福感——无疑是一个值得追求的目标。

consequent.en: Primary among the arguments against uniforms is their lack of variety and the consequent loss of individuality experienced by people who must wear them.
consequent.zh: 反对校服的主要理由是校服缺乏多样性，导致穿校服的人失去了个性。

consequently.en: They had children and were consequently tied to the school vacations.
consequently.zh: 他们有几个孩子，因此被学校假期束缚住了。

consequently.en: Consequently even this vast chorus was occasionally overwhelmed by the brass.
consequently.zh: 结果连这个大合唱偶尔也被铜管乐所压倒。

consequently.en: Consequently, even as the blogosphere continues to expand, only a few blogs are likely to emerge as focal points.
consequently.zh: 因此，虽然博客空间继续扩大，但只有少数博客有可能脱颖而出成为焦点。

conservation.en: The benefits of conservation are both financial and aesthetic.
conservation.zh: 保护自然环境在经济上和美化环境上都有好处。

conservation.en: Scientific research and conservation are intimately connected.
conservation.zh: 科学研究与环境保护联系密切。

conservation.en: The district is under consideration for designation as a conservation area.

cube.zh: 立方体是一种立体图形。

cubic.en: Jupiter's moon Io, whose density is 3.5 grams per cubic centimetre, is all rock.
cubic.zh: 木星的卫星木卫一全是岩石，其密度为每立方厘米3.5克。

cubic.en: A seed only needs one cubic centimeter of soil to grow.
cubic.zh: 一颗种子只需要一立方厘米的土壤就能生长。

cubic.en: New estimates of the water reserves go up to 2,700 billion cubic meters of fresh water.
cubic.zh: 据最新估计，淡水储量将达到2.7万亿立方米。

cucumber.en: Cucumber is good for soothing tired eyes.
cucumber.zh: 黄瓜对缓解眼睛疲劳很有效。
黄瓜和西兰花是绿色的。

culminate.en: Their summer tour will culminate at a spectacular concert in London.
culminate.zh: 在伦敦举行的一场精彩的音乐会将为他们的夏季巡回演出画上句号。

culminate.en: The American singer Diana Ross, the main performer at the introductory ceremonies, led an elaborate song-and-dance number that was to culminate in a triumphant shot.
culminate.zh: 美国歌星戴安娜.罗斯（注：老友记里有一集钱德勒调侃莫妮卡头发的桥段就是说她）是开幕式的主要演出嘉宾，在一段精心编排的歌舞之后，以一记惊天射门引爆全场。

culminate.en: The full version will provide a detailed comparison of the five options presented in the summary report – including one plan that would culminate in a trip to Mars orbit.
culminate.zh: 报告的完整版本将提供对摘要报告里的五个方案的详细比较——其中包括一项以在最终完成火星轨道飞行为目标的计划。

cue.en: Can you cue me when you want me to begin speaking?
cue.zh: 你要我开始讲话时能给我暗示一下吗？

cue.en: She stood in the wings and waited for her cue to go on.
cue.zh: 她站在舞台侧面等待着出场的提示。

cue.en: He chalked his billiard cue again and again.
cue.zh: 他一再用白垩粉擦他的球杆尖。

cultivate.en: The people cultivate mainly rice and beans.
cultivate.zh: 这里的人们主要种植稻子和豆类。
我们该如何培养积极的情感呢？

cultivate.en: I want to cultivate the relationship with myself.
cultivate.zh: 我想培养和自己的关系。

cumulative.en: It's very close, but overall the cumulative effects of cloud are to cool Earth rather than heat it.
cumulative.zh: 这十分相近，但是总体上来说，云的累积作用是降低地球的温度而不是让地球升温。

cumulative.en: Tomorrow, we will dump a slightly larger amount, with the cumulative concentrations now trapping more and more heat from the sun.
cumulative.zh: 明天，我们会释放出更大的量，累积的浓度现在会吸收越来越多的来自太阳的热量。

cumulative.en: The condition appears to result from the cumulative effect of a number of factors, with atmospheric pollutants the principal culprits.
cumulative.zh: 这种情况似乎是由许多因素的累积的结果，而大气污染物是主要的罪魁祸首。

cunning.en: He was as cunning as a fox.

culture.en: We are living in a consumer culture.
culture.zh: 我们生活在一种消费文化之中。

culture.en: This tradition has no parallel in our culture.
culture.zh: 这种传统在我们的文化中是没有的。

culture.en: She's very keen to learn about Japanese culture.

cup.zh: 当心那个杯子，你这笨手笨脚的家伙！

cupboard.en: She split her head open on the cupboard door.
cupboard.zh: 她碰到碗橱门上把头碰破了。

cupboard.en: Both movies are about a monster in the bedroom cupboard.
cupboard.zh: 两部电影都是关于卧室橱柜里的一个怪物。

curb.en: He needs to learn to curb his temper.
curb.zh: 他得学着控制自己的脾气。

curb.en: It's easier to pick up apples than to drag tree branches all the way to the curb.
curb.zh: 摘苹果比把树枝一直拖到路边要容易得多。

curb.en: If patients pay very little out of their own pockets, they have little desire to curb consumption.
curb.zh: 如果病人自掏腰包支付的钱很少，他们就不会有遏制消费的意愿。

cure.en: The search for a cure goes on.
cure.zh: 人们还在继续探寻治疗方法。

cure.en: Will you be able to cure him, Doctor?
The magic cure for inflation does not exist.
cure.zh: 解决通货膨胀的神奇方法并不存在。

curious.en: "I'm not meddling," Ken said mildly, "I'm just curious."
curious.zh: “我不是在管闲事，”肯温和地说，“我只是好奇。”

curious.en: Steve was intensely curious about the world I came from.
curious.zh: 史蒂夫对我是从哪里来的有强烈的好奇心。

curious.en: They entered the shop, which was a curious ramshackle building.
curious.zh: 他们走进商店，那是一所奇怪、摇摇欲坠的房子。

curl.en: Dry curly hair naturally for maximum curl and shine.
curl.zh: 让卷发自然地风干以最大限度地增加头发的卷曲和光泽。

curl.en: The paper started to shrivel and curl up in the heat.
curl.zh: 那张纸在高温下开始起皱卷曲。

curl.en: The wave and curl of her blonde hair gave her sensuality and youth.
curl.zh: 波浪式的卷曲金发使她显得性感并富有青春活力。

currency.en: Its currency is pegged to the dollar.
currency.zh: 其货币与美元的汇率固定了。

currency.en: When will the single currency be operable?
currency.zh: 什么时候实行单一货币？

currency.en: You need hard currency to get anything halfway decent.
currency.zh: 你得有硬通货才能买到像样点儿的东西。

current.en: The canoe found the current and swung around.
current.zh: 独木舟遇上了急流，打着转。

current.en: What is the current thinking on this question?
current.zh: 目前对这个问题的看法是什么？

curriculum.zh: 课程设置应该内容广泛而且均衡。

curriculum.en: The curriculum was too narrow and too rigid.
curriculum.zh: 课程设置过于狭窄和死板。

curriculum.en: Music is an integral part of the school's curriculum.
curriculum.zh: 音乐是这所学校的课程中基本的一环。

curt.zh: 她的语气是简短无理的。
他说话的语调粗暴无礼。

curse.en: He muttered a curse at the other driver.
curse.zh: 他低声咒骂另一位开车的人。

curse.en: They see their failure to produce an heir as a curse from God.
curse.zh: 他们将自己未能生育一个后嗣看作是来自上帝的一个诅咒。
他们咒骂我并大喊大叫。

curtain.en: A bead curtain separated the two rooms.
curtain.zh: 一挂珠帘子把两个房间分开。

curtain.en: Light beamed through a hole in the curtain.
curtain.zh: 光线透过窗帘上的一个孔照射进来。

curve.en: The slope increases as you go up the curve.
curve.zh: 你顺着那条弯路往上走，坡度越来越大。

curve.en: We just change the curve into straight lines.
curve.zh: 我们只是把曲线变成了直线。

curve.en: It's a tough learning curve and it won't always make you popular.
curve.zh: 这是一条艰难的学习曲线，且并不一定让你受欢迎。

cushion.en: A hovercraft rides on a cushion of air.
cushion.zh: 气垫船悬浮在气垫上行驶。

cushion.en: She embroidered flowers on the cushion covers.
cushion.zh: 她在这些靠垫套上绣了花。

cushion.en: She embroidered the cushion covers with flowers.
cushion.zh: 她在这些靠垫套上绣了花。

custom.en: It was her custom to rise early.
The origin of the custom is obscure.
custom.zh: 该习俗的起源鲜为人知。
应该恢复这一独特的风俗。

customary.en: It is customary to offer a drink or a snack to guests.
customary.zh: 通常用饮料或小吃招待客人。

customary.en: In the United States, it is not customary to telephone somenone very early in the morning.
customary.zh: 在美国，人们不习惯在大清早给人打电话。

customary.en: Church records show he was baptized on April 26, and three days was a customary amount of time to wait before baptizing a newly born baby.
customary.zh: 教会记录显示，他于4月26日受洗，在为新生婴儿施洗之前，通常需要等待三天。

customer.zh: 此公司与客户关系极好。

customer.en: They set high standards of customer service.
customer.zh: 他们制订了严格的客户服务标准。

cycle.en: We went for a cycle ride on Sunday.
cycle.zh: 我们星期天骑自行车去兜风了。

cycle.en: I usually cycle home through the park.
cycle.zh: 我通常骑自行车穿过公园回家。
这个周期一直循环往复。

cylinder.en: The cylinder is cooled by a jet of water.
The car was powered by a four cylinder air-cooled engine.
cylinder.zh: 这辆汽车是由一个四缸气冷式发动机驱动的。

cylinder.en: The steam was condensed rapidly by injecting cold water into the cylinder.
cylinder.zh: 由于汽缸中注入了冷水，蒸汽迅速凝结了。

cynical.en: She wanted him to stop being so cool, so detached, so cynical.
cynical.zh: 她希望他不再那么冷酷无情，那么无动于衷，那么愤世嫉俗。

cynical.en: She may be cynical about the film industry, but ultimately she has no intention of biting the hand that feeds her.
cynical.zh: 她也许会对电影业冷嘲热讽，但终究不打算恩将仇报。

cynical.en: Straight from the cynical anonymity of a big city, we luxuriated in its happy personalism.
cynical.zh: 从大城市的愤世嫉俗的匿名性中， 我们奢侈地享受其快乐的个人主义。

cut.zh: 约翰逊刮胡子时割伤了自己。
咱们切牌决定由谁发牌吧。

dairy.en: He avoids all meat and dairy products.
dairy.zh: 他不吃任何肉类和奶制品。

daily.zh: 他们召开了每日例行的新闻发布会。

daily.en: The plants want to be watered daily.
daily.zh: 这些花草需要天天浇水。

dam.en: A dam burst and flooded their villages.
dam.zh: 一个大坝决堤，淹没了他们的村子。

dam.en: The dam burst under the weight of water.
dam.zh: 大坝在水的巨大压力下溃决了。

damage.zh: 火灾造成了巨大的损失。

damn.en: Oh damn! I forgot he was coming.
damn.zh: 真该死！我把他要来这事儿给忘了。

damn.en: Don't be flippant, damn it! This is serious!
damn.zh: 该死，不要不当回事！这是很严肃的！

dance.zh: 我们情不自禁地跳起舞来。

danger.zh: 他环顾四周，觉察到了危险。

dangerous.zh: 这个男子有枪，是个危险分子。
我因危险驾驶而被抓住。

dare.en: You told him? How did you dare?
How dare you talk back to me!

daring.en: The show's a keeper–daring, imaginative and provocative.
daring.zh: 这部电影值得收藏–大胆、富于想像力和煽动性。

daring.en: The gallery was known for putting on daring exhibitions.
daring.zh: 该画廊以其举办的大胆画展而享有盛名。

daring.en: There are plenty of activities at the resort for the less daring.
daring.zh: 度假胜地有许多活动是供不太敢于冒险的人玩的。

dark.zh: 她的眼睛在黑暗中闪烁。
我们天黑以前应该能赶到。
我们有望在天黑前到达。

darling.zh: 快点，亲爱的，我们要迟到了。
“亲爱的亨利”，信的开头这样写道。

dash.en: Oh, Tim! I'm sorry but I have to dash.
dash.zh: 噢，蒂姆！很抱歉，但我得赶紧走了。

dash.en: He cut quite a dash in his uniform.
dash.zh: 他穿着这身制服显得特帅。

dash.en: The rug adds a dash of colour to the room.
dash.zh: 小地毯为房间增添了一点色彩。

data.en: He copied the data into a notebook.
data.zh: 他把资料抄在了笔记本上。

daughter.zh: 她给他生了个女儿，叫苏珊娜。

daughter.en: Her daughter is very dear to her.
daughter.zh: 她的女儿是她心爱的宝贝。

date.zh: 我今晚有一场令人激动的约会。
我们能否约定一个日期？

daylight.zh: 作画的最佳时间是白天。

daylight.en: Through the aperture he could see daylight.
daylight.zh: 通过这个孔隙他能看到日光。

daylight.en: The street looks very different in daylight.
daylight.zh: 在白天大街显得很不一样。

day.en: Your needs can differ from day to day.
day.zh: 你的需要可能每天都在变化。

day.en: I used to drink coffee day in, day out.

dazzle.en: You can dazzle members of the opposite with your quick wit and aggressive charm.
dazzle.zh: 你可以在异性面前炫耀自己过人的才智和独特的魅力。

dazzle.en: At the time, it was only an educated guess that this so-called dazzle camouflage would work.
dazzle.zh: 那个时候，炫目伪装能够起作用只是出于一种经验上的判断。

deadly.zh: 有些蘑菇含有致命毒素。

deadly.en: Life in a small town could be deadly dull.
deadly.zh: 小城镇的生活可能会非常没意思。

dead.zh: 人们担心已经死了好几百人。

deaf.en: She learnt to sign to help her deaf child.
deaf.zh: 为帮助她耳聋的孩子，她学会了手语。

deaf.en: The two deaf actors converse solely in signing.
deaf.zh: 两位聋哑演员只靠打手势语交谈。

deal.zh: 他们达成了协议，相互握手祝贺。

death.zh: 医生们对死亡变得习以为常。

debate.en: In debate he was a formidable opponent.
debate.zh: 在辩论中他是位难应付的对手。

debate.en: His speech has provoked a raging debate.
debate.zh: 他的演讲激起了激烈的争论。
反战示威者们扰乱了辩论。

debt.en: We're up to our neck in debt.
The firm ended up deep in debt.
debt.zh: 这家公司最后债台高筑。

decade.en: Women have become more assertive in the past decade.
decade.zh: 妇女在过去十年已变得更坚定自信。

decade.en: At least one supernova occurs per decade in our galaxy.
decade.zh: 每十年至少有一颗超新星在我们的银河系中出现。

decade.en: Her husband had played the trombone in the band for a decade.
decade.zh: 她丈夫已在这支乐队吹了十年的长号。

decay.en: There are problems of urban decay and gang violence.
decay.zh: 存在都市衰败和黑帮暴力问题。

decay.en: When not removed, plaque causes tooth decay and gum disease.
decay.zh: 牙斑没有清除就会导致蛀牙和牙龈疾病。

decay.en: The landlord had let the building fall into decay.
decay.zh: 房东不管，房子已经破烂不堪。

deceit.en: He was accused of lies and deceit.
His name is synonymous with deception, treachery, cunning, and deceit.
deceit.zh: 他的名字是欺骗，背叛，狡猾和欺骗的同义词。

deceit.en: Deceit, according to him, was impossibility in the case of one trained to observation and analysis.
deceit.zh: 根据他的说法，对于一个受过观察和分析训练的人来说，欺骗是不可能的。

deceive.zh: 我厌恶那些欺骗我的人。

deceive.en: It is to deceive the whole country and the princess too!
deceive.zh: 这是欺骗整个国家和公主！

December.zh: 我总是忘了现在是12月份。

December.en: Prices edged up 2% in the year to December.
December.zh: 到12月为止的年度价格上涨了2%。

decent.en: He did the decent thing and resigned.
There are no decent schools round here.
decent.zh: 附近没有什么像样的学校。

decent.en: The majority of people around here are decent people.
decent.zh: 这儿的大多数人都是正派人。

decimal.en: The figure is accurate to two decimal places.
decimal.zh: 这个数精确到小数点后两位。

decimal.en: The number is correct to three decimal places.
decimal.zh: 这个数目精确到小数点后三位数。

decimal.en: A waiter omitted the decimal point in the $13.09 bill.
decimal.zh: 一个侍者漏掉了那份$13.09的账单上的小数点。

decide.en: Whatever you decide, it's okay by me.
decide.zh: 无论你怎么决定对我来说都行。

decide.en: You have our support, whatever you decide.
decide.zh: 不管你作何决定，都会得到我们的支持。

decision.zh: 他们的决定是全体同意的。
他们决心已下，矢志不渝。
这个决定是夜间做出的。

decisive.en: He is decisive and won't shrink from a fight.
decisive.zh: 他很果断，而且不会逃避战斗。

decisive.en: The might of the army could prove a decisive factor.
decisive.zh: 军队的力量最终可能成为一个决定性的因素。

decisive.en: This is a time of decisive action and quick thinking.
decisive.zh: 这个时刻需要行动果断、思维敏捷。

declaration.en: It was meant to sound like an epoch-making declaration.
declaration.zh: 有意让它听起来像是一个划时代的宣言。

declaration.en: Some delegates believe the final declaration is likely to be too timorous.
declaration.zh: 一些代表认为这份最后的声明可能有些过于畏首畏尾的感觉。

declaration.en: On the customs declaration, the sender labelled the freight as agricultural machinery.
declaration.zh: 在报关单上，发货方将货物列为农业机械。

deck.en: I was hurled bodily to the deck.
deck.zh: 我整个人被扔到了甲板上。

deck.en: We lay sunning ourselves on the deck.
deck.zh: 我们躺在甲板上晒太阳。

decline.zh: 这个行业已成衰退之势。

decline.en: Support for the party continues to decline.
decline.zh: 对该党的支持继续下降。

decline.en: They failed to arrest the company's decline.
decline.zh: 他们未能阻止公司的衰落。

decrease.en: People should decrease the amount of fat they eat.
decrease.zh: 人们应减少脂肪的摄入量。
这会大幅降低工作效率。

decrease.en: There has been a decrease in traffic accidents.

decorate.en: The boys are planning to decorate when they get the time.
decorate.zh: 男孩们正计划在他们有时间的时候装修。

decorate.en: When they came to decorate the rear bedroom, it was Jemma who had the final say.
decorate.zh: 他们开始装修后卧室时，说了算的人是杰马。

decorate.en: My mom and I would decorate it.

dedicate.en: She vowed to herself that she would dedicate her life to scientific studies.
dedicate.zh: 她默默地发誓要献身于科学研究。

dedicate.en: Dedicate a small shelf or a drawer to lunch things and kit it out with the basics.
dedicate.zh: 贡献出一个小架子或一个抽屉来装午餐材料，将基本用品装备齐全。

dedicate.en: If working from home becomes permanent, employees will have to dedicate part of their private space to work.
dedicate.zh: 如果远程办公变得长期且固定，员工们不得不将部分私人空间用于工作。

deduce.en: Usually it is left to employers to deduce the potential from a list of extracurricular adventures on a graduate's resume.
deduce.zh: 通常情况下，由雇主从毕业生简历上的课外活动清单中来推断他们的潜力。

deduce.en: The authors want to deduce a brief formulation, and use all-purpose program to get exact result for echelon, rectangle and rotundity cross section.
deduce.zh: 作者想推导简短的公式，对梯形、矩形和圆形断面采用通用的程序，以得到准确的结果。

deduce.en: IQ tests ask you to complete verbal and visual analogies, to envision paper after it has been folded and cut, and to deduce numerical sequences, among other similar tasks.
deduce.zh: 智商测试要求你完成语言和视觉上的类比，想象纸张折叠和剪切之后的样子，推断数字序列，以及其他类似的任务。

deed.en: He is all talk and no deed.
My grandmother says a good deed is its own reward.
deed.zh: 我的奶奶说，做好事本身就是一种回报。

deed.en: Smith changed his name by deed poll to Jervis-Smith.
deed.zh: 史密斯通过单边契据将自己的名字更改为杰维斯—史密斯。

deem.en: They deem travel an important part of their life.
deem.zh: 他们认为旅行是他们生活中重要的一部分。

deem.en: I deem it an honour to accept your invitation.
deem.zh: 承蒙您的邀请，我觉得很荣幸。

deem.en: You might even deem it as extreme.
deem.zh: 你可能认为这是在走极端。

deepen.en: There were plans to deepen a stretch of the river.
deepen.zh: 曾经有过加深一段河道的计划。

deepen.en: The course is an exciting opportunity for anyone wishing to deepen their understanding of themselves and other people.
deepen.zh: 这门课程对于希望加深了解自己和他人的人们来说，是个令人兴奋的机会。
她的皱纹随着年龄增长而加深。

deer.en: Deer had stripped the tree of its bark.
He'd gone deer hunting with his cousins.
deer.zh: 他已和堂兄弟们猎鹿去了。

deer.en: Deer had stripped all the bark off the tree.

defeat.zh: 他蒙骗默瑟并击败了他。

defeat.en: They suffered a defeat at the polls.
defeat.zh: 他们在投票选举中惨遭失败。

defect.en: He was born with a hearing defect.
Children with the defect need all the help.
defect.zh: 有缺陷的孩子需要各种帮助。

defect.en: Not only was our defect rate lower, but the architecture and design were superior.

destructive.en: The war was a paradigm of the destructive side of human nature.

destructive.zh: 坦克耗油量大，对道路有破坏性，并且难以停放。

detect.zh: 阿诺德能察觉到老人脸上的某种悲伤。

detect.zh: 我们在努力探测并了解气候是怎样变化的。

detect.zh: 新的检验使医生能在早期发现该种疾病。

detach.en: The skis should detach from the boot if you fall.
detach.zh: 要是你跌倒了，滑雪板就该脱离靴子。

detach.en: I tried to detach myself from the reality of these terrible events.
detach.zh: 我尽力使自己从这些可怕事件的现实中摆脱出来。

detach.zh: 他们爬回到瀑布下面以便将卡在锯齿状岩石间的小艇拉出来。

detail.zh: 我记不住每一个微小的细节。

detection.zh: 然而许多问题却未被察觉。

detection.zh: 这架飞机用于进行电子干扰和雷达探测。

detection.zh: 这种针对老鼠检测方法无需专门的设备。

deteriorate.en: There are fears that the situation might deteriorate into full-scale war.

determination.zh: 他表现得十分勇敢和果断。

detective.zh: 那是一篇构思巧妙的侦探作品。

detective.zh: 侦探费力地辨认出这些字。

determine.en: You alone should determine what is right for you.
determine.zh: 只有你应该决定什么对你是合适的。

determine.en: Genes determine the characteristics of every living thing.
determine.zh: 基因决定每个生物的特征。

determine.zh: 波罗的海人民有权决定他们自己的未来。

deviate.zh: 如果使用奖励失败了，通过拒绝或威胁来排斥那些偏离主要群体规范的人，成员可以经常获胜。

deviate.zh: 因为道路封闭，公共汽车只得绕道而行。

deviate.zh: 他们在对待员工的方式上也不太可能有失偏颇。

development.zh: 他买了这块地准备开发。

devise.zh: 专家们在努力想出清除大面积浮油的办法。

devise.zh: 你应该设计一些策略来改变球杆和动作。

devise.zh: 你们的任务是选择一个感兴趣的学科，然后设计一个实验。

devote.zh: 最初的计划是在这个项目上投入三个月的时间。

devote.zh: 无可否认，我们必须投入更多的资源来解决这个问题。

devote.zh: 我们投入了几天时间在科潘宏伟的玛雅遗址考察。

diagnose.zh: 此项化验可用于诊断多种疾病。

diagnose.zh: 其他一些症状也有助于医生诊断出艾滋病患者。

dialog.zh: 喜剧或动画片里的对话很有趣，通常有一个皆大欢喜的结局。

dialog.zh: 按下 Windows 键+ R ，出现了一个“运行”的对话框。 在对话框中输入 taskmgr ，然后点击确定。

dialect.zh: 用方言来交流信息往往很合适。

diamond.zh: 钻石是碳元素的晶体结构。

diamond.en: The cut of a diamond depends on the skill of its craftsman.
diamond.zh: 切割钻石的好坏取决于工匠的技艺。

diary.en: She kept a diary for over twenty years.
diary.zh: 她记了二十多年的日记。

diary.en: Her diary was a record of her inner conflict.
diary.zh: 她的日记记录了她内心的矛盾。

dictate.en: The choice that does this is "dictate".
dictate.zh: 做到这一点的选择是“命令”。

dictate.en: What right do they have to dictate how we live our lives?
dictate.zh: 他们有什么权利强行规定我们该怎样生活？

dictate.en: What gives them the right to dictate to us what we should eat?
dictate.zh: 是什么给他们权利来规定我们该吃什么？

dictation.zh: 她正在根据他的口述记录西蒙·福曼的日记。

dictation.en: I wrote the letter at his dictation.
I wrote the letter at my boss' dictation.
dictation.zh: 我照我老板的口述写了这封信。

dictionary.zh: 我在词典里查过这个词。

diet.zh: 我们都需要饮食多样化。

differ.zh: 在这方面法语和英语不同。

differentiate.zh: 我无法将这几个品种区别开来。

differentiate.zh: 孩子也许无法区分想像与真实世界的差别。

differentiate.zh: 一般说来，区别效率和绝对的时间投入很重要。

different.zh: 同一颜色在不同光线下看起来会不同。

different.en: Different forms of cancer have different fatality rates.
different.zh: 不同类型的癌症死亡率也不同。

difficulty.zh: 他们讨论了到国外学习的困难。

diffuse.zh: 它使尼古丁缓慢、稳步地扩散到血液当中。

diffuse.zh: 问题在于如何将权力分散而不造成无政府状态。

dine.zh: 早上他似乎忙于生意，下午附近的绅士们来访，并且有时留下来和他一起吃饭。

dimension.zh: 弗鲁姆模型强调领导力的参与性维度：领导者如何进行决策。

diploma.zh: 合格完成此课程者将获得社会福利工作文凭。

disagree.zh: 我们不同意她提出的任何观点。

disappear.zh: 他们注视着公共汽车消失在远方。

disappear.zh: 就这样消失不是她父亲的风格。

discharge.zh: 她的耳朵里有水状物流出。

discharge.en: He received an honourable discharge from the army.

discount.en: They are often available at a discount.
discount.zh: 它们经常可以以折扣价买到。

discount.en: All full-time staff get a 20 percent discount.
discount.zh: 所有全职员工都可以享受8折优惠。

discourage.en: His parents tried to discourage him from being an actor.
discourage.zh: 他的父母试图阻止他去当演员。

discourage.en: The Swiss wanted to discourage an inflow of foreign money.
discourage.zh: 瑞士人想要阻止外资流入。

discourage.en: This greatly surprised him, but did not discourage him.
discourage.zh: 这使他大为吃惊，但并没有使他气馁。

discrepancy.zh: 差异这么明显，令人吃惊。

discrepancy.en: Which of the following, if true, best reconciles the apparent discrepancy presented in the passage?
discrepancy.zh: 下列哪个选项，如果正确，最好地调和了文章中呈现的明显差异？

discrepancy.en: Why is there such a discrepancy between the perception of immigrants' impact on the economy and the reality?
discrepancy.zh: 为什么移民对经济影响造成的感知和现实之间会有如此大的差异呢？

discovery.en: I felt I'd made an incredible discovery.
discovery.zh: 我感到自己有了一个惊人的发现。

discovery.en: This discovery may yet be the making of him.
discovery.zh: 这一发现也许成为他成功的因素。
这项发现是对传统信念的冲击。

discover.en: Only later did she discover a talent for writing.
discover.zh: 她后来才发现自己的写作天分。

discover.en: We happened to discover we had a friend in common.
discover.zh: 我们碰巧发现我们有个共同的朋友。

discover.en: It's exciting to discover traces of earlier civilizations.
discover.zh: 发现以前文明的遗迹，真令人兴奋。

discrete.en: Social structures are not discrete objects; they overlap and interweave.
discrete.zh: 社会结构不是离散的客体；他们重叠并交织在一起。

discrete.en: Put simply, a class is a discrete block or bundle of variables and methods.
discrete.zh: 简单地说，类是一个由变量和方法组成的离散块或束。

discrete.en: The discrete units that make up language can be put together in different ways.
discrete.zh: 这种组成语言的离散单元能够以不同的方式组合起来。

discriminate.en: When do babies learn to discriminate voices?
discriminate.zh: 婴儿什么时候学会辨别嗓音呢？

discriminate.en: Employers cannot discriminate on grounds of age.
The tests discriminate unfairly against older people.
discriminate.zh: 这些测验使年纪较大的人受到歧视。

discuss.zh: 他们有些重要的问题要讨论。

discuss.en: It's hardly the time to discuss it now.
discuss.zh: 现在还不是讨论的时候。

discuss.en: We will discuss these three areas in depth.
discuss.zh: 我们将全面透彻地讨论这3个领域。

discussion.zh: 这两个男人突然投入了讨论。

disguise.zh: 他竭力掩饰自己的口音。

disgust.zh: 有些人厌恶地大声嚷嚷。

disease.zh: 这种病目前还是不治之症。
疾病与贫穷常常相伴而生。

dish.zh: 这个盘子是怎么打破的？
它从一个盘子里舐食牛奶。
每道菜端上来都是加过很多香料的。

dishonour.zh: 我不想让我的老师丢脸。

dishonour.en: It's a medal of dishonour, commissioned by and first shown at the British Museum in 2009.
dishonour.zh: 那是一块不名誉的奖章。受大不列颠博物馆的委托创作并在2009年首次展出。

dishonour.en: The dishonour would come from abandoning Iraq's long-suffering people for the sake of a deadline.
dishonour.zh: 若是为了按时撤军，而置伊拉克人民于水深火热之中而不顾，那才是真正的可耻。

disk.en: My computer can't read the disk you sent.
disk.zh: 我的电脑不能读你送来的盘。

disk.en: The text on the disk seems to be corrupt.
disk.zh: 这张磁盘上的文件好像有错误。

disk.en: The disk will corrupt if it is overloaded.
disk.zh: 磁盘如果过载，数据就会出错。

dislike.en: Why do you dislike him so much?
dislike.zh: 你为什么那么讨厌他呢？

dislike.en: I took a violent dislike to him.
She took an instant dislike to me.

dismay.en: She let out a groan of dismay.
He glanced back, and saw to his dismay that they were gaining on him.
dismay.zh: 他回头一看，发现他们快追上他了，这使他很沮丧。

dismiss.en: He was so irresponsible that I decided to dismiss him.
dismiss.zh: 他如此不负责任，我决定解雇他。

dismiss.en: I think we can safely dismiss their objections.
dismiss.zh: 我认为我们对他们的异议完全可以不予理会。

dismiss.en: They were quick to dismiss rumours of an off-screen romance.
dismiss.zh: 两人迅速否认了他们在现实生活中是情侣的传言。

disorder.en: The FDA has approved a new treatment for a rare blood disorder.
disorder.zh: 食品及药物管理局通过了一种罕见血液疾病的新疗法。

disorder.en: I was relieved to find out that my problems were due to a genuine disorder.
disorder.zh: 查明我的问题的确是失调造成的，我就放心了。

disorder.en: Anyone can develop an eating disorder, but young women are most vulnerable.
disorder.zh: 任何人都可能得饮食紊乱症，但是年轻女性是最易得该症的。

disperse.en: Police used tear gas to disperse the crowds.
disperse.zh: 警察使用催泪瓦斯驱散人群。

disperse.en: Police used tear gas to disperse the demonstrators.
disperse.zh: 警察动用了催泪瓦斯来驱散示威人群。

dispatch.en: The dispatch of the task force is purely a contingency measure.
dispatch.zh: 派遣特遣队纯粹是应急措施。

dispatch.en: Mr. Vlok promised new measures to protect residents, including the dispatch of police and troop reinforcements.
dispatch.zh: 乌洛克先生答应了新的保护居民的措施，包括派遣增援的警察和军队。

dispatch.en: I also had the first BlackBerry because I was still working in dispatch at the time.
dispatch.zh: 我也有了第一部黑莓手机，因为那时我还在忙调度的事情。

displease.en: Not wishing to displease her, he avoided answering the question.
displease.zh: 由于不想对她有所冒犯，他回避了这个问题。

displease.en: We need to know the custom of this country, so that we would not displease anyone.
displease.zh: 我们要了解这个国家的习俗，这样我们就不会激怒别人了。

displease.en: So go back now; and go peaceably, that you may not displease the lords of the Philistines.
displease.zh: 现在你可以平平安安的回去，免得非利士人的首领不欢喜你。

displace.en: Renewable energy will have to displace fossil fuels to a much greater extent in the future to avoid unacceptable climate risks.
displace.zh: 为了避免难以容忍的气候风险，未来可再生能源将不得不在更大程度上取代化石燃料。

displace.en: Humans are the ultimate invasive species—when they move into new territory, they often displace the wildlife that was already living there.
displace.zh: 人类是终极入侵物种——当他们进入新的领地时，他们经常会取代已经生活在那里的野生动物。

displace.en: This is because, according to Archimedes' principle of displacement, floating objects displace their own weight in water.
displace.zh: 这是因为，根据阿基米德的位移原理，漂浮物在水中会转移自身的重量。

display.zh: 这些统计数据表现出一种明显的趋势。

display.en: They made a bar graph to display the results.
display.zh: 他们用条形图来显示结果。

display.en: Many companies are choosing to display their wares online.
display.zh: 许多公司正选择在网上展示其产品。

disposal.en: Congress passed a law that regulates the disposal of waste.
disposal.zh: 国会通过了一条管理废物处理的法律。

disposal.en: Attempts are being made to solve the problem of waste disposal.
disposal.zh: 正在想办法解决废物处理的问题。

disposal.en: Therefore, less money is spent for garbage disposal.
disposal.zh: 因此，花在垃圾处理上的钱就少了。

disposition.en: The rides are unsuitable for people of a nervous disposition.
disposition.zh: 这种骑乘不适合紧张型性格的人。

dispose.en: Obviously we ask all our customers to dispose of litter responsibly.
dispose.zh: 显然，我们要求所有的顾客负责任地处理垃圾。

dispose.en: Agencies and companies throughout the world are working on developing technology that would dispose of or capture space debris before it causes serious damage.
dispose.zh: 世界各地的机构和公司都在致力于开发一种技术，可以在太空垃圾造成严重损害之前将其处理或捕获。

dispose.en: Subway said that it worked hard to minimize the impact of litter on communities, so it was "still down to the individual customer to dispose of their litter responsibly".
dispose.zh: 赛百味表示，公司努力将垃圾对社区的影响降到最低，因此“对垃圾处理负责仍取决于个人客户”。

disregard.en: He showed a reckless disregard for his own safety.
disregard.zh: 他对个人安危全然无所顾忌。

disregard.en: She shows a total disregard for other people's feelings.
disregard.zh: 她丝毫不顾及别人的感受。

disregard.en: He drove with blithe disregard for the rules of the road.
disregard.zh: 他开车时全然不顾交通法规。

dispute.en: She played a key role in the dispute.
dispute.zh: 她在争论中起着举足轻重的作用。

dispute.en: The town is in uproar over the dispute.
dispute.zh: 该城对此争端一片哗然。

dispute.en: They supported their sisters in the dispute.
dispute.zh: 在争论中，她们支持自己的姐妹。

dissatisfy.zh: 更多或另外一些，它们仍然不满足。

dissatisfy.en: You have the ability to either satisfy or dissatisfy them when you contact them.
dissatisfy.zh: 在与顾客接触的时候，你就具有使顾客满意或者不满意的能力。

dissatisfy.en: It is our belief to further expand markets and dissatisfy with existing achievements.
dissatisfy.zh: 进一步开拓市场，不满足于现有成绩是我们的信念。

dissipate.en: Was she the pure phantom I loved because I would never touch her, never allow my all too real hands to dissipate the mist?
dissipate.zh: 她是我爱的那个纯洁的幻影吗？因为我从没接触她，从没允许自己真实的双手来拨开那层雾。

disrupt.en: A stroke can disrupt the supply of oxygen to the brain.
disrupt.zh: 中风可导致大脑供氧中断。

disrupt.en: It could disrupt the food chains there.
disrupt.zh: 它可能会破坏那里的食物链。

disrupt.en: They can disrupt experiments with the bacteria organisms they carry.
disrupt.zh: 他们可以通过携带的细菌来扰乱实验。

dissolve.en: Warm the sugar slightly first to make it dissolve quicker.
dissolve.zh: 首先把糖微微加热让它更快地溶化。

dissolve.en: The substance does not dissolve in water whether heated or not.
dissolve.zh: 无论加热与否，这种物质都不溶于水。

dissolve.en: Let's take solid salt, and dissolve it in a bunch of liquid water.
dissolve.zh: 让我们把食盐固体，溶解在一堆液态水里。

distil.en: The trend has continued with a succession of experts and would be experts who promise to distil the essence of excellence into three (or five or seven) simple rules.
distil.zh: 随着专家的不断涌现，这一趋势得以延续，而这些专家也将承诺将卓越的精髓提炼成三个（或五个、七个）简单的规则。

distil.en: The writer managed to distil his ideas into one succinct article.
distil.zh: 作家努力把他的想法浓缩成一篇简练的文章。

distil.en: Instead they distil the Palestinian experience of exile into something real.
distil.zh: 相反，它们把巴勒斯坦人的流亡经历浓缩成一些真实的画面。

distant.zh: 他是我远房的一个表亲。

distant.en: He's a distant relative of the mayor.

distinct.en: There was a distinct smell of gas.
Being tall gave Tony a distinct advantage.
distinct.zh: 托尼个子高是个明显的优势。
身高6英尺3英寸有明显的劣势！

distinction.en: We need to draw a distinction between the two events.
distinction.zh: 我们得把两起事件区别开来。

distinction.en: The distinction between craft and fine art is more controversial.
distinction.zh: 工艺和美术之间的区别更有争议。

distinguish.en: It's important to distinguish fact from fiction.
distinguish.zh: 区别真实和虚构是重要的。

distinguish.en: It was hard to distinguish one twin from the other.
distinguish.zh: 很难分辨出一对孪生儿谁是谁。

distort.en: A painter may exaggerate or distort shapes and forms.
distort.zh: 画家可能会夸大或扭曲形状与形式。

distort.en: They could distort the achievement-based system of peer-review-led research.
distort.zh: 他们可能会扭曲以同行评审为导向、以学术成就基础的研究体系。

distort.en: How can you portray something exactly as it is and at the same time distort it with emotions?
distort.zh: 你怎么可能一边完全客观的作画，一边又带有感情的去使之变形呢？

distract.en: It was all a ploy to distract attention from his real aims.
distract.zh: 那全是障眼法，借以转移对他真实目的的注意。

distract.en: It was another attempt to distract attention from the truth.
distract.zh: 这又是企图分散人们对事实真相的注意力。

distract.en: It serves to distract a predator while the octopus makes its escape.
distract.zh: 它的作用是在章鱼逃跑时分散捕食者的注意力。

distress.en: She was obviously in distress after the attack.
distress.zh: 她受到攻击后显然很痛苦。

distress.en: Widows seem to experience more distress than widowers.
distress.zh: 寡妇似乎比鳏夫感受更多痛苦。

distress.en: He keeps coming to the aid of this damsel in distress.
distress.zh: 他经常去帮助这位处于痛苦中的少女。

distribution.en: They studied the geographical distribution of the disease.
distribution.zh: 他们研究了这种疾病的地域分布情况。

distribution.en: The map shows the distribution of this species across the world.
distribution.zh: 地图上标明了这一物种在全世界的分布情况。

distribution.en: He tried to even out the distribution of work among his employees.
distribution.zh: 他尽量把工作平均分配给雇员。

distribute.en: Aid workers helped distribute corn, milk and other staples.
distribute.zh: 救助人员协助分发谷物、牛奶及其他必需的食物。

distribute.en: UN peacekeepers are trying to distribute supplies to 30,000 civilians.
distribute.zh: 联合国维和士兵正努力将供给分发给三万平民。

distribute.en: He sometimes employs sales-girls to distribute samples of his product.
distribute.zh: 他有时雇佣销售小姐来分发他的产品样品。

district.en: The Los Alamos district is solidly Republican.
district.zh: 洛斯阿拉莫斯地区是坚定的共和党地盘。

disturbance.en: He was charged with causing a disturbance after the game.
disturbance.zh: 他被指控在比赛结束后制造骚乱。

disturbance.en: During the disturbance which followed, three Englishmen were hurt.
disturbance.zh: 在随后的骚乱中，3个英国人受伤了。

disturbance.en: The building work is creating constant noise, dust and disturbance.
disturbance.zh: 建筑施工不断制造噪音、灰尘和干扰。

disturb.en: Don't disturb Jane, she's studying for her exams.
disturb.zh: 不要打扰简，她正在温习功课，准备考试呢。

disturb.en: If you get up early, try not to disturb everyone else.
disturb.zh: 如果你起得早，尽量不要打扰别人。

ditch.en: The bicycle lay upended in a ditch.
ditch.zh: 自行车翻倒在一条小水沟里。

ditch.en: The car went skidding off the road into a ditch.
ditch.zh: 汽车打滑冲出公路跌进沟里。

ditch.en: I can't bring myself to ditch him and start again.
ditch.zh: 我不能说服自己抛弃他，又重新开始。

diverse.en: Cuba is a composite of diverse traditions and people.
diverse.zh: 古巴是一个不同传统和民族的融合体。

diverse.en: The company owns a very diverse library of Arabic music.
diverse.zh: 公司收藏有多种多样的阿拉伯音乐。

diverse.en: It is geographically more diverse than any other continent.
diverse.zh: 它在地理上比其他任何大陆都更具多样性。

dive.en: The goalkeeper made a dive for the ball.
dive.zh: 守门员一个鱼跃向球扑去。

dive.en: The plane made a dive to a lower altitude.

divert.en: Even using a "hands-free" device can divert a driver's attention to an alarming extent.
divert.zh: 即使使用“免提”设备，也会在令人担忧的程度上转移司机的注意力。

divert.en: It works in compression to divert the weight above it out to the sides, where the weight is borne by the vertical elements on either side of the arch.
divert.zh: 在受到压力时，拱形结构能够起到将其上面的压力转移到侧面，在侧面的重量则由拱形结构两侧的垂直部分来承受。

divert.en: They want to divert the attention of the people from the real issues.
divert.zh: 他们想把人民的注意力从真正的问题上转移开。

diversion.en: The party will make a pleasant diversion.
diversion.zh: 晚会会是一个很不错的消遣。

diversion.en: A smoke bomb created a diversion while the robbery took place.
diversion.zh: 劫案发生时，一枚烟雾弹转移了人们的视线。
你会发现这是一种很好的消遣。

divine.zh: “他们是神圣的,”她神情恍惚地叹了口气。
更夫是我们年轻的神学学生。

divide.en: How shall we divide up the work?
Divide 2 into 7, and the answer is 3, remainder 1.

division.en: He joined the 40th Division as an army chaplain.
division.zh: 他加入了第40师当军队牧师。

division.en: Ford was attached to the 101st Airborne Division.
First Airborne Division was heavily outgunned by German forces.
division.zh: 第一空降师完全被德军的凶猛火力压住了。

divorce.zh: 这桩离婚案没有人提出异议。

dizzy.en: Climbing so high made me feel dizzy.
dizzy.zh: 爬那么高使我感到头晕目眩。

doctor.zh: 她和一个孟加拉医生结婚了。

dock.en: The ferry is expected to dock at 6.
dock.zh: 渡船预计在6点停靠码头。

dock.en: They dropped the sails and threw a line to a man on the dock.
dock.zh: 他们放下风帆，把船缆抛给码头上的人。

doctrine.zh: 这条教义是不可改变的。

doctrine.en: The African National Congress today dropped its doctrine of nationalizing industry in favour of a mixed economy.
doctrine.zh: 非洲国民大会今天放弃了工业国有化的信条转而赞同公私并存的混合型经济。

doctrine.en: The doctrine of surplus value is the cornerstone of Marx's economic theory.
doctrine.zh: 剩余价值学说是马克思经济理论的基石。

document.en: Press Exit to return to your document.
document.zh: 按“退出”键返回到你的文档。

dollar.zh: 收市时美元下降了二分。

domain.en: Physics used to be very much a male domain.
domain.zh: 物理学曾在很大程度上是男人的领域。

domain.en: Users need to find out if a domain name is already registered or is still available.
domain.zh: 用户需要查明某个域名是已经被注册过还是仍然可用。

dome.en: The shelter is built by lashing poles together to form a small dome.
dome.zh: 该掩蔽处是把杆子捆到一起形成一个小圆顶而搭建成。

dome.en: The use of steel and concrete has allowed the builders to perch a light concrete dome on eight slender columns.
dome.zh: 钢筋混凝土的使用使建筑者们能将一个轻巧的混凝土穹顶架在8根细柱上。

dominant.en: Economically, the centre of Spain has lost its dominant role.
dominant.zh: 西班牙中部在经济上已失去了其主导地位。

dominant.en: Total independence is a dominant thing in our culture.
dominant.zh: 独立自主在我们的文化中占主导地位。

dominant.en: He suffered from an oppressively dominant mother.
dominant.zh: 他那武断专横的母亲令他苦不堪言。

domestic.en: It was a scene of such domestic bliss.
domestic.zh: 这是一幕家庭美满的场景。

domestic.en: The police were called to sort out a domestic.
domestic.zh: 已叫警察来解决家庭纠纷。

domestic.en: We spent the whole evening discussing domestic trivia.
domestic.zh: 我们整个晚上谈论家庭琐事。

dominate.en: The big companies dominate the lower price points.
dominate.zh: 大公司在低端价格领域占主导地位。

dominate.en: Jones had set out to intimidate and dominate Paul.
dominate.zh: 琼斯曾试图威胁并控制保罗。

dominate.en: He denied that his country wants to dominate Europe.
dominate.zh: 他否认他的国家想称霸欧洲。

donate.en: They should donate at the registration point.
donate.zh: 他们应该在注册登记处捐款。

donate.en: I am 20 years old the first time I donate blood.
The only thing babies like to donate is their saliva.
donate.zh: 婴儿唯一喜欢捐赠的就是他们的口水了。

donkey.en: Time is like a wild donkey. Once it starts running, it never stops.
donkey.zh: 时间像一头野驴呀，跑起来就不停。

donkey.en: The donkey brayed and tried to bolt.
donkey.zh: 这头驴嘶叫着，企图挣脱缰绳。

donkey.en: A mule is a cross between a horse and a donkey.
donkey.zh: 骡是马和驴杂交的产物。

doom.en: Does this spell the doom of the physical book?
doom.zh: 这是否意味着实体书的末日？

doom.en: "Proud and insolent youth," said Hook, "prepare to meet thy doom."
doom.zh: “傲慢无礼的年轻人，”胡克说，“准备迎接你的厄运吧。”
