The dictionary is now in its sixth edition.

editor.en: We're losing a first-rate editor in Jen.
editor.zh: 我们即将失去珍这位一流的编辑。

editor.en: The editor struck out the whole paragraph.
editor.zh: 编辑把整段全部删去了。

editor.en: Michael Rosen is the editor of the anthology.
editor.zh: 迈克尔·罗森是该文集的主编。

editorial.en: Your editorial blithely ignores the hard facts.
editorial.zh: 你们的社论轻率地忽略了铁的事实。
这篇社论有几处事实性错误。

editorial.en: We are not about to change our editorial policy.
editorial.zh: 我们不打算改变我们的社论方针。

educate.en: The object is to educate people about road safety.
educate.zh: 目的就是教育人们注意交通安全。

educate.en: Caitlin's parents opted to educate her intensively at home.
educate.zh: 凯特林的父母选择在家对她进行强化教育。

educate.en: Our priority is to educate people about the dangers of drugs.
educate.zh: 我们首先要考虑的是教育人民，使他们认识毒品的危险。

efficiency.en: She arranged everything with her customary efficiency.
efficiency.zh: 她以她特有的高效率把一切都已安排妥当。

efficiency.en: It was achieved with minimum fuss and maximum efficiency.
efficiency.zh: 它以最少的慌乱和最高的效率被做到了。

efficiency.en: Defrost the fridge regularly so that it works at maximum efficiency.
efficiency.zh: 定期给冰箱除霜能取得最大效率。

effect.en: His voice had an almost hypnotic effect.
effect.zh: 他的声音有一种近乎催眠的作用。

effect.en: His words had exactly the opposite effect.
effect.zh: 他的话产生了截然相反的效果。

effect.en: The effect is almost impossible to describe.

effective.zh: 所有这些方法都同等有效。

effective.en: The world desperately needs an effective WTO.
effective.zh: 世界急切需要一个有效的世贸组织。

effective.en: Humour is a more effective defence than violence.
effective.zh: 幽默是比暴力更有效的防御武器。

ego.zh: 超人的第二自我是克拉克•肯特。

ego.en: He has the biggest ego of anyone I've ever met.
ego.zh: 他是我所见的最自负的人。

ego.en: His ego allows him to be humble, if you see what I mean.
ego.zh: 他的自我使他谦卑，如果你能明白我所说的意思。

efficient.en: The service at the hotel is efficient and unobtrusive.
efficient.zh: 那旅馆的服务工作有效率而不夸张。

efficient.en: Graphite is a highly efficient conductor of electricity.
efficient.zh: 石墨是一种高效的电导体。

efficient.en: The service at the hotel is efficient and unobtrusive.
efficient.zh: 那旅馆的服务工作有效率而不夸张。

effort.en: You should put more effort into your work.
effort.zh: 你应该更加努力地工作。

effort.en: Emma frowned, making an effort to compose herself.
effort.zh: 埃玛皱起了眉头，努力使自己镇定下来。

effort.en: Finding a cure requires considerable time and effort.
effort.zh: 找到一种治愈方法需要相当的时间和努力。

egg.en: She cracked an egg into the pan.
egg.zh: 她往锅里打了一个鸡蛋。
用刷子把打匀的鸡蛋抹在油酥面团上。

eighth.en: This will be his eighth title bout in 19 months.
eighth.zh: 这将是他19个月中的第八次比赛夺冠。

eighth.en: The play is open to all seventh and eighth graders.
eighth.zh: 所有七、八年级的学生均可观看此剧。

eighth.en: By the ninth hour the car was running in eighth position.
eighth.zh: 比赛进行到第9个小时的时候该赛车跑在第8位。

eighty.en: Eighty million years ago, dinosaurs ruled the earth.
eighty.zh: 八千万年前，地球是恐龙的天下。

either.en: Pete can't go and I can't either.
Is there any hard evidence either way?
either.zh: 不管正反，有什么确凿证据吗？

either.en: The offices on either side were empty.
either.zh: 两边的办公室都是空的。

eject.en: Officials used guard dogs to eject the protesters.
eject.zh: 官员们用护卫犬驱走抗议者。

eject.en: You can now safely eject the CD.
eject.zh: 您现在可以安全地弹出CD。

eject.en: I said to myself, I can't eject yet.
eject.zh: 我只有告诉自己，不能，还不能弹射。

elaborate.en: She went on to elaborate her argument.
elaborate.zh: 她进而详尽阐述了她的论点。

elaborate.en: She concocted some elaborate story to explain her absence.
elaborate.zh: 她精心编造了解释她不在场的一些谎言。

elaborate.en: According to the prosecution, the officers manufactured an elaborate story.
elaborate.zh: 根据起诉，军官们精心编造了事情的经过。

elapse.en: Years probably would elapse before his return. Some of us might never see him again.
elapse.zh: 他这一去可能就是多年，席上有些人恐怕今世也难得再见他面。

elapse.en: The further off this solid obstruction, the longer time will elapse for the return of the echo.
elapse.zh: 固体障碍物越远，回声返回所用时间就越长。

elapse.en: The last seven years have all been ‘the year of the mobile’; it is not clear how many more such years will need to elapse!
elapse.zh: 过去七年被看作“手机年”，还不清楚将来还会持续多久。

elastic.en: Beat it until the dough is slightly elastic.
elastic.zh: 反复捶打，直到面团略有弹性。

elastic.en: The elastic at the waist gives a nice snug fit.
elastic.zh: 腰间的松紧带使衣服正好紧紧贴在身上。

elastic.en: Her long fair hair was fastened at the nape of her neck by an elastic band.
elastic.zh: 她长长的金发用一根橡皮筋扎在了脖子后面。

elbow.en: She poked her elbow into his ribs.
elbow.zh: 她用胳膊肘顶他的肋部。

elbow.en: She poked him in the ribs with her elbow.
elbow.zh: 她用胳膊肘顶他的肋部。

elderly.zh: 许多老年人生活于贫困之中。

elderly.en: One elderly man sat morosely at the bar.
elderly.zh: 一个上了年纪的男人郁郁寡欢地坐在吧台。

elderly.en: There was an elderly couple on the terrace.
elderly.zh: 露台上有一对上年纪的老人。

elder.en: He is her elder by several years.
He had always been overshadowed by his elder sister.
elder.zh: 他与他姐姐相比总是相形见绌。

elder.en: His elder son was killed in a car crash a few years ago.
elder.zh: 他大儿子几年前死于一次车祸。

elect.en: The committee voted to re-elect him (as) chairman.
elect.zh: 委员会投票再次选举他担任主席。

elect.en: Councils should be answerable to the people who elect them.
elect.zh: 委员会应对选出他们的那些人作出交代。

elect.en: Increasing numbers of people elect to work from home nowadays.
elect.zh: 现在越来越多的人选择在家上班。

electric.zh: 他发明了第一个电动钟。

electric.en: There's an electric heater in the bedroom.

election.zh: 我们去年进行了一次选举。

electrical.en: The company is a world leader in electrical goods.
electrical.zh: 这家公司的电器产品在全世界首屈一指。

electrical.en: The fire was started by an electrical short-circuit.
electrical.zh: 火灾是由电线短路引发的。

electrical.en: The test records the electrical activity of the brain.
electrical.zh: 这个测试显示出大脑的电流活动。

electrician.en: The only electrician we could get hold of was miles away.
electrician.zh: 我们惟一能够联络上的电工在几英里之外。
电工笨拙地做接线工作。

electron.en: Magnetic coils focus the electron beams into fine spots.
electron.zh: 磁线圈将电子束聚焦成细小的点。

electron.en: The electron microscope uses a beam of electrons to produce images at high magnifications.
electron.zh: 电子显微镜利用一束电子产生高倍放大的影像。

electron.en: It is a naked electron and is a sodium positive ion.
electron.zh: 它是个裸电子，是钠正离子。

electronic.en: His desk is covered with electronic gadgetry.
electronic.zh: 他的书桌上摆满了各种电子装置。

electronic.en: This dictionary is available in electronic form.

electronic.zh: 电子词典中有一些动画片。

electronics.en: Racal Electronics shares have been in a strong uptrend.
electronics.zh: 瑞卡尔电子公司的股票已处在强劲上升趋势中。
索恩的电子公司雇佣了大约五千名员工。

electronics.en: The term electronics refers to electrically induced action.
electronics.zh: 电子学描述的是电力产生的作用。

elegant.en: She is always so chic, so elegant.
elegant.zh: 她总是那么时髦，那么优雅。

elegant.en: She was an elegant and accomplished woman.

elementary.zh: 有文化现在包括基本的计算机技能。

elementary.en: A proton is an elementary particle of matter that possesses a positive charge.
elementary.zh: 质子是带正电荷的物质的基本粒子。

elementary.en: The move from elementary school to middle school or junior high can be difficult.
elementary.zh: 从小学进入中学或者初中的这种变动可能会有困难。

element.en: Cost was a key element in our decision.
element.zh: 价钱是我们决策时考虑的主要因素。

element.en: Diamond is the crystalline form of the element carbon.
element.zh: 钻石是碳元素的晶体结构。
这个电壶需要一根新电热丝。

elevator.zh: 电梯猛震一下，升上去了。

elevator.en: I punched the button to summon the elevator.
We took the elevator to the fourteenth floor.

elephant.en: The kids had a ride on an elephant at the zoo.
elephant.zh: 在动物园里，孩子们骑着大象走了一圈。

elephant.en: The elephant is the largest living land animal.
elephant.zh: 象是现今陆地上最大的动物。

eleven.zh: 查理一世统治了十一年。

eleven.en: The meeting broke up at eleven o'clock.
Only eleven of these accidents were classified as major.
eleven.zh: 这些事故中只有十一例被判定为重大事故。

elevate.en: Even better would be to help elevate notions of beauty beyond the material standards of a particular industry.
elevate.zh: 更好的办法是帮助提升美的概念，超越特定行业的物质标准。

elevate.en: I built a platform to elevate the bed.
elevate.zh: 我搭了一个台子把床抬高了。
情绪紧张会使血压升高。

eleventh.zh: 星期四是他的第十一个生日。

elicit.en: Mr. Norris said he was hopeful that his request would elicit a positive response.
elicit.zh: 诺里斯先生说他希望他的要求会引起积极的回应。

elicit.en: These differences may elicit different brain responses.
elicit.zh: 这些差异可能引起不同的大脑反应。

elicit.en: I could elicit no response from him.
elicit.zh: 我从他那里套不出任何反应。

eligible.en: They are not eligible for sick pay.
eligible.zh: 他们没有资格领病假工资。

eligible.en: He's only 17 and therefore not eligible to vote.
eligible.zh: 他只有17岁，因此没有投票选举的资格。

eligible.en: Only 60% of eligible voters actually used their vote.
eligible.zh: 只有60%的符合资格的投票人行使了选举权。

eliminate.en: This diet claims to eliminate toxins from the body.
eliminate.zh: 这种饮食据称具有排除体内毒素的作用。

eliminate.en: We called up three economists to ask how to eliminate the deficit and they obliged with very straightforward answers.
eliminate.zh: 我们致电3位经济学家咨询消除赤字的方法，他们满足了我们的要求，给出了非常直接的答复。

eliminate.en: People should be prohibited from using plastic bags to eliminate white pollution.
eliminate.zh: 应该禁止人们使用塑料袋以消除白色污染。

elimination.en: Find which food you are allergic to by a process of elimination.
elimination.zh: 用排除法找出你对哪种食物过敏。

elimination.en: Though it may give some benefit to the poor, its key component is the elimination of tax on dividends.
elimination.zh: 尽管它可能会给穷人带来一些好处，但它的关键因素是取消股息税。

elimination.en: The company also embarked on a desperate cost-cutting program, which included the elimination of thousands of jobs.
elimination.zh: 该公司还启动了一项孤注一掷的成本削减计划，其中包括淘汰数千个工作岗位。

elite.en: Power is largely concentrated in the hands of a small elite.
elite.zh: 权力主要集中在少数精英人物的手里。

elite.en: Except for elite schools, admission standards are low.
elite.zh: 除了精英学校，其他学校的入学标准都很低。

elite.en: It is not just readers who are challenging the media elite.
elite.zh: 挑战媒体精英的不仅仅是读者。

eloquent.en: I heard him make a very eloquent speech at that dinner.
eloquent.zh: 我听他在那次晚餐上做了一次很有说服力的演说。

else.zh: 其他每个人都快喝醉了。

elsewhere.zh: 这里的价格比其他地方高。

elsewhere.en: Our troops are to be redeployed elsewhere.
elsewhere.zh: 我们的部队将被重新部署到其他地区。

elsewhere.en: The answer to the problem must be sought elsewhere.
elsewhere.zh: 这个问题的答案必须在别处寻找。

embark.en: Some forethought and preparation is necessary before you embark on the project.
embark.zh: 你着手进行这个项目之前必须有所考虑，有所准备。

embark.en: For some women I know, this sense of trust and self-belief later in life gave them the courage to leave dysfunctional relationships or embark on new career paths.
embark.zh: 对一些我认识的女性来说，这种信任感和自信心在日后给了她们离开不正常人际关系的勇气，或是从事新职业的勇气。

embark.en: Faced withunknown challenges, they are audacious enough to embark on a perilous journey while most of their peers enjoy stable salaries by working as white-collars at high-end office buildings.
embark.zh: 面对未知的挑战，他们敢于踏上一段危险的旅程，而他们的同龄人大多在高端写字楼里做白领，享受着稳定的薪水。

embassy.zh: 伊朗重新开放了在伦敦的大使馆。

embassy.en: They took refuge in the embassy compound.
embassy.zh: 他们在大使馆围区内避难。
美国使馆已经提出抗议。

embed.en: In fact, the process can embed small flaws in the genes of clones that scientists are only now discovering.
embed.zh: 事实上，这个过程可能会在克隆的基因中嵌入一些小的缺陷，而科学家们直到现在才发现这些缺陷。

embed.en: First of all, he wanted to embed in his upcoming high potentials, the user application of really advanced investment theory.
embed.zh: 首先，他想在他即将到来的高潜力中，嵌入真正先进的投资理论的用户应用。

embed.en: Not only did they develop such a device but by the turn of the millennium they had also managed to embed it in a worldwide system accessed by billions of people every day.
embed.zh: 他们不仅开发了这样一种设备，而且在世纪之交，他们还成功地将其嵌入到每天有数十亿人访问的全球系统中。

embarrass.en: I didn't want to embarrass him by kissing him in front of his friends.
embarrass.zh: 我并没想当着他的朋友吻他而使他感到难堪。

embarrass.en: When you embarrass me, I'll tell you.
embarrass.zh: 你要是使我感到难堪，我就会跟你说的。

embarrass.en: They were my friends, and I just didn't want to embarrass them publicly.
embarrass.zh: 他们是我的朋友，我只是不想公开说让他们难堪的话。

embody.en: As a ballerina, to embody the duality of the Swan Queen and the black swan can be a fiendishly difficult task.
embody.zh: 作为一名芭蕾舞女演员，体现天鹅女王和黑天鹅的二元性可能是一项极其困难的任务。

embody.en: Indeed, the streets of San Jose seem, in some ways, to embody the best of America.
embody.zh: 的确，圣何塞的街道在某些方面似乎展现出美国最好的一面。

embody.en: British cars, once memorably described as a skip on wheels, have come to embody the national humiliation of that benighted era.
embody.zh: 英国汽车在记忆中一度被称为车轮上的跳板，如今已成为那个愚昧时代的国耻象征。

embrace.en: He held her in a warm embrace.
He opened his arms wide to embrace her.

emit.en: The metal container began to emit a clicking sound.
emit.zh: 金属容器开始发出咔嗒咔嗒的声音。

emit.en: These cars emit more than all the microwaves in the EU.
emit.zh: 这些汽车的排放量超过了欧盟国家所有微波炉的排放量。

emit.en: Soil tilling releases carbon dioxide, and delivery vehicles emit exhaust.
emit.zh: 耕作翻土会释放二氧化碳，而运输车辆会排放废气。

emerge.en: Further evidence of slowing economic growth is likely to emerge this week.
emerge.zh: 更多有关在减慢的经济增长的证据本周可能出现。

emerge.en: The cultural life of the country will sink into atrophy unless more writers and artists emerge.
emerge.zh: 如果没有更多的作家和艺术家出现，这个国家的文化生活将衰退。
新的事物每天都在出现。

emergency.en: The government had to take emergency action.
emergency.zh: 政府只得采取紧急措施。

emergency.en: The government decreed a state of emergency.
emergency.zh: 政府下令进入紧急状态。

emotion.zh: 曼迪的主导情绪是困惑。

emperor.en: The Emperor kept himself aloof from the people.
emperor.zh: 这个皇帝对人民漠不关心。

emperor.en: Mr. Ying is well-known for his portrayal of a prison guard in the film "The Last Emperor."
emperor.zh: 英先生因在《末代皇帝》中扮演一个监狱看守而出名。

emotional.zh: 困惑焦灼的情绪使我心力交瘁。

emotional.en: They made an emotional appeal for help.
emotional.zh: 他们情绪激动地恳求救助。

emotional.en: The debate was highly emotional at times.

emphasis.zh: 这门课程着重职业培训。

emphasis.en: Too much emphasis is placed on research.
emphasis.zh: 把重点过多地放在研究上。

emphasis.en: Our company puts the emphasis on quality.

emphasize.en: He flourished the glass to emphasize the point.
emphasize.zh: 他挥舞着杯子来强调这一点。

emphasize.en: I tried to emphasize my good points without sounding boastful.
emphasize.zh: 我在强调自己的优点时尽量不让人觉得是在自我吹嘘。

emphasize.en: Economists emphasize measurable quantities – the number of jobs, the per capita income.
emphasize.zh: 经济学家们强调可以测算的量–职位数量，人均收入。

empire.en: She once ruled over a vast empire.
empire.zh: 她曾统治过一个幅员辽阔的帝国。

empire.en: The Ottoman empire was a Sunni state.
empire.zh: 奥斯曼帝国是逊尼派国家。

empirical.en: There is no empirical evidence to support his thesis.
empirical.zh: 没有实证根据来支持他的论点。

empirical.en: The empirical evidence considered here is subject to many qualifications.
empirical.zh: 这里所考虑的经验证据有许多限制条件。

empirical.en: They place great emphasis on empirical studies.
empirical.zh: 他们非常重视实证研究。

employ.en: How many people does the company employ?
employ.zh: 这个公司雇用了多少人？

employ.en: We employ an expert to advise on new technology.
employ.zh: 我们聘用了一位专家担任新技术顾问。

employ.en: We'll have to check him out before we employ him.
employ.zh: 我们得先调查一下再雇用他。

employee.en: He is an employee of Fuji Bank.
employee.zh: 他是富士银行的一位雇员。

employee.en: One of the main themes of TQM is employee involvement.
employee.zh: 全员质量管理的一个主要原则之一是雇员参与。

employee.en: He found it demeaning to work for his former employee.
employee.zh: 他觉得为自己以前的雇员工作有失体面。

employer.en: He had been sent to Rome by his employer.
employer.zh: 他被雇主派到罗马去了。

employer.en: She decided to sue her employer for wrongful dismissal.
employer.zh: 她决定起诉雇主非法解雇她。

employer.en: The company has proved to be a most benevolent employer.
employer.zh: 结果证明该公司是一个非常仁慈的雇主。

employment.zh: 就业是一个非常敏感的问题。

employment.en: The government is aiming at full employment.
employment.zh: 政府在力求达到全面就业。

enable.en: The new test should enable doctors to detect the disease early.
enable.zh: 新的检验使医生能在早期发现该种疾病。

enable.en: This will enable the audience to sit in comfort while watching the shows.
enable.zh: 这能使观众看演出时舒服地坐着。

enable.en: The spacecraft will enable scientists to study some dark corners of the solar system.
enable.zh: 太空船使得科学家可以研究太阳系中一些不为人知的角落。

enclosure.en: Within those precincts, within that enclosure, there's a large, open courtyard.
enclosure.zh: 在这些区域内，在围墙内，有一个大的、开放的庭院。

enclosure.en: Without this enclosure, but just within the street entrance, sat a grey-haired gentleman at a small table, with a large open ledger of some kind before him.
enclosure.zh: 没有围墙，就在街口，一位白发苍苍的绅士坐在一张小桌旁，面前摆着一本打开的大账本。

enclosure.en: This enclosure was so vast that the outermost wall could hardly be seen.
enclosure.zh: 这块圈地大得几乎看不见它最外面的围墙。

enclose.en: Please enclose your remittance, making checks payable to Valley Technology Services.
enclose.zh: 请随信附上您的汇款，支票收款方为瓦利科技服务公司。
请附上写明姓名地址的回邮信封。

enclose.en: I enclose two tickets along with this letter.

empty.en: Do not let the golden cup remain empty beneath the moon.

empty.zh: 安德鲁压扁了他的空罐子。

endeavor.en: I endeavor to find some peaceful places.
endeavor.zh: 我努力寻找一些宁静的地方。

endeavor.en: Which means Haegele isn't the only person trying to cut plastic out of her life—she isn't even the only one blogging about this kind of endeavor.
endeavor.zh: 这意味着黑格尔并不是唯一一个试图将塑料从她的生活中剔除的人——她甚至不是唯一一个在博客上谈论这种努力的人。

endeavor.en: In any field of endeavor, it is impossible to make a significant contribution without first being strongly influenced by past achievements within that field.
endeavor.zh: 在任何努力领域，如果不首先受到该领域过去成就的强烈影响，就不可能作出重大贡献。

encounter.en: People will encounter their destiny on the path of escaping from it.
encounter.zh: 人会在逃避命运的路上，遇见自己的命运。

encounter.en: Did you encounter anyone in the building?
encounter.zh: 你在那栋大楼里偶然遇到什么人了吗？

encounter.en: In high school, I was very unpopular, and I did encounter a little prejudice.
encounter.zh: 在中学，我很不受欢迎，确实遇到了一点偏见。

encourage.zh: 父母鼓励一切可能的活动。

encourage.en: They encourage boys to be sensitive and artistic.
encourage.zh: 他们鼓励男孩子们要反应敏感并有美术才能。

encourage.en: They'd got a special grant to encourage research.
encourage.zh: 他们已得到了一笔用来支持研究的特别补助金。

end.zh: 他们住在最后的那座房子。
服务员这一工作没什么前途。

endow.en: Herbs have been used for centuries to endow a whole range of foods with subtle flavours.
endow.zh: 香草几个世纪以来一直被用来赋予各种食品细腻的味道。

endow.en: With advice from AI specialists, art designers and culture researchers, our multi-language experts endow Lancom with an enormous potential for innovation within the world of language learning.
endow.zh: 在人工智能专家、艺术设计师和文化研究者的建议下，我们的多语言专家赋予了 Lancom 以巨大的语言学习创新潜力。

endow.en: They were deploring their parents' omission to endow them with so splendid a means of appealing to the Zamindar.
endow.zh: 他们在抱怨着他们的父母没有赋予他们这种向地主请愿的卓越口才。

ending.en: The movie had a really tacky ending.
ending.zh: 这部电影的结尾真差劲。

endless.en: I've had enough of their endless arguing.
endless.zh: 我听够了他们无休止的争吵。

endurance.en: He showed remarkable endurance throughout his illness.
endurance.zh: 他在整个生病期间表现出非凡的忍耐力。

endurance.en: The exercise obviously will improve strength and endurance.
endurance.zh: 这项练习将明显增强力量和耐力。

endurance.en: He used to astound his friends with feats of physical endurance.
endurance.zh: 他过去常以身体耐力之好令其朋友们震惊。

enemy.zh: 那个小镇落到敌人手里了。
敌人拥有战术上的优势。

endure.en: She could not endure the thought of parting.
endure.zh: 一想到分别她就无法忍受。

endure.en: He had to endure six months' loss of liberty.
endure.zh: 他得忍受六个月失去自由之苦。

energetic.en: He seemed a dynamic and energetic leader.
energetic.zh: 他看来是个富有创新力与活力的领导。

energetic.en: The company is trying to create a young energetic image.
energetic.zh: 这家公司正试图塑造一个充满活力的年轻形象。

energy.en: It's a waste of time and energy.

enforce.en: The legislation will be difficult to enforce.
It's the job of the police to enforce the law.
Desegregation may be harder to enforce in rural areas.
enforce.zh: 废除种族隔离可能更难在乡村地区实施。

engage.en: Even in prison, he continued to engage in criminal activities.
engage.zh: 他甚至在监狱里还继续从事犯罪活动。

engage.en: They never learned skills to engage the attention of the others.
engage.zh: 他们从来没有学过吸引别人注意的技巧。

engage.en: They tried to engage him in conversation.
engage.zh: 他们试图使他加入谈话。

engagement.zh: 那是她第一次正式约会。

engine.zh: 发动机劈劈啪啪响了一阵后便熄火了。

engineer.en: His father meant him to be an engineer.
engineer.zh: 他父亲想让他当工程师。

engineer.en: We engaged the services of a famous engineer.
engineer.zh: 我们聘了一位有名的工程师来帮忙。

engineer.en: He looked at the design with the eye of an engineer.
engineer.zh: 他以工程师的眼光审视这个设计。

engineering.zh: 她在一家工程公司工作。

engineering.en: He has not studied mechanics or engineering.
engineering.zh: 他没有学习过力学或者工程学。

engineering.en: The bridge is a triumph of modern engineering.
engineering.zh: 这座桥是现代工程的一大成就。

England.zh: 苏格兰队以5:1大胜英格兰队。
当时是约翰统治着英格兰。

English.zh: 英语是我学得最好的一门科目。

enlarge.en: There are plans to enlarge the recreation area.
enlarge.zh: 已经有了扩大娱乐场地的计划。

enlarge.en: He didn't enlarge on the form that the interim government and assembly would take.
enlarge.zh: 他未详述临时政府和议会将会采取的形式。

enhance.en: This is an opportunity to enhance the reputation of the company.
enhance.zh: 这是提高公司声誉的机会。

enhance.en: The White House is eager to protect and enhance that reputation.
enhance.zh: 白宫急于保护并提高那声望。

enhance.en: Large paintings can enhance the feeling of space in small rooms.
enhance.zh: 大幅画作能增加小房间的宽敞感。

enlighten.en: It was an elite that believed its task was to enlighten the multitude.
enlighten.zh: 精英人物都会认为自己的职责就是启迪群众。

enlighten.en: A few dedicated doctors have fought for years to enlighten the profession.
enlighten.zh: 少数富有献身精神的医生为启蒙这一行业而奋斗多年。

enlighten.en: Instead, she set up Enlighten our Future, a charity that reaches students in the countryside how to write poems.
enlighten.zh: 相反，她成立了一个名为“启迪我们的未来”的慈善机构，教导农村的学生如何写诗。

enormous.en: The problems facing the President are enormous.
enormous.zh: 总统面临的问题是巨大的。

enormous.en: She gets enormous pleasure out of working freelance.
enormous.zh: 她从事自由职业感受到极大的乐趣。

enrich.zh: 文学可以丰富你的精神生活。

enrich.en: While improving material well-being, we should also enrich our spiritual life.
enrich.zh: 我们在改善物质生活的同时，也要充实精神生活。

enrich.en: He used his position to enrich himself.

enroll.en: It is not necessary to enroll before the course starts.
enroll.zh: 不需要在课程开始前注册。

enroll.en: Please enroll with the secretary before Friday this week.
enroll.zh: 请在本周五之前到秘书处登记。

enroll.en: So you'll just enroll in a thesis seminar for the second semester.
enroll.zh: 所以你只需要在第二学期报名注册一个论文研讨会就可以了。

ensue.en: If the Europeans did not reduce subsidies, a trade war would ensue.
ensue.zh: 如果欧洲不减少补贴，贸易战将随即爆发。

ensue.en: Peacock feathers should never be brought on stage, either as a costume element, prop or part of a set as chaos will ensue.
ensue.zh: 孔雀羽毛应该永远不带上舞台，不能作为服装元素，道具或者布景的一部分，否则混乱将接踵而来。

ensure.en: We tried to ensure that everyone got a fair deal.
ensure.zh: 我们曾尽力保证每个人都受到公平待遇。

ensure.en: Ensure there is a free flow of air around the machine.
ensure.zh: 要确保机器周围空气畅通。

ensure.en: Our role is to ensure liaison between schools and parents.
ensure.zh: 我们的作用是确保学校与家长间的联系。

entail.en: What kind of responsibilities does that job entail?
entail.zh: 那份工作需要承担什么样的责任？

entail.en: Self-awareness, even in its earliest stages, might entail an awareness of others, the ability to see their perspective, to look at the world from another's point of view.
entail.zh: 自我意识，即使在它的最初阶段，也可能需要他人意识，即从他人的角度看世界的能力。

entail.en: It will entail driving a long distance every day.
entail.zh: 这意味着每天都要长途开车。

enter.en: The sentry would not let her enter.
The police observed a man enter the bank.
enter.zh: 警察注意到一个男人走进了银行。

enterprise.en: Horse breeding is indeed a risky enterprise.
enterprise.zh: 养马的确是一项有风险的事业。

enterprise.en: State bureaucracies can tend to stifle enterprise and initiative.
enterprise.zh: 国家官僚体制会压抑人的进取心和积极性。

enterprise.en: Its geographical location stimulated overseas mercantile enterprise.
enterprise.zh: 它的地理位置激发了海外商业企业的兴趣。

entertain.en: I don't like to entertain guests anymore.
She had to entertain some boring local bigwigs.
entertain.zh: 她不得不款待当地一些无聊的大人物。

entertain.en: The aim of the series is both to entertain and inform.
entertain.zh: 这个系列节目旨在集知识和娱乐为一体。

entertainment.zh: 这是典型的家庭娱乐活动。

entertainment.en: What do you do for entertainment out here?
The newscast covers topical events and entertainment.
entertainment.zh: 该新闻广播涉及时事和娱乐。

enthusiasm.zh: 热情是非常具有感染力的。
他以其特有的热情讲话。

enthusiastic.zh: 他是个热情的滑雪爱好者。

enthusiastic.en: Romeo left the stage, to enthusiastic applause.
enthusiastic.zh: 罗密欧在热烈的掌声中离开了舞台。

entire.zh: 她把吃的饭全吐出来了。

entity.en: These countries can no longer be viewed as a single entity.
entity.zh: 这些国家不能再被看成是一个单独的实体。

entity.en: He rescued the company and later spun off its textile division into a separate entity.
entity.zh: 他挽救了该公司，后来又把它的纺织部脱离出来组建成一个独立实体。

entity.en: The unit has become part of a larger department and no longer exists as a separate entity.
entity.zh: 这个单位已附属于一个大的部门，不再作为一个实体独立存在。

entitle.en: This ticket does not entitle you to travel first class.
entitle.zh: 你拿这张票不能坐头等舱。

entitle.en: If the warranty is limited, the terms may entitle you to a replacement or refund.
entitle.zh: 如果保修单有限制，这些条款可让你有权换货或退款。

entitle.en: Golden parachutes entitle them to a full year's salary if they get booted out of the company.
entitle.zh: 黄金降落伞使他们一旦被公司解雇将有权获得一整年的薪水。

entrance.en: The entrance hall is littered with toys.
entrance.zh: 入口大厅里散落着玩具。

entrance.en: A lighthouse marks the entrance to the harbour.
entrance.zh: 灯塔是进入海港航道的标志。

entrepreneur.en: An entrepreneur is more than just a risk taker. He is a visionary.
entrepreneur.zh: 企业家不仅是个冒险者，还是一个有远见的人。
美国企业家史蒂夫·乔布斯对这一点坚信不疑。

entrepreneur.en: It was designed and built for a local entrepreneur and his family.
entrepreneur.zh: 它是为一位当地企业家和他的家人设计和建造的。

envelope.en: Why do you sit there looking like an envelope without any address on it?
envelope.zh: 为什么你坐在那儿，看上去像是一个没写地址的信封？
她打开了带有香味的信封。

envelope.en: He stuck a stamp on the envelope.
envelope.zh: 他把一张邮票贴到信封上。

entry.en: He made a triumphal entry into the city.
entry.zh: 他作为胜利者进入那座城市。

entry.en: He made his triumphal entry into Mexico City.
entry.zh: 他胜利进入了墨西哥城。

environment.zh: 儿童需要一个充满关怀的环境。

environment.en: He has always been pro the environment.
The environment has become a very hot issue.
environment.zh: 环境已成为很热门的话题。

envisage.en: I can't envisage her coping with this job.
envisage.zh: 我无法设想她如何应付这个工作。

envisage.en: What level of profit do you envisage?
envisage.zh: 你预计会有什么样的利润水平？

envisage.en: I don't envisage working with him again.
envisage.zh: 我想象不出再与他一起工作的可能。

envy.en: I envy you having such a close family.
envy.zh: 我羡慕你有这么一个亲密的家庭。

envy.en: Their economy is the envy of the developing world.
envy.zh: 他们的经济令发展中国家羡慕。
我庆幸不必干她的那份工作。

episode.en: The final episode will be shown next Sunday.
episode.zh: 最后一集将于下周日播放。

episode.en: It makes you want to watch the next episode to find out what's going to happen.
episode.zh: 这使你想看下一集，以弄清接下来要发生什么。

episode.en: The first episode is the real first episode, which tells about the destruction of the earth.
episode.zh: 第一集就是真正的第一集，讲述了地球的毁灭。

epoch.en: It was meant to sound like an epoch-making declaration.
epoch.zh: 有意让它听起来像是一个划时代的宣言。

epoch.en: The birth of Christ was the beginning of a major epoch of world history.
epoch.zh: 基督的诞生是世界历史一个重要时代的开始。

epoch.en: The Pleistocene Epoch was an ice age.
epoch.zh: 更新世是一段冰河时代。

equality.en: All our activities are premised on the basis of "Quality with Equality."
equality.zh: 我们所有活动都是以“优质、平等”为基本前提的。

equality.en: Zach insists that he is but one among many who are fighting for equality.
equality.zh: 扎克坚持认为他仅仅是许多为平等而战的人们中的一个。

equality.en: Europe is not a gender-equality heaven.
equality.zh: 欧洲不是性别平等的天堂。

equator.zh: 全球定位系统在赤道附近性能最好。

equator.en: The equator is an imaginary line around the middle of the earth.
equator.zh: 赤道是一条假想的环绕地球腰部的线。

equator.en: All the planets orbit the Sun in roughly the same plane, around its equator.
equator.zh: 所有行星基本在同一个平面上围绕太阳赤道运转。

equation.en: X and Y in the equation are both unknowns.
equation.zh: 等式中的X和Y都是未知数。

equation.en: This figure is reached by a fiendishly clever equation.
equation.zh: 这个数值是用及其巧妙的方程解出来的。

equation.en: The equation is impossible for any value of n greater than 2.
equation.zh: 这个等式对于任何大于2的数值都不成立。

equal.zh: 我们在各方面都是平等的。

equal.en: They had fought hard for equal rights.
equal.zh: 他们为了获得平等权利已经进行了顽强的斗争。
婚姻应当是平等的伴侣关系。

equilibrium.en: We have achieved an equilibrium in the economy.
equilibrium.zh: 我们已在经济上达到平衡。

equilibrium.en: He sat down to try and recover his equilibrium.
equilibrium.zh: 他坐了下来，努力恢复平静。

equilibrium.en: Any disturbance to the body's state of equilibrium can produce stress.
equilibrium.zh: 对身体平衡状态的任何干扰都可能产生压力。

equipment.zh: 我们所有的计算机设备都是租来的。

equipment.en: The equipment can be tricky to install.
equipment.zh: 这设备安装起来可能很费事。

equip.en: She got a bank loan to rent and equip a small workshop.
equip.zh: 她取得一笔银行贷款来租用和装备一个小车间。

equip.en: The charity provided money to staff and equip two hospitals.
equip.zh: 这个慈善机构提供资金装备了两家医院并配备了人员。

equip.en: Owners of restaurants have to equip them to admit disabled people.
equip.zh: 餐馆老板们必须给餐馆配备接纳残疾人的设施。

equivalent.en: Zip disks could be used to store the equivalent of three music CDs.
equivalent.zh: 压缩盘能用以存储相当于3张音乐CD容量的内容。

equivalent.en: The German 'Gymnasium' is the closest equivalent to the grammar school in England.
equivalent.zh: 德语Gymnasium基本上相当于英格兰的文法学校。

equivalent.en: The helmets are designed to withstand impacts equivalent to a fall from a bicycle.
equivalent.zh: 头盔设计成能承受相当于从自行车上摔下来的力度。

era.en: It was, if you like, the dawn of a new era.
era.zh: 换句话说，那就是新时代的黎明。

era.en: These talks could herald a new era of peace.
era.zh: 这些谈判可能预示着新的和平时代的来临。

erect.en: They plan to erect an apartment house on that property.
erect.zh: 他们计划在那片地产上建造一座公寓楼。

erect.en: Your job, as captain of your soul, is to erect dams to keep these passions in check.
erect.zh: 作为灵魂的船长，你的工作就是竖起堤坝来控制这些激情。

erect.en: Police had to erect barriers to keep crowds back.
erect.zh: 警察只得设立路障来阻截人群。

erroneous.en: Some people have the erroneous notion that one can contract AIDS by giving blood.
erroneous.zh: 有些人有这样一种错误的观念：认为献血会染上艾滋病。

erroneous.en: Proper measures were taken as soon as the erroneous ideas cropped up.
erroneous.zh: 错误思想一冒头，就及时采取了措施。

erroneous.en: Allen's contribution was to take an assumption we all share—that because we are not robots we therefore control our thoughts—and reveal its erroneous nature.
erroneous.zh: 艾伦的贡献在于提出了一个我们都认同的假设——因为我们不是机器人，所以我们控制自己的思想——并揭示了这个假设的错误本质。

erosion.en: Soil erosion was mitigated by the planting of trees.
erosion.zh: 植树造林减轻了土壤侵蚀。

erosion.en: More familiar landscapes have been sculpted by surface erosion.
erosion.zh: 更多熟悉的地形是由地表侵蚀形成的。

erosion.en: We'll never be able to stop beach erosion, we can only stave it off.
erosion.zh: 我们永远都不能阻止海滩被侵蚀，我们只能暂缓其发生。

erupt.en: Ash began to erupt from the crater.
erupt.zh: 火山灰开始从火山口喷出。

erupt.en: The volcano could erupt at any time.
erupt.zh: 这座火山随时可能爆发。

erupt.en: He avers that chaos will erupt if he loses.
erupt.zh: 他断言如果他失败将会爆发动乱。

error.zh: 维森佐没能发现这个错误。

error.en: It was an error on my part.
The survey has a margin of error of 2.5%.

escort.en: Police were called to escort her off the premises.
He arrived with a police escort shortly before half past nine.
escort.zh: 快到9点半时，他由警察护送到达了。

escort.en: Policemen had to escort the referee from the football field.
escort.zh: 警察不得不护送这位裁判离开足球场。

especially.en: I love Rome, especially in the spring.
especially.zh: 我喜爱罗马，尤其是春天的罗马。
她喜爱各种运动，尤其是游泳。

essay.zh: 这篇文章满篇皆是引语。

essay.en: She got top marks for her essay.

essence.en: The essence of dialectical thought is division.
essence.zh: 辩证思想的实质是二分法。

essence.en: Though complicated in detail, local taxes are in essence simple.
essence.zh: 虽然细节复杂，地方税本质上是简单的。

essence.en: For many, the essence of French living is to be found in the rural heartlands.
essence.zh: 对许多人来说，法国生活方式的精髓要到心脏地带的乡村去寻找。

essential.zh: 金钱对于幸福并非必不可少。
对于这个工作，经验是非常重要的。
让我们只概述一下基本要点吧。

establish.en: Ukraine indicated that it would establish its own army, 400,000 strong.
establish.zh: 乌克兰表示它将建立自己的军队，多达40万人。

establish.en: We're trying to establish linkages between these groups and financial institutions.
establish.zh: 我们正试图建立这些团体和金融机构间的联系。

establish.en: Police are trying to establish the cause of death.

establishment.en: The speaker announced the establishment of a new college.
establishment.zh: 发言人宣布了新学院的成立。

establishment.en: It will result in the establishment of the world's largest marine reserve.
establishment.zh: 它将促成建立世界上最大的海洋保护区。

establishment.en: The hotel is a comfortable and well-run establishment.
establishment.zh: 这家旅馆环境舒适且经营良好。

esthetic.en: Only is has in one whole esthetic sense.
esthetic.zh: 只是有着一种整体上的美感。

esthetic.en: From the esthetic view, it was a beautiful continent.
esthetic.zh: 从美学的观点来看，那是一个美丽的大陆。

esthetic.en: There is an inherent connection among beauty, esthetic judgment, and beauty creation.
esthetic.zh: 美、审美、创美的超越性特征具有内在的逻辑联系。

estate.en: He made a fortune in real estate.

estate.zh: 房地产依然是买方市场。

eternal.en: He has the upbeat manner of an eternal optimist.
eternal.zh: 他永远都持乐观主义者的那种快乐态度。

eternal.en: Allow me to embrace you as a sign of my eternal gratitude.
eternal.zh: 请允许我拥抱你，以表达我永远的感激之情。

estimate.en: That estimate was right on the mark.

estimate.zh: 警方估计聚集的人有3万。

ethics.en: It is a question of the relation of ethics to economics.
ethics.zh: 这是个道德和经济之间关系的问题。
个人道德与职业道德之间有时会相冲突。

ethics.en: Refugee workers said such action was a violation of medical ethics.
ethics.zh: 难民工作者称这种行为违背了医学道德。

ethnic.en: The police are trying to recruit more officers from ethnic minorities.
ethnic.zh: 警察机关正试图从少数民族中征募更多的新警员。

ethnic.en: There is a crying need for more magistrates from the ethnic minority communities.
ethnic.zh: 迫切需要更多来自少数民族社区的官员。

ethnic.en: They've been living and working peacefully with members of various ethnic groups.
ethnic.zh: 他们一直与各种族群的成员们和平地生活和工作。

Europe.zh: 他们一路搭便车周游欧洲。
美国有线新闻网络也在欧洲进行广播。
我对欧洲并不充满幻想。

European.zh: 大多数欧洲蜘蛛不咬人。

European.en: The tour takes in six European capitals.
European.zh: 这次旅游包括六个欧洲国家的首都。

European.en: London was different from most European capitals.
European.zh: 伦敦与大多数的欧洲首都城市不同。

evaporate.en: Blasting cold air over it makes the water evaporate.
evaporate.zh: 向它上面快速喷冷气可使水蒸发掉。

evaporate.en: It is more difficult for gases to "evaporate" from them.
evaporate.zh: 气体更难从中“蒸发”出来。

evaporate.en: Some of the compounds in the oil evaporate reduce their impact on the environment.
evaporate.zh: 漏油中的一些化合物的蒸发能够降低它们对环境的影响。

evaluate.en: The market situation is difficult to evaluate.
We need to learn how to evaluate them properly.
evaluate.zh: 我们需要学习如何正确地评估它们。

evaluate.en: For each side of the subject, think carefully and evaluate it.
evaluate.zh: 对于主题的每一方面，都要仔细思考和评估。

eve.en: Richard had turned up on Christmas Eve with Tony.
eve.zh: 理查德在圣诞前夜与托尼一起出现。

eve.en: On New Year's Eve we had a barbecue on the beach.
eve.zh: 除夕那天我们在海滩上举行了烧烤野餐。

eve.en: On New Year's Eve I usually give a party, which is always chaotic.
eve.zh: 除夕日，我通常举办一个聚会，总是一片狼藉。

evening.zh: 我一晚上都没有摆脱心中的疑虑。

even.zh: 即使他的赞扬也是可以有两种解释的。
即便是朋友有时也有分歧。

event.en: The event was voted a great success.
event.zh: 大家认为这项活动很成功。

event.en: The election was the main event of 2004.
event.zh: 那次选举是2004年的主要大事。

event.en: The event is open to all comers.
event.zh: 所有人均可参加这项比赛。

eventually.zh: 摄影机最终将镜头推远。

eventually.en: They eventually rolled up two hours late.
eventually.zh: 他们最终晚来了两小时。

ever.zh: 配偶的不忠行为究竟可以被原谅吗？

everybody.zh: 这个消息鼓舞了每个人。
大家都准备好了吗？开演！

every.zh: 我每天晚上都慢跑锻炼。
每个人的学习方式都不一样。

everyday.en: The Internet has become part of everyday life.
everyday.zh: 互联网已成为日常生活的一部分。

everyday.en: Complaints seemed to be an everyday occurrence.
everyday.zh: 投诉似乎成了天天发生的事。

everyday.en: Her novels are anchored in everyday experience.
everyday.zh: 她的小说取材自日常生活经验。

everyone.zh: 这消息使大家十分惊讶。
唱到副歌时，大家都跟着齐唱起来。

everywhere.zh: 吸烟到处都是被禁止的。

evident.en: The threat of inflation is already evident in bond prices.
evident.zh: 通货膨胀的威胁在证券价格上已经是明显可见的。

evident.en: It was evident that someone had gone through my possessions.
evident.zh: 显然有人翻过我的物品。

evident.en: The privations of monastery life were evident in his appearance.
evident.zh: 修道院生活的清苦从他的穿着外表明显地表露出来。

evidence.zh: 我当时没有明确而具体的证据。

evil.en: Good and evil may co-exist within one family.
evil.zh: 善与恶可能共存于同一个家庭。

evil.en: He said that we were evil, malignant, and mean.
evil.zh: 他说我们邪恶、恶毒、卑鄙。

evil.en: You cannot pretend there's no evil in the world.
evil.zh: 你不能睁着眼睛瞎说世界上没有罪恶。

evoke.en: His case is unlikely to evoke public sympathy.
evoke.zh: 他的情况不大可能引起公众的同情。

evoke.en: It became apparent that smell can evoke strong emotional responses.
evoke.zh: 很明显，气味可以引起强烈的情绪反应。

evoke.en: Why do the seal's laboratory dives always evoke this response, regardless of their length or depth?
evoke.zh: 为什么不管它们潜水的长度和深度如何，海豹在实验室潜水时总是会引起这种反应？

evolution.en: Darwin eventually put forward a model of biological evolution.
evolution.zh: 达尔文最终提出了一套生物进化的理论模式。

evolution.en: We're dealing with probably the biggest missing link in what we know about human evolution.
evolution.zh: 我们正在解决的可能是我们所知的人类进化过程中缺失最大的一环。

evolution.en: What is the first step in evolution?

evolve.en: It is interesting that Chinese characters evolve from pictures and signs.
evolve.zh: 有趣的是，汉字是由图画和符号演变而来的。

evolve.en: So why would animals evolve a characteristic that seems to endanger them?
evolve.zh: 那么，为什么动物会进化出一种似乎会危及它们自身的特性呢？

evolve.en: Sometimes primary group relationships evolve out of secondary group relationships.
evolve.zh: 有时主要的群体关系从次要的群体关系演变而来。

exact.en: What is the exact location of the ship?
exact.zh: 那条船的确切位置在哪里？

exact.en: The exact length of each period may vary.
exact.zh: 每一时期的确切持续时间可能有所不同。

exaggerate.en: These figures exaggerate the loss of competitiveness.
exaggerate.zh: 这些数字夸大了竞争力的下降。

exaggerate.en: A painter may exaggerate or distort shapes and forms.
exaggerate.zh: 画家可能会夸大或扭曲形状与形式。

exam.zh: 他轻而易举地通过了考试。

examination.zh: 你的提议仍在审查之中。

examination.en: You will need to have a routine biannual examination.
examination.zh: 你需要做一年两次的常规检查。

examination.en: All students without exception must take the English examination.
examination.zh: 所有学生都必须参加英语考试，无一例外。

examine.en: It is necessary to examine how the proposals can be carried out.
examine.zh: 有必要调查一下怎样才能实施这些方案。

examine.en: We examine the wording in detail before deciding on the final text.
examine.zh: 我们详细检查了措辞，才确定了最终文本。

examine.en: The committee will examine the agreement and any problems arising therefrom.
examine.zh: 委员会将审查这项协议和由此引起的问题。

exceed.en: It is dangerous to exceed the recommended dose.
exceed.zh: 超过建议使用的剂量会有危险。

exceed.en: Your intake of alcohol should not exceed two units per day.
exceed.zh: 你每天酒精摄入量不能超过两个单位。

exceed.en: You risk incurring bank charges if you exceed your overdraft limit.
exceed.zh: 如果超出了透支限额，就有被银行加收费用的风险。

exceedingly.zh: 我们吃了一顿极其丰盛的午餐。

exceedingly.en: Even in summer this place did not look exactly hospitable: in winter, conditions must have been exceedingly harsh.
exceedingly.zh: 即使在夏天，这个地方看上去也并不太宜人：在冬天，条件一定非常恶劣。

exceedingly.en: I am exceedingly delighted to hear from you.
exceedingly.zh: 我非常高兴收到你的来信。

example.en: She is a shining example to us all.
example.zh: 她是我们所有人的光辉榜样。

example.en: Her courage is an example to us all.
example.zh: 她的勇气是我们大家的榜样。

exception.en: There is one exception to this general principle.
exception.zh: 这个一般性原则有一例外。

exception.en: No one could possibly take exception to his comments.
exception.zh: 任何人都不可能对他的意见提出异议。

exception.en: Nobody had much money at the time and I was no exception.
exception.zh: 那时候谁都没有很多钱，我也不例外。

except.zh: 我们除星期天外每天都工作。
除足球外我喜欢所有的运动。

exceptional.en: This deadline will be extended only in exceptional circumstances.
exceptional.zh: 只有在特殊情况下才会延长最后期限。

exceptional.en: Capital punishment is allowable only under exceptional circumstances.
exceptional.zh: 只有在特殊情况下才允许判死刑。

excite.en: Daniel's early exposure to motor racing did not excite his interest.
excite.zh: 丹尼尔早期对赛车运动的接触并没有激起他的兴趣。

excite.en: We tend to have a good memory for things that excite our senses or appeal to our emotions.
excite.zh: 我们往往记得那些能够激起我们的共鸣或者诉诸情感的事物。

excite.en: Such a view, however, fails to explain the ability of some works of art to excite the human mind.
excite.zh: 然而，这种观点并不能解释为什么某些艺术作品能够激发人类思维。

excessive.en: Excessive conformity is usually caused by fear of disapproval.
excessive.zh: 过分随大流通常是由于担心不被认同造成的。

excessive.en: Excessive pressure can lead to perforation of the stomach wall.
excessive.zh: 过大的压力会导致胃壁穿孔。

excessive.en: The police vigorously denied that excessive force had been used.
excessive.zh: 警方坚决否认曾过度使用武力。

excess.zh: 多余的食物作为脂肪贮存起来。

excess.en: In an excess of enthusiasm I agreed to work late.
excess.zh: 我一时热情过度答应了工作到很晚。

excess.en: The plane circled the airport to burn up excess fuel.
excess.zh: 飞机在机场上空盘旋以耗掉多余的燃料。

exchange.en: Shares soared on the New York stock exchange.
exchange.zh: 纽约证券交易所股票暴涨。

exchange.en: Trading on the stock exchange may be suspended.
What's the rate of exchange against the dollar?
exchange.zh: 与美元的兑换率是多少？

exclaim.en: The spectacular sunrise made us exclaim in surprise.
exclaim.zh: 壮观的日出让我们惊叹不已。

exclaim.en: That's why you exclaim "Ouch" after staying away from the pain signals you encountered before.
exclaim.zh: 那就是为什么你远离开始遇到的疼痛信号后才惊叫“哎呦”的原因。

exclaim.en: Could we render this inimitable picture properly, then would everybody exclaim, "Beautiful, unparalleled Italy!"
exclaim.zh: 如果我们能把这幅独一无二的图画恰当地描绘出来，那么人人都会惊叹：“美丽无比的意大利！”

exciting.zh: 他说，“天哪！这真是太令人兴奋了！”

exciting.en: It promises to be an exciting few days.
exciting.zh: 那可望是兴奋刺激的几天。
过去的每一天都令人兴奋充满惊险和刺激。

exclude.en: She gets very upset if I exclude her from anything.
exclude.zh: 如果有什么事我将她排除在外，她就会非常难过。

exclude.en: We should not exclude the possibility of negotiation.
exclude.zh: 我们不应该排除谈判的可能性。

exclude.en: I cannot entirely exclude the possibility that some form of pressure was applied to the neck.
exclude.zh: 我不能完全排除有些压力作用到了颈部的可能性。

exclusive.en: Some papers thought they had an exclusive.
exclusive.zh: 一些报社以为他们有一条独家报道。

exclusive.en: The hotel has exclusive access to the beach.
exclusive.zh: 这家旅馆有通向海滩的专用通道。

exclusive.en: Our group will have exclusive use of a 60-foot boat.
exclusive.zh: 我们组将有一条专用的60英尺的船。

exclusively.en: The proposals before the legislature include the creation of two special courts to deal exclusively with violent crimes.
exclusively.zh: 摆在议会面前的提案包括建立两个特殊法庭专门审理暴力犯罪案件。

exclusively.en: Today he was able to focus his message exclusively on the economy.
exclusively.zh: 今天他能够将重点聚焦在经济方面。

exclusively.en: He paints from a palette consisting almost exclusively of grey and mud brown.
exclusively.zh: 他画画几乎只用包含灰色和土褐色的色调。

excursion.en: She felt more than usually hungry after her excursion.
excursion.zh: 远足后她感到非同寻常地饥饿。

excursion.en: Another pleasant excursion is Matamoros, 18 miles away.
excursion.zh: 另一个怡人的短程旅游是18英里外的马塔莫罗斯。
他经历了一次痛苦的远足。

execute.en: We are going to execute our campaign plan to the letter.
execute.zh: 我们将严格执行我们的竞选方案。

execute.en: We execute that instruction and we move to the next one.
execute.zh: 我们执行那个指令，并继续下一轮。

execute.en: The lawyer argued that it is wrong to execute a person for a crime he committed while he was a minor.
execute.zh: 律师认为，因为一个人在未成年时所犯的罪而处死他是错误的。

excuse.zh: 她给出的借口还是老一套。
对不起，这是您的座位吗？

execution.en: The idea was good, but the execution was poor.
execution.zh: 这个主意倒不错，可实施情况不理想。

execution.en: He was arrested for obstruction of a police officer in the execution of his duty.
execution.zh: 他因妨碍警察执行公务而被逮捕。

execution.en: He did not witness her execution, yet he and the others are complicit in her death.
execution.zh: 他虽然没有目睹她的死刑执行，但对于她的死，他和其他人都难脱干系。

executive.en: The heroine is a senior TV executive.
executive.zh: 女主人公是一位电视台高级主管。

executive.en: He is to remain in the hot seat as chief executive.
executive.zh: 他将继续留在公司首席行政官这个身负重任的位子上。

executive.en: He is respected as a very aggressive and competitive executive.
executive.zh: 他被尊认为一位十分好强好胜的主管。

exemplify.en: These are not qualities we now exemplify.
exemplify.zh: 而我们现在倒没有了这些品质。

exemplify.en: The plays of Wilds exemplify the comedy of manners.
exemplify.zh: 王尔德的戏剧是风尚喜剧的典范。

exemplify.en: These three pictures exemplify different sorts of evil.
exemplify.zh: 这三张图展示了不同种类的恶。

exempt.en: The interest on the money is exempt from tax.
Men in college were exempt from military service.
exempt.zh: 在校男大学生免服兵役。

exempt.en: Virtually all students will be exempt from the tax.
exempt.zh: 差不多所有的学生都可免此税项。

exert.en: A number of neurotransmitters exert their effects by first increasing cyclic AMP concentrations in target neurons.
exert.zh: 许多神经递质首先通过增加靶神经元中的循环 AMP 浓度来发挥其作用。

exert.en: In order to be successful he would have to exert himself.
We all know that when we exert ourselves our heart rate increases.
exert.zh: 大家都知道，当我们竭尽全力时，心率会加速。

exercise.zh: 骑自行车是很好的锻炼。

exhaust.zh: 我的汽车需要一个新排气管。

exhibit.en: This exhibit was kindly loaned by the artist's family.
exhibit.zh: 这件展品是艺术家的家人惠借而展出的。

exhibit.en: The new exhibit will tour a dozen US cities next year.
exhibit.zh: 这批新展品明年将在美国十二个城市巡回展出。

exhibit.en: He had kindly offered to loan us all the plants required for the exhibit.
exhibit.zh: 他友好地主动提出了借给我们展览会所需的全部植物。

exile.en: He is now living in exile in Egypt.
He was dethroned and went into exile.

exhibition.zh: 这个展览每年举行一次。
你看过毕加索的画展吗？

existence.zh: 我过着相当平淡的生活。

existence.en: Surely my existence cannot be so purposeless?
existence.zh: 想必，我的存在不可能如此毫无意义吧？

existence.en: She felt estranged from her former existence.
existence.zh: 她感到自己已脱离了过去的生活方式。

exist.en: The magic cure for inflation does not exist.
exist.zh: 解决通货膨胀的神奇方法并不存在。
组合方式可能有许多种。

exotic.en: Exotic pets are the in thing right now.
exotic.zh: 奇异的宠物眼下很时髦。

exotic.en: She has a partiality for exotic flowers.
I was beguiled by the romance and exotic atmosphere of the souks in Marrakech.
exotic.zh: 我被马拉喀什剧场浪漫的异国情调迷住了。

exit.en: There was a stampede for the exit.
exit.zh: 出现了人群向出口的狂奔。

exit.en: The crowd made a mad rush for the exit.
exit.zh: 人群疯狂地冲向出口处。

exit.en: He made a quick exit to avoid meeting her.
exit.zh: 他迅速离去以避免见到她。

expansion.en: The company intends a slow-down in expansion.
expansion.zh: 公司准备放慢扩展速度。

expansion.en: Poor trading figures put back our plans for expansion.
expansion.zh: 贸易额不佳延缓了我们的扩张计划。

expansion.en: The company is forging ahead with its plans for expansion.
expansion.zh: 公司的拓展计划正顺利进行。

expand.en: We have to expand the size of the image.
expand.zh: 我们不得不扩大图像的尺寸。

expand.en: It was just a passing comment, he didn't expand.
expand.zh: 那只是顺便提到的评论，他没有展开。

expand.en: We've been given the nod to expand the business.
expand.zh: 我们得到允许扩大企业规模。

expect.zh: 不要指望这事一下子就改善了。

expect.en: Don't expect others to read your mind.
expect.zh: 不要期望别人能看出你的心思。

expect.en: Both leaders seemed to expect measurable progress.
expect.zh: 两位领导人好像都期待着显著的进展。

expectation.en: There was an air of expectation and great curiosity.
expectation.zh: 有着一种期待和好奇的感觉。

expectation.en: I applied for the post more in hope than expectation.
expectation.zh: 我申请这个职位是希望多于期待。

expectation.en: We are confident in our expectation of a full recovery.
expectation.zh: 我们满怀信心地期待着完全康复。

expedition.en: The expedition was bedevilled by bad weather.
expedition.zh: 探险队深受恶劣天气的困扰。

expedition.en: Forty-three members of the expedition were killed.
It won't be labelled in any way as a military expedition.
expedition.zh: 它无论如何也称不上是一次军事远征。

expel.en: The heart muscles contract to expel the blood.
expel.zh: 心脏肌肉收缩以挤压出血液。

expel.en: Cultivating positive interpersonal relationships helped him expel solitary feelings.
expel.zh: 培养积极的人际关系有助于他排除孤独感。

expel.en: I expel all outside forces in my works.
expel.zh: 在我的作品中，我驱散了外部力量。

expenditure.en: He is rigorous in his control of expenditure.
expenditure.zh: 他在控制开支方面一丝不苟。

expenditure.en: You must ask permission for all major expenditure.
expenditure.zh: 一切重大开支均须报请批准。

expend.en: If you give up exercise, your muscles shrink and fat increases. By the same token, if you expend more energy you will lose fat.
expend.zh: 如果你放弃锻炼，肌肉就会萎缩，脂肪会增多。同样地，如果你消耗较多的体能，你就会减掉脂肪。

expend.en: Growth, reproduction, and daily metabolism all require an organism to expend energy.
expend.zh: 生长、繁殖和日常的新陈代谢都需要有机体来消耗能量。

expend.en: Extreme athletes expend lots of energy breaking down and repairing and building muscles.
expend.zh: 极限运动员消耗大量能量来分解、修复和塑造肌肉。

expense.en: He can comfortably afford the extra expense.
expense.zh: 他支付这些额外的费用毫无问题。

expense.en: She always travels first-class regardless of expense.
expense.zh: 无论费用多高她总是乘头等舱。

expense.en: Running a car is a big expense.

expensive.zh: 滑雪用具有时会很昂贵。

experiment.en: As an experiment, we bought Ted a watch.
experiment.zh: 作为尝试，我们给特德买了块手表。

experience.zh: 那是一次令人遗憾的经历。
那是一次情感宣泄的体验。

experimental.en: The equipment is still at the experimental stage.
experimental.zh: 这种设备仍处于试验阶段。

experimental.en: The senator is ready to argue for an experimental lifting of the ban.
experimental.zh: 该参议员已准备好争取那条禁令的试验性解除。

experimental.en: For the time being, however, immunotherapy is still in its experimental stages.
experimental.zh: 然而，目前免疫疗法还处于试验阶段。

expert.zh: 我们将需要专家的意见。

expert.en: I don't claim to be an expert.

expertise.en: Griffith's expertise is in writing legal briefs.
expertise.zh: 格里菲思的专长在于撰写法律案情摘要。

expertise.en: We have the expertise to help you run your business.
expertise.zh: 我们有帮助你经营自己业务的专门知识。

expertise.en: We need to tap the expertise of the people we already have.
expertise.zh: 我们需要利用我们现有人员的专业知识。

expire.zh: 你的驾照什么时候到期？
图书馆借书证四年后到期。

expire.en: He is planning another tour abroad, yet his passport will expire at the end of this month.
expire.zh: 他计划再次出国旅行，但他的护照将于本月底到期。

explanation.en: I think you owe us an explanation.
explanation.zh: 我认为你应当给我们一个解释。
他没有得到一个合理的解释。

explain.zh: 解释一下你为什么不打电话。
你能再解释一下那一点吗？

explicit.en: He gave me very explicit directions on how to get there.
explicit.zh: 他清楚地向我说明了去那儿的路线。
他们应该有明确的许可吗？
这让他们的表达更加直白明确。

exploit.en: As computer systems become even more sophisticated, so too do the methods of those who exploit the technology.
exploit.zh: 正如计算机系统变得越来越复杂，开发计算机技术的人所采用的方法也日趋复杂。

exploit.en: What do you think my last exploit was?
exploit.zh: 你觉得我最后一项功绩是什么？

exploit.en: Modern technology is good enough to exploit all the sea resources.
exploit.zh: 现代技术足以开发所有的海洋资源。

explode.en: At last, a women's magazine to explode the myth that thin equals beautiful.
explode.zh: 终于有一家妇女杂志起来推翻瘦即美的神话。
从17世纪30年代开始，它们就爆发了。

explode.en: Unless we really do explode the internet.
explode.zh: 除非我们真的引爆互联网。

explore.en: We will explore every avenue until we find an answer.
explore.zh: 我们要探索一切途径，直到找到答案为止。

explore.en: I want to explore and get in touch with my inner self.
explore.zh: 我想认真探索，了解我内在的个性。

explore.en: I just wanted to explore on my own.
explore.zh: 我只是想独自考察一下。

explosion.zh: 她在那场爆炸中双目失明了。

explosive.en: He appeared to be treating the potentially explosive situation with some sensitivity.
explosive.zh: 他似乎正在有些敏感地处理潜在的爆炸性局面。

explosive.en: The explosive new style helped cut Killy's racing time dramatically.
explosive.zh: 这种爆发性的新方式极大地缩短了基利的比赛时间。

export.zh: 加纳的主要出口产品是可可。

export.en: Export sales were up by 32% last year.
export.zh: 去年出口销售额增长了32%。

expose.en: Altman strips away the pretense and mythology to expose the film industry as a business like any other.
expose.zh: 奥尔特曼揭穿伪装和神话，把电影业暴露成像其他任何行业一样。

expose.en: My job as a journalist is to expose the truth.
expose.zh: 我作为记者的职责就是展示事实。

expose.en: He did not want to expose his fears and insecurity to anyone.
expose.zh: 他不想向任何人显露他的恐惧与不安。

exposition.en: Aristotle was valued because of his clear exposition of rational thought.
exposition.zh: 亚里士多德因其对理性思维的清晰阐述而被重视。

exposition.en: These comments are part of the play's logical exposition.
exposition.zh: 这些评论是该剧逻辑阐述的一部分。

exposure.en: Exposure to the sun ages the skin.
exposure.zh: 太阳曝晒会使皮肤粗老。

exposure.en: I used a long exposure for this one.
exposure.zh: 我这张照片用的曝光时间长。

exposure.en: Exposure to the sun can accelerate the ageing process.
exposure.zh: 暴露在日光下会加快老化过程。

express.en: Words cannot express how pleased I am.
express.zh: 言语无法表达我的愉快心情。

express.en: I'd like to send this express, please.
I could not express my innermost feelings to anyone.
express.zh: 我不能向任何人表达我内心深处的感情。

expression.zh: 她的表情显得严肃起来。

exquisite.zh: 我们欣赏她精致的手工艺品。

exquisite.en: The room was decorated in exquisite taste.
exquisite.zh: 这个房间的装饰情趣高雅。

exquisite.en: It was a scene of exquisite beauty.

extensive.en: Extensive repair work is being carried out.
extensive.zh: 大规模的修缮工作正在进行。

extensive.en: The report is underpinned by extensive research.
extensive.zh: 这份报告以广泛的研究为基础。

extensive.en: Extensive research has been done into this disease.
extensive.zh: 对这种疾病已进行了广泛研究。

extend.en: There are plans to extend the no-smoking area.
extend.zh: 现已有扩大无烟区的计划。

extend.en: Careful maintenance can extend the life of your car.
extend.zh: 精心保养可延长汽车寿命。

extension.zh: 她可以通过分机308找到我。

extent.zh: 在一定程度上的确如此。

extent.en: To some extent this was the truth.
extent.zh: 在某种程度上这是事实。

extent.en: The extent of the violence came as a shock.

exterior.en: The exterior of the house needs painting.
The exterior walls were made of preformed concrete.
exterior.zh: 外墙是用预制混凝土建造的。

exterior.en: His gruff exterior concealed one of the kindest hearts.
exterior.zh: 他不友好的外表下藏着一颗最善良的心。

extinct.en: Herbalism had become an all but extinct skill in the Western world.
extinct.zh: 草药医术在西方世界几乎已成了一项绝迹的技术。

extinct.en: The idea of cloning extinct life forms still belongs to science fiction.
extinct.zh: 对绝种的生命形式进行克隆的想法仍然属于科学幻想。

extinct.en: Scientists are attempting to compare features of extinct animals with living analogues.
extinct.zh: 科学家正试图把已灭绝动物的特征与现存类似动物相比较。

external.en: An external auditor will verify the accounts.
external.zh: 外部审计员将核实这些账目。

external.en: Many external influences can affect your state of mind.
external.zh: 许多外在因素都可能影响人的心情。

external.en: College lecturers acted as external assessors of the exam results.
external.zh: 学院讲师是考试成绩的校外考核人。

extinguish.en: The firemen did their best to extinguish the fire.
extinguish.zh: 消防队员竭尽全力灭火。

extinguish.en: Apart from the fire, the water used to extinguish it also caused a lot of damage to Notre Dame Cathedral.
extinguish.zh: 除了大火，用于灭火的水也对巴黎圣母院造成了很大的破坏。

extinguish.en: However many generations succeed us in coming centuries, none of them will ever see this species that we extinguish.
extinguish.zh: 在未来的几个世纪里，无论我们传承了多少代人，他们都不会再看到被我们灭绝掉的物种。

extra.en: I pushed her away immediately. I said this costs extra!
extra.zh: 我一下就推开了，我说这是另外的价钱。

extra.en: I only work eight hours a day. Any overtime must be paid extra.
extra.zh: 我每天只工作八小时，如果超出的部分薪水要另算啊！
跑鞋有额外的减震设计。

extract.en: The first part is to extract each packet.
extract.zh: 第一部分是提取每一个包。

extract.en: The following extract is taken from her new novel.
extract.zh: 下面一段摘自她的新小说。

extract.en: They are unlikely to extract much benefit from the trip.
extract.zh: 他们不大可能从这次旅行中获得多大益处。

extraordinary.en: She is a designer of extraordinary versatility.
extraordinary.zh: 她是位特别多才多艺的设计师。
他的行为离奇且令人费解。

extraordinary.en: Her writings have extraordinary depth and solidity.
extraordinary.zh: 她写的东西立意极深，内容特别充实。

extravagant.zh: 那个假期是一次奢侈的享受。

extravagant.en: She scandalized her family with her extravagant lifestyle.
extravagant.zh: 她奢侈的生活方式令家人侧目。

extremely.zh: 我觉得她极其令人恼火。
我认为这是极端不明智的。

extreme.en: The heat in the desert was extreme.

extreme.zh: 他们沦落到极度贫困的地步。

eyesight.en: He was not a particularly good shot because of his eyesight.
eyesight.zh: 他由于视力缘故并不是一个特别好的射手。

eye.zh: 这部电影有种绘画的眼光。
我的眼睛里进了什么东西。

fabricate.en: It angers me that people would fabricate a story like that.
fabricate.zh: 人们编造这样的谎话让我感到愤怒。

fabricate.en: David, on the other hand, had labored to fabricate a curious patent leather trouser suit.
fabricate.zh: 另一方面，大卫努力制作了一套奇特的、别出心裁的皮革裤套装。

fabricate.en: Their advancements have been about how to design and fabricate that intricate structure cheaply.
fabricate.zh: 它们的进展主要是关于如何低成本地设计和制备这些精细结构的。

facet.en: Now let's look at another facet of the problem.
facet.zh: 现在咱们看问题的另一面。

facet.en: The worst may be behind them now, but the shocking losses of the past few years have reshaped nearly every facet of their lives—how they live, work, and spend—even the way they think about the future.
facet.zh: 最糟糕的情况可能已经过去，但过去几年令人震惊的损失几乎改变了他们生活的方方面面，包括他们的生活、工作和消费方式，甚至他们对未来的看法。

facet.en: The information revolution will touch every facet of composition, publication, distribution, and reading.
facet.zh: 信息革命将涉及写作、出版、发行和阅读的方方面面。

facilitate.en: The new airport will facilitate the development of tourism.
facilitate.zh: 新机场将促进旅游业的发展。
许多现代发明便利了家务劳动。

facility.en: There may be a cost to such facility.
facility.zh: 这种的设备可能会产生成本。

facility.en: It describes completely the facility and its safety basis.
facility.zh: 它完整地描述了设备和它的安全基础。

factor.en: Lack of cash is a limiting factor.
factor.zh: 现金短缺是一个制约因素。

factor.en: Haemophiliacs have no factor 8 in their blood.
factor.zh: 血友病患者的血液中缺乏凝血因子 VIII。

factor.en: Heredity is not a factor in causing the cancer.
factor.zh: 遗传并非导致这种癌症的一个因素。

fact.zh: 她的论述以事实为根据。

fact.en: That was a conjecture, not a fact.
But was it, in fact, a hideous goof?
fact.zh: 但其实这真的是很可笑的错误吗？

factory.en: That old factory is a real eyesore!

faculty.en: The faculty agreed on a change in the requirements.
faculty.zh: 全体教员同意改变要求。

faculty.en: How can faculty improve their teaching so as to encourage creativity?
faculty.zh: 全体教员怎样才能改进教学以便激发创造力？

faculty.en: The Bush Foundation has funded a variety of faculty development programmes.
faculty.zh: 布什基金会已经资助了各种教职工发展项目。

Fahrenheit.en: The thermometer shows the temperature in Celsius and Fahrenheit.
Fahrenheit.zh: 温度计显示摄氏温度和华氏温度。

Fahrenheit.en: He was asked for the boiling point of water in Fahrenheit.
Fahrenheit.zh: 有人问他华氏温标下水的沸点。

fade.en: The colour in this material does not fade.
Further, natural dyes tended to be muddy in hue and fade quickly.
fade.zh: 此外，天然染料往往是浑浊的颜色而且它们很快褪色。

fade.en: My resentment of her slowly began to fade.
fade.zh: 我对她的怨恨慢慢地开始消退了。

fail.en: I got three passes and one fail.
fail.zh: 我考试三门及格，一门不及格。
我？失败？我可不这样认为。

failure.zh: 失败会挫伤学生的积极性。

faint.zh: 炎热使他觉得快要晕倒了。
他的耳朵听到微弱的哭声。

fairly.zh: 我们的计划有相当大的灵活性。

fair.zh: 蓝色适合于她白皙的肤色。

faithful.en: The officers died faithful to the honour of a soldier.
faithful.zh: 军官们怀着对军人气节的忠诚而捐躯。

faithful.en: I have been a faithful reader of your newspaper for many years.
faithful.zh: 我是贵报多年来的忠实读者。

faithful.en: She was rewarded for her 40 years' faithful service with the company.
faithful.zh: 她为公司忠诚服务了40年，因而获得奖赏。

faith.en: He retains a faith in human goodness.
I have great faith in you—I know you'll do well.
faith.zh: 我对你有信心—我知道你会干好的。

fake.en: No one spotted that the gun was a fake.
fake.zh: 没有人留意到那是一支假枪。

fake.en: A sharp-eyed shop clerk spotted the fake.
fake.zh: 一名眼尖的售货员发现了假货。

fake.en: He tried to fake sincerity as he smiled at them.
fake.zh: 当他朝他们笑的时候，他设法假装真诚。

fame.zh: 名声并没有使他有丝毫改变。

fall.en: Let me fall if I must fall. The one I become will catch me.
fall.zh: 如果必须坠落，就让我坠落。我会成为的那个人，一定会接住我。

familiar.zh: 他低声哼着一支熟悉的小曲。

familiar.en: He felt a longing for the familiar.

FALSE.en: The whole argument rests on a false assumption.
FALSE.zh: 整个论证都是基于一个错误的假设。

famine.en: The famine threatened to depopulate the continent.
famine.zh: 饥荒威胁着该大陆人口数量。

famine.en: If the drought continues there's going to be a famine.
famine.zh: 如果旱灾继续下去很可能要发生饥荒。

famine.en: Many Irish people went over to America during the famine.
famine.zh: 许多爱尔兰人在饥荒时期迁徙到美国。

family.zh: 他询问了她的家庭情况。

famous.en: One day, I'll be rich and famous.
famous.zh: 总有一天我会名利双收。

fan.en: He is a fanatical fan of Mozart.
fan.zh: 他是一名莫扎特音乐的狂热爱好者。
她装了一台墙壁式电扇。

fancy.en: So you fancy yourself as the boss someday?
fancy.zh: 那么你认为自己有一天会成老板？

fancy.en: Do you fancy a jar after work?
fancy.zh: 下班后去喝一杯怎么样？

fantastic.zh: 我有着极好的社交生活。

fantastic.en: The teams served up some fantastic entertainment.
fantastic.zh: 这些队献上了精彩的表演。
你得到那工作了？太好了！

fantasy.en: He retreated into a world of fantasy.
The story is a magical mix of fantasy and reality.
fantasy.zh: 这个故事是一个幻想与现实的奇妙组合。

fantasy.en: Enough of fantasy, the workaday world awaited him.
fantasy.zh: 幻想之后，等待他的是平凡的现世。

fare.en: The taxi driver picked up a fare at the station.
fare.zh: 出租车司机在车站接了一名乘客。

far.zh: 到目前为止还是安静的。

farewell.en: When we decide to say farewell, we are not far from reunion.
farewell.zh: 当我们决定告别的时候，就离重逢不远了。

farewell.en: I bade farewell to all the friends I had made in Paris.
farewell.zh: 我告别了我在巴黎结交的所有朋友。

farm.en: I told you. Get off the farm.

farm.zh: 农场工人们手工给奶牛挤奶。

farmer.en: There once was a poor farmer who had four sons.
farmer.zh: 从前有一个贫苦的农夫，他有四个儿子。

farmer.en: A farmer is entitled to a certain particularized tax treatment.
farmer.zh: 农民能够享受某种具体的税收待遇。

farmer.en: At first glance, organic farming looks much more expensive for the farmer.
farmer.zh: 乍一看，有机耕作对农民来说似乎昂贵得多。

fascinate.en: Angels fascinate, as Christmas-card-makers rediscover every year.
fascinate.zh: 天使令人着迷，正如圣诞卡制造商们每年一再发现的那样。

fascinate.en: The private lives of movie stars never fail to fascinate.
fascinate.zh: 电影明星的私生活总为人所津津乐道。

fascinate.en: These renegades, cerebral experiments fascinate many of his peers.
fascinate.zh: 这些叛逆的、理性的实验吸引了他的许多同行。

fashion.zh: 卡罗琳是位时装设计师。
这或许会开创一种新时尚呢。

fashionable.en: It became fashionable to eat certain kinds of fish.
fashionable.zh: 吃某些种类的鱼变得时髦了。

fashionable.en: Such thinking is fashionable among right-wing politicians.
fashionable.zh: 在政界右翼人士中这种想法很流行。

fashionable.en: All shades of mauve, lilac, lavender and purple were fashionable.
fashionable.zh: 所有紫红色、淡紫粉色、淡紫色和紫色都很流行。

farther.en: We watched their ship moving gradually farther away.
farther.zh: 我们望着他们的船渐渐远去。

farther.en: Timber ran short, and it was necessary to procure it from farther and farther away.
farther.zh: 木材短缺，必须从越来越远的地方获得。

fatal.en: There was a fatal flaw in the plan.
fatal.zh: 计划中有一个致命的缺陷。

fatal.en: Even moderate amounts of the drug can be fatal.
fatal.zh: 这种药的用量即使不很大也会致命。

fatal.en: It is impossible to say who struck the fatal blow.
fatal.zh: 不可能确定是谁给了那致命的一击。

fate.en: My fate is neither up to me nor up to heaven.

fate.zh: 她的命运与他的交织在一起。

fate.en: I see no use arguing with fate.
fate.zh: 我认为与命运抗争没有什么用。

fasten.en: There were no instructions on how to fasten the carrying strap to the box.
fasten.zh: 没有如何把背带系在箱子上的说明。

fasten.en: When Ted was six we decided that he needed to know how to fasten and unfasten his seat belt.
fasten.zh: 泰德六岁时，我们决定让他知道怎样系和解他的安全带。

faulty.en: The money will be used to repair faulty equipment.
faulty.zh: 这笔钱将被用来修理出故障的设备。

faulty.en: Ask for a refund if the goods are faulty.
faulty.zh: 商品如有缺陷，可要求退款。

fatigue.en: Driver fatigue was to blame for the accident.
fatigue.zh: 这个事故是驾驶员疲劳所致。

fatigue.en: She was plagued by weakness, fatigue, and dizziness.
fatigue.zh: 她被虚弱、疲劳和眩晕折磨。

fatigue.en: The wing of the plane showed signs of metal fatigue.
fatigue.zh: 机翼显示出金属疲劳的迹象。

fault.en: Now look here, it wasn't my fault.
That wasn't his fault, it was mine.
fault.zh: 那不是他的错，是我的错。
他的最大缺点就是反复无常。

favourable.en: They offered me a loan on very favourable terms.
favourable.zh: 他们提出以十分优惠的条件贷款给我。

favourable.en: The terms of the agreement are favourable to both sides.
favourable.zh: 协议条款对双方都有利。

favourable.en: Such events occur only when the external conditions are favourable.
favourable.zh: 此类事件只有当外界条件有利时才会发生。

favourite.zh: 你最喜欢的颜色是什么？
秋季是我最喜欢的季节。
他最喜欢的消遣是打高尔夫。

fax.en: Can you send it to me by fax ?
fax.zh: 你能用传真把它发给我吗？

favour.en: Those present were in favour of change.
The Appeal Court decided in their favour.
favour.zh: 上诉法院作出了有利于他们的裁定。

feasible.en: She questioned whether it was feasible to stimulate investment in these regions.
feasible.zh: 她质问在这些地区刺激投资是否可行。
这一设想的可行性如何？

feast.en: The Jewish feast of Passover began last night.
feast.zh: 犹太人的宗教节日逾越节昨晚开始了。

feast.en: The feast was served by his mother and sisters.
feast.zh: 宴席由他的母亲和姐妹们招待。

feast.en: They were happy to partake of our feast, but not to share our company.
feast.zh: 他们喜欢享用我们准备的丰盛大餐，但是不喜欢和我们呆在一起。

fearful.en: Bankers were fearful of a world banking crisis.
fearful.zh: 银行家们害怕会有一场世界性的银行业危机。

fearful.en: They are fearful that unemployment will soon break the barrier of three million.
fearful.zh: 他们担心失业人数不久将突破300万大关。

fearful.en: What on earth are we fearful of?

fear.zh: 那是种完全合乎逻辑的恐惧。
恐惧心理会助长种族主义。

feather.en: I taped the base of the feather onto the velvet.
feather.zh: 我用胶带把羽毛的根部粘到天鹅绒上。

feather.en: The feather must be removed with a straight, firm pull.
feather.zh: 羽毛必须笔直地用力一拔才能拔掉。
这只小鸡很快就要长羽毛了。

February.en: Postal workers are getting a 5.2% pay rise, backdated to February.
February.zh: 邮政员工的工资将提高5.2%，追溯至二月份起算。

February.en: He welshed on his agreement with the team that he would play for them in February.
February.zh: 他逃避履行他与球队合同中在二月为他们踢球的协议。

federal.en: Today is Presidents' Day, a federal holiday.
federal.zh: 今天是总统纪念日，一个联邦假日。

federal.en: They are proscribed by federal law from owning guns.
federal.zh: 根据联邦法律规定，他们不准拥有枪支。

federal.en: A Federal Court case had been fast tracked to Wednesday.
federal.zh: 联邦法院的一起案件已被提前到星期三审理。

feature.en: His eyes are his most notable feature.

furnish.en: Many proprietors try to furnish their hotels with antiques.
furnish.zh: 许多企业主尽可能用古董装饰他们的旅馆。

furnish.en: California law also permits nurse practitioners to furnish patients with prescriptions for most medications.
furnish.zh: 加利福尼亚法律允许职业护士为病人开大部分药的处方。

furniture.zh: 房间里什么家具都没有。

furniture.en: We sent our furniture on by ship.
furniture.zh: 我们提前把家具水运过去了。

further.zh: 让我们更深入地考虑这一点。

furthermore.en: Furthermore, they claim that any such interference is completely ineffective.
furthermore.zh: 此外，他们声称任何此类干涉都是完全无效的。

furthermore.en: He said he had not discussed the matter with her. Furthermore, he had not even contacted her.
furthermore.zh: 他说他没有和她讨论过这个问题。而且，他甚至没有和她联系过。

furthermore.en: Furthermore, one sensory ability may back up another.
furthermore.zh: 此外，一种感知能力可能会为另一种感知能力提供支持。

fuse.en: Changing a fuse is one of those fiddly jobs I hate.
fuse.zh: 换保险丝是我不愿干的麻烦事之一。

fuse.en: I paid $80 to have my car radio fixed and I bet all they did was change a fuse.
fuse.zh: 我付了$80修车里的收音机，我敢断定他们只是换了根保险丝。
检查一下保险丝是否烧断了。

fusion.en: For the uninitiated, Western Swing is a fusion of jazz, rhythm and blues, rock and roll, and country music.
fusion.zh: 可以向不懂西部摇摆乐的人解释，这是融合了爵士乐，节奏布鲁斯，摇滚乐和乡村乐的一种音乐形式。

fusion.en: It is Wagner who first demonstrated the essential fusion of racial and religious feelings in Afro-American poetry.
fusion.zh: 瓦格纳是最早将美国黑人诗歌中种族与宗教情感的融合者。

fusion.en: The movie displayed a perfect fusion of image and sound.
fusion.zh: 这部电影展示了音响与影像的完美结合。

fuss.en: Don't fuss, Mum, everything is all right.
fuss.zh: 别瞎操心了，妈妈，一切都好。

fuss.en: All that fuss over a few pounds!
fuss.zh: 为几英镑就那么大惊小怪的！

fuss.en: It was all a fuss about nothing.
fuss.zh: 这完全是无谓地自寻烦恼。

future.en: The movie is set in the future.
future.zh: 这部电影以未来为背景。

galaxy.zh: 银河系由1千亿颗恒星组成。
天文学家们发现了一个遥远的星系。

galaxy.en: At least one supernova occurs per decade in our galaxy.
galaxy.zh: 每十年至少有一颗超新星在我们的银河系中出现。

gallery.zh: 一群人已经挤满了廊台。

gallery.en: There is no entrance fee to the gallery.
gallery.zh: 这个美术陈列馆不收门票。

gain.zh: 经常锻炼有助于防止体重增加。

gain.en: The minuses far outweigh that possible gain.
gain.zh: 不利因素远远超过了那可能获得的收益。

gain.en: The research investigates how foreign speakers gain fluency.
gain.zh: 这项研究旨在调查讲外语的人如何增加流利程度。

gallon.en: This car does 30 miles to the gallon.
gallon.zh: 这辆汽车每加仑汽油可行驶30英里。

gallon.en: The average price for all grades of petrol at the pump was $3.49 a gallon.
gallon.zh: 加油泵所有等级的汽油平均价格为1加仑3.49美元。

gallon.en: The subsidy of 45 cents per gallon remains.
gallon.zh: 每加仑45美分的补贴仍然在存在。

gamble.en: It was wrong to gamble with our children's future.
gamble.zh: 拿孩子们的未来冒险是错误的。

gamble.en: Few firms will be willing to gamble on new products.
gamble.zh: 很少有公司愿意在新产品上冒险。

gamble.en: If you own shares in large American corporations, you're a winner in the weak-dollar gamble.
gamble.zh: 如果你持有美国大公司的股票，那么你会是这场疲软美元投机中的赢家。

game.zh: 他巧妙地控制着自己的比赛节奏。

gang.zh: 警方怀疑当地的一个不良帮派。

gang.en: The gang tied up a security guard.
gang.zh: 那群歹徒把一名保安人员捆绑起来。

gang.en: The gang assaulted him with iron bars.
gang.zh: 该团伙用铁棒袭击了他。

gaol.en: A character remarks at the end that he has seen many of the old black and white gaol movies from the US.
gaol.zh: 一个角色在片尾说，他看过很多美国老的黑白监狱电影。

gaol.en: All were detained in the Salem Gaol, a grim edifice of granite blocks, iron-barred windows and brick-walled cells.
gaol.zh: 所有人都被拘禁在萨勒姆监狱中，这是一座用花岗岩砌成、装有铁栅栏窗户和砖墙砌成的牢房构成的可怕建筑。

gaol.en: The Committee of Vigilance promptly arrested the Knapp brothers and sent them to the Salem Gaol, their cells not far from those occupied by the Crowninshields.
gaol.zh: 警戒委员会迅速逮捕了克纳普兄弟，把他们也扔进了萨勒姆监狱，囚禁这二人的牢房与克劳宁希尔德兄弟的牢房相距不远。

gap.en: The product has filled a gap in the market.
gap.zh: 这个产品填补了市场的空白。

gap.en: By 1973, this gap had narrowed almost to vanishing point.
gap.zh: 到1973年，这一差距已缩小到几乎为零。

gap.en: The gap between the two teams has narrowed to three points.
gap.zh: 两队之间的差距缩小到三分了。

garbage.en: Dig a pit and bury the garbage.
Put the lid on the garbage can.

garbage.zh: 一般的垃圾会被送到一般的垃圾填埋场。

garage.en: Tim climbed on to the garage roof.
garage.zh: 蒂姆爬到车库的房顶上。

garage.en: I have a battery tester in my garage.
garage.zh: 我的车库里有台电池测试仪。

garage.en: The police found him asleep in a garage.
garage.zh: 警察发现他在一处车库里睡着了。

garden.zh: 卡斯帕正在给花园除草。
有个花园能让人放松心情。

gardener.zh: 我的妻子是个热衷园艺的人。

gardener.en: She herself was not a keen gardener.
gardener.zh: 她本人就不是一个热衷于园艺的人。

garment.en: He was wearing a strange shapeless garment.
garment.zh: 他穿着一件没样子的奇怪衣服。

garment.en: The thicker the material, the less susceptible the garment will be to wet conditions.
garment.zh: 布料越厚，衣服通常就越不容易浸湿。

gaseous.en: Freon exists both in liquid and gaseous states.
gaseous.zh: 氟利昂既有液态也有气态。

gaseous.en: All substances, whether they are gaseous, liquid or solid, are made of atoms.
gaseous.zh: 一切物质，不论它们是气体、液体还是固体，都是由原子构成的。

gaseous.en: There may be giant plankton on gaseous planets. They float in a thick atmosphere like small spaceships and live by "eating" lightning.
gaseous.zh: 气态星球上可能存在巨型浮游生物。它们像小型飞船那样漂在厚厚的大气中，靠“吃”闪电获取能量为生。

gasoline.en: I siphoned the gasoline out of the car into a can.
gasoline.zh: 我用虹吸管把汽车里的汽油抽到桶里。

gasoline.en: I fill up the tank with gasoline about once a week.
gasoline.zh: 大约每个星期我加满一箱汽油。

gasoline.en: The gasoline in the bottle has evaporated.

gasp.en: At last, I hear a soft thud, a gasp, and silence.
gasp.zh: 最后，我听到轻轻的砰的一声，一声喘息，然后是一片寂静。

gasp.en: It was the eyes that made Mr. Craven gasp for breath.
gasp.zh: 是那双眼睛让克雷文先生喘不过气。

gasp.en: When people don't get enough oxygen, they often begin to gasp for air.
gasp.zh: 当人们得不到足够的氧气时，常常就会开始喘气。

gauge.en: The fuel gauge had gone on the blink.
Tomorrow's game against Arsenal will be a good gauge of their promotion chances.
gauge.zh: 明天与阿森纳队的比赛是衡量他们能否升级的很好的依据。

gauge.en: What gauge of wire do we need?
gauge.zh: 我们需要多大直径的金属丝？

gate.zh: 她随手关上了身后的大门。
那扇巨大的铁门被锁上了。

gather.en: People would gather from near and far.
gather.zh: 人们会从四面八方聚起来。

gather.en: Weeks after his death, mourners still gather outside the house.
gather.zh: 他死后几个星期，哀悼者仍然聚集在屋外。

gaze.zh: 她用目光缓缓扫视了一下室内。
我的双眼迎视他冰冷的目光。

gay.zh: 我不知道他是同性恋者。

gay.en: He has waffled on abortion and gay rights.
gay.zh: 他在人工流产和同性恋者的权利问题上含糊其辞。

gay.en: He has always championed the cause of gay rights.
gay.zh: 他一直在为争取同性恋者的权利而斗争。

gene.en: The gene for asthma has been identified.
gene.zh: 哮喘病的基因已被识别。

gene.en: The gene is activated by a specific protein.
gene.zh: 这种基因由一种特异性蛋白激活。

gene.en: The gene is only part of the causation of illness.
gene.zh: 基因只是疾病的部分诱因。

gear.zh: 滑雪用具有时会很昂贵。

generalize.en: It would be foolish to generalize from a single example.
generalize.zh: 仅从一个事例进行归纳的做法是愚蠢的。

generalize.en: Critics love to generalize, to formulate trends into which all new work must be fitted, however contradictory.
generalize.zh: 评论家喜欢概括，归纳出所有新作品都必须符合的趋势，不管它们是如何地不符。

generalize.en: We shouldn't be too quick to generalize that to national characteristics and stereotypes.
generalize.zh: 我们不应该太快地将其概括为民族特征和刻板印象。

general.zh: 将军没有被搅得慌乱不安。

general.en: The general gave the order to advance.

general.zh: 我父亲十分敬仰艾森豪威尔将军。

generally.zh: 这个计划受到普遍的欢迎。

generate.en: The research methods of social science generate two kinds of data.
generate.zh: 社会科学的研究方法生成两类数据。

generate.en: The paradox of exercise is that while using a lot of energy it seems to generate more.
generate.zh: 锻炼的矛盾之处在于消耗很多能量却似乎又产生更多能量。

generate.en: We need someone to generate new ideas.
generate.zh: 我们需要有人出新主意。

generous.zh: 他是一个慷慨大方、勇于自我牺牲的人。

generous.en: They are very generous givers to charity.
generous.zh: 他们是慈善事业的慷慨捐助者。

generator.en: He brought it down, hooked it up, and we got the generator going.
generator.zh: 他把它放倒，连接好，然后我们让发电机开始运转。

generator.en: Perhaps each home will have a solar generator to provide power for lighting and heating.
generator.zh: 也许每个家庭都将有一个太阳能发电机来提供照明和取暖的电力。

generator.en: The company is a major generator of jobs.
generator.zh: 这家公司创造了相当多的就业机会。

genetic.en: Eye colour shows more than your genetic inheritance.
genetic.zh: 眼睛的颜色显示的不只是你基因的遗传特征。

genetic.en: Finally, I come to the subject of genetic engineering.
It is probable that the disease has a genetic element.
genetic.zh: 这种疾病很可能有遗传因素。

generation.en: He is arguably the best actor of his generation.
generation.zh: 按理他是他那一代中最优秀的演员。

generation.en: He was a beacon of hope for the younger generation.
generation.zh: 他是年轻一代的希望之灯。

generation.en: She was one of the greatest minds of her generation.
generation.zh: 她是她那一代人中最聪慧的人之一。

genius.zh: 你他娘的可真是个天才
他是人员组织方面的天才。

gentleman.zh: 他的行为像个真正的绅士。

gentleman.en: He is anxious to appear a gentleman.
gentleman.zh: 他急于表现得像一位绅士。

gentle.en: He was a very gentle boy at heart.
gentle.zh: 他实际上是一个非常温和的男孩。
这些诗显示出她温柔的一面。

gentle.en: This soap is very gentle on the hands.
gentle.zh: 这肥皂擦在手上非常柔和。

gently.zh: 她轻声哼唱了一支摇篮曲。
她把他轻轻地拉到身边。

geology.en: We went on a geology field trip.
geology.zh: 我们去进行地质野外考察。

geology.en: He was visiting professor of geology at the University of Georgia.
geology.zh: 他曾是佐治亚大学的地质学客座教授。

geology.en: At first he studied architecture, but later he switched to geology.
geology.zh: 起初他学建筑，但后来转到地质学。

genuine.en: Only genuine refugees can apply for asylum.
genuine.zh: 只有真正的难民才能申请政治避难。

genuine.en: This isn't a genuine antique—you've been done.
genuine.zh: 这不是真正的古董—你上当了。

genuine.en: If this offer is genuine, I will gladly accept it.
genuine.zh: 如果这份帮助是真诚的，我将愉快地接受它。

geography.en: I'm afraid geography is not my strong suit.
geography.zh: 恐怕地理不是我的强项。

geometry.en: The doctor doesn't know how to teach me geometry.
geometry.zh: 这个教授不知道如何教我几何学。

geometry.en: They can also learn geometry by assembling a bicycle.
geometry.zh: 他们还可以通过组装自行车来学习几何。

geometry.en: The geometry of the game, however, is essential to understanding it.
geometry.zh: 然而，游戏的几何结构是理解它的必要条件。

germ.en: This was the germ of a book.
germ.zh: 这是一本书的创作萌芽。

germ.en: There was a thick growth of staph germ.
germ.zh: 葡萄球菌的胚芽生长得很茂盛。

germ.en: The germ of protest has continued to spread.
germ.zh: 抗议行动的胚芽还在四处蔓延。

Germany.zh: 德国主办了世界杯决赛。

German.zh: 管乐队演奏了德国的进行曲。
我们在七年级开始学习德语。
他在学习普通中等教育证书的德语课程。

gesture.zh: 格里芬先生打了个急促而不连贯的手势。

gesture.en: He struck his breast in a dramatic gesture.
gesture.zh: 他以戏剧性的姿态捶他的胸。

giant.en: He looks scary but he's really a gentle giant.
giant.zh: 他看上去可怕，实际却是个性格温和的巨人。

giant.en: They were standing on top of a giant scaffold.
giant.zh: 他们站在一个巨大的脚手架顶上。

ghost.en: It wasn't a ghost; it was a real person.
ghost.zh: 那不是鬼魂，是实实在在的人。

ghost.en: A ghost indeed! I've never heard anything so silly.
ghost.zh: 真是见鬼！我可从没听说过这样无聊的事。

ghost.en: She's the editor of a new collection of ghost stories.
ghost.zh: 她编了一部新版鬼故事集。

gift.en: She has a great gift for music.
The watch was a gift from my mother.
gift.zh: 这块表是母亲给我的礼物。
你要把巧克力糖打成礼品包吗？

gigantic.en: The gigantic natural harbour is a haven for boats.
gigantic.zh: 这个巨大的天然港是船舶的避风港。

gigantic.en: The monument consists of a circle of gigantic stones.
gigantic.zh: 该纪念碑由一圈巨大的石碑组成。

gigantic.en: In Red Rock Valley the road is bordered by gigantic rocks.
gigantic.zh: 在红岩谷，道路两边都是巨大的岩石。

girl.zh: 一个年纪大些的女孩对我很友善。

give.zh: 更大的型号能奏出更多的低音。

glad.zh: 有你跟我一起来，我很高兴。
我很高兴帽子再度流行起来。

glance.zh: 特雷弗和我相互瞥了一眼。

glare.en: I shielded my eyes against the glare.
glare.zh: 我挡住眼睛以避开强光。
他的眼镜使他怒视的目光显得更凶了。

gleam.en: I saw the gleam of the knife as it flashed through the air.
gleam.zh: 我看见了刀在空中划过时的闪光。

gleam.en: Their hope did not last long; the gleam was quickly eclipsed.
gleam.zh: 他们的希望没有延长多久，微光很快就消逝了。

glide.en: The plane managed to glide down to the runway.
glide.zh: 飞机终于成功地滑翔降落在跑道上。

glide.en: That summer was the glide path of our love.
glide.zh: 那个夏天是我们爱情的下滑航道。

glide.en: Do you think we can glide down this glacier?
glide.zh: 你觉得我们可以从冰河上滑行下去吗？

glimpse.en: He caught a glimpse of her in the crowd.
glimpse.zh: 他一眼瞥见她在人群里。

glimpse.en: Below us you could glimpse the rooftops of a few small villages.
glimpse.zh: 在我们下面，你能瞥见一些小村庄的屋顶。

glimpse.en: Some of the fans had waited 24 hours outside the hotel to catch a glimpse of their heroine.
glimpse.zh: 某些追星族为了一睹女杰的风采已在宾馆外守候了24小时。

glitter.en: There was a triumphant glitter in his eyes.
glitter.zh: 他眼睛里闪烁着胜利的光辉。

glitter.en: Smoothed flat by generations of wind and rain, they glitter in the sun.
glitter.zh: 它们被一代代的风雨磨平，在阳光下闪闪发光。

global.zh: 全球变暖是个确实存在的问题。

global.en: The commission is calling for a global ban on whaling.
global.zh: 委员会要求全球禁止捕鲸。

global.en: On a global scale, 77% of energy is created from fossil fuels.
global.zh: 全球77%的能量产生自化石燃料。

globe.en: Dr. Russel is creating an elite herd by cross-breeding goats from around the globe.
globe.zh: 罗素博士正在通过使来自世界各地的山羊杂交而创造一种精品羊群。

globe.en: He still wheels and deals around the globe.
globe.zh: 他仍在世界各地钻营谋取。

globe.en: The overhead light was covered now with a white globe.
globe.zh: 顶灯现在被一个白色的球状物罩了起来。

glorious.en: Harrison had a glorious career spanning more than six decades.
glorious.zh: 哈里森有过一段长达六十余年的辉煌的职业生涯。

glorious.en: The award of the Nobel Prize has crowned a glorious career in physics.
glorious.zh: 荣获诺贝尔奖使其物理学研究的辉煌事业达到了顶点。

glorious.en: They had three weeks of glorious sunshine.
glorious.zh: 他们度过了三周阳光灿烂的日子。

gloomy.en: They found him in a gloomy, downbeat mood.
gloomy.zh: 他们发现他心情沮丧而消沉。

gloomy.en: Officials say the outlook for next year is gloomy.
gloomy.zh: 官员们称来年前景暗淡。

gloomy.en: Suddenly, the future didn't look so gloomy after all.
gloomy.zh: 突然感到前途似乎并非如此黯淡。

glory.en: She wanted to enjoy her moment of glory.
glory.zh: 她希望尽情享受自己的光荣时刻。

glory.en: I do all the work and he gets all the glory.
glory.zh: 活儿都是我干，荣誉都是他得。

glory.en: The cathedral is the crowning glory of the city.
glory.zh: 大教堂是这座城市至高无上的骄傲。

glove.en: She bent down to pick up her glove.
He bit the fingers of his right glove and pulled it off.
glove.zh: 他咬住右手手套的指套，把它扯了下来。

glove.en: There is a hole in her glove.

glue.en: I made a model out of paper and glue.
glue.zh: 我用纸和胶水做了一个模型。

glue.en: We used glue to stick the broken pieces together.
glue.zh: 我们用胶把碎片粘到一起。

glue.en: The smell of sawdust and glue pervaded the factory.
glue.zh: 锯屑和胶水的气味弥漫在工厂里。

glow.en: The fresh air had brought a healthy glow to her cheeks.
glow.zh: 新鲜空气使她两颊红润、精神焕发。

glow.en: There was no light except for the occasional glow of a cigarette.
glow.zh: 除偶尔有香烟的微弱红光外没有一点亮光。

glow.en: She felt a small glow of satisfaction.
glow.zh: 她感到了一丝满足的喜悦。

goal.zh: 那一次进球得分被判无效。

goat.en: I roped the goat to a post.
goat.zh: 我把山羊拴在一根柱子上。

goat.en: Reaching a maximum height of 56cm the pygmy goat is essentially a pet.
goat.zh: 这种最高只能长到56厘米的小山羊基本是作为宠物来养的。

goat.en: A goat was standing up against a tree on its hind legs, trying to get at the leaves.
goat.zh: 一只山羊后腿趴在一棵树上站起来，试图去够树叶。

gold.zh: 他的手指上戴着几枚金戒指。
