identical.zh: 珊瑚礁是由相同的微生物累积形成的。
大多数系统基本上是相同的。

ideal.zh: 他已经找到了理想的配偶。

ideal.en: We do not live in an ideal world.
ideal.zh: 我们并非生活在一个完美的世界里。

ideal.en: I know it's not ideal but there you go...
ideal.zh: 我知道这并不理想，但只好这样啦…

identification.zh: 你有没有任何身份证件？
请出示任何身份证件好吗？

identification.en: After a pause he asked, "You got any identification?"
identification.zh: 他停顿了一下问道，“你们有什么身份证明吗？”

identify.en: First of all we must identify the problem areas.
identify.zh: 首先我们必须找出问题所在。

identify.en: The new technique has been used to identify the sex of fetuses.
identify.zh: 这项新技术已被用来鉴定胎儿的性别。

identify.en: Sales departments try to identify a product's USP or 'unique selling point'.
identify.zh: 销售部门试图确定一种产品的“独有卖点”。

ideology.en: He attributed the party's lack of success to an overemphasis on ideology and ideas.
ideology.zh: 他将该党的不成功归咎与过分强调意识形态和观点。
这种意识形态是虚伪的。
但这种意识形态是虚伪的。

identity.zh: 他严密地保守她的身份。

identity.en: Do you have any proof of identity?

idiom.en: It's just the first half of an idiom.
idiom.zh: 它只是一个习语的前半部分。

idiom.en: Let us look at an idiom: kill two birds with double-edged sword.
idiom.zh: 我们再看一个成语：一举两得/一箭双雕。

idiom.en: An idiom is a group of words.

ignite.en: Maybe even give a little smile and ignite that twinkle in your eye.
ignite.zh: 抑或只是一个嫣然浅笑，便点燃了你眼眸中的那抹闪亮。

ignite.en: United 93 is the first feature film to deal explicitly with the events of September 11, 2001, and is certain to ignite an emotional debate.
ignite.zh: 《93号航班》是第一部明确讲述911事件的故事片，这肯定是会引发一场情绪化的的争论的。

ignite.en: Once a burning firelighter is placed against a tyre, it takes a few minutes for a car to ignite, giving the arsonist plenty of time to escape.
ignite.zh: 一旦将一个燃烧着的打火机放在轮胎上，汽车需要几分钟才能点燃，这给了纵火犯大量的时间逃跑。

idle.zh: 现在这台机器正处于闲置状态。

idle.en: In idle moments, he carved wooden figures.
Over ten per cent of the workforce is now idle.
idle.zh: 现在有超过百分之十的劳动力闲置。

ignorance.en: She was reluctant to confess her ignorance.
ignorance.zh: 她不愿意承认自己无知。

ignorance.en: Pardon my ignorance, but what is a 'duplex'?
ignorance.zh: 请原谅我无知，duplex是什么呢？

ignorance.en: Ignorance of roaming call charges is common.
ignorance.zh: 不知道漫游电话收费情况很普遍。

if.zh: 如果可能我会去那里的。

ignorant.zh: 他对现代科技一无所知。
千万别让你的学生感到自己一无所知。

ignore.en: It would be a mistake to ignore his opinion.
ignore.zh: 忽略他的意见是不对的。

ignore.en: Such arguments ignore the question of where ultimate responsibility lay.
ignore.zh: 此类争论忽视了最终责任何在的问题。

ignore.en: We cannot afford to ignore this warning.
ignore.zh: 我们对这个警告绝不能等闲视之。

illegal.zh: 这笔交易可能会被判定为非法。
在房子上乱涂乱画是非法的。

illegal.en: It is illegal to intercept radio messages.
illegal.zh: 窃听无线电信息是违法的。

ill.zh: 他们中大部分人都有慢性病。

illness.zh: 这种病通常为不治之症。

illness.en: She is still weak after her illness.

illuminate.en: Instead of formulas and charts, the two instructors use games and drawings to illuminate their subject.
illuminate.zh: 这两位教师用游戏和图画而不是公式和图表来阐明他们的题旨。

illuminate.en: Second, data can illuminate patterns of behavior we haven't yet noticed.
illuminate.zh: 其次，数据可以阐明一些我们尚未注意到的行为模式。

illuminate.en: Such explanations, however, illuminate neither the source of this curious convention nor the reason for its popularity.
illuminate.zh: 然而，这样的解释既不能说明这个奇怪的惯例的来源，也不能说明它流行的原因。

illusion.en: No matter how beautiful the illusion, it remains a dream.
Mirrors in a room often give an illusion of space.
illusion.zh: 房间里的镜子常给人一种空间增大的错觉。

illusion.en: The idea of absolute personal freedom is an illusion.
illusion.zh: 绝对个人自由的观念是一种幻想。

illustrate.en: Let me illustrate what I mean with an old story.
illustrate.zh: 让我用一个老故事来说明我指的是什么吧。

illustrate.en: One example will suffice to illustrate the point.
illustrate.zh: 举一个例子就足以说明这一点。

illustrate.en: To illustrate my point , let me tell you a little story.
illustrate.zh: 为了说明我的观点，让我来给你们讲个小故事。

illustration.en: Let me, by way of illustration , quote from one of her poems.
illustration.zh: 作为说明，让我援引她的一首诗。

illustration.en: She looked like a princess in a nineteenth-century illustration.
illustration.zh: 她看上去像19世纪插图里的公主。

illustration.en: The illustration shows a cluster of five roses coloured apricot orange.
illustration.zh: 插图上展示了一簇杏黄色的5朵玫瑰。

imaginary.zh: 许多孩子都有假想的朋友。
很多儿童都有一个假想朋友。

imaginary.en: The equator is an imaginary line around the middle of the earth.
imaginary.zh: 赤道是一条假想的环绕地球腰部的线。

image.en: Soccer needs to clean up its image.
image.zh: 足球界的形象需要改善。

image.en: Her image is engraved upon my heart.
image.zh: 她的形象铭刻在我的心中。
素食主义已经摆脱了其古怪的形象。

imagination.zh: 她发挥了海阔天空的想象。

imagination.en: That child has a very active imagination.
imagination.zh: 那个小孩想象力十分丰富。

imaginative.en: The show's a keeper–daring, imaginative and provocative.
imaginative.zh: 这部电影值得收藏–大胆、富于想像力和煽动性。

imaginative.en: You need to be more flexible and imaginative in your approach.
imaginative.zh: 你的方法必须更加灵活，更富有想象力。

imaginative.en: Mahler's own imaginative orchestration was heard in the same concert.
imaginative.zh: 在同一场音乐会上，听到了马勒自己改编的充满想像力的管弦乐曲。

imitate.en: Teachers provide a model for children to imitate.
imitate.zh: 教师是孩子仿效的典范。

imitate.en: He could imitate in speech or writing most of those he admired.
imitate.zh: 他能在口语或书写中模仿大多数他崇拜的人。

imitation.en: A child learns to talk by imitation.
imitation.zh: 小孩子通过模仿学会说话。

imitation.en: They discussed important issues in imitation of their elders.
imitation.zh: 他们模仿长辈的口气讨论重大问题。

imitation.en: Many corporate methods have been adopted by American managers in imitation of Japanese practice.
imitation.zh: 美国的管理人员效仿日本人的做法，采用了很多经营公司的方法。

imagine.zh: 我完全可以想象出他的反应。

imagine.en: You can imagine he was terribly upset.
I can't imagine life without the children now.
imagine.zh: 我现在无法设想没有了孩子们的生活。

immediate.en: The immediate cause of death is unknown.
immediate.zh: 造成死亡的直接原因不明。

immediate.en: My immediate reaction was one of shock.
immediate.zh: 我当即的反应是大吃一惊。

immerse.en: Their commitments do not permit them to immerse themselves in current affairs as fully as they might wish.
immerse.zh: 他们的职责不允许他们如其所愿地埋头于时事。

immerse.en: In the countryside, you can immerse yourself in the traditional way of life and understand this country better.
immerse.zh: 在农村，你可以沉浸在传统的生活方式中，更好地了解这个国家。

immerse.en: Immerse the cloth in the dye for twenty minutes.

immense.en: The immense difficulties facing European businessmen in Russia were only too evident.
immense.zh: 摆在俄罗斯的欧洲商人面前的巨大困难是极其明显的。

immense.en: If it had hit the Earth, it would have made a crater 100 miles across and thrown up an immense cloud of dust.
immense.zh: 如果它撞上了地球，就会砸出一个100英里宽的大坑并扬起巨大的尘埃云团。

impair.zh: 它可能会损害消化系统。

impair.en: Their inability to scowl seemed to impair their ability to see why pushy telemarketers or a lack of birthday wishes might make one's face fall.
impair.zh: 他们无法动怒似乎削弱了他们的能力，让他们明白为什么咄咄逼人的电话推销员或没得到生日祝愿可能会让一个人沉下脸来。

impair.en: Even one drink can impair driving performance.
impair.zh: 即使一杯酒也可能影响驾驶操作。

immigrant.zh: 移民来的工人被归入侨民类。

immigrant.en: Immigrant tales have always been popular themes in fiction.
immigrant.zh: 移民故事一直是小说的流行主题。

immigrant.en: Immigrant support groups are waiting to see if he sticks to his word.
immigrant.zh: 支持移民的团体正观望他是否遵守诺言。

impact.zh: 一股剧烈的冲击力将她猛地向前抛了出去。

impact.en: Her speech made a profound impact on everyone.
impact.zh: 她的讲话对每个人都有深远的影响。

impact.en: Such schemes mean little unless they impact people.
impact.zh: 除非能对人们造成影响，否则这样的计划意义不大。

immune.en: Adults are often immune to German measles.
immune.zh: 成人往往对风疹有免疫力。

immune.en: Our immune systems are killing billions of germs right now.
immune.zh: 我们的免疫系统正在杀死数以十亿计的细菌。

immune.en: His immune system completely broke down and he became very ill.
immune.zh: 他的免疫系统彻底崩溃了，他已病入膏肓。

impart.en: The ability to impart knowledge and command respect is the essential qualification for teachers.
impart.zh: 传授知识并博得尊敬的能力对老师们来说是基本的条件。

impart.en: You need to have specialist teachers who impart what they know.
impart.zh: 你需要有专业的老师来传授他们所知道的知识。

impart.en: Forcing a child to behave morally may prevent her from internalizing the lesson you're trying to impart.
impart.zh: 强迫孩子按道德行事可能会妨碍她将你试图传授的教训内化。

impatient.zh: 他不耐烦地瞥了维基一眼。
她显然是迫不及待地想离开。

imperative.en: In 'Go away!' the verb is in the imperative.
imperative.zh: Go away!中的动词是祈使语气动词。

imperative.en: It is absolutely imperative that we finish by next week.
imperative.zh: 我们的当务之急是必须于下周完成。

imperative.en: Beethoven's music tends to move from chaos to order as if order were an imperative of human existence.
imperative.zh: 贝多芬的音乐往往从混乱走向有序，仿佛有序是人类生存的必要条件。

imperial.zh: 宫廷玉液酒，一百八一杯~

imperial.en: He matriculated in the English Literature Department at the Tokyo Imperial University.
imperial.zh: 他被东京帝国大学英语文学系录取了。
王子被任命为皇家猪倌。

impetus.en: By 1982, she was restless and needed a new impetus for her talent.
impetus.zh: 到1982年，她焦躁不安，需要一个新的对其才华的推动力。

impetus.en: And some people take this a step further, and they hypothesize that this migration actually provided an important impetus in the development of ancient Egypt.
impetus.zh: 有些人对这方面做了进一步的研究，并假设这次的迁移实际上为古埃及的发展提供了一个重要的动力。

impetus.en: One impetus for the policy is that companies are already starting to build massive constellations, comprising hundreds or thousands of satellites with many moving parts among them.
impetus.zh: 政策的一个动力是，公司已经开始建造大规模的星座，包括成百上千的卫星和其中许多运动部件。

implement.en: Leadership is about the ability to implement change.
implement.zh: 领导才能是一种实行变革的能力。

implement.en: The government promised to implement a new system to control financial loan institutions.
implement.zh: 政府许诺要实施新的制度来控制金融贷款机构。

implement.en: Now, let me scramble for my implement here.
implement.zh: 现在，让我在这里夺回我的工具。

implication.en: The implication was plain, if left unstated.
implication.zh: 即使不说出来，隐含义也很明显。

implication.en: Implication in a murder finally brought him to the gallows.
implication.zh: 与一桩谋杀案的牵连最终把他送上了绞刑架。

implication.en: They resent the implication that they have behaved irresponsibly.
implication.zh: 他们对那种暗示他们的行为不负责任的言论非常不满。

imply.en: How dare she imply that I was lying?

implicit.en: Recent research on consumer memory and judgment suggests another advantage of implicit conclusions.
implicit.zh: 最近关于消费者记忆和判断的研究显示了隐含结论的另一个优势。

implicit.en: Despite these advantages, implicit conclusions may not always be more effective than explicit conclusions.
implicit.zh: 尽管有这些优势，隐性结论并不总是比显性结论更有效。

implicit.en: Because consumers are invited to make up their own minds, implicit conclusions reduce the risk of resentment, distrust, and counterargumentation.
implicit.zh: 因为邀请消费者自主决定，所以隐含的结论减少了怨恨、不信任和反驳的风险。

importance.zh: 她的认可是极其重要的。
这栋建筑有重要的历史研究价值。

import.zh: 这种争论几乎不具重要性。

import.en: The country has to import most of its raw materials.
import.zh: 这个国家大多数原料均依赖进口。

impose.en: He has tried to impose solutions to the country's problems by fiat.
impose.zh: 他已经试图采取强制性法令来解决该国的问题。

impose.en: She didn't want to impose her values on her family.
impose.zh: 她并不想勉强家人接受自己的价值观。

impose.en: I didn't want to impose myself on my married friends.
impose.zh: 我不想硬要我的已婚朋友们接受我。

important.zh: 他喜欢感到自己很重要。
现在到了非常重要的一小部分。
他们有些重要的问题要讨论。

impress.en: It didn't impress me as a good place to live.
impress.zh: 那地方没有给我留下适合居住的印象。
那个主意似乎打动了科林。

impress.en: The Grand Canyon never fails to impress.
impress.zh: 大峡谷永远让人叹为观止。

impossible.zh: 这在数学上是不可能的。

impressive.zh: 这是一项令人敬佩的成就。

impressive.en: The case for nuclear power is impressive.
impressive.zh: 支持核能的论据令人印象深刻。

impression.en: My first impression of him was favourable.
impression.zh: 他给我的第一印象不错。

impression.en: She gives the impression of being very busy.
impression.zh: 她给人的印象是特别忙。

impression.en: One gets the impression that they disapprove.
impression.zh: 本人的印象是，他们不赞成。

imprison.en: Pitcher plants use yet another strategy, growing long tube-shaped leaves to imprison their prey.
imprison.zh: 猪笼草使用了另一种策略，它们长出长长的管状叶子来囚禁猎物。
他们通常不监禁初次犯罪的人。

imprison.en: No strainers, muslin bags or other devices to imprison the tea.
imprison.zh: 别用过滤器、薄纱袋、或是其他装置把茶叶禁锢起来。

improvement.en: This is a marginal improvement on October.
improvement.zh: 这是对10月份的一个小小的改进。

improvement.en: There has already been a definite improvement.
Your work has shown a significant improvement.
improvement.zh: 你的工作有了显著改进。

improve.zh: 我需要提高我的英语水平。
我得提高我的法语水平。
不要指望这事一下子就改善了。

impulse.en: Unable to resist the impulse, he glanced at the sea again.
impulse.zh: 他抑制不住冲动，又看了一眼大海。
他往往凭一时冲动行事。

inaugurate.en: Afghanistan is due to inaugurate a parliament.
inaugurate.zh: 阿富汗将举行新议会典礼。

inaugurate.en: Q: the 8th China-ASEAN Expo will inaugurate tomorrow. Please brief us on the attendance of ASEAN leaders.
inaugurate.zh: 问：第八届中国-东盟博览会将于明天开幕，请介绍东盟国家政要出席情况。

inaugurate.en: In 1971, invited to inaugurate the International Year for Action to Combat Racism, levi-strauss gave a lecture entitled Race and Culture.
inaugurate.zh: 1971年，列维·斯特劳斯应邀出席反种族主义国际行动年启动仪式，并发表了题为《种族与文化》的演讲。

incentive.en: There will be a strong incentive to enter into a process of negotiation.
incentive.zh: 将会有一个强烈的刺激来进入谈判的过程。

incentive.en: Neither side would have a real incentive to start a war. Ergo, peace would reign.
incentive.zh: 双方都没有发动战争的真实动机。因此，和平将会到来。

incentive.en: They have an incentive to keep us hooked.
incentive.zh: 他们有动机让我们上钩。

in.zh: 他们住在肯辛顿的出租房间。
三月份我们去法国滑雪了。

in.en: He is now living in exile in Egypt.

incidence.en: The incidence of breast cancer increases with age.
incidence.zh: 乳腺癌的发病率随着年龄的增长而上升。

incidence.en: Incidence of the disease is fairly evenly spread across Europe.
incidence.zh: 这种疾病的发生率在欧洲各地相当平均。

incidence.en: Authentic Italian cooking is very healthy—witness the low incidence of heart disease in Italy.
incidence.zh: 正宗的意大利烹饪对健康非常有益，在意大利心脏病发病率低就是证据。

inch.en: Nick's grown almost an inch in the last month.
inch.zh: 尼克这一个月来长高了差不多一英寸。

inch.en: An eight-week-old embryo is only an inch long.
inch.zh: 一个8周大的胎儿仅1英寸长。

incident.zh: 这一事件究竟是什么时候发生的？
这事件影响了她的一生。

incidentally.en: Incidentally, have you heard the news about Sue?
incidentally.zh: 顺便问一句，你听说过休的事了吗？
这个信息只是偶然得到的。

incidentally.en: "I didn't ask you to come. Incidentally, why have you come?"
incidentally.zh: “我没有叫你来。顺便问一下，你为什么来呢？”

incline.en: I incline to the view that we should take no action at this stage.
incline.zh: 我倾向于认为我们在这个阶段不应采取行动。

incline.en: He stopped just as his truck tilted down the steep incline, put on the handbrake, and stepped out.
incline.zh: 就在他的卡车沿陡峭的斜坡向下滑的时候，他停了下来，拉住了手闸，然后下了车。

incline.en: As it lost weight, it started to incline its orbit toward the earth: it was dangerous, above and beyond anything else.
incline.zh: 当它失重的时候，它开始将它的轨道向地球倾斜：这是危险的，比其他任何东西都危险。

inclusive.en: The rent is inclusive of water and heating.
inclusive.zh: 租金包括水费和暖气费。

inclusive.en: The academy is far more inclusive now than it used to be.
inclusive.zh: 该学院如今比过去更为兼收并蓄。

include.zh: 这个价钱是否包括税款？
电话费包括线路租用费。

income.zh: 来自销售税的收入下降了。
各人的收入明显提高了。

incorrect.en: The firm says it unknowingly published incorrect statistics.
incorrect.zh: 这家公司说它不知情地出版了错误的数据。

incorrect.en: We apologize unreservedly for any incorrect behaviour by Mr. Taylor.
incorrect.zh: 我们对泰勒先生做出的所有错误行为毫无保留地道歉。

incorrect.en: Regional accents are still acceptable but there is to be a blitz on incorrect grammar.
incorrect.zh: 地方口音还可以接受，但错误语法必须要大力改进。

incorporate.en: The new cars will incorporate a number of major improvements.
incorporate.zh: 这种新型汽车将包含许多重大的改进。

incorporate.en: TV and movie producers often incorporate an element of bad behavior.
incorporate.zh: 电视和电影制作人通常会融入不良行为的元素。

incorporate.en: For example, universities could incorporate IDPs into their graduate curricula to help students discuss, plan, prepare for, and achieve their long-term career goals.
incorporate.zh: 例如，大学可以将个人发展计划纳入研究生课程，帮助学生们讨论、计划、准备和实现长期职业目标。

increase.zh: 汽车的使用率预计会增长。

increasingly.zh: 工作职位变得越来越少。
国外的市场越来越关键了。
这种策略显得越来越老套。

incredible.en: I felt I'd made an incredible discovery.
incredible.zh: 我感到自己有了一个惊人的发现。
“简直是令人难以置信，”库尔特突然容光焕发地说到。

incredible.en: It was an incredible display of motherly love and forgiveness.
incredible.zh: 那是慈母般关爱与宽容的一次令人难以置信的体现。

incur.en: Contractors who fall behind schedule incur heavy financial penalties.
incur.zh: 承包商如延误工期将被处以巨额罚款。

incur.en: The strategic regulation of evening body reserves is also likely to incur additional costs, as nightingales must spend more time foraging in order to build up larger body reserves.
incur.zh: 晚间的身体储能的策略管理机制，也会产生额外的能量支出，这样夜莺就必须花更多时间找食物，来增加储能。

incur.en: Though many people are accustomed to wearing shoes during all their waking hours, the more time you spend wearing shoes, the more likely you are to incur foot injuries as a result.
incur.zh: 有非常多的人习惯了只要醒着就要穿鞋，但事实是，你穿鞋的时间越长，你的脚因此受伤的可能性就越大。

indefinite.en: The trial was adjourned for an indefinite period.
They seem determined to string the talks out for an indefinite period.
indefinite.zh: 他们好像一心要把谈判无限期地拖下去。

indefinite.en: My heart was filled with puzzlement about the indefinite future and longing for the new life.
indefinite.zh: 我的心对不确定的未来充满了困惑，渴望着新生活。

independence.en: He was afraid of losing his independence.
independence.zh: 他担心丧失自己的独立。

independence.en: I admired her independence and her spunk.
independence.zh: 我敬佩她的独立精神和她的勇气。

indeed.zh: 20世纪80年代确实是繁荣的时代。

indeed.en: Horse breeding is indeed a risky enterprise.
indeed.zh: 养马的确是一项有风险的事业。

independent.zh: 莫桑比克于1975年获得独立。

independent.en: They were a proud and independent people.
independent.zh: 他们是一个独立而自尊的民族。

India.zh: 不久前她从印度回来了。

Indian.en: Chapattis are a kind of flat Indian bread.
She symbolized for me the best of Indian womanhood.
Indian.zh: 对我来说，她代表着最杰出的印度女性。

Indian.en: Ludo is a version of an ancient Indian racing game.
Indian.zh: “鲁多游戏”是一种古代印度竞赛游戏的变体。

index.zh: 甚至有一个特别的主题索引。

index.en: It will be published with annotations and index.
index.zh: 这本书出版时将附有注释和索引。

index.en: The Dow Jones index fell 15 points this morning.
index.zh: 道琼斯指数今天上午下跌了15点。

indicate.en: The extent of the rise might indicate that it had been overdone.
indicate.zh: 上涨的程度可能显示事情做得过头了。

indicate.en: Early results indicate that the government will be returned to power.
indicate.zh: 早期的结果预示这个政府将重新执政。

indicate.en: Surveys indicate that supporters of the treaty are still in the majority.
indicate.zh: 调查显示该条约的支持者仍占多数。

indicative.en: In 'Ben likes school', the verb 'like' is in the indicative.
indicative.zh: 在Ben likes school中，动词like是陈述语气。

indicative.en: Their failure to act is indicative of their lack of interest.
indicative.zh: 他们未采取行动，这表示他们没有兴趣。

indicative.en: His action is indicative of growing concern about the shortage of skilled labour.
indicative.zh: 他的行为显示对于熟练工人短缺现象的日益关注。

indication.en: There is no indication which way the vote could go.
indication.zh: 没有迹象表明投票的结果会怎么样。

indication.en: He searched Hill's impassive face for some indication that he understood.
indication.zh: 他在希尔没有表情的脸上搜寻着一些他理解的迹象。

indication.en: There had been no indication of either breathlessness or any loss of mental faculties right until his death.
indication.zh: 直到去世，他既没有出现呼吸困难也没有脑功能丧失的迹象。

indifferent.zh: 他缄默无言，对人疏远而且冷漠。

indifferent.en: She had starred in several very indifferent movies.
indifferent.zh: 她领衔主演过好几部非常平庸的电影。

indifferent.en: Her dull and indifferent husband replied that he had not.
indifferent.zh: 她那迟钝而冷漠的丈夫回答说他没有。

indignant.en: They were indignant that they hadn't been invited.
indignant.zh: 他们因没有受到邀请而愤愤不平。

indignant.en: Imagine that you know you're an evil git, but you know that the person you're playing against or with, is an indignant angel.
indignant.zh: 想象一下，你知道你是个邪恶的卑鄙小人，但是，你知道，和你一起玩或对抗的人是一个愤愤不平的天使。

indignant.en: He was indignant that his rival was offered the job.
indignant.zh: 他对他的对手得到了那份工作感到愤愤不平。

indirect.en: He took an indirect route back home.
indirect.zh: 他选择了一条迂回的路线回家。

indirect.en: The building collapsed as an indirect result of the heavy rain.
indirect.zh: 暴雨间接造成了那座楼房的倒塌。

indirect.en: What people had to pay in direct and indirect taxes had not gone up since 1979.
indirect.zh: 人们须缴纳的直接税和间接税从1979年开始没涨过。

indignation.en: He could scarcely keep in his indignation.
indignation.zh: 他几乎控制不住自己的愤怒。

indignation.en: The proposal has provoked howls of Gallic indignation.
indignation.zh: 这项提议已经激起了法国人愤怒的吼声。

indignation.en: The public's feelings were at a high pitch of indignation.
indignation.zh: 公众的愤怒情绪达到了极点。

indispensable.zh: 对他来说她正变得不可或缺。

indispensable.en: She made herself indispensable to the department.
indispensable.zh: 她成为这个部门不可缺少的一分子。

indispensable.en: Cars have become an indispensable part of our lives.
indispensable.zh: 汽车已成了我们生活中必不可少的一部分。

indoors.zh: 很多草本植物能在室内种植。

indoors.en: In view of the weather, the event will now be held indoors.
indoors.zh: 由于天气的缘故，这项赛事将在室内进行。

indoors.en: Even after you are indoors, be careful.

individual.en: Some individual investors exulted at the record.
individual.zh: 一些个人投资者为这一记录欢欣鼓舞。

individual.en: It's impossible to hold any individual responsible.
individual.zh: 不可能让任何个人承担责任。

induce.en: Nothing would induce me to take the job.
induce.zh: 没有什么能诱使我接受这份工作。

induce.en: Whales being sociable animals probably need the stimulus of sizeable gatherings to induce reproductives behavior.
induce.zh: 鲸作为社会性动物，可能需要大规模聚集的刺激来诱导繁殖行为。

indulge.en: Only rarely will she indulge in a glass of wine.
indulge.zh: 她只是偶尔才会喝上杯葡萄酒。

indulge.en: They went into town to indulge in some serious shopping.
The inheritance enabled him to indulge his passion for art.
indulge.zh: 这笔遗产使他能够尽情投入他热爱的艺术。

industrialize.zh: 能源消耗随着各国工业化而增加。

industrialize.en: The southern part of the country was slow to industrialize.
industrialize.zh: 这个国家的南部工业化进程缓慢。

industrialize.en: Many townships in the coastal area have begin to industrialize.
industrialize.zh: 沿海地区的许多乡镇已开始工业化。

industrial.zh: 日本的工业产量增长了2%。

industrial.en: Industrial production is beginning to pick up.
industrial.zh: 工业生产正在开始好转。

industry.zh: 这个行业有严格的管理。
这个行业已成衰退之势。

industry.en: Inflation is rampant and industry in decline.
industry.zh: 通货膨胀肆虐，工业生产下降。

inefficient.en: The whole process is wasteful and inefficient.
inefficient.zh: 整个程序既浪费又效率低。

inefficient.en: The train company is overstaffed and notoriously inefficient.
inefficient.zh: 这家铁路公司人员超编，且出了名地没有效率。

inefficient.en: Overall, barter is a very inefficient means of organizing transactions.
inefficient.zh: 总的说来，物物交换是一种非常低效的组织交易的方式。

inevitable.zh: 你得接受必然发生的事。
官僚主义所致的延误是不可避免的。

inevitable.en: Compromise is an inevitable part of life.
inevitable.zh: 妥协是生活不可避免的一部分。

inertia.en: We must remember that some people have a greater inertia than others.
inertia.zh: 我们必须记住，有些人比其他人更有惰性。

inertia.en: Inertia is the resistance of objects to efforts to change their state of motion.
inertia.zh: 惯性是物体对改变其运动状态的力的阻碍。

inertia.en: In physics, moving objects have two characteristics relevant to understanding the dynamics of energy systems: inertia and momentum.
inertia.zh: 在物理学中，运动的物体有两个特征与理解能量系统动力学相关：惯性和动量。

inexpensive.en: There is a large variety of good, inexpensive restaurants.
inexpensive.zh: 有多种物美价廉的餐馆。

inexpensive.en: She found a small, inexpensive motel on the outskirts of the town; it was barren and unlovely.
inexpensive.zh: 她在镇郊找了一个又小又便宜的汽车旅馆，设施不全也不好看。
这指的是任何便宜的报纸。

infant.en: There was an infant squalling in the back of the church.
infant.zh: 教堂的后面有个婴儿大声啼哭的声音。

infant.en: The nation's infant mortality rate has reached a record low.
infant.zh: 该国的婴儿死亡率已达历史最低。

infant.en: Infant mortality is a reliable barometer of socio-economic conditions.
infant.zh: 婴儿死亡率是社会经济状况的可靠指标。

infect.en: A single mosquito can infect a large number of people.
infect.zh: 一只蚊子就能传染很多人。
他的创造力会感染其他的学生。

infect.en: There is, however, a chance that the virus will infect the bilby, an endangered native marsupial.
infect.zh: 然而，这种病毒有可能会感染兔耳袋狸，这是本土的一种濒危有袋类动物。

infectious.en: Infectious diseases can be acquired in several ways.
infectious.zh: 传染病的感染途径有几种。

infer.en: What can we infer about the author from the text?
infer.zh: 从文章中我们能推断出作者的什么信息？

infer.en: What can we infer from the passage about the author?
infer.zh: 我们可以从文章中推断出关于作者的什么信息？

infer.en: You should learn how to infer a conclusion from statistics.
infer.zh: 你应该学会如何从数据中推断出一个结论。

inference.en: An evolutionary inference can then be drawn.
inference.zh: 这样就可以得到一个关于进化的推论。

inference.en: Which of the following, if true, is most damaging to the inference drawn by the scholars?
inference.zh: 下列哪一项最能推翻学者的推论？

inference.en: A third risk is that consumers may infer the intended conclusion but question the validity of their inference.
inference.zh: 第三个风险是，消费者可能会推断出预期的结论，但对其推论的有效性提出质疑。

inferior.en: Modern music is often considered inferior to that of the past.
inferior.zh: 现代音乐常被认为不如过去的。

inferior.en: He preferred the company of those who were intellectually inferior to himself.
inferior.zh: 他喜欢与那些智力不如他的人为伍。
他们在社会地位上不如他。

infinite.en: Human beings have an infinite capacity for self-deception.
infinite.zh: 人类自欺的能力是无穷尽的。

infinite.en: The most amazing thing about nature is its infinite variety.
infinite.zh: 大自然最让人惊叹的地方在于它的无限多样性。

infinite.en: Via the Internet, we are exposed to infinite information.
infinite.zh: 通过互联网，我们接触到无限的信息。

inflict.en: Do you have to inflict that music on us?
inflict.zh: 你非得逼我们听那种音乐吗？

inflict.en: The bursting of the bubble will inflict broad damage.
inflict.zh: 这场泡沫的破灭将造成广泛的影响。

inflation.zh: 通货膨胀是一种持续的威胁。

influence.en: He's never had any influence over her.
influence.zh: 他对她从没有过任何影响。

influence.en: Don't let me influence you either way.
influence.zh: 何去何从都别受我的影响。
随着时间的推移，他的影响已不如从前了。

influential.en: He was one of the most influential performers of modern jazz.
influential.zh: 他是最有影响力的现代爵士乐表演者之一。

influential.en: The West has gradually relaxed its hostile attitude to this influential state.
influential.zh: 西方对这个有影响力的国家的敌对态度已趋缓和。

information.zh: 我们汇集了意见和信息。
这条信息往后也许有用。
这项研究提供了有用的资料。

inform.en: They would inform him of any progress they had made.
inform.zh: 他们将把自己所取得的任何进展都告诉他。

inform.en: Teachers inform me that Todd's behaviour has improved no end.
inform.zh: 老师们告诉我托德的行为改善了许多。

inform.en: We regret to inform you that you are being furloughed indefinitely.
inform.zh: 我们遗憾地通知你：你被无限期地停职了。

ingenious.en: They are motivated to find ingenious ways to persuade their interlocutor.
ingenious.zh: 他们受到激励去寻找巧妙的方法去说服他们的对话者。

ingenious.en: You must have managed to escape, you clever, ingenious, intelligent Toad!
ingenious.zh: 你一定是设法逃出来的，你这聪明机灵的癞蛤蟆！

ingenious.en: His smartness of the morning had seemed to Tom a good joke before, and very ingenious.
ingenious.zh: 汤姆之前觉得他早上耍的小聪明是个很好的笑话，而且很有独创性。

ingredient.en: What is the active ingredient in aspirin?
ingredient.zh: 什么是阿司匹林中的有效成分？

ingredient.en: Coconut is a basic ingredient for many curries.
ingredient.zh: 椰子是多种咖喱菜的基本成分。

ingredient.en: Speed is the essential ingredient of all athletics.
ingredient.zh: 速度是所有体育运动的基本要素。

inhabitant.en: The former inhabitant of the Canary Isles continued his dithyrambic.
inhabitant.zh: 从前的加那利群岛居民继续喝着酒。

inhabitant.en: Princess was an inhabitant of the great Tenochtitlan.
inhabitant.zh: 公主是一个大特诺奇居民。
大力保障和改善林区民生。

inhabit.en: They inhabit reed huts built on stilts above the water.
inhabit.zh: 他们居住在建在水中木桩上的芦苇草屋里。

inhabit.en: The Olympic marmots inhabit meadows high in the Olympic Mountains where the weather conditions are much harsher.
inhabit.zh: 奥林匹克土拨鼠栖息的草地在奥林匹克山脉的高地，那里的气候条件要恶劣得多。

inhabit.en: A similar strategy—accelerated development combined with a resting stage—has also allowed amphibians to inhabit deserts.
inhabit.zh: 一个类似的策略——加速发展与休息阶段相结合——也使两栖动物得以栖息在沙漠中。

inhibit.en: Sore nipples can inhibit the milk supply.
inhibit.zh: 乳头疼痛可能抑制母乳分泌。

inhibit.en: Authority doesn't have to inhibit innovation but it often does.
inhibit.zh: 权威不一定要抑制创新，但它经常这样做。

inhibit.en: Moving around throughout the day can inhibit a tendency to fidget and chatter.
inhibit.zh: 一天内四处走动可以抑制你的烦躁和喋喋不休的谈话。

initiate.en: They wanted to initiate a discussion on economics.
initiate.zh: 他们想发起一次关于经济学的讨论。

initiate.en: People who are talked to have equally positive experiences as those who initiate a conversation.
initiate.zh: 被交谈的人与主动发起谈话的人有着同样积极的体验。

initiate.en: Next the researcher introduced a third option, a third paddle that would initiate a new trial, giving the dolphin the choice of passing on difficult trials.
initiate.zh: 接下来，研究人员引入了第三种选择，用第三只桨启动一个新的试验，让海豚选择跳过困难的试验。

inherit.en: He has no son to inherit his land.
inherit.zh: 他没有儿子来继承他的土地。

inherit.en: Sheila will inherit everything in the event of his death.
inherit.zh: 他一旦故去，所有财产都由希拉继承。

inherit.en: We inherit from our parents many of our physical characteristics.
inherit.zh: 我们从父母的遗传中得到许多体貌特征。

initial.en: My initial reaction was to decline the offer.
initial.zh: 我最初的反应是要婉言谢绝这个提议。

initial.en: They learned a lot from the initial market testing exercise.
initial.zh: 他们从最初的市场测试活动中学到了许多。

injection.en: You may notice redness and swelling after the injection.
An injection of local anaesthetic is usually given first to numb the area.
injection.zh: 通常先局部麻药注射使这一部位失去知觉。

initiative.en: We have the initiative; we intend to keep it.
initiative.zh: 我们拥有主动权；我们想要保持主动权。

initiative.en: She was disappointed by his lack of initiative.
initiative.zh: 她对他缺乏主动性感到失望。

initiative.en: He believed in giving his staff scope for initiative.
initiative.zh: 他赞成给他的员工主动的机会。

inject.en: 'Geo-engineering plans to inject stratospheric aerosols or to seed clouds would act to cool the planet, and act to increase the extent of sea ice,' says Rasch.
inject.zh: 拉施说：“地球工程计划将平流层的气溶胶注入到云层中，这将起到冷却地球的作用，并增加海冰的范围。”

inject.en: The US National Center for Atmospheric Ressearch has already suggested that the proposal to inject ulphur into the atmosphere might affect rainfall patterns across the tropics and the Southern Ocean.
inject.zh: 美国国家大气研究中心已经表示，向大气中注入硫的提议可能会影响整个热带和南大洋的降雨模式。

inject.en: The US National Center for Atmospheric Research has already suggested that the proposal to inject sulphur into the atmosphere might affect rainfall patterns across the tropics and the Southern Ocean.
inject.zh: 美国国家大气研究中心已经表示，向大气中注入硫的提议可能会影响整个热带和南大洋的降雨模式。

injure.en: You do not go out to injure opponents.
injure.zh: 你不会刻意去伤害对手。

injure.en: This could seriously injure the company's reputation.
injure.zh: 这会严重损害公司的声誉。

injure.en: When you use American weapons on your people, you injure us, too.
injure.zh: 当你对你的人民使用美国武器时，你也伤害了我们。

inland.zh: 大多数人居住在更远的内陆。

inland.en: The town lies a few kilometres inland.
inland.zh: 这个城市位于内陆几公里处。

inland.en: We travelled further inland the next day.
inland.zh: 我们第二天继续向内陆行进。

ink.en: The ink had run on the wet paper.
ink.zh: 墨迹在那张湿纸上渗开了。

injury.zh: 由于伤病，希克斯被迫认输。

injury.en: Shrugging off her injury, she played on.
injury.zh: 她受了伤，却继续进行比赛。

inlet.en: By selecting a group of suitable entrance parameters, a submerged inlet with the trapezoid entrance on the plane surface is designed and verified.
inlet.zh: 通过选取一组合适的入口参数，设计了一种在平面上具有梯形入口的水下入口，并进行了验证。

inlet.en: TC1 is mounted directly on the pump inlet tee replacing the convectron gauge shown on the diagram.
inlet.zh: TC1直接安装在泵进口三通上，取代图中所示的对流管压力表。

inlet.en: Upon inquiry, he learnt that the inn was near an inlet.
inlet.zh: 在询问之后，他知道了客栈在一个水湾附近。

inn.en: I always feel at home at Ye Olde Starre Inn.
inn.zh: 在昨日星辰客栈，我总是觉得非常舒适安逸。

inn.en: I learnt that the house had formerly been an inn.
inn.zh: 我得知这座房子以前是家客栈。

inn.en: She washed her face at the pump in front of the inn.
inn.zh: 她在客栈前的水泵旁洗了洗脸。

inner.zh: “胆小鬼！”内心一个小声音坚持说。

inner.en: She doesn't reveal much of her inner self.
inner.zh: 她不大流露她的内心自我。

innocent.zh: 我坚信她是清白无辜的。

innovation.en: His greatest innovation was the use of interchangeable parts.
innovation.zh: 他最伟大的创新是使用了可互换部件。
资本主义强调的是创新、竞争和个人至上。

innovation.en: Underpinning this success has been an exemplary record of innovation.
innovation.zh: 支持这一成功的基础是一次堪称典范的革新记录。

innumerable.en: Innumerable books have been written on the subject.
innumerable.zh: 已经有无数书籍写过这个主题。

innumerable.en: There are innumerable stars in the sky.
And the media published innumerable reports on his achievements.
innumerable.zh: 媒体对他的成就发表了无数篇报道。

inquire.en: He called them several times to inquire about job possibilities.
inquire.zh: 他给他们打了几次电话打听就业的可能性。

inquire.en: He went to the desk to inquire and make a reservation.
inquire.zh: 他到前台去咨询并做了预订。

inquire.en: Inspectors were appointed to inquire into the affairs of the company.
inquire.zh: 检查员被派去调查该公司的事务。

input.zh: 我将感激你在这方面的投入。

input.en: This program accepts input from most word processors.
input.zh: 这个程序可接受大多数文字处理系统输入的信息。

input.en: There has been a big input of resources into the project from industry.
input.zh: 工业界对这个项目投入了大量资源。

inquiry.en: The inquiry is by no means cut and dried.
inquiry.zh: 调查之事远未盖棺定论。

inquiry.en: A judge has suspended the ban pending a full inquiry.
inquiry.zh: 一名法官已暂时取消了此项禁令，等待一次全面调查。

inquiry.en: The board of inquiry is continuing its investigations.
inquiry.zh: 调查委员会在继续做调查。

insane.en: The letter made her insane with jealousy.
insane.zh: 那封信使她妒忌得发疯。

insane.en: The boy is half insane with hysteria and self-indulgence.
insane.zh: 这个男孩歇斯底里、任性放纵，成了半个疯子了。

insect.en: At rest the insect looks like a dead leaf.
insect.zh: 这种昆虫不动时看上去像一片枯叶。

insect.en: She scratched at the insect bites on her arm.
insect.zh: 她挠了挠胳膊上虫咬的包。

insect.en: The roof timbers were affected by rot and insect attack.
insect.zh: 屋顶的木料已经腐朽并遭虫害。

insight.en: He was a man of forceful character, with considerable insight and diplomatic skills.
insight.zh: 他是个性格坚强的人，有着非凡的洞察力和交际手腕。

insight.en: I missed having unique insight into tiny details that make a life.
insight.zh: 我怀念对生活中的微小细节拥有独到见解的能力。

insight.en: In business, his greatest skills were his insight and his management ability.
insight.zh: 在商业上，他最大的技能是他的洞察力和管理能力。

inside.en: Train your muscles and bones outside, and train your gomoku inside.
inside.zh: 外练筋骨皮，内练五子棋。
内心里，弗兰尼怒不可遏。

insist.en: So why do you insist on going to Beijing? Who the hell is even there?
insist.zh: 那你偏要去北京什么意思，北京到底有谁在啊！

insist.en: I insist on paying for the damage.
Oh, very well , then, if you insist.
insist.zh: 啊，那好吧，如果你坚持的话。

inspect.en: Elaine went outside to inspect the playing field.
inspect.zh: 伊莱恩到外边去检查运动场。

inspect.en: Make sure you inspect the goods before signing for them.
inspect.zh: 要确保在签收货物之前进行检验。

inspect.en: Public health officials were called in to inspect the premises.
inspect.zh: 公共卫生官员奉召来视察了建筑物。

inspection.en: On closer inspection , the notes proved to be forgeries.
inspection.zh: 经进一步检查发现钞票都是伪造的。

inspection.en: Engineers carried out a thorough inspection of the track.
inspection.zh: 工程师对轨道进行了彻底检查。

inspection.en: An inspection of his rig showed that three of the brakes were faulty.
inspection.zh: 对他的重型卡车的检查显示有3处刹车存在问题。

inspire.en: He has neither the policies nor the personal charisma to inspire people.
inspire.zh: 他既没有谋略也没有个人魅力去鼓舞人。

inspire.en: We must promote originality, inspire creativity and encourage innovation.
inspire.zh: 我们必须提倡独创性，激发创造力，鼓励创新。

inspire.en: Subjects were picked to inspire or entertain.
inspire.zh: 文章主题要有激励人心或是让人愉悦的效果。

inspiration.en: Both poets drew their inspiration from the countryside.
inspiration.zh: 两位诗人都是从乡村得到他们的灵感。

inspiration.en: She drew her inspiration from her childhood experiences.
inspiration.zh: 她从儿时的经历中获得灵感。

inspiration.en: My inspiration comes from poets like Baudelaire and Jacques Prévert.
inspiration.zh: 我的灵感来自像波德莱尔和雅克·普莱维尔这样的诗人。

installation.en: Installation of the new system will take several days.
installation.zh: 新系统的安装需要几天时间。

installation.en: Hundreds of lives could be saved if the installation of alarms was more widespread.
installation.zh: 如果警报器的安装范围更为广泛，成百上千人的生命就可能获救。

installation.en: Create an SIS installation file for easy deployment of your application.
installation.zh: 创建 SIS 安装文件，以便于部署您的应用程序。

install.en: The equipment can be tricky to install.
install.zh: 这设备安装起来可能很费事。

install.en: Unlike most systems, this one is very easy to install.
install.zh: 本系统与多数系统不同，极易安装。

instantaneous.en: Used in this way, intuition is an almost instantaneous cognitive process in which a manager recognizes familiar patterns.
instantaneous.zh: 在这种情况下，直觉是管理者识别熟悉模式的瞬间认知过程。

instantaneous.en: To a culture which has come to take instantaneous communication for granted, as part of the very structure of civilized life, this "time barrier" may have a profound psychological impact.
instantaneous.zh: 对于一个将即时通讯视为文明生活结构一部分的文化来说，这种“时间障碍”可能会产生深远的心理影响。

installment.en: Martine puts it down to, among other things, soap operas and installment plans introduced in the 1970s.
installment.zh: 此外，玛蒂娜将其归因于20世纪70年代推出的肥皂剧和分期付款计划。

installment.en: Martine puts it down to, among other things, soap operas and installment plans introduced in the 1970s. Both played an important, although indirect, role in lowering the birth rate.
installment.zh: 玛蒂娜将其归因于20世纪70年代推出的肥皂剧和分期付款计划。尽管是间接的，但两者在降低出生率方面都发挥了重要的作用。

installment.en: After the first installment, Dickens wrote to the artist and asked him to correct a drawing Dickens felt was not faithful enough to his prose.
installment.zh: 在第一期之后，狄更斯写信给这位画家，请他修改一幅狄更斯认为和自己的散文不那么相符的画。

instant.en: For an instant I was infected by her fear.
instant.zh: 一瞬间，我被她的恐惧所感染。

instant.en: For an instant, Barney was tempted to flee.
instant.zh: 那一瞬间，巴尼很想逃走。

instant.en: The engine delivers instant acceleration whatever the revs.
instant.zh: 不论转速如何，发动机都可以立即加速。

instance.en: Can you quote me an instance of when this happened?
instance.zh: 你能否给我举例说明一下发生这事的情况？

instance.en: What would you do, for instance, if you found a member of staff stealing?
instance.zh: 比如说，如果你发现有职员偷东西，你会怎么办？

instance.en: Malcolm, for instance, works in isolation but I have no doubts about his abilities.
instance.zh: 例如，马尔科姆虽然一个人独立工作，但我丝毫不怀疑他的能力。

instantly.en: I recognized it instantly and felt a quiver of panic.
instantly.zh: 我立刻认出它了，感到一阵惊恐的颤抖。

instantly.en: She can pick up a tune instantly on the piano. It's a gift.
instantly.zh: 她听到曲子就能马上用钢琴弹出来，这是天分。

instantly.en: I felt a little bump and I knew instantly what had happened.
instantly.zh: 我感到了一下轻轻的撞击，立刻就明白发生了什么。

instead.en: He put a plus instead of a minus.
instead.zh: 他填了个加号而不是减号。
我们看到的是情节剧，而不是悲剧。

instead.en: Instead of taking offence, the woman smiled.
instead.zh: 那女人不但不生气反而笑了。

instinct.en: He should have let his instinct guide him.
instinct.zh: 他本该让直觉指导他的行动。

instinct.en: Many birds have a remarkable homing instinct.
instinct.zh: 很多鸟类具有了不起的返回原地的本能。

instinct.en: Horses have a well-developed instinct for fear.

institute.en: Mr. Lin is associate director of the Institute.
institute.zh: 林先生是该研究所的副主任。

institute.en: He got a scholarship to the Pratt Institute of Art.
institute.zh: 他得到了一笔普拉特艺术学院的奖学金。

institute.en: He visited the Institute of Neurology in Havana where they both worked.
institute.zh: 他在哈瓦那参观了他们俩都曾工作过的神经病学研究所。

instruct.en: You can instruct your bank to allow a third party to remove money from your account.
instruct.zh: 你可以通知银行，允许第三方从你的账户取款。

instruct.en: Does it corrupt or instruct our children?
instruct.zh: 那它会使我们的孩子堕落，还是会教导他们呢？

instruct.en: Greater effort is needed to instruct children in road safety.
instruct.zh: 在指导儿童注意道路安全方面需要付出更大的努力。

institution.en: I believe in the institution of marriage.
Bernard works at the same institution as Arlette.
institution.zh: 伯纳德与阿莱特在同一个机构工作。

institution.en: The European Parliament is not an institution which excites interest in voters.
institution.zh: 欧洲议会是个激不起选民兴趣的机构。

instruction.en: Each candidate is given instruction in safety.
instruction.zh: 每位候选人都被给予了安全指导。

instruction.en: This technique brings life to instruction and eases assimilation of knowledge.
instruction.zh: 这种技术给教学带来活力，并使知识的吸收更加容易。

instruction.en: Two lawyers were told not to leave the building but no reason for this instruction was given.
instruction.zh: 两位律师被告知不要离开这座建筑，但没被告知这一指示的原因。

instrument.en: The instrument is beautifully made in brass.
instrument.zh: 这个乐器是用黄铜精致铸造成的。

instrument.en: He draws a unique full sound from the instrument.
instrument.zh: 他用乐器奏出了独特圆浑的音调。

insufficient.en: His salary is insufficient to meet his needs.
insufficient.zh: 他的薪水不够应付需要。

insufficient.en: Facilities for people with disabilities are still insufficient.
insufficient.zh: 供残疾人使用的设施仍然不足。

insufficient.en: Our industry suffers through insufficient investment in research.
insufficient.zh: 我们的工业因研究投入不足而大吃苦头。

instrumental.en: Asian-American parents are enthusiastic supporters of the competitive instrumental music program.
instrumental.zh: 亚裔美国人的父母是这个竞争激烈的器乐项目的热情支持者。

instrumental.en: Instrumental ties are social links formed when we cooperate with other people to achieve some goal.
instrumental.zh: 工具性联系是我们为了实现某种目标而与他人合作时形成的社会联系。

instrumental.en: Instrumental ties predominate in secondary groups; we perceive people as means to ends rather than as ends in their own right.
instrumental.zh: 工具性关系在次级群体中占主导地位；我们把人当作达成目的的手段，而不是目的本身。

insulate.en: Huxley speculated that a coat of hair would insulate against loss of body heat and might streamline the body to reduce drag in flight.
insulate.zh: 赫胥黎推测，一层毛发可以隔离身体热量的流失，并可能使身体呈现流线型，以减少飞行中的阻力。

insulate.en: People should insulate their homes to conserve energy.
insulate.zh: 人们应该使住房隔冷以保存能量。

insulate.en: Is there any way we can insulate our home from the noise?
insulate.zh: 有什么办法能使我们家隔音吗？

insult.en: Forgive me, I don't mean to insult you.
insult.zh: 请原谅我，我不是有意侮辱你。

insult.en: Their behaviour was an insult to the people they represent.
insult.zh: 他们的行为是对他们所代表的人们的一种侮辱。

insurance.zh: 预计保险索赔会急剧增加。

insure.en: Make sure you insure your camera against loss or damage.
insure.zh: 一定要给你的照相机投保，以防丢失或损坏。

insure.en: Families with modest incomes should insure the breadwinner or breadwinners first.
insure.zh: 收入不高的家庭应当首先为养家糊口的人投保。

insure.en: We insure against all damage, accidental or otherwise.
insure.zh: 我们的保险包括一切意外或其他损失。

intact.zh: 这个花瓶保存得完好无损。
战争之后没几座完好的建筑了。

intact.en: Most of the house remains intact even after two hundred years.
intact.zh: 虽然过了两百年，这房子的大部分还保持完好。

integral.en: As an integral part of learning, it brings about positive changes, making people develop and grow.
integral.zh: 作为学习的一个组成部分，它带来了积极的变化，使人发展和成长。

integral.en: Materials and methods of construction are integral parts of the design of architecture structures.
integral.zh: 建筑材料和施工方法是建筑结构设计的重要组成部分。

integral.en: All models have an integral CD player.
integral.zh: 所有型号都有内置的激光唱片机。

integrate.en: He didn't integrate successfully into the Italian way of life.
integrate.zh: 他没有成功融入到意大利的生活方式中去。

integrate.en: They have not made any effort to integrate with the local community.
integrate.zh: 他们完全没有尝试融入本地社区。

integrate.en: The strategy is to integrate the development of these cities for a better economic structure.
integrate.zh: 策略就是整合这些城市的发展，以便形成更好的经济结构。

integrity.zh: 他的诚实正直未受到过质疑。

integrity.en: Mayhew is a man of rock-solid integrity.
integrity.zh: 梅休是一个正直可靠的男人。

integrity.en: I have always regarded him as a man of integrity.
integrity.zh: 我一直把他看作个正直的男人。

intellect.en: Do the emotions develop in parallel with the intellect?
intellect.zh: 情感与智力同步发展吗？

intellect.en: You are endowed with wealth, good health and a lively intellect.
intellect.zh: 你天生赋有财富、健康，和敏锐的智力。

intellectual.zh: 他是一个聪明博学的人。

intellectual.en: Some Americans see Oxford as an intellectual Disneyland.
intellectual.zh: 一些美国人把牛津视为知识分子的乐园。

intelligence.zh: 为什么军事情报如此缺乏？

intelligence.en: He deserted from army intelligence last month.
intelligence.zh: 他上个月从军队情报部门开了小差。
很多诵读困难者的智力都在平均水平以上。

intelligible.en: His lecture was readily intelligible to all the students.
intelligible.zh: 他的讲课学生们都能轻松地听懂。

intelligible.en: The language of Darwin was intelligible to experts and non-experts alike.
intelligible.zh: 达尔文的语言对专家和平常人来说都容易理解。

intelligible.en: Will it split into varieties that become less mutually intelligible?
intelligible.zh: 它会分裂成不同的变种，变得不易相互理解吗？

intelligent.en: She's even more intelligent than her sister.
intelligent.zh: 她甚至比她姐姐还聪明。

intend.zh: 他们打算起诉，要求赔偿损失。
我们打算对此裁决提出申诉。

intense.en: It was a period of intense activity.
The battle for third place was intense.
intense.zh: 竞争第3名的较量很紧张。

intense.en: The scene was palpably intense to watch.
intense.zh: 那场面看起来显然很激烈。

intensity.en: The solemn intensity of Jade's gaze discomfited him.
intensity.zh: 在杰德强烈而严肃的凝视下他狼狈不堪。

intensity.en: Everyone I know who kept it up at that intensity is burned-out.
intensity.zh: 我所认识的一直保持那样工作强度的人都早衰了。

intensity.en: The intensity of the work left little room for personal grief or anxiety.
intensity.zh: 该工作的强度很少给个人留下悲伤或忧虑的机会。

intensify.en: Failure can never defeat me but only intensify my desire to succeed.
intensify.zh: 失败永远无法打败我，只会增强我对获得成功的渴望。

intensify.en: Criticism over the original state of the building is likely to intensify over the coming days.
intensify.zh: 在未来几天，对这座建筑原始状态的批评可能会加剧。

intensify.en: That is clearly an untenable view, since editors can often intensify reader interest in a news topic by giving it frequent coverage.
intensify.zh: 这显然是站不住脚的观点，因为编辑通常可以通过频繁报道来增强读者对新闻话题的兴趣。

intensive.en: Ahead of us lay ten days of intensive training.
intensive.zh: 我们还要进行十天的强化训练。
集约耕作使土壤变得贫瘠。

intent.en: His intent is clearly not to placate his critics.
intent.zh: 他的目的显然不是要安抚批评他的人。

intent.en: I was so intent on my work that I didn't notice the time.
intent.zh: 我专心工作，以致忘了时间。

intent.en: His intent was to connect college students.
intent.zh: 他的目的是把大学生联系起来。

intentional.en: I'm sorry I left you off the list—it wasn't intentional.
intentional.zh: 很抱歉没把你列在名单里—我不是有意的。

intentional.en: Women who are the victims of intentional discrimination will be able to get compensation.
intentional.zh: 遭受故意歧视的妇女们将能得到赔偿。

intentional.en: Changing fashions are nothing more than the intentional creation of waste.
intentional.zh: 时尚的变化只不过是故意制造的浪费。

intention.en: The bank announced its intention to bid.
intention.zh: 银行宣布了其投标意向。

intention.en: He has announced his intention to retire.
intention.zh: 他已经宣布他打算退休。

intention.en: He has already intimated to us his intention to retire.
intention.zh: 他已经向我们透露了他要退休的打算。

interact.en: You have to understand how cells interact.
interact.zh: 你必须得了解细胞之间是如何相互作用的。

interact.en: They learn how to interact with their peers.
interact.zh: 他们学习如何与同龄人互动。

interact.en: This determines both people interact in meetings.
interact.zh: 这决定了人们在会议上的互动方式。

interaction.zh: 他们在社交互动方面得分更高。

interaction.en: It is the gravitational interaction with planets, right?
interaction.zh: 这是引力与行星的相互作用，对吧？

interaction.en: Price is determined through the interaction of demand and supply.
interaction.zh: 价格是由供求关系的相互作用决定的。

interesting.zh: 你去过任何有趣的地方吗？
我们就不能做点更有意思的事情吗？

interesting.en: I collect shells and interesting seaside items.
interesting.zh: 我收集贝壳以及海边有趣的东西。

interfere.en: We take the view that it would be wrong to interfere.
interfere.zh: 我们所持的态度是：干涉是错误的。

interfere.en: I try not to let work interfere with my personal life.
interfere.zh: 我尽量不让工作干扰我的私生活。

interfere.en: She never allows her personal feelings to interfere with her work.
interfere.zh: 她从不让她的个人感情妨碍工作。

interference.en: Any outside criticism is routinely dismissed as interference.
interference.zh: 任何外来批评照例都被当作干涉而不予理睬。

interference.en: They resent foreign interference in the internal affairs of their country.
interference.zh: 他们憎恶对他们国家内政的外来干涉。

interference.en: Furthermore, they claim that any such interference is completely ineffective.
interference.zh: 此外，他们声称任何此类干涉都是完全无效的。

interim.en: The power-balance has evened out in the interim government.
interim.zh: 临时政府内的权力平衡已持平。

interim.en: She was sworn in as head of an interim government in March.
interim.zh: 她3月份宣誓出任临时政府首脑。

interim.en: The vice-president took power in the interim period before the election.
interim.zh: 在大选之前的过渡阶段由副总统执政。

interior.zh: 这种室内设计简约宜人。

interior.en: The ship's interior was an utter shambles.
interior.zh: 那艘船的内部一片狼藉。

intermediate.en: Students are categorized as novice, intermediate, or advanced.
intermediate.zh: 学生分为新生、中级生或高级生。

intermediate.en: Honestly, the harder classes that I'm in are intermediate microeconomics.
intermediate.zh: 老实说，我现在上的更难的课程是中级微观经济学。

intermediate.en: They have to assess your level and steer you to the right class, beginner, intermediate.
intermediate.zh: 他们必须评估你的水平然后把你分到正确的班级，如初级班，中级班。

intermittent.en: So, even under normal situations, the gene flow among the subpopulations is more of an intermittent trickle than a steady stream.
intermittent.zh: 所以即使在正常条件下，这些亚物种间的基因流动也更像是一条断断续续的细流，而不是一条不停流淌的小溪。

intermittent.en: When the driver accelerated, the vacuum was insufficient to run the intermittent mode and the wipers would default to high speed.
intermittent.zh: 当司机加速时，真空不足以运行间歇模式，雨刷将默认为高速。

intermittent.en: Actual loss will depend upon the particular frequencies to which one is exposed, and whether the sound is continuous or intermittent.
intermittent.zh: 实际的损失将取决于暴露的特定频率，以及声音是连续的还是间歇的。

internal.en: The medicine is not for internal use.

internal.zh: 该国加强了国内安全防卫。

internal.en: The doctor said the internal bleeding had been massive.
internal.zh: 医生说内出血的量很大。

international.zh: 这部影片为他赢得了国际声誉。

interpret.en: The students were asked to interpret the poem.
interpret.zh: 学生们被要求诠释那首诗的意义。

interpret.en: She couldn't speak much English so her children had to interpret for her.
interpret.zh: 她讲不了几句英语，所以她的孩子们得给她翻译。

interpret.en: The chambermaid spoke little English, so her husband came with her to interpret.
interpret.zh: 那个女服务员几乎不会说英语，所以她丈夫来给她作口译。

interpreter.en: They volunteered me for the job of interpreter.
interpreter.zh: 他们擅自指定由我担任口头翻译。

interpreter.en: Speaking through an interpreter , the President said that the talks were going well.
interpreter.zh: 总统通过译员说会谈进展良好。

interpreter.en: Speaking through an interpreter, Aristide said that Haitians had hoped coups were behind them.
interpreter.zh: 通过口译员，亚里斯蒂德说海地人希望政变再也不发生了。

interpretation.en: History is always a matter of interpretation.
interpretation.zh: 历史总是一个诠释的问题。

interpretation.en: She stamped her own interpretation on the role.
interpretation.zh: 她给那个角色注入了她自己的诠释。

interpretation.en: Her interpretation of the facts may be open to doubt.
interpretation.zh: 她对事实的解释可能有待质疑。

interrupt.en: Can I interrupt you just for a minute?
interrupt.zh: 我可不可以打断你一会儿？
请继续往下说，我并非有意打断你的话。

interruption.en: The sudden interruption stopped Justin in mid-sentence.
interruption.zh: 贾斯廷话说到一半时被突然打断了。

interruption.en: The birth of her son was a minor interruption to her career.
interruption.zh: 她儿子的出生对她的事业造成一个小小的中断。

intersection.zh: 我们穿过了一个繁忙的道路交叉口。
这条公路止于一个十字路口。

intersection.en: Du Du was in his usual spot: the middle of Borgela and Sans-Fil Streets, a hilly hairpin intersection between downtown and the airport.
intersection.zh: 杜杜正在他常去的地方：博吉拉和桑菲尔街的中间，位于市中心和机场之间的丘陵发夹带的交叉口。

interval.en: The process is repeated after a short interval of time.
interval.zh: 该程序间隔很短时间就重复一次。

interval.en: The interval between major earthquakes might be 200 years.
interval.zh: 大地震之间的间隔时间可能有200年。

interval.en: There is a 15-minute interval between two boats.
interval.zh: 两艘船之间有十五分钟的间隔。

intervene.en: The problem lies in deciding when to intervene.
intervene.zh: 问题在于决定何时介入。

intervene.en: The security forces had to intervene to prevent the situation worsening.
intervene.zh: 那些安全部队不得不干预以阻止形势变得更糟。

intervene.en: They remain unwilling to intervene militarily in what could be an unending war.
intervene.zh: 他们仍然不愿意对一场可能无休止的战争进行军事干预。

interview.zh: 她刚刚录制了一次采访。
她为参加面试打扮了一番。

intimidate.en: If you're too concerned with outcomes to the extent that you manipulate and intimidate others to achieve those outcomes, then you aren't leading at all, you're dictating.
intimidate.zh: 如果你过于关注结果，为此到了去操纵和恐吓他人的程度，那么你根本不是在领导，而是在发号施令。

intimidate.en: Jones had set out to intimidate and dominate Paul.
intimidate.zh: 琼斯曾试图威胁并控制保罗。

intimidate.en: "You have no right to intimidate this man," Alison continued.
intimidate.zh: “你无权威胁这个男人，”爱丽森继续说。

intimate.en: He wrote about the intimate details of his family life.
intimate.zh: 他写下了家庭生活中一些私人的细节。

intimate.en: He went on to intimate that he was indeed contemplating a shake-up of the company.
intimate.zh: 他接着暗示他确实在考虑对公司进行一次改组。

intimate.en: The cafe has an intimate but buzzy atmosphere.
intimate.zh: 咖啡馆气氛暧昧但又很活泼。

into.zh: 他不声不响地钻进被子。

intricate.en: He knows his way around the intricate maze of patent law.
intricate.zh: 他通晓错综复杂的专利法。

intricate.en: His new play, Arcadia, is as intricate, elaborate and allusive as anything he has yet written.
intricate.zh: 他的新剧本《阿卡狄亚》是他迄今为止创作的最错综复杂、煞费苦心和让人琢磨不定的。

intricate.en: You develop in-depth knowledge of the intricate structure of the language.
intricate.zh: 你对复杂的语言结构有更深入的了解。

intrinsic.en: Diamonds have little intrinsic value and their price depends almost entirely on their scarcity.
intrinsic.zh: 钻石没有多少内在价值，它们的价格几乎完全取决于其稀有程度。

intrinsic.en: It's got extrinsic and intrinsic value for me.
intrinsic.zh: 对我来说，它有外在和内在的价值。

intrinsic.en: Let me introduce a couple of technical terms: extrinsic value and intrinsic value.
intrinsic.zh: 让我来介绍几个术语：外在价值和内在价值。

intrigue.en: He found himself snared in a web of intrigue.
They spiced their conversations and discussions with intrigue.
intrigue.zh: 他们通过设谜为他们的谈话和讨论增加乐趣。

intrigue.en: The young heroine steps into a web of intrigue in the academic world.
intrigue.zh: 年轻的女主人公陷入了学术界钩心斗角的罗网。

introduce.zh: 我来介绍一下我的妻子。

introduce.en: It gives me great pleasure to introduce our guest speaker.
introduce.zh: 我很荣幸来介绍我们的特约演讲人。

introduce.en: "And now, without further ado, let me introduce our benefactor."
introduce.zh: “现在，闲话少说，让我来介绍一下我们的捐赠人。”

introduction.en: The notes are intended as an introduction to the course.
introduction.zh: 这些笔记的目的是作为对这门课程的介绍。

introduction.en: It's a useful introduction to an extremely complex subject.
introduction.zh: 这是对一门极为复杂的学科的有益入门教程。

introduction.en: The book is a friendly, down-to-earth introduction to physics.
introduction.zh: 这是一本简明、实用的物理学入门书。

intuition.zh: 她的得体和直觉从不出错。

intuition.en: Her intuition was telling her that something was wrong.
intuition.zh: 她的直觉在告诉她事情有些不对头。
直觉可能会影响反思性任务。

invade.en: Whales will invade king penguins' breeding grounds.
invade.zh: 鲸鱼会入侵帝企鹅的繁殖地。

invade.en: Species that invade a territory can harm ecosystems, agriculture and human health.
invade.zh: 入侵一个地区的物种会危害生态系统、农业和人类健康。

invade.en: I suspect that whatever Facebook has done so far to invade our privacy, it's only the beginning.
invade.zh: 我认为，到目前为止，无论 Facebook 做了什么侵犯我们的隐私的事情，这仅仅是个开始。

invaluable.en: In his job, patience is an invaluable asset.
invaluable.zh: 他干的这份工作，耐心是无价之宝。

invaluable.en: I was able to gain invaluable experience over that year.
invaluable.zh: 在那一年里我获得了十分宝贵的经验。

invariably.zh: 他们几乎总是将它弄错。
患者们的各种需求总是相互重合的。

invalid.en: The trial was stopped and the results declared invalid.
invalid.zh: 审判被终止了，其结果被宣布无效。

invalid.en: People with invalid papers are deported to another country.
invalid.zh: 持无效证件的人被驱逐到别国。

invalid.en: Margaret resides with her invalid mother in a Seattle suburb.
invalid.zh: 玛格丽特和她有病的妈妈住在西雅图郊区。

invasion.en: There was widespread condemnation of the invasion.
invasion.zh: 那次侵略遭到了人们普遍的谴责。

invasion.en: The actress described the photographs of her as an invasion of privacy.
invasion.zh: 那位女演员认为她的这些照片是对隐私权的侵犯。

invasion.en: He leaned towards her and she stiffened at this invasion of her personal space.
invasion.zh: 他向她俯过身去，这种侵犯她个人空间的举动让她绷紧了身子。

invent.en: The U.S. needs the new companies that will invent them.
invent.zh: 美国需要能发明这些产品的新公司。

invent.en: I learned that different inventors often invent similar things.
invent.zh: 我了解到不同的发明家经常发明类似的东西。

invent.en: What excuse did he invent this time?

invention.en: The spinning wheel was a Chinese invention.
invention.zh: 纺车是中国人的一项发明。

invention.en: You can't fault them for lack of invention.
invention.zh: 你不能因为他们没有发明而加以批评他们。
他的发明从赢利角度看并不成功。

inventor.en: In my youth my ambition had been to be an inventor.
inventor.zh: 在我年轻时我的抱负曾是当一名发明家。

inventor.en: The royalties enabled the inventor to re-establish himself in business.
inventor.zh: 这些使用费使这名发明者能再次立足商界。

inventory.en: They're likely to hold big fire sales to liquidate their inventory.
inventory.zh: 为了盘活库存，他们很可能会进行大甩卖。

inventory.en: I did all of the ordering for the store, and I kept track of the inventory.
inventory.zh: 我为店里做了所有的订单，并记录了库存情况。

inventory.en: This concept appears in manufacturing where they count both scrap and inventory.
inventory.zh: 这一概念出现在制造业中，在其中计算废料和库存。

invert.en: Aspects are used to invert dependencies and decouple code.
invert.zh: 方面用于倒置依赖和解耦代码。

invert.en: No condition, however, the option to invert the result it used.
invert.zh: No条件使用相同的代码片段，不过，在这里使用了将结果取反的选项。

invert.en: So, how did we invert matrices? Let me just remind you very quickly.
invert.zh: 我们是怎样做的呢？，提示你们一下。

investigate.zh: 他觉得有必要作进一步调查。
警方决定作进一步调查。

investigate.en: The FBI has been called in to investigate.
investigate.zh: 联邦调查局奉命进行调查。

invest.en: It would be hazardous to invest so much.
Many people don't like to invest in stocks.
invest.zh: 许多人不喜欢投资股票。

invest.en: They had the foresight to invest in new technology.
invest.zh: 他们有投资新技术的先见之明。

investigation.zh: 警方的调查在持续进行中。

investment.en: Training is an investment not a cost.
investment.zh: 培训是一种投资而不是一种花费。
投资正在成为一项冒险的事业。

invisible.en: Most spiders weave webs that are almost invisible.
invisible.zh: 大多数蜘蛛可结成几乎看不见的网。

invisible.en: Above him an invisible plane droned through the night sky.
invisible.zh: 在他头顶上空一架隐形飞机飞过夜空，不断发出低沉单调的声音。

invisible.en: Patterns that are invisible on the ground can be the most striking part of an aerial photograph.
invisible.zh: 在地面上看不见的图案可能是空中照片中最为醒目的部分。

invite.en: Who did you invite to the party?
invite.zh: 你邀请了哪些人来参加聚会？

invite.en: It was nice of them to invite us.
I'm in a dither about who to invite.

invitation.zh: 伊夫一口回绝了马克的邀请。

involve.en: The treatment does not involve the use of any artificial drugs.
involve.zh: 这种疗法不涉及任何人造药物的使用。

involve.en: Most political questions involve morality in some form or other.
involve.zh: 多数政治问题牵涉到这样或那样的道义性。

involve.en: Most air rage incidents involve heavy drinking.
involve.zh: 大多数空中愤怒事件都与酗酒有关。

inward.zh: 我内心释然地长出了一口气。

inward.en: Her calm expression hid her inward panic.
inward.zh: 她平静的外表掩盖了内心的恐慌。

inward.en: He pushed open the front door, which swung inward with a groan.
inward.zh: 他推开前门，门呀的一声向里开了。

irony.en: 'England is famous for its food,' she said with heavy irony.
irony.zh: “英格兰的食物很有名哪。”她极其讽刺地说道。

iron.zh: 那扇巨大的铁门被锁上了。

iron.en: She was known as the 'Iron Lady'.

irregular.zh: 她考了我们的不规则动词。
不规则形式标注在括号内。

irrespective.en: Everyone is treated equally, irrespective of race.
irrespective.zh: 不分种族，每个人都受到公平对待。

irrespective.en: The weekly rent is the same irrespective of whether there are three or four occupants.
irrespective.zh: 无论三个还是四个人住，周租金不变。

irrespective.en: Irrespective of the quality of a school a child's home life is of key importance.
irrespective.zh: 不管学校教育的质量如何，孩子的家庭生活都是至关重要的。

irrigation.en: The agricultural land is hilly and the irrigation poor.
irrigation.zh: 这片农田多丘陵，而且灌溉条件很差。

irrigation.en: The rivers merge just north of a vital irrigation system.
irrigation.zh: 这些河流在一个重要的灌溉系统的北部汇合了。

irrigation.en: If the irrigation plan goes ahead, it could spell disaster for the birds.
irrigation.zh: 如果该灌溉计划继续的话，这对鸟类可能预示着灾难。

irritate.en: Some drugs can irritate the lining of the stomach.
irritate.zh: 有些药物会刺激胃内壁。

irritate.en: Wear rubber gloves while chopping chillies as they can irritate the skin.
irritate.zh: 剁辣椒时戴上橡皮手套，因为它们会刺激皮肤。

irritate.en: In fact, this may irritate some people.
irritate.zh: 事实上，这可能会激怒一些人。

island.zh: 这个岛已经没有人居住了。

isolate.en: Researchers are still trying to isolate the gene that causes this abnormality.
isolate.zh: 研究人员仍然在试图分离导致这种畸形的基因。

isolate.en: This policy could isolate the country from the other permanent members of the United Nations Security Council.
isolate.zh: 这项政策可能会将这个国家从联合国安理会的其他常任理事国中孤立出来。

isolate.en: Element 43's radioactivity makes it easy to isolate and measure.
isolate.zh: 43号元素的放射性使其易于分离和测量。

issue.zh: 你只不过是在回避问题。
这个问题至今仍在激烈地辩论中。

it.zh: 是谁干的真的很重要吗？

Italian.en: Where is your Italian cannon? Get it up here!
Italian.zh: 你他娘的意大利炮呢，给我拉上来！
意大利鞋是无与伦比的。

Italy.zh: 这艘船是开往意大利的。

Italy.en: Did you get my card from Italy?
Italy.zh: 你收到我从意大利寄出的明信片了吗？

item.en: What's the next item on the agenda?
The other item on the agenda is the tour.

its.en: Its film industry operates in its own curiously hermetic way.
its.zh: 它的电影业以奇特而封闭的方式运作。

its.en: This made its mini-computers incompatible with its mainframes.
its.zh: 这使得它的微型电脑与其主机不兼容。

its.en: Her speech was memorable for its polemic rather than its substance.
its.zh: 她的演说之所以令人难忘，不是因其内容而是因其辩论方法。

itself.zh: 比赛本身就令人非常兴奋。

ivory.en: He showed him how to blow into the ivory mouthpiece.
ivory.zh: 他给他演示了如何把气吹进象牙吹口。

ivory.en: They don't really, in their ivory towers, understand how pernicious drug crime is.
ivory.zh: 身处象牙塔里，他们并不真正懂得毒品犯罪多么有害。

jacket.zh: 那把刀划破了他的上衣。
我把夹克的拉链拉上，系好扣子。

jail.zh: 他已从监狱里放出来了。

jail.en: A forty-foot-high concrete wall encircles the jail.
jail.zh: 一道40英尺高的水泥墙环绕着该监狱。

January.zh: 一月是我最不喜欢的月份。

January.en: Rose is due to start school in January.
January.zh: 罗斯一月份就要开始上学了。

January.en: The new President takes office in January.
January.zh: 新总统将于一月份就职。

Japan.zh: 这个乐队在日本很走红。

Japan.en: How do you find life in Japan?
Japan.zh: 你觉得日本的生活如何？
去年四月我们去了日本。

jam.en: We were stuck in a traffic jam.
The fruit can be made into jam.
jam.zh: 这种水果可以制成果酱。

jam.en: Skim the jam and let it cool.
jam.zh: 撇去果酱上的浮沫，让它冷却。

Japanese.zh: 凡是日本的东西她都喜欢。

jar.en: She opened up a jar of plums.
I can't get the lid off this jar.
jar.zh: 我打不开这广口瓶的盖子。

jaw.zh: 他长着一副结实的方下巴。
唾液顺着他的下巴流下。

jazz.en: He put some jazz on the stereo.
jazz.zh: 他用立体声音响播放了一点爵士乐。
爵士乐对于我来说是不可或缺的。

jeopardize.en: By capping her grades at 94 while most other teachers grade on a scale that tops out at 100, your teacher could jeopardize a student's chance of getting a scholarship or getting into a top college.
jeopardize.zh: 如果你的老师把自己的成绩限制在94分，而其他大多数老师的评分范围都在100分以上，那么你的老师可能会危及学生获得奖学金或进入顶尖大学的机会。

jeopardize.en: He would never do anything to jeopardize his career.
jeopardize.zh: 他决不会做任何有损于他事业的事。

jerk.en: Why would you invite a jerk like that anyway?
jerk.zh: 你为什么还要邀请那样一个混蛋呀？
他感到自己的头部突然反射性的抽动。

jet.en: He had arrived from Key West by jet.
jet.zh: 他已乘喷气式飞机从基韦斯特来了。

jet.en: I watched as they got on the jet ski.
jet.zh: 我看着他们坐上了喷气式滑艇。

jet.en: The aircraft is powered by a jet engine.
jet.zh: 这架飞机由喷气发动机驱动。

jew.en: He was black and spent his entire life as a Jew, which was opposed by his family.
jew.zh: 他是黑人，并以犹太人的身份度过一生，这样做受到了家人的反对。

jew.en: If the only Jew you know is Shakespeare's Shylock, it's going to be a very bad impression.
jew.zh: 如果你知道的唯一一个犹太人是莎士比亚笔下的夏洛克，那这将给你留下一个非常糟糕的（犹太人）印象。

jew.en: Mr Sarkozy, whose maternal grandfather was a Jew from Salonika, is the first French president born after the war.
jew.zh: 萨科齐是第一位战后出生的法国总统，其外祖父是来自萨洛尼卡的犹太人。

jewish.en: The Jewish feast of Passover began last night.
jewish.zh: 犹太人的宗教节日逾越节昨晚开始了。

jewish.en: Their children attend a Jewish parochial school.
jewish.zh: 他们的孩子在一所犹太教区学校上学。

jewish.en: The Warners were from a Jewish working-class background.
jewish.zh: 沃纳一家人是犹太工人阶级出身。

jewel.en: He asked how much I spent on the rare jewel.
jewel.zh: 他问我花了多少钱买这件稀有的珠宝。

jewel.en: The lowest estimate would put the worth of the jewel at ＄200.
jewel.zh: 按最低的评估这块宝石也值 200 美元。

jewel.en: It's a jewel box of about 150 artifacts, the density of the installation providing a powerful experience for the visitor than does the sparser display.
jewel.zh: 它是一个珠宝盒，大约有150件手工艺品，陈设的密度比稀疏展览更能为参观者提供了强大的体验。

job.zh: 她的工作涉及许多方面。

join.en: They may apply to join the organization.
join.zh: 他们可能申请加入该组织。

join.en: Strangely, they hadn't invited her to join them.
join.zh: 令人奇怪的是，他们没邀请她参加。
这两件东西怎样接合呢？

joint.en: They issued a joint statement denying the charges.
joint.zh: 他们发表联合声明否认指控。

joint.en: It would have to grow by acquisitions or joint ventures to achieve global reach.
joint.zh: 它得通过收购或合资来成长壮大以便触及全球。

jolly.en: She had a very jolly time in Korea.

jolly.zh: 帕迪总是很高兴，很开心。

joke.zh: 这个笑话他一点也没听懂。
究竟是谁想出那个笑话的？
女孩子们让这笑话逗得咯咯笑。

journal.zh: 萨拉在日记中倾吐心事。
他编辑了《私语》这本文学杂志。

journal.en: I put my journal away and prepared for bed.
journal.zh: 我把日记收好，准备睡觉。

journalist.en: She had taken him for a journalist.

journalist.zh: 迈克尔·克罗斯是一个自由新闻工作者。

journalist.en: He daydreams of being a famous journalist.
journalist.zh: 他梦想成为一个有名的记者。

joy.zh: 使他感到非常高兴的是她接受了。
我欢欣鼓舞，流下了快乐的泪水。
她的3个孩子给她得带来了快乐。

joyful.en: We're a very joyful people; we're very musical people and we love music.
joyful.zh: 我们是非常快乐的民族；我们是音乐之族；我们热爱音乐。
这是一次令人高兴的见面。

joyful.en: He called, full of joyful excitement, "hold on!"
joyful.zh: 他满怀喜悦和兴奋地喊道：“停下！”

judge.zh: 她很善于鉴定别人的性格。
法官不断点头表示同意。

July.zh: 这辆汽车的牌照税缴纳到了七月。

July.en: It was the hottest July on record.
July.zh: 那是历史记载中最热的七月。
这家新医院七月一日开诊。

juice.en: Would you care for some orange juice?

junction.en: I had right of way at the junction.
junction.zh: 我在这交叉路口有优先通行权。
在这个路口，公共汽车有优先通行权。

junction.en: It was near the junction of City Road and Old Street.
junction.zh: 那是在城市路与老街的交叉路口附近。

June.en: They are to be married in June.
June.zh: 他们计划于六月份结婚。
六月份的销售额下降了0.2%。

jungle.en: The tiger's home is in the jungle.
The lion is the king of the jungle.
We decided to go deeper into the jungle.
jungle.zh: 我们决定继续深入丛林。

jump.en: The horse fell at the last jump.
jump.zh: 那匹马在跨越最后一个障碍物时跌倒了。
砰的一声巨响吓我一跳。

junior.en: He dropped out of junior high school.
Junior nurses usually work alongside more senior nurses.
junior.zh: 初级护士通常和较高级的护士一起工作。

jury.zh: 陪审团作出了对被告有利的裁决。
陪审团裁决他谋杀罪不成立。

justification.en: His justification for the merger was just hot air.
justification.zh: 他提出的合并理由只是连篇空话。

justification.en: All I can say in justification of her actions is that she was under a lot of pressure at work.
justification.zh: 我唯一能为她的行为辩解的理由是她工作压力很大。

justification.en: Reverse spelling (crumb for crum, a word in which b has no justification) is also a trivial mistake.
justification.zh: 反向拼写（crum 拼成 crumb，b在这里没有理由存在）也是微不足道的错误。

justice.zh: 我的正义感受到了冒犯。

justice.en: Access to justice is a basic right.
justice.zh: 享有公正是一种基本权利。

justify.en: How can they justify paying such huge salaries?
justify.zh: 他们怎能证明付这么大笔薪金是正当的呢？

justify.en: He made a half-hearted attempt to justify himself.
justify.zh: 他没有尽力证明自己有理。

justify.en: No amount of rationalization could justify his actions.
justify.zh: 无论怎么解释，他的行为都不能说是正当的。

keeper.en: He won the soccer game with the goal keeper.
keeper.zh: 他和守门员一起赢了这场足球比赛。

keeper.en: The young men understand they are their brother's keeper.
keeper.zh: 年轻人懂得他们是兄弟的守护者。

keen.zh: 我的妻子是个热衷园艺的人。

keen.en: She herself was not a keen gardener.
keen.zh: 她本人就不是一个热衷于园艺的人。

kettle.zh: 这个电壶需要一根新电热丝。
壶里的水开了，冒着蒸汽。

kettle.en: Someone went upstairs and brought down a huge kettle.
kettle.zh: 有人上楼拿下来一个巨大的水壶。

keep.zh: 她的孙子孙女让她保持年轻。

keep.en: You just have to keep yourself busy and keep going.
keep.zh: 你只要让自己忙起来，就能坚持下去。

key.en: He turned the key in the lock.

key.zh: 他的贡献可能是最重要的。
这把钥匙打不开这把锁。

keyboard.zh: 坦尼娅的双手在键盘上起伏摆动。

keyboard.en: Treat your keyboard with care and it should last for years.
keyboard.zh: 爱惜你的键盘，这样就可以使用很多年。

keyboard.en: You can enter text on the QWERTY keyboard or simply write on the screen.
keyboard.zh: 你可以用标准键盘输入文本或者直接写在屏幕上。

kick.en: He gave the door a hefty kick.

kid.en: 'Oh, she's just a kid,' he said scathingly.
kid.zh: “咳，她还是个孩子呢。”他尖刻地挖苦道。

kid.en: The kid can read words, but did miserably on the test.
kid.zh: 这孩子能认字，但考试时却一塌糊涂。

kidney.en: Doctors removed the healthy kidney from the donor.
kidney.zh: 医生从捐献者体内取出了健康的肾脏。

kidney.en: The blade missed his kidney, but went into his bowel.
kidney.zh: 刀片没刺中他的肾脏，但却扎进了他的肠子。

kilogram.en: We bought a kilogram of lemons from the supermarket.
kilogram.zh: 我们从超市买了一公斤的柠檬。

kilogram.en: We will take a chunk of some material and we will call it a kilogram.
kilogram.zh: 我们取一大块物质，称它为一千克。

kill.zh: 有没有什么情况下，杀人是对的？

kill.en: Chlorine is widely used to kill germs.

kilometer.en: What's the area of Canada in square kilometer?
kilometer.zh: 加拿大的面积有多少平方公里？

kilometer.en: She watched the train drag her car almost a kilometer down the railway tracks.
kilometer.zh: 她看着火车把她的车沿着铁轨拖了将近一公里。

kilometer.en: The game included three events: full marathon, half marathon and 5 kilometer mini marathon.
kilometer.zh: 比赛包括全程马拉松、半程马拉松和5公里迷你马拉松三个项目。

kindness.en: He is entranced by the kindness of her smile.
kindness.zh: 她善意的微笑令他着迷。

kindness.en: His sweet nature and kindness made him a keeper, she said.
kindness.zh: 她说他的可爱和善良使他成为值得珍视的人。

kind.zh: 她是一位善良的充满母爱的女人。

kingdom.en: Rome annexed the Nabatean kingdom in AD 106.
kingdom.zh: 罗马帝国于公元106年并吞了纳巴泰王国。

kingdom.en: The animal kingdom is full of fine and glorious creatures.
kingdom.zh: 动物界有很多精巧而美妙的生物。

kingdom.en: He taught his followers that they could all be members of the kingdom of God.
kingdom.zh: 他教导他的信徒说他们都会成为天国的成员。

king.en: He was the king of the cowboys.

kit.zh: 我孩提时的偶像是基特·卡森。
克里斯托弗通常被称为基特。

kit.en: Make sure you keep a well-stocked first aid kit ready to deal with any emergency.
kit.zh: 确保你有一套足够库存的急救用具，随时应对任何突发情况。

kitchen.zh: 她的厨房保持得一尘不染。

kite.en: The kite has a span of 1.5 metres.
Willy asks if I've ever flown a kite before.
kite.zh: 威利问我以前是否放过风筝。

kiss.en: He gave her a brief, brotherly kiss.
kiss.zh: 他给了她短促、兄弟般的一吻。
玛丽亚给了他一个飞吻。

kneel.en: Don't bend or kneel next to fireworks once you light them.
kneel.zh: 点燃烟花时不要弯腰或跪在烟花旁。

kneel.en: It seemed as though he dared not kneel directly before God.
kneel.zh: 他似乎不敢直接向上帝下跪。

kneel.en: You can squat rather than kneel to lift an object from the floor.
kneel.zh: 你可以蹲着而不是跪着把一个物体从地板上抬起来。

knee.zh: 她摔了一跤，把膝盖蹭破了。

knife.en: He held the knife by its blade.

knife.zh: 那把刀划破了他的上衣。

knit.zh: 织一趟平针，织一趟反针。
菲立斯穿着一件织得厚厚的毛衣。

knob.en: He twiddled a knob on the dashboard.
knob.zh: 他转动着这块仪表板上的一个旋钮。

knob.en: The knob is only held on by sticky tape.
knob.zh: 这个旋钮只是用胶带粘住的。

knot.en: She tied a knot in a cherry stem.
knot.zh: 她在樱桃梗上打了个结。

knot.en: I tied a knot in the rope.
His clumsy fingers couldn't untie the knot.
knot.zh: 他的手很笨拙，无法解开这个结。

knock.en: You don't have to knock—just walk in.
They heard a knock at the front door.
knock.zh: 他们听到前门有一敲门声。

knowledge.en: His knowledge of French is only fair.
knowledge.zh: 他的法语知识还算可以。

knowledge.en: He denied all knowledge of the affair.

lab.en: The lab assistant was wearing a white overall.
lab.zh: 实验室助手穿着一件白罩衣。

lab.en: "He went back to the lab," Inez exclaimed impatiently.
lab.zh: “他回实验室了，”伊内兹不耐烦地叫道。

lab.en: She sat in the Spanish lab for hours, trying to acquire the accent of a native speaker.
lab.zh: 她在西班牙语研究所里坐了好几个小时，试着学习以西班牙语为母语的人的口音。

label.en: She glued the label onto the box.
He peered at the label on the bottle.
label.zh: 他注视着瓶子上的标签。

label.en: It's his first release for a major label.
label.zh: 这是他在大唱片公司发行的第一张唱片。

labor.en: The developments leave the airline with several problems, including an unsettled labor situation.
labor.zh: 事情的发展给航空公司带来了一些问题，其中包括不安定的劳工状况。
劳动节之后我们就开学了。

laboratory.en: Laboratory and field tests have been conducted.
laboratory.zh: 已进行实验室试验和现场试验。

laboratory.en: The blood samples are sent to the laboratory for analysis.
laboratory.zh: 血样要送往实验室进行分析。

laboratory.en: This was demonstrated in a laboratory experiment with rats.
laboratory.zh: 这点通过在实验室中用老鼠做试验得到证明。

ladder.zh: 那梯子看来摇摇晃晃的。

lack.en: Her eyes ached from lack of sleep.
lack.zh: 她的眼睛因睡眠不足而隐隐作痛。

lack.en: They were exhausted from lack of sleep.
lack.zh: 他们因睡眠不足而疲惫不堪了。

lace.en: She finally found the perfect gown, a beautiful creation trimmed with lace.
lace.zh: 她最终找到了那件完美的大衣，款式漂亮、饰有花边。

lace.en: I have a good pair of skates, but no matter how tightly I lace them, my ankles wobble.
lace.zh: 我有一双很好的溜冰鞋，但是无论我把鞋带系得多么紧，我的脚踝还是在里面晃荡。

lace.en: The lingerie was exquisite; silk, handmade and trimmed with a cobweb of lace.
lace.zh: 内衣很精致；真丝，手工制作，还装饰着蛛网状的花边。

lamb.en: The lamb was a puny little thing.

lag.en: Western banks still lag behind financial institutions in most other regions of the country.
lag.zh: 西部地区的银行仍然落后于这个国家其他大部分地区的金融机构。

lag.en: There's a time lag between infection with HIV and developing AIDS.
lag.zh: 从感染艾滋病病毒到发展成为艾滋病病人有一定的时间间隔。

lag.en: There is a long time lag between when I do the work and when I get paid.
lag.zh: 我做工作和领薪水之间相隔很长一段时间。

lady.zh: 她母亲曾是个有爵位的贵夫人。
她是一位非常亲切的老太太。

lame.en: What do I want with a lame donkey?
lame.zh: 我要一只瘸腿的驴子干什么？

lame.en: So enough with the lame analogy for now.
lame.zh: 这个蹩脚的比喻到此为止吧。

lamp.en: A sister can start a fire. Brother can't light the lamp.
lamp.zh: 只许姐姐放火，不许弟弟点灯

landing.zh: 我跑出去上了楼梯平台。

land.zh: 他们终于看不见陆地了。

landlady.zh: 女房东不安地轻拍着她的头发。

landlady.en: There was a note under the door from my landlady.
landlady.zh: 门下有我女房东的一张便条。

landlady.en: When my landlady said she wanted to keep $380 of my deposit to paint the walls, I threw a fit.
landlady.zh: 当女房东说她要用我的$380押金来粉刷墙壁时，我大发脾气。

landlord.zh: 他的房东把房租提高了一倍。

landlord.en: She has now settled with her landlord.
landlord.zh: 她现在已经和她的房东算清了。

landlord.en: The landlord has put the rent up again.

landscape.en: The landscape had a stark, unworldly beauty.
landscape.zh: 那景色有一种简朴、超凡的美。

landscape.en: The landscape seemed to stretch into infinity.
landscape.zh: 风景似乎延伸到了无穷远处。

landscape.en: The landscape is intersected with spectacular gorges.
landscape.zh: 在大地景色中点缀着壮观的峡谷。

lane.en: The road is only one lane wide.
lane.zh: 这条路只有一个车道那么宽。

lane.en: She signalled and pulled over into the slow lane.
lane.zh: 她给信号后把车开进了慢车道。

lane.en: The truck was travelling at 20 mph in the slow lane.
lane.zh: 那辆卡车以每小时20英里的速度行驶在慢车道上。

lantern.en: The night lantern glowed softly in the darkness.
lantern.zh: 夜灯在黑暗中发出微弱的光。

lap.zh: 她双目低垂，看着自己的腿。

lap.en: He was overtaken on the final lap.
She sat with her hands in her lap.
lap.zh: 她双手放在大腿上坐着。

language.zh: 这个国家的官方语言为西班牙语。

large.zh: 她目前担任一个大合唱团的指挥。

largely.en: He largely passed over the government's record.
largely.zh: 他对政府的相关记录基本上是避而不谈。
这个地区大部分是无人居住的。
大致说来，犀牛是一种定栖动物。

laser.en: She's had laser surgery on her eye.
The print quality of the new laser printer is superb.
laser.zh: 新激光打印机的打印质量好极了。

laser.en: Laser discs can store prodigious amounts of information.
laser.zh: 激光磁盘能够贮存大量信息。

lately.zh: 不久前她从印度回来了。

last.en: At last they were agreeing, at last they were getting somewhere.
last.zh: 最终他们取得了一致，最终他们取得了一些进展。

latent.en: These children have a huge reserve of latent talent.
latent.zh: 这些孩子蕴藏着极大的潜在天赋。

latent.en: Advertisements attempt to project a latent meaning behind an overt message.
latent.zh: 广告试图传达一种隐藏在公开信息里的潜在意义。

latent.en: For systems transforming solar to thermal energy, the thermal energy may be stored in matter as either latent heat or sensible heat.
latent.zh: 对于将太阳能转化为热能的系统，热能可能以潜热或显热的形式存储在物质中。

Latin.zh: 现在学拉丁语的学生少得很。

Latin.en: Latin nouns have case, number and gender.
Latin.zh: 拉丁语名词有格、数和性。

Latin.en: Cuba was one of the least Catholic of the Latin countries.
Latin.zh: 古巴是拉丁语国家中最不信仰天主教的国家之一。

latitude.en: Most oceanic islands are similar to one another in latitude and contain plants and animals typical of tropical islands.
latitude.zh: 大多数海洋岛屿彼此都纬度相近，并且都有热带岛屿典型的动植物。

latitude.en: This is because middle- and upper- latitude timberlines are strongly influenced by the duration and depth of the snow cover.
latitude.zh: 这是因为中纬度和高纬度地区的林木线受到积雪存留时间和厚度的强烈影响。

latitude.en: If they kept on going, and the next night they saw the pair of stars setting separately, then they would know that they were at a different degree of latitude.
latitude.zh: 如果他们继续走，第二天晚上看见这两颗星星分别落下，就知道他们在不同的纬度上了。

latter.en: The latter point is the most important.
latter.zh: 后面提及的那一点是最重要的。

latter.en: He tracked down his cousin and uncle. The latter was sick.
latter.zh: 他追踪找到了他的堂兄和叔叔。后者病了。

latter.en: The exercises can be fun and a good warm-up for the latter part of the programme.
latter.zh: 这些练习很有趣，还可以为后面的课程做热身准备。

laugh.zh: 你们听了我的笑话从不发笑！
不要笑，伙计。这事很重要。

launch.en: The official launch date is in May.
launch.zh: 正式的发行日期是在五月。

launch.en: The Navy is to launch a new warship today.
launch.zh: 海军今天有一艘新军舰要下水。

launch.en: They decided to launch a pre-emptive strike.
launch.zh: 他们决定发动先发制人的攻击。

laundry.en: He worked in the laundry at Oxford prison.
laundry.zh: 他曾在牛津监狱的洗衣房工作。

lavatory.en: The nearest public lavatory is at the station.
lavatory.zh: 最近的公共厕所在车站。

lavatory.en: There's an alcove with a small sink and mirror, and a door to the tiny, but private lavatory.
lavatory.zh: 壁龛里有一个小洗脸盆和一面镜子，还有一扇门通往一个微型但私用的盥洗室。

lavatory.en: The Emilio Carranza School's freshly painted walls, new lavatory doors and flower-beds show a way forward.
lavatory.zh: 埃米利奥·卡兰萨学校新粉刷的墙壁、新的厕所门和花床为我们指明了前进的道路。

lawn.en: I mow the lawn every week in summer.
lawn.zh: 夏天我每周都要修剪草坪。

lawn.en: There were ducks quacking on the lawn.
lawn.zh: 有鸭子在草坪上发出嘎嘎的叫着。

lawn.en: She ran swiftly over the lawn to the gate.
lawn.zh: 她轻快地跑过草坪，来到大门口。

lawyer.en: I should like to call my lawyer.
lawyer.zh: 我希望给我的律师打个电话。

lawyer.en: The lawyer was paid a huge salary.
lawyer.zh: 这个律师拿了很高的薪金。

layman.en: The subject matter was so technical as to be beyond the ken of the average layman.
layman.zh: 该主题专业性太强，一般的外行人很难理解。

layman.en: Where the law is concerned, I am only a layman.
layman.zh: 谈到法律，我不过是门外汉。

layman.en: I'm a layman. What I'm going to say may expose myself to ridicule, yet I still want to say a few words.
layman.zh: 我是个外行，我说的话可能贻笑大方，可我还是要说几句。

layer.en: A thin layer of dust covered everything.
layer.zh: 所有的物品上都积了薄薄的一层灰尘。

layer.en: Teeth have a hard surface layer called enamel.
layer.zh: 牙齿有一层叫做釉质的坚硬表层。

layer.en: I could see a thick layer of dust on the stairs.
layer.zh: 我能看见楼梯上厚厚的一层灰尘。

layout.en: The layout is hard to fault ergonomically.
layout.zh: 这一设计从工效学方面看几乎无懈可击。

layout.en: He tried to recall the layout of the farmhouse.
layout.zh: 他想回忆那农舍的布局。

layout.en: A diagram of the new road layout was superimposed on a map of the city.
layout.zh: 新公路的规划示意图被叠映在该城市的地图上。

lay.zh: 她躺在那儿，直到天亮才睡着。

lazy.en: We spent a lazy day on the beach.
lazy.zh: 我们在海滩上懒洋洋地度过了一天。

leadership.zh: 有三位候选人角逐领导权。

leadership.en: She beat off a challenge to her leadership.
leadership.zh: 她战胜了对她的领导地位的挑战。

leadership.en: He praised her leadership during the crisis.
leadership.zh: 他称赞了她在危机中的领导作用。

leader.zh: 这个政党希望由她做领袖。

leader.en: She is a leader, not a follower.
leader.zh: 她是领导者，不是追随者。

lead.en: Lead is more solvent in acidic water.
lead.zh: 铅在酸性水中更易溶解。

lead.en: The United States held a slender lead.

leading.en: She was leading at the half-way mark.
leading.zh: 赛程到一半时是她领先。
这些是第一轮比赛的领先成绩。

leaflet.zh: 这个传单用的是可移植文档格式。

leaflet.en: You can request a free copy of the leaflet.
leaflet.zh: 你可以索要一份免费的宣传单。

leaflet.en: PS Please show your friends this letter and the enclosed leaflet.
leaflet.zh: 又及：请将这封信和随附的传单拿给你的朋友们看。

leaf.en: The trees are just coming into leaf.

league.zh: 联队是上个赛季的联赛冠军。

league.en: The New England team is the worst in the league.
league.zh: 该新英格兰队是联盟中最差劲的球队。

leak.en: Water had started to leak into the cellar.
More details are now beginning to leak out.
leak.zh: 更多的细节现在开始泄露出来。

leak.en: Crews are working to plug a major oil leak.
leak.zh: 机组人员正在努力堵一个漏油的大洞。

lean.en: Like most athletes, she was lean and muscular.
lean.zh: 像大部分运动员一样，她清瘦而且肌肉强健。

leap.en: His heart gave a sudden leap when he saw her.
leap.zh: 他看见她时，心猛地一跳。

leap.en: The suspect took a leap out of a third-storey window.
leap.zh: 那个犯罪嫌疑人从三楼的窗口跳了出去。

leap.en: She took a flying leap and landed on the other side of the stream.
leap.zh: 她一个飞跃跳到小溪的对面。

learn.zh: 你在哪里学会的焊接技术？

learned.en: She learned to fly on a dare.
learned.zh: 她在激将下学会了驾驶飞机。
我在越南学会了驾驶飞机。

learning.zh: 我正在学习怎样编制预算。

lease.en: They lease the land from a local farmer.
lease.zh: 他们从当地一位农场主手中租得这块土地。

lease.en: He took up a 10-year lease on the house.
lease.zh: 他为这房子签了10年的租约。

lease.en: The lease plainly states that all damage must be paid for.
lease.zh: 租约明确规定，一切损坏必须赔偿。

least.en: At least he knew right from wrong.

leather.zh: 这个钱包摸上去像是皮的。

lecture.zh: 我觉得她的讲座非常费解。

precede.zh: 这一因素一定出现在冰川期之前，并有稍微降低地球温度的效果。

preceding.en: As we saw in the preceding chapter, groups can be powerful agents of socialization.
preceding.zh: 如我们在前一章所见，团组可以是社会化的有力动因。

preceding.zh: 她当时告知我们，18位教职员在此前的一年里离开了。

preceding.zh: 我们将比前几代人更出名。

precipitate.en: I don't think we should make precipitate decisions.
precipitate.zh: 我认为我们不应该做出仓促的决定。

precipitate.zh: 面对面社交接触的减少会导致抑郁。

precious.en: Her family's support is particularly precious to Josie.
precious.zh: 家人的支持对乔茜尤为珍贵。

precious.en: A family break allows you to spend precious time together.
precious.zh: 一次家庭休假使你有机会和家人共度宝贵时光。

precise.en: She gave me clear and precise directions.
precise.zh: 她给了我清晰而准确的指示。

precise.en: The precise details still have to be firmed up.
precise.zh: 准确的细节仍需最后敲定。

precise.en: I could pinpoint his precise location on a map.
precise.zh: 我能在地图上指出他的确切位置。

precision.zh: 他缺乏深度和分析的精确性。

precision.en: Your working day will need to be organized with military precision.
precision.zh: 你们的工作日需要以军人般的精确性来安排。
