preclude.zh: 那将阻止他逃走，那将使他无法逃走。

preclude.en: Black holes are dense, but their event horizons preclude observations.
preclude.zh: 黑洞密度足够高，但是他们的视界阻止了观察者。

preclude.en: A poor choice could preclude acquisition if the technology were too esoteric.
preclude.zh: 如果技术过于深奥的话，糟糕的选择可能会妨碍到被收购。

predecessor.en: He is cast in a different mould from his predecessor.

predict.en: Defence planners predict an extended period of retrenchment.
predict.zh: 国防规划人员们预计，开支紧缩期会延长。

predominant.zh: 在希腊，杜鹃花和夹竹桃只在春天开花，那时它们是花蜜的主要来源。

predominant.en: The archaeological evidence clearly indicates, though, that Teotihuacán was the center that did arise as the predominant force in the area by the first century A.D.
predominant.zh: 然而，考古证据清楚地表明，特奥蒂瓦坎是一个中心，在公元一世纪崛起成为该地区主导力量。

preface.en: The preface of the book includes an account of the author's life.
preface.zh: 该书前言记述了作者生平。

preface.zh: 美国国家科学院的主席布鲁斯·阿尔伯茨在该小组报告的前言中补充了这一点：“科学永远无法提供所有答案。”

preferable.zh: 防止出现问题总是比试图解决问题更可取。

premium.zh: 单居室公寓的空间是很有限的。

preparation.zh: 认真准备考试十分必要。

prepare.zh: 我将为你准备一份经过修正的评估报告。

preposition.zh: 在语法规则中没有哪一条表明以介词结束一个句子是错误的。

present.zh: 她的信把过去与现在结合在一起。

presentation.zh: 一个电脑软件故障弄砸了他们的展示会。

preside.zh: 教皇把香撒在圣坛上，然后用拉丁文念了传统的和平祷文，并开始主持弥撒。

preside.zh: 首相回到唐宁街去主持一场核心内阁会议。

prestige.zh: 是他在外交事务中的尽职尽责为他赢得了国际声望。

presumably.zh: 我的精神集中不起来，大概是太累了吧。

pretend.zh: 她会进行日光浴并假装她是在坎昆。

pretext.zh: 他借口有事要处理，早早离开了聚会。

pretext.zh: 他借口有事要处理，早早离开了聚会。

pretext.zh: 房东通常不退还租户的押金，借口是租户损坏了房子。

prevalent.zh: 这种情况在女性中比在男性中更为普遍。

previously.zh: 他讲的话与先前所说的相抵触。

previously.zh: 该合同给了一家先前不知名的公司。

prince.zh: 应该赶紧让王子投入工作。

prince.zh: 王子骑马走在卫队的前头。

primitive.zh: 达菲简单的吉他演奏远远低于预期的标准。

primitive.zh: 当时，医学仍是原始的准科学。

primitive.zh: 原始人们需要能够像这样反应以逃脱危险的动物。

princess.zh: 她像童话故事里的一位公主。

principal.zh: 我寄了一份复印件给校长。

principal.zh: 这张地图标出了主要城镇和河流。

principle.en: The principle behind it is very simple.

probability.zh: 不输血的话，该患者的死亡概率是100%。

probable.zh: 这种疾病很可能有遗传因素。

produce.zh: 我们只售当地的新鲜农产品。

produce.en: The shop sells only fresh local produce.
produce.zh: 这家商店专售当地的新鲜农产品。
该产品上贴有“中国制造”的标签。

production.zh: 生产成本开始加速上涨。

product.en: The product is at the design stage.
We cannot satisfy demand for the product.
product.zh: 我们不能满足对该产品的需求。

productive.en: He was hopeful that the next round of talks would also be productive.
productive.zh: 他对下一轮会谈也会富有成效充满了希望。

productive.en: Too much spending on rearmament would place an insupportable burden on the nation's productive capacity.
productive.zh: 过于庞大的重整军备开支会给国家的生产力带来难以承受的负担。

productivity.en: The result has been a giant leap in productivity.
productivity.zh: 其结果就是生产力的大幅度提高。

productivity.en: The average yearly increment in productivity was 4.5 per cent.
productivity.zh: 生产率的年平均增长量是4.5%。

profession.zh: 他们两人的职业都是医生。

profession.en: She is an honour to the profession.

professional.zh: 她成为一名专业的女中音歌手。
他的职业生涯持续了16年。

professor.zh: 他看上去像个古怪的的教授。

proficiency.en: Evidence of basic proficiency in English is part of the admissions requirement.
proficiency.zh: 基本英语水平的证明是录取条件的一部分。

proficiency.en: Specifically, Conrad believes that many of the brain's capabilities stem from the pattern-recognition proficiency of the individual molecules that make up each brain cell.
proficiency.zh: 具体来说，康拉德认为大脑的许多能力源于组成每个脑细胞的单个分子的模式识别能力。

proficiency.en: We focus both on generic linguistic proficiency and specialist vocabulary.
proficiency.zh: 我们既关注一般的语言能力，也关注专业词汇。

profitable.en: It would take a miracle to make this business profitable.
profitable.zh: 让这个公司赢利简直是天方夜谭。

profitable.en: Other less profitable services are to be axed later this year.
profitable.zh: 其他盈利较少的服务项目预定今年稍晚将大量削减。

profitable.en: For us, saving energy has been very, very profitable.
profitable.zh: 对我们来说，节约能源是非常非常有益的。

profile.en: This picture shows the girl in profile.
profile.zh: 这张照片从侧面显示该女孩。

profile.en: Below you will find a profile of each program.
profile.zh: 下面你会看到每个项目的简介。

profile.en: His handsome profile was turned away from us.
profile.zh: 他英俊的侧面轮廓转离了我们。

profit.en: What level of profit do you envisage?
profit.zh: 你预计会有什么样的利润水平？
税前利润几乎暴涨到了以前的十二倍。

profound.en: Her speech made a profound impact on everyone.
profound.zh: 她的讲话对每个人都有深远的影响。

profound.en: Colour has a profound, though often subliminal, influence on our senses and moods.
profound.zh: 颜色对我们的感觉和情绪有一种很深远的影响，尽管常常是潜意识的。

profound.en: Recent studies have borne out claims that certain perfumes can bring about profound psychological changes.
profound.zh: 最近的研究已经证实了某些香水能导致深刻的心理变化的说法。

program.en: How much memory does the program occupy?
program.zh: 这个程序占用多少内存？

program.en: The program won't load. What am I doing wrong ?
program.zh: 这程序载入不了。我哪里出错了？

prohibit.en: Surfwatch allows parents to prohibit access to specific web sites, newsgroups, and bulletin boards.
prohibit.zh: 过滤器软件可以让父母禁止对特定的网站、新闻组和电子布告栏的访问。

prohibit.en: Record's suggestion is to prohibit agents from hiring models with a BMI below 18.
prohibit.zh: 克劳德的建议是禁止代理公司雇用身体质量指数低于18的模特。

prohibit.en: The trade laws did prohibit Anglo-Americans from competing with large-scale British manufacturing of certain products, most notably clothing.
prohibit.zh: 在英国大规模生产的某些产品上，贸易法确实禁止英裔美国人与英国竞争，尤其是服装产业。

progressive.en: One prominent symptom of the disease is progressive loss of memory.
progressive.zh: 这种病的一个突出症状是记忆的逐步丧失。

progressive.en: Willan was able to point to the progressive changes he had already introduced.
progressive.zh: 威兰能够指出他已经带来的有进步意义的变化。

progressive.en: Halsey was identified as a leading proponent of the values of progressive education.
progressive.zh: 哈尔西被认为是进步教育价值观的首要支持者。

prolong.en: It seems commonly believed that companies are not motivated to prolong their products' lifespan.
prolong.zh: 人们似乎普遍认为，公司没有动力去延长产品的寿命。

prolong.en: In government laboratories and elsewhere, scientists are seeking a drug able to prolong life and youthful vigor.
prolong.zh: 在政府实验室和其他地方，科学家们正在寻找一种能够延长寿命、让人保持年轻活力的药物。

prolong.en: Extreme high-performance sports may lead to optimal cardiovascular performance, but they quite certainly do not prolong life.
prolong.zh: 极限高强度运动可能会带来最佳的心血管功能，但这些运动肯定无法延长寿命。

project.en: The project is in its final stages.
project.zh: 这个项目到了最后阶段。
这个项目的工期是多长？

prominent.en: He had an angular face with prominent cheekbones.
prominent.zh: 他有一张颧骨突出、棱角分明的脸。

prominent.en: He went on to earn a prominent professorial position.
prominent.zh: 他接着得到了一个著名的教授职位。

prominent.en: Here the window plays a prominent part in the design.
prominent.zh: 这里，窗户在设计中有着突出的作用。

promise.en: She kept her promise to visit them.
promise.zh: 她遵守诺言去看望了他们。

promising.en: He was voted most promising new director.
promising.zh: 他当选为最有前途的新导演。

promising.en: She shamed her father into promising more help.
promising.zh: 她使父亲感到过意不去，只好答应多给她些帮助。

promising.en: She is among the most promising players in her age group.
promising.zh: 在她那个年龄组中她是最有前途的选手之一。

prompt.en: The meeting will begin at ten o'clock prompt.
prompt.zh: 会议将于十点钟准时开始。

prompt.en: You have been so prompt in carrying out all these commissions.
prompt.zh: 你执行所有这些任务非常迅速。

prompt.en: There are many emergencies which need prompt first aid treatment.
prompt.zh: 有很多紧急情况需要迅速的急救治疗。

promote.en: Is it ethical to promote cigarettes through advertising?
promote.zh: 通过广告推销香烟合乎道德吗？

promote.en: We need to promote an open exchange of ideas and information.
promote.zh: 我们需要促进思想和信息的公开交流。

promote.en: She refused to promote Colin above the low rank of "legal adviser."
promote.zh: 她拒绝提升科林，只让他做低级别的“法律顾问”。

prone.en: He was found lying in a prone position.
These plants are peculiarly prone to disease.
prone.zh: 这些植物特别容易发生病变。

prone.en: Old people's bones are more prone to fracture.

pronoun.en: In 'He cut himself', 'cut' is a reflexive verb and 'himself' is a reflexive pronoun.
pronoun.zh: 在He cut himself一句中，cut是反身动词，himself是反身代词。

pronoun.en: In 'the man who came', 'who' is a relative pronoun and 'who came' is a relative clause.
pronoun.zh: 在the man who came中，who是关系代词，而who came是关系从句。

pronoun.en: In the phrase 'you are', the verb 'are' is in the second person and the word 'you' is a second-person pronoun.
pronoun.zh: 在短语you are中，动词are是第二人称形式，而单词you是第二人称代词。

pronounce.en: I don't know how to pronounce this word.
pronounce.zh: 我不知道这个单词怎么发音。
我把你的名字读对了吗？

pronunciation.en: She gave the word its French pronunciation.
pronunciation.zh: 她给出了这个单词的法语发音。

pronunciation.en: There is more than one pronunciation of 'garage'.

propaganda.zh: 他们散布了反法宣传资料。

propaganda.en: Art may be used as a vehicle for propaganda.
propaganda.zh: 艺术可以用作宣传的工具。

propaganda.en: The news reports were being discounted as propaganda.
propaganda.zh: 人们认为这些新闻报道不过是为了宣传，不可全信。

proof.zh: 我们没有任何确凿的证据。

proof.en: Do you have any proof of identity?

propagate.zh: 植物在这种条件下不能繁殖。

propagate.en: The easiest way to propagate a vine is to take hardwood cuttings.
propagate.zh: 繁殖葡萄藤最容易的办法就是采取硬木扦插。

propagate.en: Many of the species native to California, such as the prickly chaparral, rely on fires to propagate.
propagate.zh: 加利福尼亚有许多土生土长的物种，比如多刺的灌木荆棘丛，依靠火来繁殖。

propel.en: The tiny rocket is attached to the spacecraft and is designed to propel it toward Mars.
propel.zh: 微型火箭附在宇宙飞船上，用来推进飞船飞向火星。

propel.en: He also used ski poles in an unorthodox way—to propel himself as he skied.
propel.zh: 他还以一种非正统的方式使用滑雪杖，就是在滑雪时用它推动自己。

propel.en: It now appears that they also have an important influence on the geophysical processes that propel the plates across the globe.
propel.zh: 现在看来，它们对推动板块在全球范围内运动的地球物理过程也有重要影响。

proper.zh: 她真是个说一不二的小姑奶奶。
我们现在真是一点头绪都没有。

properly.zh: 这台电视机运作不正常。

properly.en: Make sure the letter is properly addressed.
properly.zh: 一定要正确书写信上的地址。

property.zh: 这座大楼是政府的财产。

property.en: He transferred the property to his son.
property.zh: 他把财产转让给了儿子。

prophet.en: The pity is that you are not a prophet.
The prophet appropriately appropriated the fund for repairing propeller.
prophet.zh: 提倡者恰当地为修理螺旋桨拨专款。

prophet.en: In the tradition, one of the companions asked the prophet what's the most powerful verse in Koran.
prophet.zh: 在传统中，一个同伴问先知《古兰经》中最有力量的一节是什么。

proportional.en: Their system seems to combine the two ideals of strong government and proportional representation.
proportional.zh: 他们的体制似乎同时具有强有力的政府与比例代表制这两种理想状况。

proportional.en: The passage's suggestion that the total anaerobic energy reserves of a vertebrate are proportional to the vertebrate's size is based on which of the following assumption?
proportional.zh: 这篇文章提出的脊椎动物的无氧能量储备总量与脊椎动物的体型成正比，是基于以下哪些假设？

proportional.en: Salary is proportional to years of experience.

proportion.en: The head is out of proportion with the body.
A large proportion of old people live alone.
proportion.zh: 一大部分老人都是独居。

proportion.en: To my eye , the windows seem out of proportion.
proportion.zh: 在我看来，这些窗子似乎不成比例。

proposal.zh: 这个建议已被断然否决。
这个建议并没有什么重大的争议。
目前人们正在详细讨论这个提案。

propose.en: What do you propose to do now?

proposition.zh: 对于第8项修正案你是怎么投的票？

proposition.en: As a business proposition, it's a non-starter.
proposition.zh: 作为一份商业建议，它不可能取得成功。

proposition.en: I'd like to put a business proposition to you.
proposition.zh: 我想向您提个业务上的建议。

prose.en: Shute's prose is stark and chillingly unsentimental.
prose.zh: 舒特的散文刻板而冷峻。

prose.en: Most of the play is written in verse, but some of it is in prose.
prose.zh: 这剧本大部分是用韵文写的，不过有一些是用散文。

prose.en: Her prose style is not always felicitous; she tends to repetition.
prose.zh: 她的散文文风并非一直恰到好处，她会赘叙。

prospect.en: The prospect of civil war is very real.
prospect.zh: 内战爆发的可能性确实存在。

prospect.en: There is no immediate prospect of peace.
prospect.zh: 短期内没有和平的可能。

prospect.en: The prospect of failure scares me rigid.
prospect.zh: 失败的可能吓得我都僵了。

prosperity.zh: 他们的繁荣依靠的是出口带来的增长。

prosperity.en: Our future prosperity depends on economic growth.
prosperity.zh: 我们未来的繁荣昌盛依赖经济的发展。

prosperity.en: He was pursuing a utopian dream of world prosperity.
prosperity.zh: 他那时在追求一个不切实际的世界繁荣之梦。

prospective.en: A prospective premium of about 30 percent on their initial investment is enticing.
prospective.zh: 初始投资30％左右的预期收益是诱人的。

prospective.en: I think I told you that we ask prospective reporters to turn in some outlines for articles .
prospective.zh: 我想我告诉过你，我们要求未来的记者们上交几篇文章的提纲。

prospective.en: I think they're really useful for making contact with careers development staff and prospective candidates.
prospective.zh: 我认为它们在联系职业发展人员和潜在的候选人时非常有用。

prosperous.en: Dirty streets are no advertisement for a prosperous society.
prosperous.zh: 肮脏的街道绝不是繁荣社会的景象。

prosperous.en: Dirty streets and homelessness are no advertisement for a prosperous society.
prosperous.zh: 肮脏的街道和无家可归现象绝不是繁荣社会的景象。

prosperous.en: Barcelona has become one of the most dynamic and prosperous cities in the Mediterranean.
prosperous.zh: 巴塞罗那已经成为地中海地区最具活力、最为繁荣的城市之一。

protection.en: He asked to be put under police protection.
The wall gives some protection from the prevailing wind.
protection.zh: 这堵墙挡着常刮的风，起到一些保护作用。

protection.en: Some animals roll themselves into a ball for protection.
protection.zh: 有些动物蜷缩成一团以保护自己。

protective.en: It pays to invest in protective clothing.

protective.zh: 工人应该穿着全套防护服。

protect.en: I, Long Aotian, swear to protect Liu Bo'er with my life!
protect.zh: 我龙傲天要誓死守护刘波儿！
protect.source: 《一年一度喜剧大赛》少爷和我

protect.en: My prime concern is to protect my property.
protect.zh: 我最关心的是保护自己的财产。

protect.en: Women banded together to protect each other.
protect.zh: 妇女们联合起来互相保护。

protein.en: You need more protein to build you up.
protein.zh: 你需要更多蛋白质以增强体质。
极为精密的蛋白质纤维是能被看见的。

protein.en: The gene is activated by a specific protein.
protein.zh: 这种基因由一种特异性蛋白激活。

prototype.en: Chris Retzler has built a prototype of a machine called the wave rotor.
prototype.zh: 克里斯·雷兹勒做出了一台叫做波转子的样机。

prototype.en: The prototype is, by all accounts, athletic, good-natured and supersmart.
prototype.zh: 所有人都说，它的原型体格健壮、性情温和、非常聪明。

prototype.en: We broke up into groups, and each group designed its own toy and made an alpha prototype.
prototype.zh: 我们分成几个小组，每个小组都设计了自己的玩具并制作了一个 alpha 原型。

proud.en: She must be very proud of herself.
It's something you'll be mighty proud of.
proud.zh: 这是个你会非常骄傲的事。

proud.en: They are rightly proud of their children.
proud.zh: 他们当然为他们的孩子而骄傲。

provide.zh: 他们不肯提供任何细节。

provide.en: Can you provide any proof of identity ?
provide.zh: 你能提供什么身份证明吗？

provided.zh: 他们提供的细节不充分。

province.en: Guerrilla groups are active in the province.
province.zh: 游击队组织在该省活动。

province.en: The province is heavily forested and sparsely populated.
province.zh: 该省森林茂密，人烟稀少。

province.en: The economy of the province was atypical because it was particularly small.
province.zh: 该省的经济并不算典型，因为它的规模特别小。

provision.en: There is a lack of adequate provision for disabled students.
provision.zh: 为残疾学生提供的服务不够。

provision.en: The government is responsible for the provision of health care.
provision.zh: 政府负责提供医疗服务。

provision.en: One provision of the law was to roll back taxes to the 1975 level.
provision.zh: 该法律的一项条款是把税收削减至1975年的水平。

provocative.en: The show's a keeper–daring, imaginative and provocative.
provocative.zh: 这部电影值得收藏–大胆、富于想像力和煽动性。

provocative.en: He has made a string of outspoken and sometimes provocative speeches in recent years.
provocative.zh: 他最近几年做了一系列直言不讳的、有时带有挑衅的演说。

provocative.en: He doesn't really mean that—he's just being deliberately provocative.
provocative.zh: 他不是真有此意，只不过是存心挑逗一下罢了。

provoke.en: His duty was to conciliate the people, not to provoke them.
provoke.zh: 他的任务是安抚这些人，而不是激怒他们。

provoke.en: Premature moves in this respect might well provoke a reaction against the reform.
provoke.zh: 在这方面过早的行动可能会激起对改革的抵触。

provoke.en: They accused both radicals and conservatives of trying to provoke a split in the party.
provoke.zh: 他们指责激进人士和保守人士都企图挑起党内分歧。

proximity.en: He became aware of the proximity of the Afghans.
proximity.zh: 他开始意识到那些阿富汗人的接近。
随着不断接近，理解也在增加。

proximity.en: Proximity refers to the physical distance between speakers.
proximity.zh: 接近性是指说话人之间的物理距离。

psychological.en: The problem was psychological rather than physiological.
psychological.zh: 这是个心理而不是生理问题。

psychological.en: Lack of confidence is a psychological barrier to success.
psychological.zh: 缺乏信心是阻碍成功的心理因素。

psychological.en: Abuse can lead to both psychological and emotional problems.
psychological.zh: 虐待可造成心理和情绪上的问题。

publication.zh: 所有报道都要经过仔细检查后才能发表。

publication.en: Publication dates are given in brackets after each title.
publication.zh: 出版日期括于书名后面。

publication.en: The statement was carefully scrutinized before publication.
publication.zh: 声明在发表前经过仔细审查。

public.zh: 在公开场合他一直是个谜。
她很擅长在公开场合演讲。

publicity.en: All the publicity nearly sent him crazy.
publicity.zh: 成天生活在公众的注意之下让他差一点发疯了。

publicity.en: They got married in a blaze of publicity.
publicity.zh: 他们结婚的事受到了传媒大力宣扬。

publish.en: The DOT is to publish the conference proceedings.
publish.zh: 运输部将公布会议记录。

publish.en: They only publish novels which cater to the mass-market.
publish.zh: 他们只出版迎合大众市场的小说。

pudding.en: All that she would have to do was warm up the pudding.
pudding.zh: 她所需要做的只是加热布丁。

pudding.en: We found the apple pie pudding too good to resist. Sure enough, it was delicious.
pudding.zh: 我们觉得这块苹果馅饼布丁令人无法抗拒。果然，它很美味。

puff.en: I took a puff on the cigarette and started coughing.
puff.zh: 我抽了一口烟就开始咳嗽起来。

puff.en: The magician vanished in a puff of smoke.
puff.zh: 魔术师在一股烟雾中突然不见了。

puff.en: I was starting to puff a little from the climb.
puff.zh: 爬坡弄得我有点喘息起来。

pulse.zh: 安的脉搏因惊恐而加快了。
他的脉搏速率突然下降。

pull.en: They use oxen to pull their carts.

pump.en: The pump sucks air out through the valve.
pump.zh: 气泵通过阀门把空气抽出去。

pump.en: I left my purse back there on the gas pump.
pump.zh: 我把钱包忘在那儿的油泵上了。

pump.en: The pump doesn't work and we have no running water.
pump.zh: 这个水泵不运转了，我们没有自来水。

punch.en: She landed a punch on his chin.
punch.zh: 她对着他的下巴揍了一拳。

punctual.en: He's always very punctual. I'll see if he's here yet.
punctual.zh: 他一向很准时。我要看看他是不是已经来了。

punctual.en: A man who gets up at seven o'clock every morning is punctual.
punctual.zh: 每天早上七点起床的人是守时的。

punish.en: My parents used to punish me by not letting me watch TV.
punish.zh: 过去我父母常以不让我看电视来惩罚我。

punish.en: I don't believe that George ever had to punish the children.
punish.zh: 我不相信乔治曾不得不惩罚这些孩子。

punish.en: Current employment laws will be changed to reward effort and punish laziness.
punish.zh: 现行的雇佣法将被修改以便奖勤罚懒。

pupil.en: These complex formulae are beyond the grasp of the average pupil.
pupil.zh: 这些复杂的公式是一般小学生不能理解的。

pupil.en: Amy was a pupil in Grade Three.
pupil.zh: 艾米是一名三年级的学生。
她深受每个学生的喜爱。

puppet.en: It's a puppet. Do you like puppets?
puppet.zh: 它是一个木偶。你喜欢木偶吗？

rarely.en: She is rarely seen in public nowadays.
She was a placid child who rarely cried.
rarely.zh: 她是个温和的孩子，很少哭。

rare.en: He contracted a rare form of cancer.
rare.zh: 他患上了一种罕见的癌症。

rare.en: He suffers from a rare blood disease.
rare.zh: 他患有一种罕见的血液病。

rat.en: He held his breath as a rat scuttled past.
rat.zh: 见一只老鼠跑过，他屏住了呼吸。

rat.en: Mr. Rat, Mr. Rat, I'm near the river.
rat.zh: 老鼠先生，老鼠先生，我在河边。

rat.en: A rat? Yes, a rat. Right next to you.
rat.zh: 老鼠？对，一只老鼠，就在你身旁。

rather.zh: 这些叶子尝起来相当苦。

ratio.en: The adult to child ratio is one to six.
The school has a very high teacher-student ratio.
ratio.zh: 这所学校的师生比例很高。

ratio.en: What is the ratio of men to women in the department?
ratio.zh: 这个部门的男女比例是多少？

rate.zh: 他的脉搏速率突然下降。

rating.en: But Cahoot's overdraft rate depends on your credit rating.
rating.zh: 然而合伙人的透支率取决于你的信用等级。

rating.en: She wants to improve her credit rating immediately.
rating.zh: 她想立即提高自己的信用等级。

rating.en: What star rating does this restaurant have?

rational.en: There is no rational explanation for his actions.
rational.zh: 对他的所作所为无法作出合理的解释。

rational.en: The decision was based on emotion rather than rational thought.
rational.zh: 这个决定不是基于理性的思考而是基于感情作出的。

rational.en: The alphabet might be more rational if all the vowels came first.
rational.zh: 要是所有的元音都排在前面，字母表也许会更合理些。

razor.en: He plugged his razor in to recharge it.
razor.zh: 他把剃刀插在插座上，给它充电。

razor.en: Van Gogh cut off his left ear with a razor blade in 1888.
razor.zh: 1888年，梵高用剃须刀片割掉了自己的左耳。

razor.en: Their electric razor gets hot and now the whole house smells like singed hair.
razor.zh: 他们的电动剃须刀变热了，现在整个房子闻起来像烧焦的头发。

raw.en: Exploitable raw materials were in short supply.
raw.zh: 可开采的原料供应短缺。

raw.en: Raw materials were carried to the works by barge.
raw.zh: 原材料由驳船运到工厂。

raw.en: We cannot guarantee adequate supplies of raw materials.
raw.zh: 我们不能保证提供充足的原料。

ray.en: Ray was getting very hot and bothered about the idea.
ray.zh: 雷为这个想法感到焦虑不安。

ray.en: It will only register on sophisticated X-ray equipment.
ray.zh: 只有在先进的X光设备上它才会显示出来。

ray.en: "Is there something else?" Ray queried as Helen stopped speaking.
ray.zh: 海伦话音刚落，雷便问道：“还有别的什么吗？”

react.zh: 他们会凶猛地作出反应。

react.en: I nudged her but she didn't react.
react.zh: 我用胳膊肘捅了她一下，可她没有反应。
很难说他会有何种反应。

reaction.zh: 对这次访问的反应不一。
他们的反应使他感到惊愕。

read.zh: 我可以看一下你的报纸吗？

reach.en: Can you reach me down that box?
reach.zh: 你帮我把那个盒子拿下来好吗？

reach.en: Victory is now out of her reach.
reach.zh: 胜利现在对于她来说已遥不可及。
我够不着最上面的架子。

reader.zh: 你是《泰晤士报》的读者吗？

reader.en: The reader is told the story in flashback.
reader.zh: 故事是以倒叙手法向读者讲述的。

reader.en: I leave it to the reader to ferret these out.

readily.en: The components are readily available in hardware stores.
readily.zh: 这些零件在五金商店容易买到。

readily.en: When she told them what she intended they readily consented.
readily.zh: 她告诉他们她的打算时，他们欣然同意。

readily.en: I asked her if she would allow me to interview her, and she readily agreed.
readily.zh: 我问她是否允许我采访她，她欣然同意了。

reading.zh: 这份报告值得仔细阅读。

realistic.en: We are now far more sober and realistic.
realistic.zh: 我们现在严肃多了，也现实多了。

realistic.en: These proposals represent a realistic starting point for negotiation.
realistic.zh: 这些提议代表着谈判的一个现实起点。
我们必须制订可实现的目标。

real.zh: 她是个真正的四海为家的人。

ready.zh: 大家都准备好了吗？开演！
摄影机准备好了吗？好，开拍！

reality.en: Will time travel ever become a reality ?
reality.zh: 时光旅行真的会成为现实吗？

realm.zh: 王国的防御是至关重要的。

realm.en: In the realm of olfaction, we must make do with descriptions and recollections.
realm.zh: 在嗅觉领域，我们只能勉强依赖于描述与回忆。

realm.en: Smirks, raised eyebrows, and quizzical looks are not out of the realm of possibility.
realm.zh: 傻笑、扬起的眉毛和戏弄的样子都是在可能出现的范围之内的。

realize.en: Only later did she realize her mistake.
realize.zh: 只是到了后来她才意识到自己的错误。

realize.en: I hope people realize I'm not a dingbat.
realize.zh: 我希望人们意识到我不是个疯子。

realize.en: You don't realize how aggravating you can be.
realize.zh: 你没意识到你有多烦人。

reap.en: Machines that reap and thresh in one operation.
reap.zh: 同时完成收割和脱粒的机器。

reap.en: You'll soon begin to reap the benefits of being fitter.
reap.zh: 你很快就会获得身体更健康带来的好处。

reap.en: The company is just starting to reap the rewards of long-term investments.
reap.zh: 这家公司正开始收获长期投资的回报。

rear.en: I got a ding in my rear fender.
rear.zh: 我汽车后面的挡泥板撞瘪了一处。

rear.en: Her car crashed into the rear of a van.
rear.zh: 她的汽车撞毁了一辆面包车的尾部。

rear.en: A high gate blocks the only entrance to the rear.
rear.zh: 一座高大的门挡住了通往后面的唯一入口。

reasonable.en: We sell good quality food at reasonable prices.
reasonable.zh: 我们以公道的价格出售优质食品。

reasonable.en: Public spending must be kept within reasonable bounds.
reasonable.zh: 公共开支必须控制在合理的范围内。
他是那种通情达理的人。

reason.en: I had no reason to doubt him.
That's the only reason I'm actually going.
reason.zh: 这是我确实要走的唯一理由。

rebel.en: She had been a rebel at school.
rebel.zh: 她在学校时就是个叛逆者。
阿莫瑞塔成了一位英勇无畏的反叛者。

rebel.en: He was taken prisoner by rebel soldiers.

rebellion.zh: 他们没有料到会发生叛乱。

rebellion.en: It roused a feeling of rebellion in him.
Soldiers went in to put down a rebellion.
rebellion.zh: 士兵们攻进去镇压了一场叛乱。

receipt.en: I wrote her a receipt for the money.
receipt.zh: 我为那笔钱给她开了张收据。

receipt.en: The buyer has to sign a delivery note as proof of receipt.
receipt.zh: 购买者必须签收送货单表明货已收到。

recall.zh: 你能记起到底发生了什么事吗？

recall.en: He tried to recall the layout of the farmhouse.
recall.zh: 他想回忆那农舍的布局。

recall.en: I recall many discussions with her on these and kindred topics.
recall.zh: 我回想起多次同她就这些问题及类似话题进行的讨论。

receiver.zh: 他砰的一声将电话听筒摔下来。

receiver.en: The receiver had already clicked into place.
receiver.zh: 听筒咔的一声放回原位了。

receiver.en: She picked up the receiver and started to dial.

receive.en: I didn't receive a letter from him yet.
receive.zh: 我还没有收到过他的信。

receive.en: All joiners will receive a welcome pack.
receive.zh: 每位入会者都会收到一个迎新包。

recent.en: He seems unabashed by his recent defeat.
recent.zh: 他似乎不为近期的失败感到羞耻。
这些灌木丛是最近栽植的。

recent.en: A recent book has demolished this theory.
recent.zh: 最近出版的一本书推翻了这种理论。

recession.zh: 这个国家陷入了经济衰退的困境。

reception.zh: 招待会开得冷冷清清的。
所有来宾必须到接待处报到。

reception.en: You can leave a message with reception.
reception.zh: 你可以在接待处留个口信。

recipe.en: This recipe is foolproof—it works every time.
recipe.zh: 这个食谱绝对管用，每次都万无一失。

recipe.en: This recipe will be enough for four servings.

recipient.en: If you are submitting your resume in English, find out if the recipient uses British English or American English because there are variations between the two versions.
recipient.zh: 如果你要提交英文简历，要弄清楚收件人使用的是英式英语还是美式英语，因为两者是有区别的。

recipient.en: With so many ways to communicate, how should a manager choose the one that's best—particularly when the message to be delivered is bad or unwelcome news for the recipient?
recipient.zh: 有如此丰富的沟通方式，经理应该如何选择最好的方式——特别是当你要传递的消息对接收者来说是坏消息或是不受欢迎的消息时？

recipient.en: Gift certificates are personalized with both the recipient and giver names.
recipient.zh: 礼品券上标明了获得者和给予者的名字。

recite.en: She can recite the whole poem from memory.
Each child had to recite a poem to the class.
recite.zh: 每个孩子都得在班上背诵一首诗。

reciprocal.en: They expected a reciprocal gesture before more hostages could be freed.
reciprocal.zh: 他们期望在更多的人质被释放之前有互惠的表示。

reciprocal.en: The two colleges have a reciprocal arrangement whereby students from one college can attend classes at the other.
reciprocal.zh: 两所学院有一项互惠协定，允许学生在院际间选课。

reciprocal.en: The result indicates that there are reciprocal connections between the parabrachial nucleus and caudal portion of the dorsal vagal complex.
reciprocal.zh: 结果说明臂旁核和迷走神经背核簇尾侧部之间有交互联系。

reckless.en: She was a good rider, but reckless.
reckless.zh: 她是个好骑手，但太鲁莽。

reckless.en: He showed a reckless disregard for his own safety.
reckless.zh: 他对个人安危全然无所顾忌。

reckless.en: Many people believe reckless drivers are treated too leniently.
reckless.zh: 很多人认为对鲁莽的司机处理得太宽大了。

reclaim.en: The good news for the industry was that investors don't seem to be in any hurry to reclaim their money.
reclaim.zh: 对该行业来说，好消息是投资者们似乎不急于要求收回他们的钱。

reclaim.en: The richest merchants in Amsterdam contributed money to reclaim a good 7,100 hectares of land.
reclaim.zh: 阿姆斯特丹最富有的商人们捐钱并开垦了7100公顷的良田。

reclaim.en: You'll have to go to the police station to reclaim your wallet.
reclaim.zh: 你得到警察局去认领你的钱包。

recognition.en: She gained only minimal recognition for her work.
recognition.zh: 她的工作仅仅得到极少的赞誉。

recognition.en: Her unusual talent gained her worldwide recognition.
recognition.zh: 她非凡的才能举世公认。

recognition.en: There is a general recognition of the urgent need for reform.
recognition.zh: 人们普遍认识到迫切需要改革。

reckon.en: I reckon (that) I'm going to get that job.
reckon.zh: 我认为我会得到那份工作。

reckon.en: They reckon (that) their profits are down by at least 20%.
reckon.zh: 他们估计利润至少下降了20%。

recognize.zh: 我承认我自己的那些缺点。

recognize.en: I recognize you. Aren't you on television?
recognize.zh: 我认出你来了。你不是常上电视吗？

recognize.en: I didn't recognize him—he's grown a beard.
recognize.zh: 我没认出他来—他留胡子了。

recollect.en: As far as I can recollect, she wasn't there on that occasion.
recollect.zh: 据我回忆，当时她不在场。
好吧，试着回忆一下——好吗？

recommendation.en: I got the job on the strength of your recommendation.
recommendation.zh: 由于您的推荐，我得到了那份工作。

recommendation.en: The best way of finding a lawyer is through personal recommendation.
recommendation.zh: 找律师的最好方法是通过个人推荐。

recommendation.en: Nearly 60% of our bookings come from repeat business and personal recommendation.
recommendation.zh: 我们近60％的预订来自于回头客生意或个人推荐。

recommend.en: What course of action would you recommend?
I recommend (that) he should see a lawyer.

reconcile.en: He could not reconcile himself to the prospect of losing her.
reconcile.zh: 他一想到有可能失去她，就觉得难以忍受。

reconcile.en: It was hard to reconcile his career ambitions with the needs of his children.
reconcile.zh: 他很难兼顾事业上的抱负和孩子们的需要。

reconcile.en: It's difficult to reconcile the demands of my job and the desire to be a good father.
reconcile.zh: 协调我工作的要求与我当个好父亲的愿望很难。

recorder.en: He was wired up to a police tape recorder.
recorder.zh: 他被连接到了警方的录音机上。

recorder.en: The guards permitted me to bring my camera and tape recorder.
recorder.zh: 守卫允许我带上相机和录音机。

recorder.en: Rodney put the recorder on the desk top and pushed the play button.
recorder.zh: 罗德尼把录音机放在桌面上，按下了播放键。

recover.en: The economy is at last beginning to recover.
He sat down to try and recover his equilibrium.
recover.zh: 他坐了下来，努力恢复平静。

recover.en: He is unlikely to ever recover his legal costs.
recover.zh: 他不大可能收回他的诉讼费用了。

record.zh: 他的出勤记录时好时差。
这笔生意带来了创纪录的收益。

recreation.en: I play the flute in a wind band for recreation.
recreation.zh: 我在管乐队吹长笛消遣。

recreation.en: His only form of recreation is playing football.
recreation.zh: 他唯一的娱乐就是踢足球。

recreation.en: Saturday afternoon is for recreation and outings.
recreation.zh: 周六下午是娱乐和外出的时间。

rectangular.en: I think I've seen photos of rectangular concert halls.
rectangular.zh: 我想我看过长方形音乐厅的照片。

rectangular.en: Older concert halls from the 1800s are generally rectangular.
rectangular.zh: 19世纪的旧音乐厅一般都是长方形的。

rectangular.en: The houses are all rectangular, one storey, made of sun-dried bricks.
rectangular.zh: 这些房子都是长方形的，一层高，是用晒干的砖砌成的。

recruit.en: He is hoping to recruit a chairman from outside the company.
recruit.zh: 他在希望从公司之外招聘一位董事长。

recruit.en: The police are trying to recruit more black and Hispanic officers.
recruit.zh: 警方正试图招收更多的黑人和西班牙裔的警官。

recruit.en: The police are trying to recruit more officers from ethnic minorities.
recruit.zh: 警察机关正试图从少数民族中征募更多的新警员。

recur.zh: 按指定时间间隔重复发生。

recur.en: Let us recur to the subject later on.
recur.zh: 让我们稍后再重回到我们的主题。

rectify.en: We must take steps to rectify the situation.
rectify.zh: 我们一定要采取措施整顿局面。

rectify.en: The comprehensive spending review offers an opportunity for the government to help rectify this.
rectify.zh: 全面支出审查让政府有机会帮助纠正这一问题。

rectify.en: Only an act of Congress could rectify the situation.
rectify.zh: 只有国会的法案才能扭转这种局面。

recycle.en: The objective would be to recycle 98 percent of domestic waste.
recycle.zh: 该目标是循环使用98%的生活垃圾。

recycle.en: The power of the Green movement in Germany has made that country a leader in the drive to recycle more waste materials.
recycle.zh: 德国环保运动的力量已经使该国成了循环利用更多废料运动中的领先者。

red.zh: 我的皮肤变红而且起了斑点。

redundant.en: Changes in technology may mean that once-valued skills are now redundant.
redundant.zh: 技术的变化可能意味着从前受重视的技巧现在变得多余了。

redundant.en: This word is redundant, it can be left out.
redundant.zh: 这个字是多余的， 可以去掉。

redundant.en: Rather than maintaining the now redundant leaves throughout the winter, the tree saves its precious resources and discards them.
redundant.zh: 这棵树并没有在整个冬天都保留现在多余的叶子，而是储存了宝贵的资源并抛弃了多余的树叶。

reduction.en: There has been some reduction in unemployment.
This represents a reduction of 5% in real terms.
The company has made heroic efforts at cost reduction.
reduction.zh: 该公司在降低成本方面进行了艰苦卓绝的努力。

reduce.en: The packets are measured to reduce waste.
reduce.zh: 测量包裹尺寸以减少浪费。

reduce.en: These sunglasses are designed to reduce glare.
reduce.zh: 这些太阳镜是为减少刺眼的强光而设计的。

reduce.en: The government is looking to reduce inflation.
reduce.zh: 政府正在力求降低通货膨胀率。

reed.en: They inhabit reed huts built on stilts above the water.
reed.zh: 他们居住在建在水中木桩上的芦苇草屋里。

reed.en: Referee Michael Reed had no hesitation in awarding a penalty.
reed.zh: 裁判迈克尔·里德毫不犹豫地判了罚球。

reed.en: Reed credits Thomas Bouchard's work for today's surge in twin studies.
reed.zh: 里德认为，托马斯·布沙尔的工作促成了如今双胞胎研究的激增。

reel.en: The reel comes complete with a set of spares for all the working parts.
reel.zh: 那个卷轴配有一套所有运行部件的备用件。

reel.en: The rod bent double, the reel shrieked and ratcheted.
reel.zh: 该操作杆加倍弯曲，线轴发出刺耳的嗒嗒声。

reel.en: The musicians burst into a rousing rendition of "Paddy Casey's Reel."
reel.zh: 这些音乐家激情演绎了《帕迪·凯西的里尔舞曲》。

refer.en: You may refer to your notes if you want.
refer.zh: 如果需要，可以查阅笔记。

refer.en: They come from Tuam, a place they refer to on the title track of their album, "All the Way From Tuam."
refer.zh: 他们来自蒂厄姆，一个他们在专辑的标题曲《从蒂厄姆远路而来》中提到的地方。

refer.en: May I refer you to my letter of 14 May?
refer.zh: 你查看一下我5月14日给你的信好吗？

refine.en: At the same time, more of this newly discovered oil is of the type that requires a greater investment to refine.
refine.zh: 与此同时，在这些新发现的石油中，更多是需要加大投资才能提炼的类型。

refine.en: Can they refine the idea and resubmit it?
refine.zh: 他们能改进一下想法然后重新提交吗？

refine.en: Instead of trying to refine old formulas, they invent new ones.
refine.zh: 他们不是试图改进旧的公式，而是发明新的公式。

reference.zh: 地图上的坐标方格数字为C8。

reflexion.en: All her poems are pathways to deeper reflexion and meditation.
reflexion.zh: 她所有的诗的途径更深入的反思和冥想。

reflexion.en: I think that today's music lacks a serious artistic reflexion.
reflexion.zh: 我不知道…我觉得如今的音乐往往缺乏严肃的艺术态度。

reflexion.en: Tillering is the most important part of making a bow, so I think some reflexion is in order.
reflexion.zh: 驯弓是做弓种最重要地部分，所以我像一些反曲是合适地。

reflect.en: We should all give ourselves time to reflect.
reflect.zh: 我们都应该给自己时间来深思。

reflect.en: The third-quarter results reflect continued improvements in productivity.
reflect.zh: 第三季度的结果反映了生产率的持续提高。

reflect.en: Such attitudes are valueless unless they reflect inner cognition and certainty.
reflect.zh: 这种态度如果不能反映内心的认知和确定性就毫无价值。

reflection.en: After days of reflection she decided to write back.
reflection.zh: 经过几天的认真思考，她决定回信。

reflection.en: Your clothes are often a reflection of your personality.
reflection.zh: 穿着常常反映出一个人的个性。

reflection.en: He admired his reflection in the mirror.
reflection.zh: 他欣赏着自己在镜中的影像。

refrain.en: When breaking in an engine, you should refrain from high speeds for the first thousand miles.
refrain.zh: 磨合发动机时,你应当避免在最初的1千英里高速行驶。

refrain.en: Complaints about poor food in schools have become a familiar refrain.
refrain.zh: 抱怨学校饭菜差已是耳熟能详的老调了。

refrain.en: You hear the refrain all the time.
refrain.zh: 你总是听到这样的叠句。

refresh.en: There is a hypothesis that we sleep so that our brain can repair and refresh itself.
refresh.zh: 有一种假设是，我们睡觉是为了让大脑自我修复和更新。

refresh.en: If technological diffusion and implementation develop faster, workers will have to constantly refresh their skills.
refresh.zh: 如果技术的传播和应用发展得更快，工人们将不得不持续更新他们的技能。

reform.zh: 很多人对改革持怀疑态度。
她为改革进行了有力的辩论。

refreshment.zh: 可以请您吃点喝点什么吗？

refreshment.en: In York we had a short stop for refreshment.
refreshment.zh: 在约克，我们稍作停留，吃了点东西。

refugee.en: Many of the refugee villages are in isolated areas.
refugee.zh: 许多难民村位于偏僻的地方。

refugee.en: Troops tried to set up a lookout post inside a refugee camp.
refugee.zh: 军队试图在一个难民营里设一个瞭望台。

refrigerator.en: To put an elephant in the refrigerator,how many steps does it take?
refrigerator.zh: 请问把大象装进冰箱分几步？

refrigerator.en: He foraged in the refrigerator for munchies.

refrigerator.zh: 他的冰箱经常看上去有点儿空。

refuge.en: They took refuge in a bomb shelter.
refuge.zh: 他们在一个防空洞里避难。

refuge.en: A further 300 people have taken refuge in the US embassy.
refuge.zh: 又有300人在美国大使馆避难。

refuge.en: Four people who sought refuge in the Italian embassy have left voluntarily.
refuge.zh: 到意大利大使馆寻求避难的四个人已经自愿离开了。

refusal.en: Her answer amounted to a complete refusal.
refusal.zh: 她的答复等于完全拒绝。

refusal.en: His refusal to talk was simple stubbornness.
refusal.zh: 他拒绝交谈只是出于固执。

refusal.en: His refusal to discuss the matter is very annoying.
refusal.zh: 他拒绝商量这件事，令人很恼火。

refute.en: I covered the conference as a reporter, but what really unnerved me was a counter-conference of scholars to refute the earlier one.
refute.zh: 我以记者的身份报道了那次会议，但真正让我感到不安的是学者们召开的反驳会议。

refute.en: Even if true, this evidence does not refute the contention that editors should bear some of the blame for the reductions, unless editors are merely passive instruments responding to reader interest.
refute.zh: 即使这是真的，这一证据也不能反驳编辑应该承担部分责任的论点，除非编辑只是被动地回应读者的兴趣。

refute.en: It was the kind of rumour that it is impossible to refute.
refute.zh: 这是那种不可能推翻的谣言。

refuse.en: Am I to understand that you refuse?

regarding.en: She has said nothing regarding your request.
regarding.zh: 关于你的要求，她什么也没说。

regarding.en: He refused to divulge any information regarding the man's whereabouts.
regarding.zh: 他拒绝透露任何关于那个男人下落的消息。

regarding.en: The controversy regarding vitamin C is unlikely to be resolved in the near future.
regarding.zh: 关于维生素C的争论近期不大可能被解决。

regard.en: I have nothing further to say in this regard.
regard.zh: 在这方面，我没什么要说的了。

regard.en: He seemed to regard the whole thing as a joke.
regard.zh: 他似乎是把整件事当成玩笑。

regard.en: I regard this as a serious matter.
regard.zh: 我认为这是一件重要的事情。

regime.en: He refused requests to play the cello suites in many countries that recognised the regime.
regime.zh: 他拒绝了许多国家要他演奏大提琴组曲的请求，因为它们都承认了该政权。

regime.en: The Little Ice Age has given way to a new climatic regime, marked by prolonged and steady warming.
regime.zh: 小冰河时代已让位于以持续稳定变暖为特征的新气候体制。

regime.en: As the regressive nature of Mussolini's regime became clear, he began to suffer a crisis of conscience.
regime.zh: 随着墨索里尼政权的倒退性逐渐显露，他开始感到良心不安。

regardless.en: She always travels first-class regardless of expense.
regardless.zh: 无论费用多高她总是乘头等舱。

regardless.en: Despite her recent surgery she has been carrying on regardless.
regardless.zh: 尽管她最近动了手术，她却一直在不顾一切地继续工作。

regardless.en: Everyone has the right to good medical care regardless of their ability to pay.
regardless.zh: 无论支付能力如何，每个人都有权得到良好的医疗。

region.zh: 这地区大部分是低洼地。
这个地区有着深厚的传统。
该地区的医院供过于求。

register.en: Thousands lined up to register to vote.
Have you come to register at the school?
register.zh: 你到学校来注册过了吗？

register.en: Could you sign the hotel register please, sir?
register.zh: 先生，请在酒店登记簿上签字好吗？

regret.en: I regret some of my posts about President @realDonaldTrump last week. They went too far.
regret.zh: 我对上周发布的一些关于总统@realDonaldTrump的帖子感到后悔。它们太过分了。
我非常后悔说了那些话。

regret.en: I came to regret my unconsidered remarks.
regret.zh: 我对我那些考虑不周的言辞开始感到后悔。

regularly.zh: 她经常去从事跳伞活动。
我差不多经常练习慢跑。
她定期来为我们照看小孩。

regular.zh: 经常锻炼有助于防止体重增加。
员工们定期向慈善机构捐赠物品。

regulate.en: The FCC has no statutory authority to regulate the Internet.
regulate.zh: 美国联邦通信委员会没有规范因特网的法定权力。

regulate.en: Under such a plan, the government would regulate competition among insurance companies so that everyone gets care at lower cost.
regulate.zh: 根据这样一个计划，政府会控制保险公司之间的竞争，这样每个人都能以较低价格获得保险。

regulate.en: The government should regulate the app-based car rental market.
regulate.zh: 政府应规范以应用软件为基础的汽车租赁市场。

regulation.en: The regulation operates in favour of married couples.
regulation.zh: 这一规定的实施有利于已婚夫妇。

regulation.en: Some in the market now want government regulation in order to reduce costs.
regulation.zh: 市场上现在有人想要政府来管理以降低成本。

regulation.en: The results prove that regulation of the salmon farming industry is inadequate.
regulation.zh: 结果证明，大马哈鱼养殖业的管理是失当的。

rehearsal.en: We only had six days of rehearsal.
rehearsal.zh: 我们只有六天的排练时间。

rehearsal.en: The rehearsal process also irked him increasingly.
rehearsal.zh: 排练过程也更加让他厌烦。

rehearsal.en: The rehearsal studio is buzzing with lunchtime activity.
rehearsal.zh: 排练场被午餐时段活动搞得很热闹。

reign.en: In this lecture I shall concentrate on the early years of Charles's reign.
reign.zh: 这一节课我将着重讲查理王朝的早期统治时期。

reign.en: Juan Carlos fired back with a rare public defense of his reign in a recent speech.
reign.zh: 胡安·卡洛斯在最近的一次演讲中对自己的统治进行了罕见的公开辩护。

reign.en: North of the border, where price controls reign, those same brand-name drugs cost 50% to 80% less.
reign.zh: 在边境以北，价格控制盛行，同样的名牌药品价格要低50%到80%。

rein.en: Many people have begun looking for long-term ways to rein in spending.
rein.zh: 很多人已经开始寻找控制开支的长远方式。

rein.en: Her parents kept her on a tight rein with their narrow and inflexible views.
rein.zh: 她的父母目光短浅而又固执地严格控制着她。

rein.en: He promised that between now and the end of the year the government would try to rein back inflation.
rein.zh: 他承诺从现在起到年底政府将努力严格控制通货膨胀。

reinforce.en: I hope this will reinforce Indonesian determination to deal with this kind of threat.
reinforce.zh: 我希望这会加强印度尼西亚对付这类威胁的决心。

reinforce.en: Remember you want your visuals to reinforce your message, not detract from what you are saying.
reinforce.zh: 要记住，你是要用视觉资料来强化你的信息，而不是削弱你所讲述的内容。

reinforce.en: We agreed on a form of splint to reinforce the damaged portion.
reinforce.zh: 我们同意用一种夹板来加固损坏的部分。

reject.en: Animals reject the runt of the litter.
reject.zh: 动物们排斥一窝中最弱小的幼仔。
患者经常排斥移植的器官。

reject.en: It lies with you to accept or reject the proposals.
reject.zh: 接受或是拒绝这些建议由你决定。

rejoice.en: When the war ended, people finally had cause to rejoice.
rejoice.zh: 战争结束，人们终于可以欢欣鼓舞了。

rejoice.en: Should we rejoice in the death of another human being?
rejoice.zh: 我们该为另一个人类的死亡而高兴吗？

rejoice.en: In him our hearts rejoice, for we trust in his holy name.
rejoice.zh: 我们的心必靠他欢喜，因为我们倚靠他的圣名。

relate.en: Trainees should be invited to relate new ideas to their past experiences.
relate.zh: 应该要求实习生把新想法与他们的以往经历相联系。

relate.en: I don't think he understood the dynamics of how the police and the city administration relate.
relate.zh: 我认为他不理解警方与市政部门如何发生联系的动态原理。
许多成年人并不了解儿童的想法。

relation.en: It is a question of the relation of ethics to economics.
relation.zh: 这是个道德和经济之间关系的问题。

relation.en: The relation that exists when opposites cannot coexist.
relation.zh: 对立面不能共存的关系。

relation.en: The relation between employees and employers is becoming tense.
relation.zh: 员工和雇主之间的关系变得紧张起来。

relationship.zh: 他们的关系变得更好了。
他们的关系很快有了嫌隙。
她身陷一段没有爱情的关系中。

relative.en: He's a distant relative of the mayor.
She enjoyed the relative informality of island life.
relative.zh: 她喜欢相对轻松随意的岛屿生活。

relative.en: Fitness is relative; one must always ask "Fit for what?"
relative.zh: 适宜是相对的；始终必须问问：“适宜什么？”

relatively.zh: 相对而言，这工作报酬很低。

relativity.en: According to the theory of relativity, nothing can travel faster than light.
relativity.zh: 根据相对论，任何东西都无法超越光速。

relativity.en: Einstein's theory of relativity won for him universal esteem.
relativity.zh: 爱因斯坦的相对论赢得了全世界对他的崇敬。

relativity.en: My colleague mentioned how the theory of relativity completely changed the field of physics.
relativity.zh: 我的同事提到了相对论如何彻底改变了物理学领域。

relax.zh: 泡个澡能放松紧绷的肌肉。
咱们轻松一下，好好享受享受。

relay.en: They raced to a thrilling victory in the relay.
relay.zh: 他们在接力赛中取得了激动人心的胜利。

relay.en: The satellite will be used mainly to relay television programmes.
relay.zh: 这颗卫星将主要用来转播电视节目。

relay.en: Britain's prospects of beating the United States in the relay looked poor.
relay.zh: 英国队在接力赛中战胜美国队的希望看上去不大。

relevant.en: She brought him, unasked, the relevant file.
relevant.zh: 她主动把有关案卷带给了他。

relevant.en: I tried googling but couldn't find anything relevant.
relevant.zh: 我试着用搜索引擎检索，但找不到任何相关信息。

release.en: She commanded the release of the prisoners.
It was considered unsafe to release the prisoners.
release.zh: 释放这些囚犯被认为是危险的。

reliability.en: The incident cast doubt on her motives and reliability.
reliability.zh: 这件事使人怀疑她有何动机，以及她是否可靠。

reliability.en: Car buyers are more interested in safety and reliability than speed.
reliability.zh: 比起速度，汽车买主更关注安全性和可靠性。

reliability.en: Our goods compete in terms of product quality, reliability and above all variety.
reliability.zh: 我们的产品从质量、可靠性、尤其是多样性来看很有竞争力。

reliable.zh: 我知道她是诚实可靠的。

reliance.en: People learned self-reliance because they had to.
reliance.zh: 人们学会了自立因为他们不得不这样做。

reliance.en: Heavy reliance on one client is risky when you are building up a business.
reliance.zh: 创业时过分依赖某一个客户是有风险的。

reliance.en: About 10% of Japanese teenagers are overweight. Nutritionists say the main culprit is increasing reliance on Western fast food.
reliance.zh: 约10%的日本青少年都超重。营养学家们称主要的原因是他们越来越依赖西方快餐。

relief.zh: 救援物资很快就运来了。
我内心释然地长出了一口气。

relieve.en: The doctor drew off some fluid to relieve the pressure.
relieve.zh: 医生排掉了一些液体以缓解压力。

relieve.en: Drugs can relieve much of the pain.
relieve.zh: 药物可以大大缓解疼痛。

relieve.en: I had to relieve myself behind a bush.
relieve.zh: 我只好在树丛后面方便了一下。

religious.zh: 他谴责了宗教偏执的行为。

religion.zh: 你还奉行你的宗教信仰吗？

religion.en: Religion informs every aspect of their lives.
religion.zh: 宗教影响着他们生活的各个方面。

religion.en: She objects to the ritual of organized religion.
religion.zh: 她反对有组织宗教的仪规。

rely.en: It would be rash to rely on such evidence.
rely.zh: 依靠这样的证据太轻率了。

rely.en: Many animals rely on concealment for protection.
rely.zh: 许多动物靠藏匿自己来避害。

reluctant.en: Mr. Spero was reluctant to ask for help.
reluctant.zh: 斯珀洛先生不愿意请求帮助。

reluctant.en: She was reluctant to admit she was wrong.
We were reluctant to start the long trudge home.
reluctant.zh: 我们不情愿的开始长途跋涉回家。

remainder.en: He gulped down the remainder of his coffee.
remainder.zh: 他一口喝完了剩下的咖啡。

remainder.en: Efforts to persuade the remainder to follow suit have continued.
remainder.zh: 说服其余的人也跟着做的努力在继续。

remainder.en: His widow became a virtual recluse for the remainder of her life.
remainder.zh: 他的遗孀在其余生成了一名实际上的隐居者。

remain.zh: 他们的动机仍然是个谜。
作为主席，我必须保持中立。

remains.zh: 他的勇敢仍然不容置疑。
这个问题至今仍在激烈地辩论中。

remarkable.zh: 她是一位真正非同凡响的女人。

remark.en: What did he mean by that remark?
The remark was made half in jest.
remark.zh: 这话是半开玩笑说出的。

remedy.en: There is no simple remedy for unemployment.
remedy.zh: 失业问题没有简单的解决办法。

remedy.en: Their remedy lay within the range of existent technology.
remedy.zh: 他们的补救措施在现有科技范围内。

remedy.en: Your only remedy is to go to law.
remedy.zh: 你唯一的补救办法是诉诸法律。

remnant.en: The Ainu settlers in Hokkaido are the last remnant of a prehistoric race.
remnant.zh: 北海道的阿伊努人是史前某个种族的最后残存者。

remnant.en: It's not a remnant of some huge population that is dwindled in the last few hundred years for some reason.
remnant.zh: 它并不是由于某种原因而在过去几百年里减少的庞大人口的残余。

remnant.en: The common ancestor is, however, too recent for the new species to be a remnant of the first human excursion from Africa.
remnant.zh: 然而，共同的祖先对于新物种又太现代，而不能作为来自非洲的人类首次远足的遗迹。

remind.en: Remind me to phone Alan before I go out.
remind.zh: 提醒我在出去之前给艾伦打电话。

remind.en: Can you remind me to buy a bottle of wine?
remind.zh: 你能提醒我买一瓶葡萄酒吗？

remind.en: I'm sorry, I've forgotten your name. Can you remind me?
remind.zh: 对不起，我忘了你的名字。提醒我一下好吗？

remember.zh: 我的确记得，只是记不太清楚了。
我绝不会忘记这次旅行！
我不记得密码锁的数码组合了。

remote.en: The monastery is in a remote mountain pass.
remote.zh: 那僧院在一个偏远的山坳通道处。

removal.en: They rejected a demand for the removal of all nuclear weapons.
removal.zh: 他们拒绝了清除所有核武器的要求。

removal.en: What they expected to be the removal of a small lump turned out to be major surgery.
removal.zh: 他们本以为只是切除一个小肿块，结果却成了个大手术。

removal.en: Nearby Malaysia may have the right to order the wreck's removal, the newspaper said.
removal.zh: 附近的马来西亚可能有权命令移除残骸，该报纸说。

renaissance.en: The theme of the conference is renaissance Europe.
renaissance.zh: 该会议的主题是文艺复兴时期的欧洲。

renaissance.en: Italian works reflect the essence of the Renaissance.
renaissance.zh: 意大利的作品反映出文艺复兴的精髓。

render.en: It's a concept that is difficult to render into English.
render.zh: 这个概念难以用英语来表达。

render.en: They couldn't resist anymore and decided to render up the city.
render.zh: 他们无法继续抵抗，决定放弃这座城市。

render.en: It contained so many errors as to render it worthless.
render.zh: 太多的错误使之变得毫无价值。

remove.en: Scuff marks from shoes are difficult to remove.
The logical treatment is to remove this blockage.
remove.zh: 合理的处理方法是清除这种堵塞物。

remove.en: Once the turkey has defrosted, remove the giblets.
remove.zh: 一旦火鸡解冻，立刻移除鸡杂。

renew.en: We have to renew our efforts to attract young players.
renew.zh: 我们只好重新开始努力吸引年轻队员。

renew.en: We went to renew our monthly season ticket.
Larry's landlord threatened not to renew his lease.
renew.zh: 拉里的房东威胁说不再让他续租。

rent.zh: 他的房东把房租提高了一倍。

rent.en: She agreed to rent me the room.
rent.zh: 她同意租给我这个房间。

rent.en: Have you paid him the rent yet?

repay.en: I'll repay the money I owe them next week.
repay.zh: 我将在下个星期偿还欠他们的钱。

repay.en: I can never repay your many kindnesses to me.
repay.zh: 我无法报答你对我无微不至的关怀。

repay.en: How can I ever repay you for your generosity?
repay.zh: 你对我这样慷慨，我怎么才能报答你呢？

repair.en: I took my bike in for repair.
The building was in need of repair.
We'll repair it as quickly as possible.
repair.zh: 我们会尽快把它修好的。

repeatedly.en: He struck at me repeatedly with a stick.
repeatedly.zh: 他拿着棍子一再朝我打过来。

repeatedly.en: Both men have repeatedly denied the allegations.
repeatedly.zh: 两个人都再三地否认这些指控。

repeatedly.en: He was paged repeatedly as the flight was boarding.
repeatedly.zh: 登机时，他被反复地呼叫着。

repeat.en: The joke is too rude to repeat.
repeat.zh: 这个笑话太下流，不宜重复。
“这是新播出的连续剧吗？”“不，是重播的。”

repeat.en: The claims are, I repeat, totally unfounded.
repeat.zh: 我再说一遍，这些说法是毫无根据的。

repel.en: They have fifty thousand troops along the border ready to repel any attack.
repel.zh: 他们沿边界有5万军队，随时准备击退任何进攻。

repel.en: Ants store food, repel attackers and use chemical signals to contact one another in case of attack.
repel.zh: 蚂蚁储存食物，击退攻击者，并使用化学信号联系彼此以防被攻击。

repent.en: I was shown that I am a sinner, that I needed to repent of my sins.
repent.zh: 我被证明是个罪人，需要为我的罪孽忏悔。
我就不能忏悔我的罪过了！

repertoire.en: His repertoire encompassed everything from Bach to Schoenberg.
repertoire.zh: 他的表演曲目从巴赫到勋伯格，样样俱全。

repertoire.en: Meredith D'Ambrosio has thousands of songs in her repertoire.
repertoire.zh: 梅雷迪思•丹布罗西奥的全部曲目达到几千首。

repertoire.en: Merely expanding the orchestra's repertoire will not be enough.
repertoire.zh: 仅仅扩大乐团的演奏曲目是不够的。

repetition.en: It is real prayer, and not mechanical repetition.
repetition.zh: 这是真正的祈祷，而不是机械式的重复。

repetition.en: He could also have cut out much of the repetition and thus saved many pages.
repetition.zh: 他本来也可以删掉很多重复的语句，省去很多页数。
重复有助于提高我们的记忆力。

replacement.en: We need to find a replacement for Sue.
replacement.zh: 我们需要找一个替代休的人。

replacement.en: She will continue in her present job until a replacement can be found.
replacement.zh: 在找到替换人员以前，她将继续做她目前的工作。

replacement.en: It is a delicious replacement for plastic ones.
replacement.zh: 它是塑料制品的美味替代品。

replace.en: Have they found anyone to replace her yet?
replace.zh: 他们找到了代替她的人没有？

replace.en: He headed off efforts to replace him as leader.
replace.zh: 他挫败了要取代他的领导地位的企图。

replace.en: New laws will soon replace existing legislation.
replace.zh: 新法律即将取代现行法规。

reply.zh: 他们得到一个否定的答复。
她的回答不宜被印刷出来。

reporter.zh: 他是一个24岁的实习记者。

reporter.en: He seemed too ingenuous for a reporter.
reporter.zh: 他好像太天真诚实，不适合做记者。

reporter.en: She was a TV reporter and worked long hours.
reporter.zh: 她曾是个电视记者，长时间工作。

revive.en: Their efforts to revive him were futile.
revive.zh: 他们努力使他苏醒，但失败了。

review.en: The case is subject to judicial review.
review.zh: 这个案子必须接受司法审查。

review.en: He submitted his latest novel for review.
review.zh: 他提交了自己的最新小说供评论。

review.en: The review is a brilliant piece of writing.

reverse.en: You should reverse the order of these pages.
reverse.zh: 你该把这几页的顺序颠倒过来。

revolt.en: In February 1848, the people of Paris rose in revolt against the constitutional monarchy of Louis-Philippe.
revolt.zh: 1848年2月，巴黎人民奋起反抗路易-菲利浦君主立宪制。

revolt.en: If instead we regard the financing of warfare by taxation in this period as a background condition, then we will see the English reverse themselves as the main cause of the revolt.
revolt.zh: 如果我们将这一时期的通过税收来支持军事作为背景条件，那么我们就会看到英国人自己的失败反倒是造成反抗的主要原因。

revolution.en: His name was invoked as a symbol of the revolution.
revolution.zh: 他的名字被提出作为那次革命的象征。

revolution.en: The feeding of dairy cows has undergone a revolution.
revolution.zh: 奶牛的喂食已经历了一场革命。

revolution.en: She lived through the turmoil of the French Revolution.
revolution.zh: 她经历过法国大革命的混乱之后仍旧活着。

revolutionary.en: She ran away with him to Mexico and espoused the revolutionary cause.
revolutionary.zh: 她与他一起逃到了墨西哥，支持革命事业。

revolutionary.en: This revolutionary expansion required energetic nation-building policies.
revolutionary.zh: 这次革命性扩张需要有积极的国家建设政策。

revolutionary.en: Invented in 1951, the rotary engine is a revolutionary concept in internal combustion.
revolutionary.zh: 1951年发明的旋转引擎是内燃领域的一个革命性观念。

revolve.en: Our planet Earth, together with other planets, revolve around our Sun in what is called our Solar system.
revolve.zh: 我们的行星地球，连同其他行星，围绕我们的太阳旋转，这就是我们的太阳系。

revolve.en: Of course, we now know that the planets, including Earth, revolve around the Sun, and that the solar system is only a tiny part of the universe.
revolve.zh: 当然，我们现在知道，包括地球在内的行星都围绕太阳公转，而太阳系只是宇宙的一小部分。

revolve.en: Geocentric means Earth-centered, so the geocentric view holds that the Sun, the planets, and the stars, all revolve around the Earth, which is stationary.
revolve.zh: 地心论是指以地球为中心，所以地心论认为，太阳、行星和恒星都围绕着地球旋转，而地球是静止的。

reward.en: You deserve a reward for being so helpful.
reward.zh: 你帮了这么大的忙，理应受到奖励。

reward.en: Winning the match was just reward for the effort the team had made.
reward.zh: 赢得比赛的胜利是全队付出努力应得的回报。

reward.en: There is a reward for information leading to the recovery of the missing diamonds.
reward.zh: 凡能为找回丢失的钻石提供线索者可获奖赏。

rhythm.zh: 这是一种音低节奏强的旋律。

rhythm.en: Rhythm and blues mutated into rock and roll.
rhythm.zh: 节奏布鲁斯演变成为摇滚乐。

rhythm.en: A basic sense of rhythm and pitch is essential in a music teacher.
rhythm.zh: 基本的韵律感和音高感是音乐教师的必备素质。

rib.en: You've fractured a rib, maybe more than one.
rib.zh: 你断了一根肋骨，也许不止一根。

rib.en: If you sneeze too hard, you could fracture a rib.
rib.zh: 要是你打喷嚏用力过猛，你可能会折断肋骨。

rib.en: We picked up the rib fragment, flipped it over and there were these two clear marks.
rib.zh: 我们捡起肋骨碎片，将它翻过来，就发现有这两处清晰的痕迹。

ribbon.en: The road was a ribbon of moonlight.
ribbon.zh: 这条路在月光下如同一条缎带。

ribbon.en: She had tied back her hair with a peach satin ribbon.
ribbon.zh: 她用一条桃红色的缎带把头发扎在了脑后。

ribbon.en: Mrs. Haines stood nearby, holding scissors to cut a ribbon.
ribbon.zh: 海恩斯太太站在旁边，拿着剪刀剪缎带。

rice.en: Could you give the rice a stir?

riddle.en: Scientists claimed yesterday to have solved the riddle of the birth of the universe.
riddle.zh: 科学家们昨天宣布已经解开了宇宙诞生之谜。

riddle.en: This is the riddle you have to solve.
riddle.zh: 这是你必须要解决的谜题。

rid.en: I can't get rid of this headache.
We got rid of all the old furniture.
rid.zh: 我们扔掉了所有的旧家具。

rid.en: Are you trying to say you want rid of me?

rich.zh: 橘子含有丰富的维生素C。

rider.en: She was a good rider, but reckless.
rider.zh: 她是个好骑手，但太鲁莽。

rider.en: The horse reared and threw off its rider.
rider.zh: 那匹马后腿直立，把骑手摔了下去。

ridge.en: The fawn ran to the top of the ridge.
He slowed the pace as they crested the ridge.
ridge.zh: 当他们到达山脊时，他放慢了步伐。

ridge.en: Rammick lives high on a ridge in a 400-home subdivision.
ridge.zh: 拉米克住在高高的山脊上一块有400户的住宅区。

ridiculous.zh: 我戴这顶帽子看上去很可笑。

ridiculous.en: It did nothing but make us ridiculous.
ridiculous.zh: 它只是让我们显得可笑。
“别荒唐了！”帕特生气地回答道。

ride.en: They hitched a ride in a truck.
ride.zh: 他们搭乘了一辆路过的货车。

ride.en: Do you want a ride? Jump in.
He could cadge a ride from somebody.
ride.zh: 他可以求别人搭个便车。

rifle.en: There was a rattle of rifle fire.
rifle.zh: 有步枪射击发出的嘎嘎声。

rifle.en: When he appeared again, he was aiming the rifle at Wade.
rifle.zh: 他再次出现时，他正将步枪瞄准维德。

rifle.en: You'd swear he was a cardboard cut-out except that he'd moved his rifle.
rifle.zh: 你会断言他是个用纸板裁出的假人，除非他动了他的来福枪。

rig.en: It took a team of engineers to rig it up.
rig.zh: 这需要一个工程师团队来操纵它。

rig.en: The oil slick resulted from an accident at the Deepwater Horizon rig in the Gulf of Mexico.
rig.zh: 这片浮油是由于处于墨西哥湾的“深海地平线”钻井平台的一次事故造成的。

rig.en: When the rig sank, the riser broke near the top while remaining attached to the blowout preventer at the bottom.
rig.zh: 当钻井平台下沉时，立管在顶部附近的地方断裂，同时另一端仍与底部的防喷器相连。

rigid.en: The curriculum was too narrow and too rigid.
rigid.zh: 课程设置过于狭窄和死板。

rigid.en: He was weaned on a diet of rigid discipline and duty.
rigid.zh: 他自幼受到严格纪律和职责的约束。

rigid.en: He balanced his budgets by rigid control over public expenditure.
rigid.zh: 他通过严格控制公共开支来平衡预算。

rigorous.en: The work failed to meet their rigorous standards.
rigorous.zh: 工作没有达到他们的严格标准。

rigorous.en: Was it a curriculum that appeared more rigorous, perhaps?
rigorous.zh: 或许，这是一门看起来更严格的课程？

rigorous.en: All vitamin supplements would be evaluated in scientifically rigorous clinical trials.
rigorous.zh: 所有维生素补充剂都会经过科学严格的临床试验评估。

rim.en: There is also a new steering wheel with an energy-absorbing rim to cushion the driver's head in the worst impacts.
rim.zh: 还有新式方向盘，其边缘具有减震功能在最严重的冲击中缓冲保护司机的头部。

rim.en: Insects that land on the rim of the pitcher slide on the liquid and tumble in.
rim.zh: 落在水罐边缘的昆虫在液体上滑行，并在里面打滚。

rim.en: Other items included a Lapita burial urn with modeled birds arranged on the rim as though peering down at the human remains sealed inside.
rim.zh: 其他物品还包括一个拉皮塔人的骨灰盒，骨灰盒边缘摆放着模型鸟，仿佛在俯视密封在里面的人类遗骸。

ring.en: That ring must be worth a fortune.
ring.zh: 那枚戒指肯定要值好多钱。

ring.en: I could never part with this ring.
ring.zh: 我永远也不摘掉这枚戒指。

riot.en: After about 10 minutes the riot police arrived.
riot.zh: 大约10分钟之后，防暴警察就到了。

riot.en: Cars and buses were set ablaze during the riot.
riot.zh: 暴乱中许多轿车和公共汽车被纵火焚烧。

ripe.en: Reforms were promised when the time was ripe.
ripe.zh: 曾经作出承诺，时机一成熟就进行改革。

ripe.en: You'll need four ripe tomatoes, skinned and chopped.
ripe.zh: 需要四个熟了的西红柿，去皮切碎。

rip.zh: 我听到了帐篷撕裂的声音。
来吧，史蒂夫—让车全速前进吧。

rip.en: Once on the open road, he let rip.
rip.zh: 一上空旷的公路，他就全速行驶。

ripen.en: I'm waiting for the apples to ripen.
This helps to ripen new growth and makes it flower profusely.
ripen.zh: 这有助于新植物成熟并且开出繁茂的花朵。

ripen.en: They've got fruit retailing down to a fine art. You can be sure that your pears will ripen in day.
ripen.zh: 他们精于水果零售之道。你可以放心，你那些梨一天之内就会熟。

ripple.en: The air was so still that there was hardly a ripple on the pond's surface.
ripple.zh: 没有风，池塘的水面上几乎看不到波纹。

ripple.en: Ships could be diverted to other ports and that would have a serious ripple effect through the local economy.
ripple.zh: 可以把货轮转向其他港口，那样的话可能会对当地经济造成严重的连锁反应。

ripple.en: A ripple of fear passed through him.
ripple.zh: 一股恐惧感传遍了他的全身。

risk.en: You must be mad to risk it.
risk.zh: 你去冒这种风险，简直是疯了。

risk.en: Dare she risk staying where she was?
risk.zh: 她敢冒险呆在原地不动吗？

ritual.en: It is a familiar, and quintessentially Japanese ritual.
ritual.zh: 它是个熟悉而又典型的日式仪式。

ritual.en: Sunday lunch with the in-laws has become something of a ritual.
ritual.zh: 星期天，和姻亲们共进午餐已经成了例行的公事。

ritual.en: Their mating ritual is just so impersonal.
ritual.zh: 它们的求偶仪式是如此的没有人情味。

rise.en: I'm going to ask for a rise.
Within two months Kelly got a rise.
rise.zh: 两个月内凯利就获得了加薪。

rival.en: This year the newspaper has outsold its main rival.
rival.zh: 今年该报的发行量已超过了它的主要对手。

rival.en: Their smaller rival is battling to end their duopoly.
rival.zh: 比他们小的竞争对手正在为结束他们两家寡头集团而斗争。

rival.en: There is often no discernible difference between rival brands.
rival.zh: 相互竞争的品牌之间往往看不出明显的区别。

river.zh: 这条河流周围满是各种鸟类。

roar.zh: 我们听见了狮子的吼声。

roar.en: I could barely hear above the roar of traffic.
roar.zh: 过往车辆的轰鸣声使我几乎什么也听不见。
响起了一片表示赞成的喊叫声。

road.zh: 克莱尔匆匆地沿路而行。

roast.en: They serve the most delicious roast beef.
roast.zh: 他们做最美味的烤牛肉。

rob.zh: 她到罗布那儿寻求慰藉。

rob.en: Rob Harmeling won the sprint in Bordeaux.
rob.zh: 罗布•哈梅林赢得了波尔多短跑赛。

rob.en: That Rob was a snob and a social climber could not be denied.
rob.zh: 那个罗布是个势利小人，喜欢攀龙附凤——无可否定。

robber.en: This was the first time he had confronted an armed robber.
robber.zh: 这是他第一次面对一个武装劫匪。

robbery.zh: 莫里斯已经承认犯有抢劫罪。

robbery.en: They had been found guilty of armed robbery.
robbery.zh: 他们被判犯有持械抢劫罪。

robbery.en: A man has been arrested in connection with the robbery.
robbery.zh: 一名男子因与这桩抢劫案有关已被逮捕。

robe.en: Kyle put on a robe and went down to the kitchen.
robe.zh: 凯尔穿上睡袍，下楼去了厨房。

robe.en: She was wearing only a thin robe over a flimsy nightgown, and her feet were bare.
robe.zh: 她只在薄薄的睡衣外面穿了件薄袍子，还光着双脚。

robot.en: This is the latest in robot technology.
robot.zh: 这是最新的机器人技术。

robot.en: The company is credited with inventing the industrial robot.
robot.zh: 发明工业机器人是那家公司的功劳。

robot.en: The robot was programmed to mimic a series of human movements.
robot.zh: 机器人可按程序设计模仿人的各种动作。

robust.en: She was almost 90, but still very robust.
robust.zh: 她将近90岁了，但身体仍然十分强健。

robust.en: He was always the robust one, physically strong and mentally sharp.
robust.zh: 他一向是个健壮的人，身体强壮、头脑敏锐。
他以典型的坚定风格作答。

rock.zh: 船撞在海图上未标示的岩石上。

rocket.zh: 火箭呼啸着朝天上飞去。

rod.en: The rod bent double, the reel shrieked and ratcheted.
rod.zh: 该操作杆加倍弯曲，线轴发出刺耳的嗒嗒声。

rod.en: Her mother was there, trying to put a curtain rod up over the little window.
rod.zh: 她妈妈在那儿，正试着给小窗上安一根挂帘杆。

rod.en: This is a traditional fuel rod lens that glows underwater.
rod.zh: 这是一个传统的水下发光的燃料棒镜头。

role.zh: 他是这个角色的最佳人选。

role.en: He won a BAFTA for the role.
role.zh: 他演出这个角色获得英国电影电视艺术学院奖。

Roman.en: The novel is set in the Roman period.
Roman.zh: 该小说的背景是罗马时期。
索雷吉耶塔女士是位罗马天主教徒。

Roman.en: The rebels took on the entire Roman army.
Roman.zh: 反叛者与整个罗马军队战斗。

roller.en: A boy of about ten came up on roller skates.
roller.zh: 一个大约十岁的男孩穿着双排四轮旱冰鞋滑了过来。

roller.en: The last few weeks have been a real roller coaster.
roller.zh: 过去的几个星期，形势真是变幻莫测。

roller.en: A cinema and roller rink attracted customers and profit.
roller.zh: 一家兼作溜冰场的电影院吸引了顾客，也招来了利润。

roll.en: Comedy is the new rock and roll.
roll.zh: 说笑表演风头直追摇滚乐。

roll.en: Rhythm and blues mutated into rock and roll.
roll.zh: 节奏布鲁斯演变成为摇滚乐。

roll.en: They have simply misunderstood what rock and roll is.
roll.zh: 他们完全误解了摇滚乐是什么。

romance.zh: 这是一场发展缓慢的恋情。

romance.en: The movie mixes broad humor with romance.
romance.zh: 那部电影把粗俗幽默和浪漫故事结合在一起。

romance.en: Romance is making a comeback. Reality is out.
romance.zh: 浪漫正回归；现实已过时。

romantic.zh: 这部电影是一个浪漫喜剧。
你是个无可救药的浪漫主义者。
他们演唱了一首缓慢的浪漫歌曲。

roof.zh: 已宣布屋顶有安全隐患。

root.en: We got to the root of the problem.
root.zh: 我们触及了这个问题的根源。

root.en: Most plants will root in about six to eight weeks.
root.zh: 大多数植物会在六到八周内生根。

root.en: There would be a major drive to root out corruption.
root.zh: 将会有一场根除腐败的大规模的运动。

rose.zh: 各人的收入明显提高了。

rot.en: The house was riddled with dry rot.
rot.zh: 屋子因木材干腐而变得千疮百孔。

rot.en: The rubbish in modern landfills does not rot.
rot.zh: 现代垃圾填埋场里的垃圾不会腐烂。

rot.en: The wood must not get damp as rot can quickly result.
rot.zh: 木头不能受潮，否则很快就会烂掉。

rotary.en: Invented in 1951, the rotary engine is a revolutionary concept in internal combustion.
rotary.zh: 1951年发明的旋转引擎是内燃领域的一个革命性观念。

rotary.en: It's like a rotary phone, where you could turn to a pageboy, or that haircut that looked like a nuclear bomb exploded your bangs, and then the Peter Pan look.
rotary.zh: 就像个旋转式电话，在那儿你能做个童花头，或者是爆炸式的刘海，再或者一个彼得潘的发型也行。

rotary.en: A rotary engine attached to the steam engine enabled shafts to be turned and machines to be driven, resulting in mills using steam power to spin and weave cotton.
rotary.zh: 连接在蒸汽机上的旋转式发动机使轴承转动，机器得以驱动，从而使得利用蒸汽动力纺线和织布的工厂出现。

rotation.en: Wheat, maize and sugar beet are planted in rotation.
rotation.zh: 小麦、玉米和甜菜是轮流种植的。

rotation.en: The workers in this workshop do day and night shifts in weekly rotation.
rotation.zh: 这个车间的工人上白班和上夜班每周轮换一次。

rotation.en: The earth's gravity slows the moon's rotation, matching it to the speed of its orbit.
rotation.zh: 地球引力减缓了月球的自转速度，使之与其轨道的速度相匹配。

rotate.en: With a low-pitched rumbling noise, the propeller began to rotate.
rotate.zh: 随着低沉的隆隆声，螺旋桨开始旋转起来。

rotate.en: Stay well away from the helicopter when its blades start to rotate.
rotate.zh: 直升机的螺旋桨开始转动时，尽量离远点儿。

rotten.en: The pond was choked with rotten leaves.
rotten.zh: 池塘被腐烂的叶子塞满了。

rough.zh: 凯茜作了一个粗略的计算。
他们比赛总是这么粗野吗？

roughly.en: They all left at roughly the same time.
roughly.zh: 他们都是大约同一时间离开的。

rouse.en: He did more to rouse the crowd there than anybody else.
rouse.zh: 他比其他任何人都更卖力地鼓动那里的群众。

rouse.en: She seemed to be unable to rouse herself to do anything.
rouse.zh: 她似乎打不起精神做任何事情。

rouse.en: Richard couldn't rouse himself to say anything in reply.

round.zh: 有没有人带你四处走走？

route.zh: 这条路线路标设置完善。
他们沿着事先规划的路线前进。

route.en: Which is the best route to take?

routine.zh: 警察的工作主要都是按常规的。
采集了一份常规的脱氧核糖核酸样本。
你需要从日常工作中解脱出来去休息一下。

row.en: We were sitting in the back row.
The boatman refused to row him back.
row.zh: 那船夫拒绝划船送他回去。

royal.zh: 我们受到了盛大的欢迎。

royal.en: He's a dancer with the Royal Ballet.
royal.zh: 他是皇家芭蕾舞团的舞蹈演员。

royal.en: She reports on royal stories for the BBC.
royal.zh: 她为英国广播公司做有关王室活动的报道。

rubber.zh: 这个男孩儿穿着橡胶底的鞋。

rubber.en: The smell of burning rubber filled the air.
rubber.zh: 空气中弥漫着橡胶燃烧的气味。

rubber.en: The stench of burning rubber was overpowering.
rubber.zh: 燃烧橡胶散发出的臭味极其强烈。

royalty.en: The King chafed bitterly over the stupendous indignity thus put upon his royalty, but Hendon was moody and taciturn.
royalty.zh: 国王对他的王权受到的巨大侮辱感到非常愤怒，亨顿更是憋住一肚子气，沉默寡言。
我们受到了君王般的礼遇。

royalty.en: The gala evening was attended by royalty and politicians.
royalty.zh: 王室成员和政坛要人参加了这个晚会。

rub.en: She gave her knee a quick rub.
She sometimes asks if I want a back rub.
rub.zh: 她有时问我是否想要一次背部按摩。

rub.en: You may need to give the floor a rub-down with glasspaper.
rub.zh: 你可能得用玻璃砂纸打磨一下地板。

rubbish.zh: 他写的是自鸣得意、道貌岸然的垃圾。

rug.en: The corners of the rug were curling up.
The rug adds a dash of colour to the room.
rug.zh: 小地毯为房间增添了一点色彩。

therapy.en: I was ready for a little retail therapy.
therapy.zh: 我准备去进行一下购物治疗。

therapy.en: Group therapy classes have been his salvation.

there.zh: 我们约有六、七个人在场。

thereby.en: Regular exercise strengthens the heart, thereby reducing the risk of heart attack.
thereby.zh: 经常锻炼可以增强心脏机能，从而减少心脏病发作的危险。

thereby.zh: 这一设施于1933年被拆除，从而切断了（运河间的）联系。

thereby.en: This gives you the opportunity to pray for and bless the other, thereby blessing yourself.
thereby.zh: 这给你了一个机会去为他人祈祷和祝福，从而赐福给你自己。

therefore.en: He's only 17 and therefore not eligible to vote.
therefore.zh: 他只有17岁，因此没有投票选举的资格。

therefore.en: Muscle cells need lots of fuel and therefore burn lots of calories.
therefore.zh: 肌肉细胞需要很多“燃料”，并因此燃烧大量卡路里。

therefore.en: They had seen him trawling and therefore knew that there were fish.
therefore.zh: 他们看见他正用拖网捕鱼，因此他们知道那里有鱼。

thermal.zh: 他被一架警用直升飞机用热成像设备找到了。

thermal.en: Rescue teams are using thermal imaging to locate survivors of the earthquake.
thermal.zh: 救援队伍正利用热成像确定地震幸存者的位置。

thermal.en: For systems transforming solar to thermal energy, the thermal energy may be stored in matter as either latent heat or sensible heat.
thermal.zh: 对于将太阳能转化为热能的系统，热能可能以潜热或显热的形式存储在物质中。

thermometer.en: It is essential that you are able to read a thermometer.
thermometer.zh: 能读出温度计上的温度是基本要求。

thermometer.en: The thermometer shows the temperature in Celsius and Fahrenheit.
thermometer.zh: 温度计显示摄氏温度和华氏温度。

thesis.en: This thesis does not stand up to close inspection.
thesis.zh: 这个论点经不起仔细推敲。

thesis.en: There is no empirical evidence to support his thesis.
thesis.zh: 没有实证根据来支持他的论点。

thesis.zh: 你选了论文的暂定题目吗？

他们知道他们做得不对。
如果他们过高地估算，就会损失收入。

thick.zh: 他有着浓密乌黑的头发。

thickness.en: The size of the fish will determine the thickness of the steaks.
thickness.zh: 鱼的大小决定鱼排的厚度。

thickness.zh: 这条裤子上有双倍厚的护膝片以加强保护。

thing.zh: 究竟有谁听说过这种事！
马里奥说的完全是同一件事。

First of all, there are not many of them, and secondly, they have little money and, thirdly, they're hungry.
thirdly.zh: 首先，他们人数不多；第二，他们没什么钱；第三，他们在挨饿。
第三，训练足够的国内安全力量。

third.en: This is her third win in a row.
third.zh: 这是她连续获得的第三次胜利。
那个可望夺魁者得了第三名。

thirst.en: Order me a soda, I'm dying of thirst.
thirst.zh: 给我要杯汽水，我快渴死了。

thirst.zh: 我们渴了，他却独自满足。

thirteen.zh: 十三常被认为是不吉利的数字。

thirsty.en: When a baby is thirsty, it feeds more often.
thirsty.zh: 婴儿口渴时，吃奶更频繁。

thirsty.zh: 他们都口渴了，所以我给了他们一杯饮料。

thirsty.en: Drink whenever you feel thirsty during exercise.
thirsty.zh: 锻炼时一感到口渴就喝水。

thirty.zh: 到日落时我们已走了三十英里。
大约有三十人参加了葬礼。

thorn.en: The thorn of bone may dislodge from his throat without surgery.
thorn.zh: 也许不用动手术就能去除他喉咙卡着的那块骨刺。

thorn.zh: 南丁格尔更加的靠近那个刺，刺碰到了她的心脏，一股剧烈的疼痛击穿了她的身体。

thorn.en: She fell to reflecting again, and in looking downwards, a thorn of the rose remaining in her breast accidentally pricked her chin.
thorn.zh: 她又陷入了沉思，向下看时，她戴在胸前的玫瑰花刺扎了一下她的下巴。

this.zh: 这个建议使乔伊惊呆了。

thorough.zh: 我们正在进行彻底的调查。

thorough.zh: 这项非常彻底的调查可追溯到1784年。

thorough.zh: 修车厂对这辆汽车进行了彻底检修。

those.zh: 那些看上去比这些熟一些。

though.zh: 他确实回复了，不过不是立马回复。

though.en: One major problem did present itself, though.
though.zh: 不过，确实出现了一个重大问题。

though.en: Seriously though, it could be really dangerous.
though.zh: 不过说实在的，这事说不好真的很危险。

thought.zh: 我还以为你会完成不了呢！
究竟是谁想出那个笑话的？

thoughtful.en: He scratched his head and looked thoughtful.
thoughtful.zh: 他挠着头显出一副深思的样子。

thoughtful.zh: 道格拉斯是个复杂的男人，他体贴、殷勤而且慷慨。

thread.en: He took a needle and thread and sewed it up.
thread.zh: 他取来一根针和线并把它缝起来。

thread.zh: 这些讨论都贯穿着一条共同的主线。

thread.en: The blue fabric was interwoven with red and gold thread.
thread.zh: 蓝布中交织着红色和金色的线。

threat.zh: 这是对世界和平的威胁。

threat.en: I mistook her offer as a threat.
threat.zh: 我把她的好心错看成威胁了。

threaten.en: We are reproducing ourselves at such a rate that our numbers threaten the ecology of the planet.
threaten.zh: 我们繁衍得如此之快，以至于人口数量威胁到地球的生态系统。

threaten.zh: 人类还以其他方式对食肉植物产生威胁。

threaten.en: You could threaten to replace all their tunes with white noise.
threaten.zh: 你可以威胁用白噪音代替他们所有的曲调。

three.zh: 他们有三个年幼的孩子。
三名运动员飞跑了过去。

threshold.en: She felt as though she was on the threshold of a new life.
threshold.zh: 她觉得好像就要开始新生活了。

thrill.en: She gets an obvious thrill out of performing.
thrill.zh: 她显然从表演中得到一种兴奋感。

thrill.en: I can remember the thrill of not knowing what I would get on Christmas morning.
thrill.zh: 我记得，在不知道圣诞节早上会收到何种礼物时自己的激动心情。

thrill.zh: 温迪的心突然激动得一阵颤动。

thrive.zh: 然而，有些鸟会在嘈杂的环境中茁壮成长。

throne.zh: 她的任务就是生育王位继承人。

throne.zh: 她被迫让出西班牙的王位。

throne.zh: 这个国家承认了他继承王位的权利。

throughout.zh: 比赛自始至终不分上下。

throughout.zh: 他在整个生病期间表现出非凡的忍耐力。

thrust.zh: 它提供了使飞机前进的推力。

thumb.zh: 手套的拇指上有个窟窿。

timid.zh: 它们通常很胆小，极少远离自己的洞穴。

timid.zh: 伊莎贝拉是一个羞怯的孩子，很小的时候就已经学会了顺从。

timely.zh: 警察的及时到来阻止了一次严重事故。

timely.zh: 这次事故及时地提醒了人们登山运动有时会多么危险。

timely.zh: 最近几次爆发的霍乱是一个适时的提醒，该疾病依然是个严重的健康危害。

timetable.zh: 时间安排上出了点小问题。

timetable.zh: 我不可能事事都按着你的时刻表安排！

tissue.zh: 鼻部的组织和软骨结构太软，无法形成化石。

tissue.zh: 手术过程中切除的组织用于诊断疾病是否为恶性。

to.zh: 我当时正努力攒钱去上大学。

to.zh: 她想和人们一对一地谈话。

toast.zh: 他被一块烤面包噎得透不过气来。

toast.zh: 你在这里会感到暖烘烘的。

tobacco.zh: 约翰逊仍然对烟草几乎一无所知。

tobacco.zh: 我们需要对烟草广告采取强硬的态度。

toe.zh: 我的右脚趾撞到一块水面下的石头。

troublesome.en: Tom's whole class were of a pattern--restless, noisy, and troublesome.
troublesome.zh: 汤姆的整个班级都是一个模式——躁动不安、吵吵闹闹、麻烦不断。

troublesome.en: When it does rain, it tends to be a very light rain that isn't troublesome.
troublesome.zh: 下雨了一般也是小雨，不会造成太大的麻烦。

troublesome.en: It was a tedious and troublesome piece of work, but he finished it at last.
troublesome.zh: 这是一件乏味而麻烦的工作，但他终于完成了。

trousers.zh: 他穿着一条卡其色的裤子。

truck.en: They hitched a ride in a truck.
truck.zh: 他们搭乘了一辆路过的货车。

truly.zh: 她是一位真正非同凡响的女人。

truly.en: I really and truly am in love this time.
truly.zh: 我这一次确确实实是恋爱了。

truly.en: He makes King Lear a truly tragic figure.
truly.zh: 他把李尔王刻画成一位真正的悲剧人物。

trumpet.en: I played the trumpet in the school orchestra.
trumpet.zh: 我在学校管弦乐队吹小号。

trumpet.en: It fell and hit right on his trumpet.
trumpet.zh: 它掉了下来，正好砸在他的小号上。

trunk.zh: 要伸展的那条腿应该放在躯干的后面并弯曲膝盖。

tub.en: They found her lying in the tub.
tub.zh: 他们发现她躺在浴缸里。

tub.en: She poured all of the bath salts into the swirling water of the tub.
tub.zh: 她把所有的浴盐都倒进浴缸里旋动的水中。

truth.zh: 可怕的事实慢慢地清晰起来。

trust.zh: 她对他的信任毫无道理。

try.zh: 咱们尽量计划得更长远些。
只要有可能我们都尽量帮忙。
尽量不再想发生过的事情。

tube.en: I work in the extruded tube business.
Stop up the other end of the tube, will you?
tube.zh: 你把管子的另一头堵上好不好？

tube.en: I went out today and bought a tube of toothpaste.
tube.zh: 我今天出去买了一管牙膏。

Tuesday.zh: 星期二以来她一直没上班。

Tuesday.zh: 一周后的星期二是我的生日。

tuck.en: The presidential contest is nip and tuck.

tuck.zh: 她做过13次手术，包括1次腹部减脂。

tuck.en: He tried to tuck his flapping shirt inside his trousers.
tuck.zh: 他试图把飘动的衬衫塞进他的裤子里。

tug.en: The tug crossed our stern not fifty yards away.
tug.zh: 那艘拖船在不到50码的地方与我们的船尾错过。

tug.en: Waiting for the Star Ferry, I see the winking lights of tug boats as they fuss around a cruise ship.
tug.zh: 在等天星轮的时候，我看到拖船的灯光闪烁着，它们在一艘游轮的周围忙乱着。

tug.en: Finally, scientists measure the star's wobble due to the planet's gravitational tug, known as the radial velocity.
tug.zh: 最后，科学家测量了由于行星的引力拖拉而产生的恒星摆动，这就是径向速度。

tuition.en: Your parents will have to cover your tuition fees.
tuition.zh: 你的父母得支付你的学费。

tuition.en: Do parents have to bear the whole cost of tuition fees?
tuition.zh: 父母是否应当负担全部学费？

tuition.en: His parents were beginning to groan about the price of college tuition.
tuition.zh: 他的父母开始抱怨大学的学费。

tumble.en: Babies tumble when they are learning to walk.
tumble.zh: 幼儿在学走路时常常跌倒。
石油价格昨天一阵暴跌。

tunnel.en: The tunnel was blasted out of solid rock.
tunnel.zh: 这条隧道是在坚固的岩石中炸出来的。

tune.zh: 你能听出这是哪支曲子吗？

turbine.en: If we can make a turbine, it's sold.
turbine.zh: 如果我们能制造涡轮机，它就卖出去了。

turbine.en: His name was Nenoit Fourneyron, and his device was the first successful water turbine.
turbine.zh: 他叫奈诺伊特·福内隆，他成功发明了第一个水轮机。

turbine.en: You don't have to erect a wind turbine in your backyard to make an impact on climate change.
turbine.zh: 你不需要在你的后院建造一个风力涡轮机来应对气候变化的冲击。

turbulent.en: I had to have a boat that could handle turbulent seas.
turbulent.zh: 我必须有一条能应付汹涌海浪的船。

turbulent.en: Wars and conflicts have subjected people living in this area to turbulent life.
turbulent.zh: 战争与冲突使该地区的人民过着动荡不安的生活。

turbulent.en: A turbulent business environment also has senior managers cautious of letting vague pronouncements cloud their reputations.
turbulent.zh: 动荡的商业环境也让高级管理人员变得小心翼翼，以免含糊的声明玷污了他们的声誉。

turkey.zh: 他们同土耳其缔结了一项条约。
我们过感恩节时总是吃火鸡。

turning.en: He sighed, turning away and surveying the sea.
turning.zh: 他叹了口气，转过身去，眺望着大海。
他坐在那里无所事事地翻着书。

turning.en: Not turning up was just a cop-out.
turning.zh: 不露面只不过是在逃避而已。

turnip.zh: 萝卜是另一种根茎类蔬菜。

turnip.en: The iron horse conducted the wood pig and turnip rabbit to play programs.
turnip.zh: 铁皮马指挥木头猪和萝卜兔演节目。

turnip.en: He yoked his oxen, and drew the turnip to the court, and gave it to the king.
turnip.zh: 他给他的牛套上牛轭，把萝卜牵到院子里，献给国王。

turnover.en: We have a fast turnover of stock.

turnover.zh: 去年我们的营业额竟然增加了。

twelfth.zh: 我的生日是在三月十二日。
你是第十二个到达的人。
现在，让我们学习第十二课吧！

tutor.en: He was my personal tutor at university.
tutor.zh: 他是我大学时的个人指导教师。

tutor.en: You seem to be on very familiar terms with your tutor.
tutor.zh: 你似乎和你的导师之间很随便。

tutor.en: Activities all take place under the guidance of an experienced tutor.
tutor.zh: 所有活动都在经验丰富的导师指导下进行。

twelve.en: He retired twelve batters in a row.
twelve.zh: 他一连使十二个击球手出局。

twelve.en: Twelve enemy fighters had been brought down.
twelve.zh: 有十二架敌方的战斗机被击落。

twentieth.zh: “已经尝试了二十次。”温迪提醒他。

twentieth.en: World War I left an indelible imprint on the twentieth-century world.
twentieth.zh: 第一次世界大战给20世纪的世界留下了深远的影响。

twentieth.en: Some have called him the greatest entertainer of the twentieth century.
twentieth.zh: 有人称他为20世纪最伟大的表演艺术家。

twenty.en: It's twenty years since I've seen her.
twenty.zh: 我已经二十年没见她了。

twice.zh: 她已经两次改变主意了。

twice.en: The villa is cleaned twice a week.
twice.zh: 这栋别墅一周打扫两次。

twin.zh: 我们就是排名第1346的绝命双子星。

twin.en: I can't tell one twin from the other.
twin.zh: 我分不出双胞胎中谁是谁。

twin.en: Can you tell Tom from his twin brother?
twin.zh: 你能分得出汤姆和他的孪生弟弟吗？

twinkle.en: At night, lights twinkle in distant cabins across the valleys.
twinkle.zh: 晚上，灯光在山谷对面远处的小木屋里闪烁。

twinkle.en: Do you know why the stars twinkle so merrily?
twinkle.zh: 你知道为什么星星闪烁得那么快乐吗？

twinkle.en: "Yes, there is!" I say with a magical twinkle.
twinkle.zh: “是的，确实有！”我闪烁着神秘的眼神说道。

two.en: Two of the men were leftists and two were centrists.
two.zh: 这些人其中两人是左派分子，两人是中间派。

twist.zh: 你总是歪曲我说的每一句话。

twist.en: She gave the lid another twist and it came off.
twist.zh: 她又拧了一下，盖儿开了。

type.zh: 她是威严的、有条理的那一类。

typewriter.en: She took up a sheet and ratcheted it into the typewriter.
typewriter.zh: 她拿起一张纸，把它塞入打字机，发出一阵“嗒嗒”的声音。

typewriter.en: She handed over a form, then bobbed down again behind a typewriter.
typewriter.zh: 她递过来一张表格，又快速坐回到打字机后面。

typewriter.en: He was in his office, battering the keyboard of his computer as if it were an old manual typewriter.
typewriter.zh: 他在办公室重重地敲打着他的计算机键盘，好像在用一部老式的手动打字机。

typhoon.en: In front of the two trees which have been destroyed in the typhoon sit a group of young kids.
typhoon.zh: 被台风摧毁的两棵树前面，坐着一群小孩。

typhoon.en: Death toll from Typhoon Haiyan in the Philippines rose to 3,637, after the strongest storm this year destroyed the central part of the country on Nov. 8, 2013.
typhoon.zh: 2013年11月8日，今年最强的台风“海燕”袭击了菲律宾中部地区，造成3637人死亡。

typhoon.en: Is the answer that, like a tall pine tree, the Japanese pagoda—with its massive trunk-like central pillar known as shinbashira—simply flexes and sways during a typhoon or earthquake?
typhoon.zh: 答案会不会是这样：日本宝塔——由于有着一根叫做“塔心柱”的巨大树干状中心柱子——就像一棵高大的松树般，在一场台风或地震中仅仅只会来回摇摆和弯曲呢？

typist.en: I've got a job as a shorthand typist.
typist.zh: 我找到了一份速记打字员的工作。

typist.en: I can just imagine a scene with a typist sitting on an old-fashioned typing chair, her back aching, exhausted.
typist.zh: 我可以想象这样一个场景：一个打字员坐在一把老式的打字椅上，她的背很疼，很累。

typist.en: She dictated a letter to a typist.

tyre.zh: 他的自行车的后胎被扎破了。

tyre.en: She taught me how to change a tyre.

ugly.zh: 出现了一些丑恶的场面。

ugly.en: An ugly new building blocked the view from the window.
ugly.zh: 一座难看的大楼把窗外的景物遮住了。

ugly.en: The river that runs through Middlesbrough became ugly on the eye and hard on the nose.
ugly.zh: 那条流经米德尔斯伯勒的河变得丑不忍睹，臭不可闻。

ultimately.en: The divorce ultimately led to his ruin.
ultimately.zh: 离婚最终使得他一贫如洗。
不诚实最终将会自食其果。

ultimately.en: Politicians are ultimately accountable to the voters.
ultimately.zh: 从政者最终是向选民负责。

ultimate.en: Plants are the ultimate source of all foodstuffs.
ultimate.zh: 植物是所有食物的最终来源。

ultimate.en: Their ultimate aim was a market economy for Hungary.
ultimate.zh: 他们的最终目标是为匈牙利建立市场经济。

ultraviolet.en: Exposure to ultraviolet light is closely linked to skin cancer.
ultraviolet.zh: 受紫外线照射与皮肤癌紧密相关。

ultraviolet.en: The ozone layer shields the earth from the sun's ultraviolet rays.
ultraviolet.zh: 臭氧层保护地球不受太阳紫外线的辐射。

ultraviolet.en: Ozone is produced by the reaction between oxygen and ultraviolet light.
ultraviolet.zh: 臭氧是氧气与紫外线发生化学反应而产生的。

umbrella.zh: 她的伞被吹得往外翻了。

umbrella.en: They held a large umbrella over her.
umbrella.zh: 他们给她撑起一把大伞。

unable.en: She was unable to contain her excitement.
unable.zh: 她无法抑制内心的激动。

unable.en: He was unable to control his sensibility.
unable.zh: 他无法控制自己敏锐的情感。

unbearable.zh: 炎热开始变得难以忍受。
等待变得几乎令人难以忍受了。

unbearable.en: The film contains moments of almost unbearable poignancy.
unbearable.zh: 电影中有几段令人无法承受的辛酸情节。

unanimous.zh: 这项决定没有得到一致通过。

unanimous.en: The jury returned a unanimous guilty verdict.
unanimous.zh: 该陪审团作出了一份一致通过的有罪裁决。

uncertain.zh: 经济气候依然是不确定。

uncertain.en: The baby took its first uncertain steps.
uncertain.zh: 宝宝迈出了最初的蹒跚的脚步。

uncle.en: My Uncle Jim had a high fever.
uncle.zh: 我的叔叔吉姆发高烧了。

unconscious.zh: 那年轻人仰面倒下，不省人事。

unconscious.en: He had drunk himself unconscious on vodka.
unconscious.zh: 他喝伏特加酒喝得不省人事。

uncomfortable.zh: 我坐着的姿势难受极了。

uncover.en: When the seedlings sprout, uncover the tray.
uncover.zh: 幼苗发芽后，揭开盘上的遮盖物。

uncover.en: The reason he had to uncover it was that beehive tombs, like everything else, were buried.
uncover.zh: 他必须揭开它的原因是这些蜂窝墓，像其他东西一样，被埋在地下。

uncover.zh: 这位科学家正在进行认真的研究，以揭示物理世界的本质。

underestimate.zh: 我们常常低估自己的潜力。

underestimate.zh: 我认为许多人仍然低估了他。

underestimate.zh: 他是个精明圆滑的人，别低估他。

undergo.en: These act like batteries when they undergo a temperature change: attach electrodes to them and they generate a current.
undergo.zh: 它们经历温度变化时会像电池一样工作：给它们接上电极，它们就会产生电流。

undergo.zh: 仰慕者们可能要接受保安人员的搜身。

undergo.zh: 他去了医院接受对他的腹部疼痛进行的各项检查。

undergraduate.en: Every day, there's going to be a TA in the undergraduate lounge.
undergraduate.zh: 每天都会有一名助教在本科休息室里。

undergraduate.en: One idea is to allow people to study law as an undergraduate degree.
undergraduate.zh: 一个想法是允许人们在本科阶段学习法律。

undergraduate.en: This leaves today's average law-school graduate with $100000 of debt on top of undergraduate debts.
undergraduate.zh: 这让如今的法学院毕业生平均承担10万美元的债务，居本科生债务之首。

underlying.en: The underlying trend of inflation is still upwards.
underlying.zh: 通货膨胀的潜在趋势仍然是上升的。

underlying.zh: 要解决问题，你得了解其潜在原因。

underlying.zh: 失业可能是犯罪率攀升的潜在原因。

underline.zh: 有些读者在阅读时会在页面下划线。
