underline.zh: 其次，我们需要强调政府在这些问题上发挥领导作用的必要性。

underline.en: They underline the fact that every subject has its own importance and pupils will absorb knowledge useful for their future.
underline.zh: 他们强调每个学科都有其重要性，而学生会吸收对自己未来有用的知识。

undermine.en: He accused me of slandering him and trying to undermine his position.
undermine.zh: 他指控我诽谤他并想削弱他的地位。

undermine.en: The continued fighting threatens to undermine efforts to negotiate an agreement.
undermine.zh: 持续的战斗有可能破坏通过谈判达成协议的努力。

undermine.zh: 每个问题都为她提出忠告会逐渐削弱她的成年意识。

underground.en: The train was trapped underground by a fire.
underground.zh: 列车被一场大火困在了地下。

understanding.en: She shows a lamentable lack of understanding.
understanding.zh: 她显得缺乏理解能力，实在令人遗憾。

understanding.zh: 据我了解，会议是在星期四。

understand.zh: 你懂得这些指令的意思吗？

undertake.zh: 大学教授既要教学又要从事研究工作。

undertake.en: Their brief is to undertake outreach work aimed at young African Americans.
undertake.zh: 他们的任务是承担主动帮助年轻美国黑人的工作。

undertake.zh: 我们希望我们所有的成员都明白其中的困难、负责任地进行这次旅行。

underneath.zh: 那个装置在一辆面包车底下爆炸了。

underneath.en: The space underneath could be used as a storage area.
underneath.zh: 下面的空间可被用作一个储藏区。

undoubtedly.en: Mozart's compositions are undoubtedly among the world's greatest.
undoubtedly.zh: 莫扎特的作品无疑位列于世界上最伟大的作品之中。

undoubtedly.en: Undoubtedly, political and economic factors have played their part.
undoubtedly.zh: 毫无疑问，政治和经济因素起了作用。

undoubtedly.en: Country music was undoubtedly one of the forerunners of rock and roll.
undoubtedly.zh: 乡村音乐无疑是摇滚乐的先导之一。

undertaking.en: The landlord gave a written undertaking that the repairs would be carried out.
undertaking.zh: 房东书面保证将进行维修。

undertaking.en: Organizing the show has been a massive undertaking.
undertaking.zh: 组织这场演出是一项巨大的任务。

undertaking.en: Making the house habitable was a major undertaking.
undertaking.zh: 把这房子收拾得可以住人是个大工程。

undo.en: He tried to undo the knot by picking at it with his fingers.
undo.zh: 他用手指不停地扯，想把绳结解开。

undo.en: Oh, do let me help to undo it!

undo.zh: 我设法偷偷地打开包裹的一角。

uneasy.zh: 莫莉不自在地微微窃笑了一下。

uneasy.en: She felt uneasy in the unfamiliar surroundings.
uneasy.zh: 她在陌生的环境中感到局促不安。

uneasy.en: He looked uneasy and refused to answer questions.
uneasy.zh: 他看起来心神不安，并且拒绝回答问题。

unfair.zh: 人生有时似乎非常不公平。

unexpected.zh: 发生了一件出乎意料的事。
一个出人意料的来源提供了帮助。
这个通告并非完全出乎意料。

unfold.en: Araby is easier because it's linear, the story unfold chronologically.
unfold.zh: 《阿拉比》比较简单，因为它是线性的，故事按时间顺序展开。

unfold.en: Unfold the flag first, and then hoist it quickly to the top of the flagpole.
unfold.zh: 先把旗子展开，然后迅速地把它升到旗杆的顶端。

unfortunate.zh: 她把这项决定说成是“令人遗憾”。

unfortunate.en: He was unfortunate to lose in the final round.
unfortunate.zh: 他不幸在最后一轮输了。

unfortunately.zh: 不幸的是，计划产生了适得其反的结果。
遗憾的是，我的时间有限。

unhappy.zh: 弗格森不高兴，而且表现了出来。

unhappy.en: He was a shy, sometimes unhappy man.
unhappy.zh: 他是一个害羞、有时不快乐的人。

unify.zh: 然而，任何试图将小说的所有不同元素统一起来的解读，都必然有些难以令人信服。

unify.en: Stirrups unify lance, rkier, and horse into a force capable of unprecedented violence.
unify.zh: 马镫将骑枪、长矛和马团结在一起，形成一股具有空前暴力能力的力量。

unify.en: By consolidating the hawks, the new alignment may also unify and perk up the doves in Israel's aviary.
unify.zh: 通过巩固鹰派，新的结盟也可能团结和振奋以色列的鸽派。

unique.zh: 每个人的签名是独一无二的。
每个人的指纹都是独一无二的。
它们是无价的、独一无二的，不可替代的。

union.en: Do all teachers have a right to join a union?
union.zh: 所有的教师都有权利加入工会吗？

union.en: I've got a feeling that the trade union representative is behind this.
union.zh: 我有一种感觉，职工会代表是幕后黑手。

union.en: Mayor Rahm Emanuel is trying some of them—yet the union is resisting.
union.zh: 市长拉姆·伊曼纽尔正在尝试其中的一些措施，但工会仍在抵制。

unite.zh: 他的目标是统一意大利。
我们需要团结起来反对恐怖主义。

unite.en: Will they unite behind the new leader?
unite.zh: 他们会团结支持新领导人吗？

unit.en: The unit plugs into any TV set.
unit.zh: 该部件可接入任何电视机。

unit.en: A Serb army unit took the town.
unit.zh: 一支塞尔维亚部队夺取了这个镇。
T恤衫的单位销售增加了6%。

unity.en: Religious unity remained as much a chimera as ever.
unity.zh: 宗教统一仍旧是一通幻想。

unity.en: Speakers at the rally expressed sentiments of unity.
unity.zh: 集会上的发言者们表达了团结的观点。

unity.en: We have to act to preserve the unity of this nation.
unity.zh: 我们必须行动起来以维护这个国家的统一。

universal.en: Agreement on this issue is almost universal.
universal.zh: 这个问题几乎取得全体一致的意见。

universal.en: Several writers have posited the idea of a universal consciousness.
universal.zh: 几个作者都假设一种普遍意识的思想。

universal.en: The dove is a universal symbol of peace.
universal.zh: 鸽子是和平的共同象征。

universe.en: The universe is slowly yielding up its secrets.
universe.zh: 宇宙慢慢地展现出它的秘密。

universe.en: The idea of a parallel universe is hard to grasp.
universe.zh: 认为另有一个平行宇宙的概念是很难理解的。

universe.en: The clear inference is that the universe is expanding.
universe.zh: 显然结论是宇宙在扩大。

unjust.zh: 对查尔斯的攻击是不公正的。

unjust.en: The unjust Stamp Act must be annulled.
unjust.zh: 必须废止这个不公正的印花税案。

unjust.en: Those who are unjust in their manner of doing things lose the support of the people.
unjust.zh: 办事不公的人不得人心。

unkind.en: It's not in his nature to be unkind.
He was never actually unkind to them.
unkind.zh: 其实他从没有对他们不好。

unkind.en: It would be unkind to go without him.
unkind.zh: 甩掉他那就太不够朋友了。

unknown.en: The motive for the killing is unknown.
The immediate cause of death is unknown.
unknown.zh: 造成死亡的直接原因不明。

unknown.en: Unknown attackers riddled two homes with gunfire.
unknown.zh: 不明来路的袭击者用枪把两座房屋打得千疮百孔。

unlike.en: It's very unlike him to be so late.
unlike.zh: 迟到这么久可实在不像他平时的作风。

unlike.en: This was a foreign country, so unlike San Jose.
unlike.zh: 这是异国，因而不像圣何塞。

unlike.en: The sound was not unlike that of birds singing.

unlikely.zh: 一场兵变似乎不太可能。

unlikely.en: The two actors are an unlikely pairing.
unlikely.zh: 这二位演员不大可能是搭档。

unlikely.en: He is unlikely to alter his game plan.
unlikely.zh: 他不太可能改变他的策略。

unless.en: That's the plan—unless anything untoward happens.
unless.zh: 计划就这么定了—除非出现异常情况。

unless.en: Unless I'm mistaken, she was back at work yesterday.
unless.zh: 除非是我记错了，她是昨天回来上班的。

unless.en: Recovery can't be sustained unless more jobs are created.
unless.zh: 除非有更多的工作机会被创造出来，否则复苏无法保持下去。

unlucky.en: He was very unlucky not to win.
We all felt (that) we were unlucky to lose.
unlucky.zh: 我们都认为我们输了是运气不好。

unlucky.en: Thirteen is often considered an unlucky number.
unlucky.zh: 十三常被认为是不吉利的数字。

unnecessary.en: The slaughter of whales is unnecessary and inhuman.
unnecessary.zh: 对鲸的屠宰是不必要且不人道的。

unnecessary.en: That last comment was a little unnecessary, wasn't it?
unnecessary.zh: 那最后一点评论有点多余，不是吗？

unload.en: The truck driver was waiting to unload.
This isn't a suitable place to unload the van.
Everyone helped to unload the luggage from the car.
unload.zh: 大家都帮着从汽车上卸行李。

unpleasant.en: She thought he was an unpleasant man.
unpleasant.zh: 她曾认为他是个令人不愉快的人。

unpleasant.en: We hope to prevent anything unpleasant from happening.
unpleasant.zh: 我们希望防止任何不愉快的事发生。

unpleasant.en: The symptoms can be uncomfortable, unpleasant and serious.
unpleasant.zh: 其症状会是令人不舒服、不愉快且严重的。

unsatisfactory.en: The film's ending is an unsatisfactory cop-out.
unsatisfactory.zh: 那部电影的结尾是个不令人满意的回避。

unsatisfactory.en: There are also, of course, people who interview extremely well, but are later found to be very unsatisfactory employees.
unsatisfactory.zh: 当然，也有面试表现非常好的人，但后来发现是非常不令人满意的员工。

unsatisfactory.en: The present system of funding for higher education is unsatisfactory.
unsatisfactory.zh: 目前高等教育的经费体制并不令人满意。

unstable.en: The situation is unstable and potentially dangerous.
unstable.zh: 情况不稳定，可能有危险。
氮是一种不稳定的元素。

unstable.en: So evanescent and unstable are men's works in this world!
unstable.zh: 在这个世界上，人的工作是这样的短暂和不稳定！

unsuitable.en: The rides are unsuitable for people of a nervous disposition.
unsuitable.zh: 这种骑乘不适合紧张型性格的人。

unsuitable.en: Amy's shoes were unsuitable for walking any distance.
unsuitable.zh: 埃米的鞋根本不适合走路。

unsuitable.en: He was wearing shoes that were totally unsuitable for climbing.
unsuitable.zh: 他穿了一双完全不适合登山的鞋子。

until.zh: 她躺在那儿，直到天亮才睡着。
这辆汽车的牌照税缴纳到了七月。

unusual.en: He has an unusual cast of mind.
I grew up in rather unusual circumstances.
unusual.zh: 我在相当不寻常的环境中长大。

unusual.en: Jim was described by his colleagues as 'unusual'.
unusual.zh: 吉姆被同事们称为“不寻常”的人。

unusually.en: Anxiously, she examined his unusually grave face.
unusually.zh: 她不安地审视着他那张异常严肃的脸。

unusually.en: He had been feeling drowsy, the effect of an unusually heavy meal.
unusually.zh: 他一直感到昏昏欲睡，因为吃了一顿异常量大而难以消化的饭、菜。

unwilling.en: She is tough, unwilling to take no for an answer.
unwilling.zh: 她很难对付，不答应不肯罢休。

unwilling.en: The directors were unwilling to respond to questions.
unwilling.zh: 董事们不愿意回答问题。

unwilling.en: Judges were unwilling to nullify government decisions.
unwilling.zh: 法官们不愿废止政府决定。

update.en: The one thing that she accomplished was raising money to update our facilities.
update.zh: 她完成的这项工作就是募集资金来更新我们的设备。

update.en: You'll need to update your card details directly on our website.
update.zh: 您需要直接在我们的网站上更新您的银行卡信息。

update.en: Type up to 1500 characters to append to your forum posts and click Update.
update.zh: 最多可以输入1500个字符来附加到你的论坛帖子中，然后单击更新。

uphold.en: We have a duty to uphold the law.
uphold.zh: 维护法律是我们的责任。

uphold.en: Our policy has been to uphold the law.
uphold.zh: 我们的政策一直是维护法律。

uphold.en: It is the responsibility of every government to uphold certain basic principles.
uphold.zh: 每个政府都有责任维护某些基本原则。

up.en: In 'She tore up the letter', the word 'up' is a particle.
up.zh: 在She tore up the letter句中，up是小品词。

up.en: The offer seems to be on the up and up.

upgrade.en: How do we know when to invest in an upgrade?
upgrade.zh: 我们如何知道何时投资升级？
人们应该定期升级他们的设备。

upgrade.en: Maybe there's no need for an upgrade and that's OK.
upgrade.zh: 也许不需要提升也没关系。

upon.en: He set the tray upon the table.
How might the plans be improved upon?
upon.zh: 这些计划还能怎么改进呢？

upper.en: Her novels poke fun at the upper class.
upper.zh: 她的小说嘲弄上流社会。

upper.en: They were on the upper floor of the building.
upper.zh: 他们在该建筑物的上层。

upper.en: There is a good restaurant on the upper floor.
upper.zh: 楼上有一家很好的餐馆。

upright.zh: 他英俊、正直、对女士彬彬有礼。
海伦笔直地坐在椅子上。
他换成了一个挺直的姿势。

upward.en: She started once again on the steep upward climb.
upward.zh: 她再次沿着峭壁开始向上攀爬。

upward.en: Unemployment will continue upward for much of this year.
upward.zh: 失业率今年大部分时间将继续上升。

upward.en: The chopper shot upward in a manoeuvre matched by the other pilot.
upward.zh: 这架直升飞机向上冲去，另一架飞机也以相同的移动方向冲了上去。

upstairs.zh: 他在楼上打开他的旅行袋取出东西。

upwards.en: We may have to revise this figure upwards.
upwards.zh: 我们也许要将这个数字往上调一调。

urge.en: He denounces people who urge him to alter his ways.
urge.zh: 他指责那些敦促他改变习惯的人们。

urge.en: He continued to urge the Republican Party to tilt rightward.
urge.zh: 他继续力劝共和党右倾。

urge.en: The urge to survive drove them on.
urge.zh: 求生的欲望驱使他们继续下去。

us.zh: 他以怀疑的眼光看着我们。
他的沉默令我们心里发慌。
车辆从我们身边疾驰而过。

urgent.en: I have some urgent business to attend to.

usage.zh: 汽车的使用率预计会增长。

usage.en: He was a stickler for the correct usage of English.
usage.zh: 他是一个坚持英语的正确使用的人。

usage.en: Parts of the motor wore out because of constant usage.
usage.zh: 发动机的一些部件由于不断使用而磨损了。

useless.en: She knew it was useless to protest.

use.zh: 请让我用一下你的电话可以吗？
我们将使用混凝土铺地面。
他们应该使用大写字母。

useful.zh: 他提出了一些有益的建议。
照片可以成为有用的教具。

user.en: If a computer user fails to log off, the system is accessible to all.
user.zh: 如果一位电脑用户没有登出，所有人都可以进入该系统。

user.en: The goal of a GUI is to present the user with as few decision points as possible.
user.zh: 图形用户界面的目标是呈现给用户尽可能少的决定点。

user.en: You have to be able to describe things in a form that the end user can understand.
user.zh: 你必须能以最终用户能够理解的方式描述产品。

usual.zh: 你像往常一样，非常准时。
这次葡萄的收获季节比往常晚。

utility.en: We can greatly enhance the utility of green space through designs that provide a range of different uses in a confined space.
utility.zh: 我们可以通过在有限的空间中提供多种不同用途的设计，大大提高绿色空间的实用性。

utility.en: The Conservatives plan to adopt this strategy by making utility companies print the average local electricity and gas usage on people's bills.
utility.zh: 保守党计划采用这一策略，让公用事业公司将当地的平均用电量和用气量印在人们的账单上。

utility.en: He used to own Toyota's Hilux Surf, a sport utility vehicle.
utility.zh: 他曾经拥有丰田的 Hilux Surf——一款运动型多用途车。

utilize.en: Sound engineers utilize a range of techniques to enhance the quality of the recordings.
utilize.zh: 音响工程师利用一系列的技术来提高录音质量。

utilize.en: The agents were able to utilize their full potential and experiences to build up the company.
utilize.zh: 这些代理人能够充分利用他们的潜力和经验来促进公司发展。

utilize.en: Even the government of Iran has been forced to utilize the very tool they attempted to squelch to try to hold on to power.
utilize.zh: 即使伊朗政府也被迫利用这个他们原本试图粉碎的工具来维持自己的权力。

utmost.en: Our resources are strained to the utmost.
This is a matter of the utmost importance.
utmost.zh: 这是个极其重要的问题。

utmost.en: He would have done his utmost to help her.
utmost.zh: 他本来会尽最大努力帮助她。

utter.zh: 令我大感意外的是，她同意了。

vacant.en: The seat next to him was vacant.
She had a kind of vacant look on her face.
vacant.zh: 在她脸上有一种茫然的表情。

vacant.en: The position of chairman has been vacant for some time.
vacant.zh: 主席的职位已经空缺一段时间了。

vacuum.zh: 真空吸尘器靠抽吸除尘。
这个真空吸尘器有股难闻的气味。

vacuum.en: Exclusion of air creates a vacuum in the bottle.
vacuum.zh: 瓶子里的空气排除后就产生真空。

vacation.en: We're going to the beach for vacation.
They're on vacation in Hawaii right now.
vacation.zh: 他们此时正在夏威夷度假。

vacation.en: The job includes two weeks' paid vacation.
vacation.zh: 这份工作包括两周的带薪假期。

vain.en: I think he is shallow, vain and untrustworthy.
vain.zh: 我认为他浅薄、虚荣、不可信。

vague.zh: 这项描述是相当含糊的。
这些指控的内容模糊不清。

vague.en: The phrasing of the question was vague.
vague.zh: 在这个问题上措词模糊。

valid.en: All tickets are valid for two months.
valid.zh: 所有的票在两个月内有效。

valid.en: Our realty agent says the sales contract is valid.
valid.zh: 我们的房地产代理人称该销售合同是有效的。

valid.en: This special offer is valid until the end of the month.
valid.zh: 这个特价优惠月底前有效。

valley.zh: 乳白色的薄雾弥漫了山谷。
我们把车开上了陡峭的峡谷。

validity.en: We had doubts about the validity of their argument.
validity.zh: 我们对他们的论点的正确性有过怀疑。

validity.en: The period of validity of the agreement has expired.
It was for the police to assess the validity or otherwise of the evidence.
validity.zh: 应由警方来评价证据的有效与否。

valuable.zh: 幸运的是，没有贵重物品失窃。
入室窃贼偷走了贵重的东西没有？

valuable.en: We're wasting valuable time, time we can ill afford.
valuable.zh: 我们是在浪费宝贵的时间，我们浪费不起的时间。

valve.en: This valve regulates the flow of water.
The pump sucks air out through the valve.
valve.zh: 气泵通过阀门把空气抽出去。

value.en: I don't own anything of any value.
value.zh: 我没有任何值钱的东西。
这场演出有很大的娱乐价值。

van.en: The driver got out of his van.

van.zh: 我开着他的货车横穿了全国。
他驾着厢式货车缓缓前行。

vanish.en: Ann saw the cheer vanish from her children face.
vanish.zh: 安看到孩子们脸上的笑容消失了。

vanish.en: The track seemed to vanish a hundred yards from where I stood.
vanish.zh: 离我站的地方一百码远，小路似乎消失了。

vanish.en: Some people believe that schools and libraries will vanish in the wake of the Internet.
vanish.zh: 一些人相信，在互联网到来之后，学校和图书馆会消失。

vanity.en: Men who use steroids are motivated by sheer vanity.
vanity.zh: 服用类固醇的男人们纯粹是受了虚荣心的驱使。
她挖苦的语言刺伤了他的虚荣心。
这样的支出不仅仅是虚荣心。

vapour.en: One of the most powerful of all weather systems, hurricanes are powered by the heat energy released by the condensation of water vapour.
vapour.zh: 作为所有天气系统中最强大的系统之一，飓风是由水蒸气凝结释放的热能所驱动的。

vapour.en: Some warming is certain, but the degree will be determined by cycles involving melting ice, the oceans, water vapour, clouds and changes to vegetation and plants.
vapour.zh: 一定程度的气候变暖是确定无疑的，但其程度将由冰的融化、海洋、水蒸气、云和植物的变化等循环过程所决定。

variation.en: This delicious variation on an omelette is quick and easy to prepare.
variation.zh: 这种略有变化的美味煎蛋饼做起来又快又容易。

variation.en: Variation among humans is limited to the possible permutations of our genes.
variation.zh: 人类的变化形式受限于我们基因可能的那些排列。

variation.en: Modern violins had a greater variation, a larger differential.
variation.zh: 现代小提琴有更大的变化，更大的差异。

variable.en: The potassium content of foodstuffs is very variable.
variable.zh: 食品中钾的含量是多变的。

variable.en: The temperature remained constant while pressure was a variable in the experiment.
variable.zh: 做这实验时温度保持不变，但压力可变。

various.zh: 他导演过各种电视节目。
方法很多而且各不相同。
警方扣留了各种图书和磁带。

vase.en: What am I bid for this vase?
vase.zh: 诸位愿给这个花瓶出多少钱？

vase.en: You can use that glass as a vase.
vase.zh: 你可以把那个玻璃杯当作花瓶用。
希拉里拿起一个花瓶向他打去。

variety.en: We all need variety in our diet.
variety.zh: 我们都需要饮食多样化。

variety.en: There is little tonal variety in his voice.
variety.zh: 他的嗓音中几乎没有声调的变化。

variety.en: I can't differentiate one variety from another.
variety.zh: 我无法将这几个品种区别开来。

vary.zh: 她的小说篇幅长短不一。
其它服务在质量上差异很大。

vary.en: Prices vary according to the quantity ordered.
vary.zh: 价格根据所订数量而变化。

vast.en: She once ruled over a vast empire.
vast.zh: 她曾统治过一个幅员辽阔的帝国。

vast.en: Development has affected vast swathes of our countryside.
vast.zh: 开发建设影响了乡村广大地区。

vegetable.en: Severe brain damage turned him into a vegetable.
vegetable.zh: 严重的脑损伤使他变成了植物人。

vegetable.en: The vegetable harvest is disastrously behind schedule.
vegetable.zh: 蔬菜收割灾难性地滞后于计划。

vegetable.en: Peas, beans and lentils are a good source of vegetable protein.
vegetable.zh: 豌豆、豆荚和扁豆是植物蛋白质的大好来源。

vegetation.en: We fought our way through the dense vegetation.
vegetation.zh: 我们在茂密的植被中开出一条通路。

vegetation.en: The hills are covered in lush green vegetation.
vegetation.zh: 这片丘岭草木茂盛，郁郁葱葱。

vegetation.en: The inn has a garden of semi-tropical vegetation.
vegetation.zh: 这家小酒店的花园里种着亚热带植物。

vehicle.en: The robbers drove off in a stolen vehicle.
vehicle.zh: 劫匪驾驶着一辆偷来的汽车逃跑了。

vein.en: A tiny wire is threaded through a vein to the heart.
vein.zh: 一根细金属丝从静脉里穿到心脏。

vein.en: He could have died after developing deep vein thrombosis during a flight to Sydney.
vein.zh: 他在飞往悉尼的航班上引发成深部静脉血栓之后，差点送命。

vein.en: Passengers on long-haul flights are being warned about the risks of deep vein thrombosis.
vein.zh: 长途航班上的乘客须注意可能出现深静脉血栓。

veil.en: She put on a velvet veil, then set out.
veil.zh: 她蒙上一块天鹅绒的面纱，然后出发了。

veil.en: The veil she was wearing obscured her features.
veil.zh: 她罩的面纱遮掩了她的面容。

veil.en: A fine drizzle began to veil the hills.
veil.zh: 蒙蒙细雨渐渐笼罩了群山。

velocity.zh: 加速度和速度都是矢量。

velocity.en: Jaguars can move with an astonishing velocity.
velocity.zh: 美洲豹跑起来速度惊人。

velocity.en: I mean, that's the whole point of escape velocity, right?
velocity.zh: 我的意思是，这是逃逸速度的全部意义所在，不是吗？

velvet.zh: 她身着蓝色的天鹅绒服装。

velvet.en: She was arrayed in a black velvet gown.
velvet.zh: 她穿着一件黑色天鹅绒长礼服。

velvet.en: I taped the base of the feather onto the velvet.
velvet.zh: 我用胶带把羽毛的根部粘到天鹅绒上。

vent.en: She gave vent to her anger and jealousy.
vent.zh: 她发泄了自己的怒意和嫉妒。

vent.en: She telephoned her best friend to vent her frustration.
vent.zh: 她打电话给自己最好的朋友来发泄她的沮丧。

vent.en: She gave full vent to her feelings in a violent outburst.
vent.zh: 她大发脾气以宣泄情绪。

ventilate.en: Shake up the quintessential powder in the bag, tear down the smaller paster of the ventilate adhesive plaster, and then attach the bag to the volar.

他听任自己的思绪信马由缰。

wander.en: Try not to let your mind wander.
wander.zh: 尽量别让你的思想开小差。

war.zh: 采取外交手段胜于诉诸战争。
战争期间，鸡蛋限量供应。

ward.en: Mr. Ward wasn't a rogue at all.
ward.zh: 沃德先生根本不是个无赖。

ward.en: He worked as a nurse on the children's ward.

want.zh: 你还想要点别的什么吗？

warehouse.en: We have plenty more of them in the warehouse.
warehouse.zh: 我们仓库里这类东西还多得很。

warehouse.en: The warehouse has been badly damaged by fire.
Matters were made worse by a fire in the warehouse.
warehouse.zh: 仓库失火使得事态更为严重。

warfare.en: These clashes could develop into open warfare.
warfare.zh: 这些冲突可能会发展成公开的战争。

warfare.en: The debate soon degenerated into open warfare.
warfare.zh: 争论很快恶化，演变成了公开的论战。

warfare.en: Much of the violence is related to drugs and gang warfare.
warfare.zh: 很多暴力行为都与毒品和帮派冲突有关。

warmth.zh: 这些香水温暖且令人愉悦。

warmth.en: She felt the warmth of his arms around her.
warmth.zh: 她感到了他双臂搂着她的温暖。

warmth.en: The letter was devoid of warmth and feeling.
warmth.zh: 这封信既无热情又无感情。

warn.zh: 我要跑在前头，警告他们。

warn.en: I tried to warn him, but he wouldn't listen.
warn.zh: 我设法提醒过他，可他就是不听。

warn.en: It seems only right to warn you of the risk.
warn.zh: 似乎应该警告你有风险。

warrant.en: There is no warrant for such criticism.
They issued a warrant for her arrest.
warrant.zh: 当局发出了逮捕她的令状。
总统签署了死刑执行令。

waste.zh: 浪费好好的食物是有罪的！

waste.en: It's a waste of time and energy.
The waste was dumped in the sea.

watch.zh: 他们看电视看得太多了。

water.zh: 水汩汩地从管道中流过。

watertight.en: The rules state that samples must be enclosed in two watertight containers.
watertight.zh: 条例规定样品必须用两个不漏水的容器封装起来。

watertight.en: If she could just establish the time the picture had been taken, Mick would have a watertight alibi.
watertight.zh: 只要她能确定拍这张照片的时间，米克就可以有一个无懈可击的不在现场的证据。

watertight.en: Only teak matches oak's expansion coefficient and stays watertight.
watertight.zh: 只有柚木才能达到橡木的膨胀系数，并保持水密性。

waterfall.en: As you descend, suddenly you see at last the hidden waterfall.
waterfall.zh: 你往下走，最终会突然发现那个隐秘的瀑布。

waterfall.en: The moon was casting a rainbow through the spray from the waterfall.
waterfall.zh: 月亮在瀑布溅起的水雾中映出了一道彩虹。

waterfall.en: The water roiled to his left as he climbed carefully at the edge of the waterfall.
waterfall.zh: 当他在瀑布边缘小心攀爬时，水飞溅到他左边。

waterproof.en: Take waterproof clothing – Oregon weather is unpredictable.
waterproof.zh: 带上防水的衣物吧–俄勒冈州的天气总是难以预测。

waterproof.en: The traditional backpack with a difference—it's waterproof.
waterproof.zh: 这个跟传统背包不同—它防水。

watt.en: Two people who have divergent views on this question are George Watt and Bob Marr.
watt.zh: 在这个问题上意见相左的两个人是乔治·瓦特和鲍勃·马尔。

watt.en: His biographies of James Watt, Richard Arkwright and Josiah Wedgwood were held up as beacons to guide the working man through his difficult life.
watt.zh: 他写的关于詹姆斯·瓦特、理查德·阿克赖特和约西亚·韦奇伍德的传记被奉为是指引工人们度过艰难生活的灯塔。

watt.en: In the late 1700s James Watt designed an efficient and commercially viable steam engine that was soon applied to a variety of industrial uses as it became cheaper to use.
watt.zh: 18世纪晚期，詹姆斯·瓦特设计了一种高效的、商业上可行的蒸汽机，随着它的使用成本越来越低，它很快被应用于各种工业用途。

wavelength.en: If this distance is large in comparison to the wavelength, this dam simply casts a shadow.
wavelength.zh: 如果这个距离比波长大，那么这个水坝就会投下阴影。

wavelength.en: We want to divide all of this by our wavelength, and to keep our units the same we'll do meters.
wavelength.zh: 我们想用波长除以所有这些，而且为了保持单位统一我们采用米为单位。

wavelength.en: The precise thickness at which the fibre traps the light depends on the wavelength of that light.
wavelength.zh: 纤维捕捉光束的确切厚度取决于那条光束的波长。

wax.en: It was recorded on a wax cylinder.

wax.zh: 上光蜡可保护木材和皮革。

wave.en: He dismissed her with an airy wave.
wave.zh: 他随意一挥手就把她打发走了。

wave.en: His boat hit a wave and somersaulted.
wave.zh: 他的船撞上了一个波浪，翻了。

wave.en: A wave of fear swept over him.
wave.zh: 一阵恐惧传遍他的全身。

we.zh: 我们以为已经轻易地把他们对付过去了。
我们输了，但离赢只差了那么一小点儿。
我们如今想穿什么就可以穿什么。

weak.en: She is still weak after her illness.

weaken.en: Nothing could weaken his resolve to continue.
weaken.zh: 什么也不能削弱他继续下去的决心。

weaken.en: He accused them of conniving with foreign companies to weaken employment rights.
weaken.zh: 他指控他们与外国公司共谋来削弱雇用权。

weakness.zh: 他惟一的弱点是他的脾气。

weakness.en: She was plagued by weakness, fatigue, and dizziness.
weakness.zh: 她被虚弱、疲劳和眩晕折磨。

wealth.en: They enjoyed all the trappings of wealth.
wealth.zh: 他们享有所有象征财富的东西。

wealth.en: There was a wealth of supporting evidence.

wealthy.en: They live in a wealthy suburb of Chicago.
wealthy.zh: 他们住在芝加哥郊区的一处富人区。

wealthy.en: It had once been the home of a wealthy nobleman.
wealthy.zh: 这曾是一个有钱贵族的宅邸。

wealthy.en: All of them came from wealthy, upper class families.
wealthy.zh: 他们所有人都来自富裕的上层阶级家庭。

weapon.en: Discipline was the new coach's secret weapon.
weapon.zh: 严格的训练是这位新教练的秘密武器。

weapon.en: Their most potent weapon was the Exocet missile.
weapon.zh: 他们效力最强的武器是飞鱼导弹。

weapon.en: He was charged with carrying an offensive weapon.
weapon.zh: 他被指控携带攻击性武器。

weary.zh: 雷切尔看起来苍白而疲惫。
她突然感到了衰老和疲倦。
她的脸色显得憔悴疲惫。

weave.en: She sat at her loom and continued to weave.
weave.zh: 她坐在织布机前，继续织布。

weave.en: They would spin and weave cloth, cook and attend to the domestic side of life.
weave.zh: 他们纺纱、织布、做饭，还料理家务。

weave.en: The key is to weave relevant personal anecdotes into your writing.
weave.zh: 关键是要编织有关的个人轶事到你的写作中。

wedding.zh: 今天是我们的结婚纪念日。

web.zh: 你需要一个最新的网络浏览器。

web.en: I found the information on the Web.
web.zh: 我在万维网上找到了这条消息。

web.en: The handbook is available on the Web.

Wednesday.zh: 我们把开会时间改到星期三吧。

Wednesday.en: Today is Tuesday, so tomorrow is Wednesday.
Wednesday.zh: 今天是星期二，那么明天就是星期三。

Wednesday.en: Did you happen to see her leave last Wednesday?
Wednesday.zh: 上星期三你正好碰巧看见她离开？

wedge.en: He hammered the wedge into the crack in the stone.
wedge.zh: 他用锤子把楔子砸入石缝里。

wedge.en: A small curve in the sliding part of the convex top of the lower nut acts as the wedge.
wedge.zh: 下螺母凸顶的滑动零件上有一条小弧线充当楔块。

wedge.en: The logograms were incised on damp clay tablets with a stylus with a wedge shape at its end.
wedge.zh: 这些标识是用一根末端为楔形的手写笔在潮湿的泥板上刻下的。

weed.en: He is eager to weed out the many applicants he believes may be frauds.
weed.zh: 他急于剔除那些他认为可能是行骗的申请人。
到了20世纪20年代，杂草猖獗。

weed.en: I volunteered to weed the hospital garden.
weed.zh: 我自愿给医院的花园除草。

week.zh: 特价促销从下星期开始。

weekday.en: There are several free hours every weekday.
weekday.zh: 每个工作日都有几个小时的空闲时间。

weekday.en: If you normally do your fruit shopping on Saturday, choose a weekday night to go instead.
weekday.zh: 如果你通常在周六买水果，那就选择一个工作日的晚上再去。

weekday.en: On a recent weekday, they sprayed smoke on the hotel terrace to calm the bees before extracting honey.
weekday.zh: 在最近的一个工作日，他们在提取蜂蜜之前，在酒店的露台上喷烟来让蜜蜂平静下来。

weekend.zh: 咱们这个周末去钓鱼吧。
这个周末我们要做什么呢？

weekly.en: I do a weekly shop at the supermarket.

weekly.zh: 这份报纸每周出版两次。

weep.zh: 她不由自主地哭了起来。

weep.en: She wanted to laugh and weep all at once.

weld.zh: 你在哪里学会的焊接技术？

weld.en: The crisis helped to weld the party together.
weld.zh: 这场危机促使整个党紧密地团结在一起。

weld.en: It's possible to weld stainless steel to ordinary steel.
weld.zh: 将不锈钢和普通钢焊接在一起是可能的。

weigh.en: Some things seem light if you don't weigh them, but once you do, they might weigh a ton.
weigh.zh: 有些事不上称没有四两重，上了称一千斤也打不住。

weigh.en: The largest stones weigh over five tonnes apiece.
weigh.zh: 最大的石头每块重五吨以上。

weight.zh: 他在疯了似地进行举重训练。

welcome.zh: 我们受到了盛大的欢迎。

welfare.zh: 福利给困苦提供了一个缓解。

welfare.en: The children's welfare must be seen as paramount.
welfare.zh: 孩子们的福利必须被视为是最为重要的。

welfare.en: Welfare reform is a top priority for the government.
welfare.zh: 福利改革是政府的当务之急。

western.en: Most Western societies are liberal in outlook.
western.zh: 西方社会大多思想观念开放。
很明显他们已经接受了西方的消费主义观念。

western.en: The single-engine plane landed in western Arizona.
western.zh: 单引擎飞机在亚利桑那州西部降落。

west.en: The sun was sinking in the west.

west.zh: 我们将往西去加利福尼亚。

westward.en: During periods when commodity prices were high, the rate of westward migration increased spectacularly.
westward.zh: 在商品价格较高的时期，西迁的速度大幅增长。

westward.en: "Old America seemed to be breaking up and moving westward," observed an English visitor in 1817, during the first great wave of migration.
westward.zh: 1817年，在第一次移民大潮中，一位英国游客观察到：“古老的美洲似乎正在分裂并向西移动。”

westward.en: Therefore, these social traits helped to produce the nomadic and daring settlers who kept pushing westward beyond the fringes of settlement.
westward.zh: 因此，这些社会特征有利于造就流浪在外并且大胆的移民，这些移民会一直向西迁移到比定居点更遥远的地方。

well.zh: 好啊，好啊，好啊。变化真快啊。

wheat.en: He raises 2,000 acres of wheat and hay.
wheat.zh: 他种植了2000英亩的小麦和饲料用草。

wheat.en: The price of wheat has decreased by 15%.

whatever.zh: 不管发生什么事我都会到那儿的。
你觉得什么最好，就做什么。

wet.zh: 阴雨天总使我心情抑郁。
我们回到家时，浑身湿淋淋的。

what.en: We should investigate what happened, what went wrong.
what.zh: 我们应该调查发生了什么事情，什么地方出了问题。

whenever.zh: 只要有可能我们都尽量帮忙。

whenever.en: Whenever she comes, she brings a friend.
whenever.zh: 她每次来都带着个朋友。

whenever.en: Whenever I have a cold I get a nosebleed.
whenever.zh: 每次我一感冒都会流鼻血。

when.zh: 你下一次预约时间是什么时候？
人们会在沮丧时吃东西。

wheel.en: The wheel is pulling to the left.
The wheel is rubbing on the mudguard.

wheel.zh: 我的副驾驶突然抢过了方向盘。

whereas.en: Some of the studies show positive results, whereas others do not.
whereas.zh: 有一些研究结果令人满意，然而其他的则不然。

whereas.en: She has authentic charm whereas most people simply have nice manners.
whereas.zh: 她有真正的魅力，而大多数人只是有礼貌而已。

whereas.en: Benefits are linked to inflation, whereas they should be linked to the cost of living.
whereas.zh: 救济金与通货膨胀联系了起来，而它们应该与生活费用挂钩。

whereby.en: They have introduced a new system whereby all employees must undergo regular training.
whereby.zh: 他们采用了新的制度，所有的雇员都必须定期进行培训。

whereby.en: The two colleges have a reciprocal arrangement whereby students from one college can attend classes at the other.
whereby.zh: 两所学院有一项互惠协定，允许学生在院际间选课。

whereby.en: The company operates an arrangement whereby employees may select any 8-hour period between 6 a.m. to 8 p.m. to go to work.
whereby.zh: 该公司做出了一种安排，据此员工可以在上午6点到晚上8点之间任意选择8个小时去上班。

whether.zh: 检查一下保险丝是否烧断了。

whether.en: I'm going whether you like it or not.
whether.zh: 不管你愿意不愿意，我都要走了。

whether.en: Whether we like him or not is immaterial.
whether.zh: 我们喜不喜欢他都不重要。

wherever.zh: 他究竟会到哪儿去了呢？

wherever.en: We have sworn to fight cruelty wherever we find it.
wherever.zh: 我们已郑重许诺，无论在哪儿发现暴行我们都要与其斗争。

wherever.en: Wherever he goes, a carload of soldiers goes with him.
wherever.zh: 他无论到哪里都有一满车士兵跟着。

whilst.en: He gained valuable experience whilst working on the project.
whilst.zh: 从事这项工程使他获得了宝贵的经验。

whilst.en: You will play decoy whilst I beg.
My mother died whilst I was yet a boy.
whilst.zh: 我母亲在我还是个孩子的时候就去世了。

whichever.zh: 挑选你喜欢的那个品牌。

whichever.en: It takes three hours, whichever route you take.
whichever.zh: 无论你走哪一条路都需要三个小时。

whichever.en: Whichever of you gets here first will get the prize.
whichever.zh: 你们谁第一个到达这里谁就获奖。

while.zh: 她在蹒跚学步时摔倒了。

which.en: They all look so alike to me that I'm never sure which is which.
which.zh: 它们在我看来简直一模一样，我永远分不清哪个是哪个。

whirl.en: To free electrons, something has to make them whirl fast enough to break away from their nuclei.
whirl.zh: 为了释放电子，必须使电子高速旋转而足以摆脱它们的原子核。

whirl.en: I learn not to separate these creatures bursting with violent energy from the sky where their desires whirl.
whirl.zh: 我学会了不应拆散这些有着狂暴精力的生物，他们爆发出的精力源于天空，他们的欲念亦回旋于九霄之上。

whirl.en: Planets are believed to emerge from the accretion of particles in a disk of gas and dust as they whirl around the star.
whirl.zh: 行星被认为是由围绕恒星旋转的气体和尘埃组成的圆盘中的粒子累积而成。

whip.en: At his belt he carried a rawhide whip.
whip.zh: 他腰间别着一根生牛皮制作的鞭子。

whip.en: He cracked his whip and the horse leapt forward.
whip.zh: 他甩了个响鞭，马儿就奋蹄向前奔去。

whip.en: He could whip a crowd into hysteria.
whip.zh: 他可以怂恿一群人，使他们变得歇斯底里。

whisky.en: There was more whisky in it than soda.
whisky.zh: 那里面的威士忌比苏打水多。
这家工厂用蒸馏法酿造瓶装威士忌酒。

whisky.en: She swilled the whisky around in her glass.
whisky.zh: 她晃动着杯中的威士忌酒。

whisper.zh: 她低沉沙哑地轻声说话。

whitewash.en: His wife had wanted to whitewash his reputation after he died.
whitewash.zh: 他妻子在他死后本来想粉饰他的名声。

whitewash.en: If he hadn't run out of whitewash he would have bankrupted every boy in the village.
whitewash.zh: 要不是他的灰浆用光了，他会让村里的每个孩子都破产的。

whitewash.en: What he said was a load of whitewash.
whitewash.zh: 他所说的是一大堆粉饰之词。

whistle.en: On the platform, the guard blew his whistle.
whistle.zh: 站台上，警卫吹响了他的哨子。

white.zh: 我大口喝完两杯白葡萄酒。

whoever.zh: 究竟是谁想出那个笑话的？
究竟有谁听说过这种事！

whoever.en: Come out of there, whoever you are.
whoever.zh: 不管你是谁，从那里出来吧。

wholly.zh: 这样的批评完全是不公平的。

wholly.en: In my opinion, the decision was wholly justified.
wholly.zh: 在我看来，这个决定是完全合理的。

wholly.en: The aims of the organization are wholly peaceful.
wholly.zh: 这个组织的宗旨完全是追求和平。

whole.zh: 四个四分之一构成一个整体。

whom.en: To whom did she address the letter?
To whom should I address the letter?

wicked.en: Jane has a wicked sense of humour.
wicked.zh: 简有一种恶作剧的幽默感。

wicked.en: The judge liked using the word "wicked" of people he had sent to jail.
wicked.zh: 那位法官喜欢用“邪恶的”这个词来形容他判决入狱的人。

wide.zh: 这个案件得到广泛的关注。

widely.zh: 这个思想现在已获得普遍接受。

widely.en: Chlorine is widely used to kill germs.

widely.zh: 我们为这次音乐会做了相当广泛的宣传。

widespread.zh: 漫天要价的情况普遍存在。

widespread.en: The new laws have gained widespread acceptance.
There is widespread apathy among the electorate.

widen.en: They may have to widen the road to cope with the increase in traffic.
widen.zh: 他们可能得拓宽这条道路以适应车辆的增多。

widen.en: I know some teachers do use photocopied newspaper articles sometimes, as their students are eager to learn more to widen their views.
widen.zh: 我知道有些老师有时会复印报纸上的文章，因为他们的学生渴望学习更多东西来开阔自己的眼界。

widen.en: While enriching their imagination, books widen their outlook, develop a fact-finding attitude and train them to use leisure properly.
widen.zh: 在丰富他们想象力的同时，书籍也拓宽了他们的视野，培养了他们实事求是的态度及训练了他们正确利用闲暇的能力。

widow.en: She became a widow a year ago.
"You're a widow?"—"Yes. My husband's been dead a year now."
widow.zh: “你是个寡妇？”——“是的，我丈夫去世1年了。”

width.en: The terrace runs the full width of the house.
width.zh: 露台里铺砌的地面和房子一般宽。

width.en: The road was reduced to 18 ft in width by adding parking bays.
width.zh: 这条路增加了停车区域后，宽度减少为18英尺。

wife.zh: 他和妻子之间产生了隔阂。

willing.en: I'm willing to give it a shot.
Are you willing to vouch for him?

willing.zh: 我愿意帮忙，可有一定的限度。

will.en: You will be remunerated and so will your staff.
will.zh: 你将会得到报酬，你的员工也会。

will.en: A fresh egg will sink and an old egg will float.
will.zh: 新鲜鸡蛋会下沉，旧鸡蛋会浮起来。

will.en: There will come a time when they will have to negotiate.
will.zh: 他们终将会进行谈判的。

win.zh: 这是他们连续第四次获胜。

wind.zh: 今夜风力将加大，气温下降。

window.zh: 我打开了一扇已经合上百叶窗的窗户。

wine.zh: 这葡萄酒里掺入了有害物质。

wing.en: He is on the right wing of the party.

wing.zh: 米德把该团体称为“激进右翼团体”。

winner.en: The winner gets first pick of the prizes.

winter.en: It had been a wet raw winter.
winter.zh: 那是一个寒冷潮湿的冬天。
燕子在冬天迁徙到南方。

wipe.en: I tried to wipe the whole episode from my mind.
wipe.zh: 我设法把这整个经历从心中抹掉。

wipe.en: You can never wipe out the past.
wipe.zh: 你永远不能把过去一笔勾销。

wire.en: What gauge of wire do we need?
wire.zh: 我们需要多大直径的金属丝？

wire.en: The box was fastened with a rusty wire.
wire.zh: 那个箱子是用生锈的铁丝捆紧的。

wireless.en: Some companies are outfitting their satellite offices with wireless LANs.
wireless.zh: 一些公司正在为其办事处装备无线局域网。

wireless.en: The group is working to promote the adoption of broadband wireless access over long distances.
wireless.zh: 该集团正在致力于推广远距离宽带无线访问的采用。
这应该是一个无线的过程。

wisdom.en: All human wisdom is summed up in these two words: 'Wait and Hope.'
wisdom.zh: 人类的全部智慧就包含在这四个字里面：“等待”和“希望”。

wisdom.en: They were godlike in their wisdom and compassion.
wisdom.zh: 他们的智慧和关爱有如圣贤一般。

wisdom.en: In this job you need to exhibit the wisdom of Solomon.
wisdom.zh: 做这份工作需要表现出所罗门王一样的才智。

wise.en: She had made a very wise decision.
wise.zh: 她作出了一个非常明智的决定。

wise.en: It was very wise to leave when you did.

wit.en: Boulding was known for his biting wit.
wit.zh: 博尔丁以其嘲讽式的风趣而出名。

wit.en: Julie Burchill is famous for her rapier wit.
wit.zh: 朱莉•伯奇尔以其聪慧机智闻名。

wit.en: She has great charm and a ready wit.

wish.zh: 爸，我但愿你不要嚷嚷了。

with.en: He's more comfortable with computers than with people.
with.zh: 比起与人相处，他和电脑打交道更能应付自如。

with.en: Fewer people write with their left hand than with their right.
with.zh: 用左手写字的人比用右手的人少。

with.en: Tie it with fabric bows that coordinate with other furnishings.
with.zh: 扎上和其他的饰品相配的布制蝴蝶结。

withdraw.en: A back injury forced her to withdraw from Wimbledon.
withdraw.zh: 一处背伤迫使她退出了温布尔登网球赛。

withdraw.en: There have been calls for Britain to withdraw from the EU.
withdraw.zh: 一直有人呼吁英国退出欧盟。

withdraw.en: He refused to withdraw derogatory remarks made about his boss.
withdraw.zh: 他拒绝收回对自己老板的贬抑之言。

withhold.en: It can be inferred that Facebook is self-enhancer's paradise because people can withhold their unflattering sides.
withhold.zh: 可以推断，Facebook 是自我增强者的天堂，因为人们可以保留自己不讨喜的一面。

withhold.en: A: Does the company withhold income tax?

without.zh: 他们接受了，没有提出异议。

withstand.en: The aircraft is designed to withstand turbulent conditions.
withstand.zh: 这架飞机是为经受猛烈的气流而设计的。

withstand.en: She failed to withstand the stresses and strains of public life.
withstand.zh: 她承受不了作为一个公众人物的生活压力和紧张。

withstand.en: The plants were unable to withstand the rigours of a harsh winter.
withstand.zh: 这些植物经受不住严冬的考验。

wolf.en: The wolf clawed at the tree and howled the whole night.
wolf.zh: 那只狼在那颗树上抓挠，还嗥叫了整整一个晚上。

wolf.en: The Rams held on to defeat the Nevada Wolf Pack in Reno, 32-28.
wolf.zh: 公羊队坚忍不拔，在雷诺市以32比28的比分击败了内华达狼群队。

wolf.en: He thought he had better track this wolf and see where it lived.
wolf.zh: 他认为他最好跟踪这只狼，并看看它在哪儿生活。

witness.en: He took the stand as the first witness.
He has been witness to a terrible murder.
witness.zh: 他目击了一起残忍的凶杀事件。

witness.en: He is trying to improperly influence a witness.
witness.zh: 他正试图不适当地影响一名证人。

woman.zh: 她是个非常迷人的女子。
她是个非常美丽的女人。

wonderful.zh: 他们有一座漂亮的房子。

wonder.en: I wonder if you can help me.
wonder.zh: 不知您是否能帮我的忙？

wonder.en: I wonder who that letter was from.

wooden.zh: 这个码头是木结构建筑。
莫娜爬上了摇摇晃晃的木楼梯。

wood.zh: 他们的盘子是用木头制成的。

wood.en: We sawed the wood up into logs.
wood.zh: 我们把木头锯成段段木材。

wool.en: He wound the wool into a ball.

woollen.en: She was demurely dressed in a black woollen suit.
woollen.zh: 她当时端庄得体地身着一套黑色羊毛西服。

woollen.en: These woollen suits are not designed for wear in hot climates.
woollen.zh: 这些毛料西服不是为炎热气候下穿着的。

woollen.en: She had a warm woollen hat on that left only her eyes and nose showing.
woollen.zh: 她戴了一顶保暖呢帽，只露出眼睛和鼻子。

worker.en: She was a zealous worker for charity.
worker.zh: 她是个热衷于慈善事业的工作者。

worker.en: Meyers is a diligent and prolific worker.
worker.zh: 迈耶斯是个勤奋而且出活多的工人。

worker.en: She was an industrious and willing worker.
worker.zh: 她是个勤劳肯干的工人。

workman.en: The workman was disciplined by his company but not dismissed.
workman.zh: 这名工人被他的公司处罚了，但没有被开除。

workman.en: Hundreds of flies buzz around us, and the workman keeps swatting them.
workman.zh: 数百只苍蝇围着我们嗡嗡转，这位工人则在不停地抽打它们。

workman.en: With a mind prepared by thorough school discipline, the American boy develops rapidly into the skilled workman.
workman.zh: 由于有了学校对心智彻底的纪律训练，美国男孩迅速成长为技巧熟练的工人。

workshop.zh: 这个讲习班帮助失业的年轻人。

workshop.en: She got a bank loan to rent and equip a small workshop.
workshop.zh: 她取得一笔银行贷款来租用和装备一个小车间。

workshop.en: They bought an old schoolhouse to live in and built a workshop in the basement.
workshop.zh: 他们买了座旧校舍居住，还在地下室建了个作坊。

word.zh: 他想不起来那个合适的词。

word.en: The English word 'sensible' and the French word 'sensible' are false friends.
word.zh: 英语的sensible一词和法语的sensible一词同形异义。

worm.en: He stopped on it to look for a worm.
To wriggle is to wrest about like a worm.
worm.zh: 蠕动就是像虫子一样扭来扭去。

worm.en: The worm burrowed its way under the earth.

world.en: I advance across the wide world, through all the truths of the world.
world.zh: 我在广阔的天地里前进，穿越世界的真理。
卡斯帕罗夫成了世界冠军。
她已获得三项世界冠军。

worse.zh: 我到过糟糕得多的地方。
哎，算了，情况本可能会更糟的。

worship.zh: 我们在圣马利教堂做礼拜。

worship.en: He prefers to worship in his own home.
worship.zh: 他更喜欢在自己的家里敬奉神明。

worship.en: Singer Brett Anderson inspires old-fashioned hero worship.
worship.zh: 歌手布雷特•安德森唤起了老式的个人崇拜风潮。

worst.zh: 尼柯莱的英语糟糕透了。

worst.en: He was voted the worst dressed celebrity.
worst.zh: 大家一致认为他是衣着最差的名人。

worst.en: If the worst comes to the worst, we'll just have to sell the house.
worst.zh: 如果最坏的事发生，我们就只好把房子卖掉。

worthless.en: He dismissed the opinion polls as worthless.
worthless.zh: 他认为民意测验毫无用处而不予考虑。

worthless.en: The car was a worthless wreck after the collision.
worthless.zh: 撞车以后，那辆车成了毫无价值的残骸。

worthless.en: An agreement is worthless till our name is written with a pen.
worthless.zh: 除非用笔把我们的名字写下来，否则协议毫无价值。

worthwhile.en: The smile on her face made it all worthwhile.
worthwhile.zh: 她脸上的笑容使得这一切都非常值得。

worthwhile.en: It is worthwhile to include really high-quality illustrations.
worthwhile.zh: 把真正高质量的插图包括进去是值得的。

worthwhile.en: We believe the time and hard work involved in completing such an assignment are worthwhile.
worthwhile.zh: 我们相信为完成这项任务所需要投入的时间和付出的努力是值得的。

worthy.en: A number of the report's findings are worthy of note.
worthy.zh: 这份报告里有些调查结果值得注意。

worthy.en: He felt he was not worthy of her.
The bank might think you're worthy of a loan.
worthy.zh: 这家银行可能认为你应该得到一笔贷款。

would.en: One would shop and cook, another would set the table and another would wash up.
would.zh: 一人会购物和烹饪，一人摆桌子，另外一人洗餐具。

wrap.en: We stock a wide range of cards and gift wrap.
wrap.zh: 我们备有各种各样的贺卡和礼品包装材料。

wrap.en: It looked as though the plastic wrap was moulded to the fruit.
wrap.zh: 看上去好像那个塑料包装与这个水果的轮廓完全吻合。

wrap.en: Store refrigerated food in reusable containers rather than in plastic wrap or aluminium foil.
wrap.zh: 用可再用容器而不是保鲜膜或铝箔纸来储存冷冻食品。

wreath.en: The Queen laid a wreath at the war memorial.
wreath.zh: 女王向阵亡将士纪念碑献了花圈。

wreath.en: A Christmas wreath exclaiming PEACE ON EARTH hangs on the restaurant door.
wreath.zh: 一个写着“世界和平”的圣诞花环悬挂在饭店的门上。

wreath.en: Hang the wreath on your wall or the front door.
wreath.zh: 把花环挂在你的墙上或者前门上。

wreck.en: The wreck was raised from the seabed in June 2000.
wreck.zh: 沉船于2000年6月从海底打捞上来。

wreck.en: The precise location of the wreck was discovered in 1988.
wreck.zh: 船舶失事的确切地点是在1988年发现的。

wrench.en: Leaving home was a terrible wrench for me.
wrench.zh: 对我来说离开家是件十分痛苦的事。

wrench.en: Adjustable wrench for turning off gas and water.
wrench.zh: 可调扳手，用于关闭煤气和自来水。

wrench.en: I ran to several stores before I found the wrench.
wrench.zh: 我跑了好几家商店，才找到这扳手。

wrinkle.en: Ben brushed smooth a wrinkle in his trousers.
wrinkle.zh: 本把他裤子上的一个皱褶刷平了。

wrinkle.en: The skin on her cheeks and around her eyes was beginning to wrinkle.
wrinkle.zh: 她脸颊上和眼睛周围的皮肤开始起皱纹了。

wrinkle.en: Ava had a wrinkle formed on her nose.
wrinkle.zh: 艾娃的鼻子上长了一条皱纹。

wretched.en: She finally agreed to have the wretched animal put down.
wretched.zh: 她最后同意用药结束这头可怜的动物的生命。

wretched.en: The wretched Hatter trembled so, that he shook both his shoes off.
wretched.zh: 可怜的帽商听到这话，吓得浑身发抖，连两只鞋都抖掉了。
你看起来愁眉苦脸的，怎么啦？

wrist.zh: 他的手指使劲抓住布莱克的手腕。

writer.zh: 谁是你特别喜欢的作家？
特纳是一位作家和评论家。

writing.zh: 珍妮在写一个电影脚本。
利奥，你写的那是什么呀？

yacht.en: His 36 ft yacht sank suddenly last summer.
yacht.zh: 他的36英尺游艇去年夏天突然沉没了。

yacht.en: I crewed for him on his yacht last summer.
yacht.zh: 去年夏天我在他的游艇上当船员。

yawn.en: She makes no attempt to stifle a yawn.
yawn.zh: 她并未试图忍住一个哈欠。

yard.en: I saw him standing in the yard.

yearly.en: The two sisters looked forward to their yearly meetings.
yearly.zh: 姐妹俩期盼着她们一年一度的会面。

yearly.en: In Holland, the government sets a yearly budget for health care.
yearly.zh: 在荷兰，政府设有一个保健年度预算。

yearly.en: Pay is reviewed on a yearly basis.

year.zh: 与去年同期比较，开销增加了。

yellow.zh: 他的眼球是不健康的蜡黄色。

yell.en: Her yell sent nearby grouse running for cover.
yell.zh: 她的喊声让附近的松鸡奔跑着四处躲藏。

yell.en: Something brushed past Bob's face and he let out a yell.
yell.zh: 什么东西擦过了鲍勃的脸，他发出了一声大叫。
他们咒骂我并大喊大叫。

yesterday.zh: 帕特里克昨天给我发电邮了。

yes.zh: 是，警察先生，我看到了发生的事。
是的，那是个有说服力的论据。

yield.zh: 高利率的存款会产生丰厚的收益。

yoke.en: Patience and submission are the only comforts that are left to a poor people who groan under tyranny unless they are strong enough to break the yoke.
yoke.zh: 坚忍与顺从是可怜的人儿仅有的慰籍，她们在暴行面前只能低声抽泣，除非她们有力量挣脱枷锁。

yoke.en: The introduction attempts to yoke the pieces together.
yoke.zh: 引言试图将各部分硬拼凑在一起。

yoke.en: "Too much too soon either results in injury or burnout," says Mary Yoke, PhD, a faculty member in the kinesiology department at Indiana University in Bloomington.
yoke.zh: 印第安纳大学布鲁明顿分校运动机能学系教师玛丽·约克博士说道：“太多或太快的运动都会导致身体受伤或过度劳累。”

you.zh: 你知道莫莉对你很恼火。
他会在任何你希望的地点见你。

young.zh: 他是一个才华横溢的青年科学家。
她的孙子孙女让她保持年轻。
她是个善表达的年轻女子。

youngster.en: As a youngster, she might have found it too restrictive, not creative enough.
youngster.zh: 作为一个年轻人，她可能会发现这项活动约束太多，不够创新。

youngster.en: Tests do not compensate for gross social inequality, and thus do not tell how able an underprivileged youngster might have been had he grown up under more favorable circumstances.
youngster.zh: 测试并不弥补明显的社会不公，因此不能说明一个物质条件差的年轻人，如果在较好的环境下成长的话，会有多大才干。

youngster.en: For example, tests do not compensate for gross social inequality, and thus do not tell how able an underprivileged youngster might have been had he grown up under more favorable circumstances.
youngster.zh: 例如，测试并不弥补明显的社会不公；因此，它们不能说明一个物质条件差的年轻人，如果在较好的环境下成长的话，会有多大才干。

your.zh: 你首要的是对家庭尽责。
你父母舍得你离开家吗？
你的医生会监测你的血压。

yourself.zh: 现在你该把自己的事好好安排一下了。
你需要更善于展示自己。

youth.zh: 这首诗对比了青春与老年。

youth.en: Youth is simply an attitude of mind.
The music evoked memories of her youth.
youth.zh: 这乐曲勾起了她对青年时代的回忆。

youthful.zh: 他满脑子都是年轻人的理想主义。
她65岁了，但显得非常年轻。
我是个显得很年轻的50岁的人。

zeal.zh: 他的改革热情是无穷尽的。

zeal.en: She had a kind of missionary zeal about bringing culture to the masses.
zeal.zh: 她对把文化带给大众具有一种传教士般的热情。

zeal.en: They plunged into their work with immense zeal.
zeal.zh: 他们以极大的热情投入工作。

zealous.en: To make up for the mediocrity, zealous parents send their kids to the expensive cram schools.
zealous.zh: 为了弥补平庸，积极的父母把孩子送到昂贵的补习班。

zealous.en: She was a zealous worker for charity.
zealous.zh: 她是个热衷于慈善事业的工作者。

zealous.en: But other European Banks were not so zealous.
zealous.zh: 但其它欧洲银行就没那么积极了。

zebra.en: The quagga was a strikingly beautiful variant of the zebra.
zebra.zh: 白氏斑马是一种极其美丽的斑马变种。
斑马，斑马,你听到什么了？

zero.zh: 温度计显示温度降到了零度。

zero.en: Temperatures will not rise above zero tonight.
zero.zh: 今天夜间的温度不会高于零度。

zinc.en: Brass is an alloy of copper and zinc.
Zinc is used to protect other metals from corrosion.
zinc.zh: 锌被用来保护其他金属免受腐蚀。

zinc.en: Copper and zinc are fused to make brass.
zinc.zh: 铜与锌熔合后形成黄铜。

zoo.en: He took his son Christopher to the zoo.
zoo.zh: 他带儿子克里斯托弗去了动物园。

zoo.en: I thought we might go to the zoo on Saturday.
zoo.zh: 我觉得周六我们可以去动物园。

zoo.en: The kids had a ride on an elephant at the zoo.
zoo.zh: 在动物园里，孩子们骑着大象走了一圈。

zone.en: The area has been declared a disaster zone.
zone.zh: 该地区已被宣布为灾难带。

zone.en: The new treaty establishes a free trade zone.
zone.zh: 新条约设立了自由贸易区。

zone.en: More troops are being despatched to the war zone.
zone.zh: 更多的部队被派往作战地区。
